description: Local Friendly & Professional Chimney Sweep

records.title: Peter was excellent
records.text: Peter was excellent. On time, efficient, friendly and informative.  Definitely recommend and will have again next year.

records.title: Good  job work was carried out professionally…
records.text: The work was carried out professionally with no mess and I was reassured that the installation was safe

records.title: The service was excellent
records.text: The service was excellent. Quick clean and efficient. Experienced service with good personal skills.

records.title: Very professional, no mess
records.text: Very professional, clearly experienced and informed. Understood problems and solutions, communicated high level weather concepts and how they related to the stove clearly and in understandable language. Had all his own equipment, left no mess

records.title: Exceptional
records.text: Gareth was exceptional. He was personable and took so much pride in a job well done. A rare quality in modern tradespeople, we would give him six stars if we could also a great ambassador for his company, highly recommended and would certainly use him again.Mike & Ann WebsterChandlers Ford

records.title: Good for another year.
records.text: Always a pleasure to hang around while Matthew is doing his sweeping. He is always happy to install or repair parts and has good advice and knowledge of how to get a clean burn and avoid tarring up your flue.

records.title: Quick, professional, tidy and affordable!
records.text: Quick, professional, friendly and affordable! You can't really ask for much more than that. Absolutely zero mess and a fantastic job done by Ian McMullen.This is the second time we've used their services and we'll definitely be a repeat customer!

records.title: Stress free experience.
records.text: The chimney was swept by a very pleasant man, who took great pains to keep any mess and disruption to an absolute minimum, he even wore boot protectors coming in and out of the house. He was polite, quick, considerate and happy to answer no end of questions. The whole job was done in a very short time and apart from a faint wiff of soot, you'd never have known he'd been there. Also i rang him at 8am for an ETA and he then arrived that afternoon exactly when he said he would. I then recieved my certifcate with my invoice that i was able to pay  by BACs. Perfect.

records.title: Attention to detail
records.text: Arriving on time. Being completely honest about the bend in the chimney which made sweeping the hall chimney almost impossible. Going the extra mile to empty the grate when I had failed to do so.  Leaving everything spotless.

records.title: Our cleaner Gareth was polite
records.text: Our cleaner Gareth was polite, friendly and professional, he was on time, and the work was done efficiently and cleanly! Perfect service. Thankyou

records.title: Clean and efficient but an hour later…
records.text: Clean and efficient but an hour later than booked

records.title: John did a great and tidy job
records.text: John did a great and tidy job. Would be five stars except he arrived much earlier than expected, which caused some issues for us due to managing in-progress remote working meetings. A few years ago this would not have caused a problem. But since the introduction of hybrid working patterns scheduling  work on your house has become more difficult for both sides.

records.title: As always,prompt,neatandfriendly
records.text: As always,prompt,neatandfriendly. we have an eco-stove which is more tricky than many, so despite having the maker's guide,the cleaning wasnot immediatelysuccessful. However, a requested second visit was made very quickly and cheerfullywhich resulted in the stove then burning perfectly, so many thanks for that. So really this merits five  stars.

records.title: Great job!
records.text: Leigh arrived within the allocated time and swept our two chimneys as requested. He was a meticulous worker and tidied up carefully after each sweep. He did a great job whilst answering a few questions I had too. A very interesting man to talk to. Thanks for doing a good job and see you next year!

records.title: Highly Recommended Chimney Sweep
records.text: I have used this company for many years and I have always been satisfied with service provided. There is no mess & my home was treated with respect & care. Adam turned up when promised. Wilkins  have my complete trust & confidence I was somewhat  disappointed that they are now unable to do a Saturday booking which means I have had to take a day off work which is why I have given a 4 star rating rather than my usual 5.

records.title: Good
records.text: More expensive than our previous chimney sweep, but they did a thorough job and cleaned up afterwards. They did arrive nearly an hour late but my husband was working from home so no big issue. Might be a problem for others though?

records.title: From call to clean was quick and tidy
records.text: from call to clean was quick and tidy. John offered further advice on another fireplace too which was appreciated. I'd also appreciated it if he'd brought me some wood.. at least tried to sell me some during the booking or even as he was leaving.

records.title: After the first visit we experienced soot falls
records.text: After the first visit we experienced some soot falling from the chimney. I questioned if this was normal with the office they said it was possible that some soot had not been cleaned of the ‘ledge’ but agreed a second cleaning cleaning with no charge and no fuss. Since the second cleaning we have had no more soot falls. All in all a professional and efficient service.

records.title: Disappointed that the young man didn’t…
records.text: Disappointed that the young man didn’t wear any protective covering over his shoes so came in from a wet lane and straight onto our carpet. Other than that very pleasant and chatty.

records.title: The chimney sweeper was prompt and…
records.text: The chimney sweeper was prompt and polite and explained everything well. My only query afterwards would be why the fire place wasn't covered more whilst he was sweeping to reduce the dust and smell as had been the case with a previous sweeper.

records.title: Just to say
records.text: Just to say , although my chimney liner is at fault the service was very professional & options pointed out to me . Did miss the fact I had CO monitor on stairs but all in all pleased with service .

records.title: Service good and efficient
records.text: Service good and efficient. Only slight problem is we booked for two chimneys to be swept and the sweep only swept one, as apparently he had condemned the one above the wood burner on a previous visit. (we only recently bought the house) and we still had to pay for the double slot. So be aware.

records.title: Good, but...
records.text: Service was swift, efficient and friendly but strangely, the report said that my CO detector was "Present" and "Working" although it ran out of battery power two years ago. Tut, tut.

records.title: Stephen arrived on time and did the…
records.text: Stephen arrived on time and did the sweep and checks efficiently and also helped replaced a cracked stove brick.I would have liked a hand written certificate on completion of the work but one was forwarded to me by email together with and invoice

records.title: Professional and effective
records.text: This company are organised, efficient and excellent communicators. From the outset, appointments are made quickly. Everything is confirmed in writing and their website gives good information on the entire process.The staff member who attended was experienced and proficient- albeit he cracked the baffle plate at the rear of the stove. This was accidental and the owner, John, was quick to source a new plate and effect a repair.I found the whole experience professional and well organised. I will use again.

records.title: Camera Inspection
records.text: I have an ongoing problem with smoke ingress, which is proving difficult to resolve.  They explained what they were going to do and were good at answering my questions.   They also responded helpfully via email after their visit

records.title: Friendly, Helpful & Professional
records.text: Friendly, helpful and professional. I had two chimneys swept and both were done efficiently and to a high standard. Negligible mess and disruption caused.  I would happily recommend Wilkins Chimney Sweep to friends.

records.title: The overall experience was OK but…
records.text: The overall experience was OK but during the sweep I noticed the operator had forgotten to connect the hose to the vacuum cleaner.  This may have been a momentary lapse or had been unconnected for some minutes.  I would use Wilkins Chimney Sweep again.

records.title: Great concept
records.text: Great concept, but the build quality didn’t meet my expectations

records.title: Clean and efficient service as usual.
records.text: The service was clean and efficient as usual, but on the certificate the CO monitor was marked as N/A. Philip didn't ask about it and of course I forgot all about it too!! Therefore it was not checked this time.

records.title: Fire stove
records.text: He didn't seem friendly, also never mentioned that one of the fire bricks was broken until we bought it up, never knew how to remove fire bricks until my husband informed him

records.title: Boot prints
records.text: Work was carried out well but left black boot prints in the wc and on carpets.

records.title: The service was fine and the chap nice…
records.text: The service was fine and the chap nice but i was disappointed when i found he'd emptied the ash on my front garden.

records.title: Hi the initial booking was great no…
records.text: Hi the initial booking was great no problem.The man came on time and the chimney clean was very efficient no dust or dirt.The man said he would email our certificate. We have not recieved it yet our clean was on the 15th so that's 2 weeks ago.I am sure it will be sent soon he should have informed us that it could take a while.

records.title: Could have done better…
records.text: All the rubbish removed from the chimney was left for me to dispose and not taken away. 2 pigeons where found in the chimney but no recommendations given about installing a cowl over the chimney which I would have liked done as an 'extra'.

records.title: I found that the office staff are not…
records.text: I found that the office staff are not overly truthful with information. When the chap came to sweep the chimney all fine then decided he wished to show my wife on how to set a fire, a little condescending in my opinion.

records.title: Sweep
records.text: We didn’t have John this time around it was his colleague. Chimney swept with no issues. Gasket had come away slightly so the guy glued it. In my opinion in needs changing but for 2 years running they’ve said it was ok. Don’t seem keen on doing it if I’m honest!

records.title: Would not use again 😕
records.text: Have experienced many visits from chimney sweeps over the last 15 years .. this certainly wasn't the best one. I have discussed the outcomes of a broken flue on our morso wood burner with Adrian (the boss) the next day whilst on way to get my flue cover repaired. Gareth the chap who swept the chimney mid afternoon said that he'd contact his boss and left. I contacted and left a message asking someone to contact me.Whilst the outcome of the broken back plate on flue could have happened at any time with any sweep .. the communication from sweep on site and time for boss to come back to me was poor. I have suggested that this is a potential learning point and was advised that "many customers didn't like follow up calls at about 8pm" which was the time I was advised by Adrian he  had received feedback at close of play from his team.  If there is a problem and a customer is left without main heating .. I would suggest that ALL the sweeps are instructed to contact boss immediately so that any options can be confirmed in a timely fashion .. there may well be none .. but we had our sweep visit mid afternoon and did feel abandoned which as I discussed with Adrian who surprised me by reporting the frequency of woodburner issues he and his sweeps deal with on a regular basis  .. this may well be the case but we've had our burner 15 years and experienced no problems. So, when we did experience a problem, it would be great for the knowledge with potential options and timescales to be shared at time of sweep taking place. Too late for us, but may be useful should you experience something similar ..

records.title: I didn’t like the all knowing approach
records.text: I didn’t like the all knowing approach, put the co sensor here or here attach to wall? No!I didn’t like the comment that it’s been awhile since we had it cleaned, it was only left last year?I didn’t like the tone when told me to remove dog whilst he works?I didn’t like comment after telling him we have problems sometimes lighting the fire due to it blowing back in. He said there you go, lit first time no problem. It was a nice sunny afternoon!!I didn’t like having to leave a deposit and then get a reminder as a regular customer I asked him if all ok outside, the reply was yes alk ok but once managed to get to it? There is lots of access?I found it an unfriendly visit and will have to reconsider using Wilkins next time!

records.title: Arrived promptly
records.text: Arrived promptlyUnfortunately soot was left on the carpet. I offered to dust sheets which he advised he did not require.???Did not test fire after clean with a smoke test.Otherwise he did a good job and would recommend the company

records.title: Chimney Sweep Experience
records.text: The actual chimney sweep and the job that he did was excellent. He was considerate, clean in his work, efficient and thorough BUTThe staff carrying out the booking service were not very informative. One hour before our original booking we received a call to tell us that the sweep was ill and we had to reschedule. We had to wait another ten days for another appointment which was very inconvenient, it was to be a different sweep and the charge was £7 more! On the day of the second appointment we were again called to say that the sweep was not coming due to unforeseen circumstances and we would have to reschedule. I was very angry as we were having a wood burner stove fitted the following week and the chimney had to be swept. I asked for a call back in one hour with an explanation and a booking that day. I did not receive a call back and when I called I was informed that the sweep would arrive at 15:00 - 16:00 that same day. At 16:15 the sweep rang and said he was on route. He explained that he had an agreement with the owner that if he was on a night shift the night before that he would start his appointments a little later in the morning. The booking service knew this but did not convey this message to us.I think that the chimney sweep company is being let down by the booking service. It caused me a lot of stress and unnecessary upset just to get our chimney swept.

records.title: Your sweep did one chimney…
records.text: Your sweep did one chimney successfully, but failed to access the second one. No other sweep has had this problem.

records.title: Carl arrived on time and was an polite…
records.text: Carl arrived on time and was an polite worker, but he was only working on the chimney for  30 to 40 minutes at a cost of £74.00.I forgot to ask the cost of his visit and felt it was quite expensive, as there was a sooty film on the mantle piece and either side of the hearth. The last chimney sweep charged me £50.00.

records.title: Too many problems
records.text: I've had a woodburner for 10 years and had the chimney swept every year. I've never been told before that my "chimney cap shouldn't be on". Never been asked "how am I supposed to reach that?" (there is an access panel about 10 feet up ther side wall) It turned out he had a ladder anyway. Never been asked "how am I supposed to plug my vacuum cleaner in so far away from the socket?" I offered an extension cable but it turned out he had one in his van any way! He arrived an hour early and wasn't happy that I didn't realise he was there to let him in until the booked time.

records.title: I hadn't realised it was a Franchise
records.text: Rather curt operator who came one and a half hours early and seemed very much in a rush. Left the  2 front  doors open so nearly lost one of my house cats  He did however, seem efficient and left no mess

records.title: Close the gates as you find them
records.text: Hi the sweep arrived in the time specified and the job was carried out fine bit sweep left the property he left all the gates open and my dogs got out and took themselves for a walk not happy about it the sweep opened the gates to bring his van on to the drive then just drove off with out shutting them

records.title: Reasonably good job
records.text: Reasonably good job, but very expensive for approx 20mins work.

records.title: I did not totally trust the guy who…
records.text: I did not totally trust the guy who came to do the work even he had been before.

records.title: Price had gone up 20% since booking…
records.text: Price had gone up 20% since booking with no notification, and when asked for feedback following the sweep, none was given verbally and it wasn’t until I received certificate stating a recommendation of a power sweep - no idea what that is!? Last year was Heatas certified and this year it wasn’t. No issue with actual work - was clean tidy, punctual and polite.

records.title: Very expensive
records.text: Very expensive. The whole job took 15 minutes and cost £75 or £300 pounds an hour

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Chimney sweep from Andy Neville at Wilkins Chimney Sweep arrived on time and was polite, knowledgeable and didn't leave even a speck of soot.  Was delighted at this stage and was hoping to use Wilkins regularly in the future.  Was also looking forward to having an open fire.  The sweep recommended a different chimney cowl and said he would ask Andy to organise a quote.  Six weeks later, four emails and three telephone calls later I still have no quote.   Really disappointing.  Wish I'd gone elsewhere.  Thought it was going to be easy dealing with a large company but on closer inspection it's actually a franchise under which the members may do as they wish.  Perhaps I was just unlucky but I would not recommend Wilkins Chimney Sweep given my experience.

records.title: stop moaning to the customer that your…
records.text: stop moaning to the customer that your too busy and had too many appointments booked.  Not our problem and what a nice problem to have part way through a recession?

records.title: Not great.
records.text: Your Sweep wasn’t particularly sociable. He did a good job I suppose but then I had a lot of hassle getting the Certificatr required as part of my tenancy agreement. My name is Sarah. I’m Mrs. You seemed to think I was James. Nobody called James lives at my address. I booked you. I paid you. I know nobody called James. I won’t use your company again thank you. Not impressed.

records.title: Arrived on time and covered area to…
records.text: Arrived on time and covered area to protect room from soot. The whole process took 30 minutes including setting up time and clearing away.  We didn't feel enough time was spent on sweeping the chimney as soot could still be seen. My partner finished removing more soot the next day. Quite a bit fell down quite easily. He commented that the brush looked old and worn out. This could explain why soot was left behind.

records.title: Man did good job
records.text: Man did good job . After a while after leaving he phoned to say he found dads poker in his bag I told him tongs were missing too . He said he hadn’t found tongs . He returned poker later that day . Had to go out and buy another pair of tongs unfortunately could only find a shorter pair

records.title: There was nothing put down when he…
records.text: There was nothing put down when he emptied the chimney outside.   He undone it and the Soot just fell out all over the patio and the wall.   He hoovered it but was left in a state for me clean up after he left.  Wasn’t happy to be honest

records.title: Disappointed customer
records.text: My log stove and flue liner was installed 2 years ago at a cost of £1000 for installation only.  The installation was performed by HEATAS engineers.  This is the first time the flue has been swept - the log stove is used infrequently.  During the sweeping process the flue became dislodged from the stove.  Have contacted original installers who state repair will possibly have to wait until 2021 at an estimated cost of £100.  Cannot use this log stove until fixed. Am very disappointed with this experience

records.title: One bolt had rounded so they refused to…
records.text: One bolt had rounded so they refused to do any further work and sweep the chimney. I was able to fix this myself with a simple tool in 5 mins afterwards. I would have expected this from the service.Still got charged though.

records.title: Good service and very efficient but…
records.text: Good service and very efficient but broke a fire brick and said they are cheap to buy just go to the local shop. Completely not true. Cheapest one ive found is £33 and I'm not sure it's the right one. Now I have no stove until I can find one.

records.title: Yr engineer came to
records.text: Yr engineer came toLook at cracked chimney pot after chimney fire. He said it would need to be replaced but didn’t know anyone who could do it so can’t really comment. There was no charge. John n Geraldine O’sullivan

description:

Tenancy Cleaner has worked with many reputable estate agents and individual landlords and tenants for the last decade and have delivered thousands professional cleaning service in the tenants industry.
Whether your moving in or moving out of a property and need a deep clean contact Tenancy Cleaner Team to do the work for you.
We have teams all over the city of London and surrounded areas to deliver the best possible cleaning experience.
We are in Greater London now and looking to expand to outer London soon and we shall keep you update in due course

for all type of professional, end of tenancy, deep and after builder cleaners contact your Tenancy Cleaner to do it right

records.title: Highly recommended!
records.text: They did a great job! Our oven which hasn't been cleaned much is now spotless. Our windows where there mould build ups during winter has been de-moulded. The limescale build up at the bottom of the toilet which took me months to figure out how to dissolve using various chemicals has been magically removed! Would really recommend. They were also very courteous and polite.

records.title: I hired this team for an end-of-tenancy…
records.text: I hired this team for an end-of-tenancy clean, and they were fantastic. They arrived promptly, brought all their own supplies, and left my apartment spotless. My full deposit was returned without any issues!

records.title: Super impressed with the end-of-tenancy…
records.text: Super impressed with the end-of-tenancy clean! The team was fast, efficient, and left my flat absolutely spotless. My landlord was so impressed that he even asked for their contact details. Will definitely hire them again.

records.title: The deep cleaning service exceeded my…
records.text: The deep cleaning service exceeded my expectations. The cleaners paid attention to every little detail and left my house looking and smelling amazing. Even the carpets seemed brand new. Very impressed!

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Fantastic service! The cleaners arrived on time, were polite, and thoroughly cleaned my flat from top to bottom. The kitchen and bathroom are now spotless, and I couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend!

records.title: I hired this company for an…
records.text: I hired this company for an end-of-tenancy clean, and they did an outstanding job. They were punctual, professional, and left the flat in pristine condition. My landlord was thoroughly impressed. I’ll be using them again!

records.title: We hired this company to clean my…
records.text: We hired this company to clean my parents’ home, and they did a phenomenal job. The team was professional, kind, and incredibly thorough. My parents are thrilled with the results. Thank you so much!

records.title: I was worried about my end-of-tenancy…
records.text: I was worried about my end-of-tenancy clean, but this company made it stress-free. They were reliable and left the property sparkling clean. Even my picky landlord couldn’t find a single fault. Fantastic service!

records.title: This company is worth every penny
records.text: This company is worth every penny. The cleaners arrived on time and left my rental property absolutely spotless. The kitchen, bathroom, and every detail were shining. I received my full deposit back without any trouble!

records.title: The cleaners arrived early and were…
records.text: The cleaners arrived early and were incredibly friendly and professional. They performed an end-of-tenancy clean for my flat, and I was amazed at how spotless it looked afterward. Even my landlord was impressed. Five stars!

records.title: Good communication and customer…
records.text: Good communication and customer service. Would use again!

records.title: Well I think they did a great job ,few…
records.text: Well I think they did a great job ,few things they left or may be over looked in kitchen because 2/3 drawers were unopened they missed it the bathrooms were cleaned very nicely and over all staff was friendly and accommodating

records.title: Initial clean poor but resolved quickly by excellent new team.
records.text: The initial clean was poor but when we complained a new team was sent out the following day and they were excellent and I would rate them as five stars. I think the initial team failed to read what I had requested and paid for as parts of my request were not done, for example I paid for an internal and external clean of the downstairs windows and I had to prove that I had indeed paid for this service by showing my itemised invoice. I think a close reading of the invoice should be carried out by the cleaning team and any areas that are unclear should be clarified with the customer. Another example of poor communication is that I asked for the patio and rear deck to be power washed but instead they did the front drive which is laid to gravel.

records.title: They were on time
records.text: They were on time, cleaning was well done but there was a point when the time was almost changed at last minute.

records.title: I’ve never seen my oven so clean!
records.text: Bianca and her team came out to do an end of tenancy cleaning for me.They were unfortunately slightly late to the appointment, however they were very accommodating and helpful through the whole process. They did an amazing job and were happy to send over pictures after the cleaning. I’ve never seen the oven looking so clean!Would definitely recommend

records.title: The team was friendly and cooperative
records.text: The team was friendly and cooperative. They did a great job throughout.  The experience was very smooth from getting a quote to job done.  Will recommend them.

records.title: Quick and attentive
records.text: They were quick and attentive to answer all my queries, even when I had to change the date of the cleaning at the last minute. Arrived on time as expected and called me when they finished the job. We had some very dirty windows and bathroom lime-scales which they cleaned well, and even informed me when they had some areas they had difficulty cleaning due to stains that were already there from before which I was aware of, so appreciated their honesty!

records.title: Overall good experience - would recommend
records.text: Booking was easy. Communication with the main email/phone was good and I gave instructions which I was told were passed along however it didn't seem that message went to the cleaner. The cleaner didn't follow instructions (IE where to leave the keys) but it didn't cause us any problems. The flat was considered "spotless" on our check out - so a very good job.

records.title: Though I could not go ahead with their…
records.text: Though I could not go ahead with their cleaning services due to some personal issues, I can absolutely review the admin team ( esp Ruqaya whom I had email exchanges with) who were prompt in their reply, every time, and attended to every query I had till I was satisfied. The quote seemed fair for the work they were to provide. I was also assured if and when I did get back in contact with them, I didn't have to restart the process and they would maintain the quote. In the online jungle of choices I was assured this would prove to be a reliable company.

records.title: Great thorough clean throughout…
records.text: Great thorough clean throughout the property. No areas left unclean, cleaned top to bottom to a very good standard. Would definitely use again and recommend the service.

records.title: Really quick and easy process
records.text: Really quick and easy process. I put what I needed done through their website, we needed an end of tenancy clean. We received the quote within 24 hours and were able to book in the day we wanted. The communication has been really great too not only with the team but with the person who attended the home. They were running late due to traffic and called us to let us know and then when they arrived literally cracked on and was done within 3 hours and the place looks amazing!

records.title: I would recommend!
records.text: A really easy and clear way of booking the cleaning schedule required for our end of tenancy clean. Clear and prompt communication and completed the job to a good standard. I would recommend!

records.title: Really good service
records.text: Really good service. Turned up on time and kept in touch with their progress. Everything was really clean and everything was done within a 4 hour time frame. My only sad thing was whatever chemicals were used when cleaning the carpet or the skirting did damage the paintwork a bit that I then had to repaint the night before I moved house. Otherwise, it would have been 5 stars. I would still 100% recommend this company to others

records.title: Very impressed with the speed and…
records.text: Very impressed with the speed and thoroughness of the clean. A small confusion with payment that was sorted before the clean took place.I would recommend this cleaning company as my home is spotless.They also attended the clean on a Saturday meaning I didn’t have to change any plans.

records.title: Very efficient and thorough
records.text: My original time slot was missed (only reason for not giving 5 stars), but when a new team was allocated they did an amazing job. They took their time to be thorough and made sure everything was spotless. Highly recommend!

records.title: Bianca and he team did a good job…
records.text: Bianca and he team did a good job cleaning my flat ready for rental. They completed everything I had requested in good time.Unfortunately there were some issues with her vehicle which meant we had to try and work out a new time. The staff at Tenancy Cleaner were helpful and it worked it in the end.

records.title: A good clean with respectful and efficient cleaners
records.text: The standard of the clean overall was great. The cleaners were respectful, efficient and really lovely to. It could have been slightly more thorough but only in a few very specific areas. Also, due to delays from earlier on in the day, they were over an hour late arriving.

records.title: Company were very quick to respond with…
records.text: Company were very quick to respond with a reasonable quote and answered all my questions. Cleaner who came was efficient, polite friendly and he and his colleague were very quick. I have given 4 stars because the cleaner didn’t  seem to have the full list of things I had paid to have done. I had to send him my itemised invoice.

records.title: The cleaner’s were very punctual and…
records.text: The cleaner’s were very punctual and for the money paid it was value for money. The empty flat was quite dusty and needed an end of tenancy deep clean, on arrival they got straight on with it and i just left them to it. They called me once they’d finished saying if i was unhappy with anything to let them know. A couple of things had been missed by them but overall they did a fairly decent job that i was happy with.

records.title: A great experience
records.text: Friendly crew who did a really good job and paid particular attention to a lot of detail and who worked really very hard for me.

records.title: Great communication from Head Office… poor experience on the day… …
records.text: Great communication from the beginning and itemised cleaning quote received.All went pear shaped when I asked for additional windows to be cleaned.  Monies taken within 5 minutes with Enoch the cleaner classing a divided window as 2 windows. This was not disclosed at point of sale and although refunded £7 from the total amount I paid this experience  left a bitter taste in my mouth.  I’ve given 3 stars for the head office experience but would not recommend Enoch who got pretty technical with what 1 window looked like despite a 5 minute job and a £400 house clean!

records.title: two moving-out cleaning experience  - frequently  something does not work
records.text: I asked for a moving-out cleaning two times in the past period. The first house was empty, so the clearing was rather good - ( cancelled just few hours before the planned time, so had to wait for another day - "car broke." )The second time the flat was furnished. Though most parts were cleaned very well, some were not. The apartment was not very dirty; in fact, it was cleaned recently. Had to clean many areas myself. again. Will be looking for another firm when I need this service the next time.

records.title: Not thorough but responsive
records.text: We hired an End-of-tenancy service. They arrived two hours late and argued about doing specific cleanings that were paid explicitly for—although they finally did it. Still, the cleaning wasn't thorough, leaving the balcony and the sofa unattended and water on the kitchen floor and inside the fridge. After complaining, they offer a new visit to correct the wrongdoing

records.title: Good cleaning :)
records.text: Good cleaning :) however I would not say it is professional cleaning. I did feel the cleaning was on the basic side. I could have done a better job. Just did not want to make the guys feel bad. They did leave their water and drinks in the house where I have to clean up after they leave..not a good behavior. gave them a tip as well. They were not able to clean the carpet as it's still filthy. Will I use their service again. Nope sorry. Feel waste of the £310.00 I could have spend the day cleaning myself

records.title: Sensational Cleaner - Poor Company
records.text: This is a difficult review to write. Basically I had an incredible cleaner but terrible service.  We ordered a deep clean of our 3 bed house and paid a large amount of money for it - over £300. I was informed a TEAM of professionals would turn up. I was shocked when one man turned up. I immediately contacted the organisation to highlight this was not the arrangement and that there was no way one person could clean the house to the expected standard in 4 hours. We had family plans that all had to change. I was in informedthey were trying to find more people, I asked to speak to the supervisor and was told I would get a call back. I didn’t get a call nor did anyone else turn up. The job was scheduled for 2-4 hours with a team. Instead I got one man for 8 hours and only after I ensured his next job was re-organised and given to someone else. Atanas, a young Bulgarian man turned up at 0915. He worked all day, over 8 hours solid. His dedication, professionalism and selfless commitment were exceptional. The issue for me of course, is that the company should have never given this task to one person. It’s seems exploitative. Using this company was a stressful experience when I was paying for a service to relieve a burden over Christmas. However Atanas was 1 in million. But for £330 a day for 1 man he had to be!

records.title: Disappointing …
records.text: Had tenancy cleaner to clean two bathrooms. One was brand new, and just needed a wipe down, which was ok. The other was left in a poor state so I asked them to return. They came this morning, and after ten minutes said they were done and asked me to check. The toilet, bath and floor hadn’t been touched, and the bottom of the taps were filthy. The guy said he had wiped the taps and it “might have got more dirt on since”!! He produced a piece of kitchen roll and gave it a half hearted wipe. I took the roll off him and ran it round the base of the tap where a load of black came off. I pointed out the state of the toilet and left him to it. The other guy took all the cleaning stuff out to the car apart from a toilet brush and a floor mop. 15 mins later he came and asked me to check again. This time it looked ok, although there was definitely no product used as it had all been packed away. Disappointing.

records.title: Did a good job of cleaning my decking
records.text: Did a good job of cleaning my decking, friendly and personable service

records.title: Good cleaning
records.text: Good cleaning, friendly staff. A quick post cleaning inspection and everything requested was seen to have been done to a high standard. Unfortunately on deeper inspection 2 days later, found some areas that had not been clean to the level I expected

records.title: Cleaners arrived 3 hours late
records.text: Cleaners arrived 3 hours late, which is very frustrating. But they did an okay job - on the parts that they actually did. Let’s not mention the parts that they just completely ignored 😂Overall I would say this company is okay… don’t expect a meticulous cleaning job, but just an average one. But make sure you have enough time afterwards as you’ll probably end up having to finish the job yourself 😂If you’re absolutely desperate and can’t find any other company to book, then sure book this one. But just be wary!

records.title: Adequate Service
records.text: Service provided was adequate.

records.title: Very average
records.text: The general cleaning was good, but they didn’t steam clean some curtains that I’d paid for them to do and were reluctant to get the machine back out of the car. In fact, it was a carpet steam cleaning machine  which wasn’t suitable, as it left the curtains soaking, so I had to ask them to stop. Communication was very poor and we were having to use Google translate which  didn’t really help. The office were unhelpful with poor communication and couldn’t be bothered and offered a refund on the curtains, but all I wanted was for them to be cleaned, as tenants are moving in tomorrow. The young girl was very polite and courteous, whilst the other 2 hardly bothered acknowledging me.Suffice to say, I will not be using them again, having been let down at the last minute.Disappointing  🤨

records.title: I wanted the cleaner for late morning
records.text: I wanted the cleaner for late morning. However on the day of cleaning I got asked twice if they could come earlier.When you pay £125 for a studio flat clean I expect the arrangements to suit me 100%.Saying that the cleaners were very polite and did a good job.

records.title: Overall a good service
records.text: Overall a good service. They arrived earlier than stated (which wasnt a problem) and left earlier than expected (again not a problem). Rooms and carpets were cleaned throughly, however did require going over in a few places, I think this was more down to the equipment than the workmanship (steam carpet cleaning machine) and choice of hand swiping floors rather than using mops and I suspect they didn’t hoover first in the rooms that were mopped. The only other thing was the fridge wasn’t cleaned or inside the kitchen units however once prompted they were apologetic and cleaned straight away (think they just forgot to do them). At the end of the clean they were more than accompanying going around with me after asking me to inspect the clean. Overall a good service, would I use again probably yes.

records.title: Incompetent cleaners, honest management
records.text: Cleaners were unfriendly and gave impression of resenting their job. They did a poor job cleaning the flat and ruined a kitchen counter by spilling an acidic cleaning fluid on it. They denied having damaged it when I asked what happened. Fortunately management was honest, admitted fault, and committed to replacing the ruined counter. However they would not pay for the landlord to appoint his own repairer; they insisted on sending their own repairmen. Luckily the landlord agreed to this. To get the repair done I spent literally dozens of hours negotiating with the landlord, dealing with the cleaner's repairers, and making several visits to the property to allow the repairers in. Four weeks later it was finally over. The landlord was satisfied with the counter repair but deducted £200 from the deposit because of the poor cleaning job. I will give 3 stars because management is at least honest and did repair the counter. But obviously I cannot recommend these guys after this nightmare.

records.title: Squeaky Clean with Added Damage Which Was Eventually Resolved
records.text: The process of getting a quote, booking and the cleaning process were excellent. My flat smelt clean, looked clean and the carpets looked so much better. However, this is where the bad news starts, they broke my sliding blinds in the cleaning process. It was apparent the blinds had been tampered with when I arrived home (panels at different angles, end cap of the rail loose and one side of the blinds pushed to one side). Of course, they deny damaging these blinds but considering they worked fine Sunday night and by the Monday evening they were stuck in the closed position - must be those pesky elves again. I understand that it is a my word against theirs situation but their cleaners are not the most honest of people if you look at other reviews. They have since rectified the situation by covering the costs of my new blind but this only because of my review. If they had solved the issue because of my complaint rather than my review, I would have left a higher rating. Appreciate the manager texting me and offering the money but it was too little too late.

records.title: Very friendly team but I found quite a…
records.text: Very friendly team but I found quite a few areas neglected.

records.title: Poor cleaning job!
records.text: I hired this company for my end of tenancy cleaning. They cleaned the flat but forget many areas - the closet, under the bed, behind the toilet, etc. As a result my landlord took a chunk out of my deposit. They also left NEW stains on the kitchen counter and when I told them about this they denied it and said the stains were already there. They returned a few days after and scraped the kitchen counters to remove the stains but damaged the finishing as a result for which I also had to pay my landlord from my deposit. Lastly they finished the cleaning job quickly within 2 hours - which explains the poor job. Would not recommend.

records.title: Poor
records.text: Poor experience but depends on what you need. I needed a clean for an empty and newly decorated home to be cleaned of dust and general build up post works. If you are looking for sparkle and shine with a clean look and feel, this is not it! They just do a wipe down with a sticky cloth and the smell of the cloth stays in your flat. It’s not a deep clean it’s just a quick wipe which is worth doing yourself. Now to go re-do everything they did! Really wish I didn’t read the positive reviews before I chose this as I could have spent this money elsewhere to get a better service.

records.title: Not worth it tbh
records.text: A very half arsed job by a company I had used before and received good service. Maybe it’s location dependent. Received a clean in a flat in Brixton. Find plenty of hair left behind by one of the cleaners as well as them not moving the microwave to clean under it. Fairly basic things I would expect for a £181 end of tenancy clean. Do not recommend.

records.title: Not thorough!
records.text: Loqman team were friendly however their cleaning standard was not up to the £260 price. The oven and fridge were clean but the floors and carpets were left minimally hoovered and dirty. Wouldn't recommend.

records.title: Turn up on time to do half a job
records.text: I thought the quote for the works to be completed seemed to be a bargain. The team turned up on time, however only gave themselves 2 hours to do a deep clean of a 3 bed house, including oven, microwave, fridge freezer plus a carpet clean.The main cleaning was done to a decent level. However the carpets were not cleaned at all with stains remaining. When I complained they blamed it on the carpets being old, however I had been able to get the stains out of the carpet previously (high traffic area so regular cleaning during the tenancy). I would not recommend to any one.

records.title: Tenancy clean - The price does not match the quality we received
records.text: The people who came were nice and I felt comfortable with them in our space, BUT, the clean was far from thorough and we’ve had to go over in places. We booked for 9am and they arrived late afternoon and had finished by 6:45pm, which was disruptive. I think some honesty would go a long way to avoid peoples plans being changed last minute. The price does not match the quality we received.

records.title: Not a deep clean company material
records.text: Not a deep clean company material! Had tenants with pets and needed a deep end of tenancy clean, not very impressed. They've came with rug doctor to clean the carpets which was not enough to get rid of the hair, the carpets are also absolutely soaked. Missed lot of things like cleaning some windows, the ones which have been cleaned had smudges all over. Switches not cleaned. Completely missed back hallway. Lot of hair over the surfaces. Only giving the seconds star as the guy was nice enough to offer hoovering again, but it didn't really make much difference. Would not recommend this company for a deep clean, surfaces were just swiftly wiped not actually scrubbed so they are still dirty. Doors weren't cleaned either.

records.title: Good for basic cleaning, definitely not professional
records.text: This is a difficult review to give. The cleaners arrived were giving their best but it wasn't what the company offered in the first place. I took their service to get the kitchen deep cleaned. The quote says deepcleaning but the cleaners had just normal cleaning tools with them. A fairy dish washing liquid, sponges and scrub. They did their best with them but what the description says is that the surfaces will be deep cleaned and polished where required. Sounded like a professional deep cleaning service. They should give their cleaners proper tools to work with. Because the price is not cheap, it's average in the market. With that price you can get better services.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Disappointed! For a ‘deep clean’ nothing was done properly. Starting with the floor in the living room there were still marks left on the floor and I had to end up doing it myself in the end. The guy asked when am I moving out and I said tomorrow morning and he said normally people book on the day they move out - sounded like he was already planning an excuse to cover himself if I were to complain. The shower drain hairs were not taken out. The bathroom floor was not cleaned properly. Oven not cleaned properly. I would honestly avoid. I have taken pictures of everything. As a cherry on top I was pushed whilst in the midst of moving to give them a review. Not happy.

records.title: Terrible service and a waste of money.
records.text: Bathroom not properly cleaned, bathtub not even touched despite clearly being on the job sheet, hoovering very minimal. Entire properly looks like they spent maybe an hour tops doing a quick run around. The only positive point was the oven, which was done very well. For circa £200.00 this was an awful level of service.

records.title: Not as great a deal as you would think.
records.text: Although the original rep from H2B was extremely informative and honest, the company they forwarded us onto, Sunshine Home Improvements, I felt, was quite unprofessional. After having made an appointment date and time, I was called a further three times to be told they "were in the area" and could come earlier despite being told I would not be at home. They ended up turning up half an hour early as I felt pressured into being home earlier to accommodate them. Although Amy from Sunshine Home Improvements was very nice indeed, I explained at the forefront that I do not agree with "pressurised sales tactics" to which she agreed, but I was still subjected to. I appreciate that this was her job but it was extremely uncomfortable.  I have had several quotes from other companies for around the £9000 which seemed very reasonable and had hoped that Sunshine Home Improvements could better those with the discount they purport to give. Unfortunately their quote was £19,000 for six windows and two doors, £10,000 more than everyone else! They "discounted" it down to £17,000 which I promptly declined. Amy then called her supervisor (textbook sales tactics), who then said he would knock off a further £6000 if I agreed to have them replaced within the next two months in the winter! If I were to replace my windows, it would not matter what time of year it took place. A quote is a quote regardless of what time of year it is! Unfortunately, I feel I have been misled in certain aspects of this scheme and will be purchasing my windows from a more reputable, professional and client orientated local business. Thank you but no thank you.
