records.title: Misleading?
records.text: Kayleigh (Help2Buy) was informative, polite and generally helpful but, although careful to say this is not a government funded scheme, the implication on the website (showing multiple individuals grateful for their FREE windows) and from the conversation I had, (in which it was suggested that this is a new, exciting scheme  etc), is definitely that this is that there will be more help given than there actually is. Yes, the company I was referred to was willing to offer a discount.... but this is something they do ANYWAY... What's being offered is not new, and it certainly doesn't give you free or even hugely reduced windows... it feels more like Help2Buy are just taking on the task of generating customers for double glazing companies. I would prefer them just to say that.

records.title: Customer agent asked me to rate his…
records.text: Customer agent asked me to rate his service out of 10, I gave a 9 and an automated response returned thanking me for rating the customer agents service a 10 - somethings not right there is it 🫣😳

description:
Able Group provide planned and reactive maintenance services nationwide. 

We offer a fast-response, 24-hour emergency service so that when the unexpected happens, impact to your property is minimal.
Even if the problem cannot be rectified immediately, we are on hand to stabilise the situation and ensure the safety of yourself and others. So if you need a professional you can rely on, we can be with you in just 90 minutes to safely resolve your dilemma. 

Here for all your home or commercial needs, our services include Glazing, Locksmiths Plumbing, Drainage, Gas & Heating, Electrics and Pest Control.

So, let us help you today and receive your free over the phone quote from one of our expert advisers, along with any advice you may need.

records.title: Nightmare blocked drain sorted
records.text: First class service from a top class engineer. Jamie sorted out our difficult to reach blocked drain with a high pressure jet efficiently and with good humour. People like him are what make the world go around, highly recommend ! Thanks very much, Owen

records.title: Door lock.
records.text: I am very impressed with both the admin ( Jacqueline) and the technical aspects. Especially the technician attending. I forgot to take his personal details. He was ..... brilliant.I have noted all the services you offer and if and when the needs arise I will contact you. Keep up the excellent service.

records.title: Fantastic Service and very Efficient
records.text: I had an issue with my UPVC window, it was on a Sunday and in the Christmas Period. The window was partially open and locked in that position, the locking mechanism was clearly broken. I tried a few local companies and none of them were able to help and I was flying the next day. I called the Able Group and they had someone at my door within the hour and although the problem was difficult they managed to repair the window within an hour of arriving. Perhaps a little more expensive than expected but they were very efficient and resolved my problem very quickly. Would recommend.

records.title: Emergency drain call-out
records.text: I had a drain emergency the day before Christmas. This agency found me a great local company who dealt with the problem speedily and efficiently.  An emergency call out is always expensive, but I paid happily knowing that all would be well over the festive season

records.title: Brilliant speedy service
records.text: Brilliant speedy service, I had an engineer at the house within 45 minutes of my call. He inspected my problem and put my mind at ease by saying I had no major problem, just a failure of my shower, which needs to be replaced. I felt totally relaxed after his diagnosis of my problem.

records.title: Efficient descrete & prompt service
records.text: Efficient descrete & prompt service. Minor niggle that follow up appointment did not offer option of a preferred time slot.

records.title: The ease of contact and communication…
records.text: The ease of contact and communication through out process, great engineer (Dal) attended and after some perseverance got into the house and replaced lock gearbox on door! Service was great under the unfortunate circumstances of a lock failure so this is what you pay for, that said the parts are available much cheaper!

records.title: Excellent response and communication.
records.text: Excellent response, quickly sorted out a team to come to us. Communication was very good and our problem was cleared up within a couple of hours. A very professional service - highly recommended!

records.title: There was a rapid response and the…
records.text: There was a rapid response and the electrician arrived as promised.He did what was needed in30 minutes so we were really happy.

records.title: Electrics had gone off in our kitchen…
records.text: Electrics had gone off in our kitchen so phoned able-group to come and sort the problem out. All done very quickly and high standard which meant we were able to cook christmas dinner thank you very much cheers Paul.

records.title: I had an emergency window repair call…
records.text: I had an emergency window repair call out and the service was swift. All my questions and queries were answered by the engineer who was also polite and friendly and did a great job of repairing my window.

records.title: Prompt and efficient
records.text: Called Able on Friday 21 December and electrician came out the next day. We were very pleased at the quick response so near to Christmas.  The job, fitting pull cord shower switch, was completed quickly. The only reason not give 5 stars, it was wet outside and no protective shoe covering worn.

records.title: Everything was good except that the…
records.text: Everything was good except that the engineer didn't have a replacement timer with him and the cost was more than I usually pay/

records.title: This a prompt and efficient service…
records.text: This a prompt and efficient service from a most polite and engaging young man!

records.title: Great job but pricey.
records.text: Prompt, efficient,  polite and clean. Drain was unblocked in 5 minutes. My only criticism is that the fee is a set £190 and even the technician said he was only here for 5 minutes but could do nothing about the price. Had it been a more significant problem then perhaps the price was fair. Obviously I have no way of knowing what the issue is but perhaps a reduction would have been appropriate for the 5 minute job?

records.title: Came within the allotted time and…
records.text: Came within the allotted time and completed the job in a friendly and polite manner.

records.title: Impressed with quick response
records.text: Impressed with quick response, after having no luck calling other companies.

records.title: The guy who came did an excellent job
records.text: The guy who came did an excellent job , but it was a day later than promised

records.title: Don't let first impressions fool you
records.text: We had a problem with an upstairs window not closing this week.  As it is above a flat roof this obviously caused a security issue so I needed it fixed quickly.  After a search online, I came across the Able Group, read their reviews so gave them a call.  The phone line was poor, it kept cutting out and there was a lot of background noise at the call centre and I struggled to hear what the lady on the phone was saying.  What I did not fail to hear, though, was her rude and arrogant tone!  If I hadn't needed an urgent repair, because of this lady I would have put the phone down and gone somewhere else!  She sounded as if she was doing me a favour by speaking to me!Anyway, I persevered with the call and an engineer was booked in for the following morning.  He, Sam, arrived within the allotted time frame and could see what the problem was straight away.  Within half an hour my window's hinges were replaced and the house was secure again.  It is people like Sam that make or break a company and he was spot on and a credit to Able.  Quick, tidy and friendly, unlike the lady at the call centre!

records.title: Came out same day over the holiday…
records.text: Came out same day over the holiday period and was very professional.

records.title: Review
records.text: Prompt response, nice tradesman and pleased with the outcome

records.title: Prompt and efficient
records.text: The man came on time and re-set the boiler.It has not given further problems.

records.title: work was satisfactorily done on time
records.text: work was satisfactorily done on time, many thanks

records.title: Had a leak from kitchen ceiling
records.text: Had a leak from kitchen ceiling, turned out to be a burst pipe. plumber arrived within time slot given, and quickly found the problem and replaced damaged section of the pipe. excellent service all round, although a little expensive in my opinion any only reason for 4 stars. But overall a good experience

records.title: Highly efficient and friendly staff
records.text: Quick and efficient at getting the job completed Easy to organise someone coming out and turned up when they said they would.Would use them again

records.title: Informative Man Came to Our Rescue
records.text: The knowledgeable man who came to the house was most informative and quickly fixed the blockage.However, the young lady who took my telephone call was not particularly helpful and didn't speak in a respectful manner.  I would call upon them again as the plumber was a real professional.

records.title: Not cheap but still worth it..
records.text: A quick efficient service to resolve two electrical issues. The electrician who attended completed the work quickly and without any disruption to our day.Not the cheapest but in our case worth it to get the work done so quickly

records.title: reliable and kind
records.text: The plumber was very informative and explained everything he was doing.He reassured me that everything was going to be alright especially when water was flowing over the sinks in the bathroom and kitchen. he kept me calm throughout the situation. He knew his job very well and was very courteous throughout the time

records.title: Wasp nest treatment
records.text: Pest controller came to eliminate wasps nest. came on time, was polite and seemed efficient.  Said he could spray insecticide through air brick - no attempt to  locate nest.   Assured all wasps would have been eliminated in 48 hours.  A week later wasps still appearing in house in small numbers.   No guarantee given, though that wasn't pointed out.   Able Group eventually offered me a further treatment at no cost.

records.title: Plumber was excellent
records.text: Plumber was excellent. The job was done very quickly so the price was high for what it was, but it was done well.

records.title: Fantastic call out time and locksmith, shocking pricing
records.text: Shortly before New Year's one of our door locks completely broke and led to anxiety regarding security. However, during the same morning (!) we were given a quote for a replacement lock and mechanism. The locksmith arrived a few hours later. He was very professional and prompt and even took the time and care to explain all the faults and what he was doing to fix/replace them. I was very impressed and he was done within 30 minutes, it was a very good end result. We were shocked, however, when the bill was nearly double the quote despite there being no additional changes to the job and the reason for this price hike was "it is that time of year". I fully appreciate that the Christmas period is busy, it was brilliant and quick work but we paid less for a new washing machine to be installed and the old one recycled in the same month, so it puts things into perspective.

records.title: Block drain experience   I was pleased that you came out on the…
records.text: I was pleased that you came out on the day I first called you, but disappointed that you could not complete the job that day and I had to spend Christmas with blocked drains which caused a lot of extra work having to dispose of washing up water in the garden and couldn't use dish washer or washing machine.

records.title: Very prompt service but!
records.text: Very prompt service but not clear when giving a quote so experienced a much larger bill than expected. I rang to complain which wasn’t helpful at all. Totally upset by the amount taken from my bank.

records.title: Satisfactory
records.text: Plumber came promptly and was friendly and polite but on initial visit just told us what parts to order without offering to come back to do the job. Had to phone again to arrange the repair once the parts arrived. Work done was satisfactory but I actually had to help as access was restricted and I have small hands.

records.title: Quick Service
records.text: The call out went well and the fitter was most helpful. But the sting was the cost at £400. The cost was only broken down as labour £334 plus £66 Vat. The two barrels at best cost £30 each excl Vat and took less than 10 mins to fit. As the complete job took 45mins, labour must have been charged out at £438 incl Vat. Felt ripped off but happy to get in on a freezing night. Would not recommend Able Group.Original rating was one star, upgraded to 3 star on receipt of a £150 refund.

records.title: Great work
records.text: Great work, prompt response, but expensive for a 2 minute job

records.title: Expensive!
records.text: I needed a plumber quickly and this business was 'local' on Check-A-Trade so gave them a call. A local plumber was sent and sorted the leak in 15 minites yet Able Group charged me for 1 hour labour!! Had I known that this is a 'broker' or 'agency' I would've gone elsewhere. Issue resolved quickly but very expensive.

records.title: Boiler service.
records.text: Receptionist was very helpful when rang up to book a boiler service. She said it could be done that day so was booked for later in the day. What surprised was that the engineer was NOT from The Gas Shop whom had been rung. Presume that The Gas Shop is now part of the Able Group and all the original engineers have moved on.The engineer was from another company, who said that he had only worked on 2 boilers of the make he came to service before and was the manual to hand for him to look at. Luckily it was so it was serviced but he did keep going in and out of the propertyseveral times.Overall, receptionist 10, engineer 5.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: Absolute daylight robbery! Would never use this company again! Initially came out to repair leak in electric boiler costing £179, leak repaired but following this hot water no longer working & subsequent repair for this has cost over £600 with over £400 for labour with us disputing duration of repair. We knew we were paying £82 for a half hour call out but the full £620 now taken from our bank card with no communication to agree this.Would not use this company againUPDATECustomer service contacted us following this review and Jodie was courteous & professional in listening to & we reached an amicable resolution

records.title: Odd experience
records.text: Came at the alot time. However   the guy had no interest in the job and lacked customer service skills. Could barely say hello or speak. Wouldn't use again.

records.title: Cooker Installation.
records.text: Cooker Installation.The guy who did the job was all good, knew his trade, civil and polite.What I didn't like was after objecting to the first price the person who booked the installation did the underhanded thing of quoting the price without VAT.When I looked at the deductions on my card the bill was dearer than the first quote!Clearly skulduggery is part and parcel of using trades people through the enterprises that run them.

records.title: Cleared the blocked drain or so we…
records.text: Cleared the blocked drain or so we thought but alas not the case . Left inspection cover off the drain and sewage waste which had collected from  blockage - had been promised someone would clean this up never happened - gave up and used another well known company which cost lessUPDATE the complaints team were extremely efficient and helpful with the matter thank you Jodie

records.title: Managed to fit the job in quickly
records.text: Plumber wasn't able to complete half the jobs I needed doing due to not having the right equipment/fittings. He did work quite quickly. But he also mansplained pipe insulation to me. Very expensive as well but at least they could fit the job in after ringing 7 or more local plumbers with no answer/availability

records.title: Professional, but too pricey
records.text: Able Group was called to fix a full glass heavy door with 3 heavy duty hinges one of them bent by excess opening by wind (therefore not shutting). Couple arrived on time agreed, the locksmith determined what was the problem with the door, replaced 3 screws, informed us he was unable to fix the door, spent there 20 mins and charged £122.40. Appearance was professional, but the fee they charged was much higher then expected for that service.

records.title: prompt and efficient but way too expensive
records.text: The service was prompt and efficient and the problem solved quickly.However what started out as a £119 call out fee ( excluding vat which was never mentioned on the phone) came to a grand total of £332. The pricing structure is extortionate and I can’t recommend them on that basis.

records.title: Couldn't relocate with our Honey bees
records.text: We had a honey bee nest in our back garden patio roof space which the telephone responder said they couldn't relocate unless deemed 'dangerous' so this conversation went nowhere.  How is 'dangerous' defined?

records.title: Concerns Around Taking Payment
records.text: Very professional on call and clearly explained how they work.I was asked for card details on initial call, but told i wouldnt be charged until after the job completion. I was also told someone would contact me after the job and to discuss payment.No one has contacted me, email or phone, and I have been charged the same day as the job was done, which was around 7:30pm.

records.title: emergency locksmith
records.text: Did not like to give payment details in advance.However service was delivered reasonably promptly and was successful. I authorised gaining entry, but was left with no alternative to also change locks. Cost is high for this type of service, but the charges were spelt out in advance. Being an emergency does not allow alternative quotes.

records.title: As a retired and carer for my wife
records.text: As a retired and carer for my wife, the wasp nest was a life threatening situation for her,I contacted Able group to help ,and they 'the wasp man' knocked out the nest in a bush in 1.5 minutes,however ,I was suprised having to pay £150+ for the service,being on pension credit it was rather a lot.I cant estimate the hourly rate.But, job done.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Very expensive and wouldn’t do a couple of small plumbing jobs that I also needed doing, they sorted out why my toilet wasn’t flushing and if I wanted the other jobs done they would charge me call out and parts again. I have managed to find a local plumber and he has done all my other jobs and checked if everything is working ok.So I had quiet a large bill to payfor a few simple plumbing jobs and being a woman on pension I wasn’t offered any discount or help, will be sticking to my local plumber I found in the future.Very disappointed with the cost and the minimal service I received.Very doubtful I will use again unless it’s a real emergency.

records.title: Turned out at 48 hours notice and did a…
records.text: Turned out at 48 hours notice and did a good job, but over £250 for 45 minutes work is a rip off, and to add insult charged £30 for a replacement part which retails at £5 - £10.

records.title: Lost the spark
records.text: Well we were originally booked for 12-5pm slot they did call at 1040am to extend it to 1-6pm, we waited & waited only to receive a call at 2 minutes to 6pm to say the engineer had a vehicle breakdown, I can't say for sure but the excuse didn't really ring true.  Very disappointing, I just feel they took on too many jobs & over promised.  I turned down the offer of trying again on Christmas Eve and will go elsewhere.

records.title: Not sure why so expensive
records.text: Called Able to ask if they would find an electrician to help set up a timer and photocell for outside lights. .  Mistakenly accepted quote of £119 + VAT as wanted job done asap.  Agreed half day slot .  Electrician spent 10 minutes, was competent.  In meantime I found a similarly qualified electrician who would have charged £60, so Able is very expensive.  Also I did not receive the promised email confirming appointment slot and had to phone again to confirm.  Would only use Able again if emergency.

records.title: No show first appointment
records.text: No show first appointment. No explanation or warning. Same again second apptmt. Third apptmt plumber arrived an hour late no warning given. Did the job OK anyway. But company seems expensive and doesnt seem to care about wasting 12 hours customers time waiting at home. So many 1 star reviews echo similar stories. The replies are all copy and paste. However a £25 refund given after a phone call.

records.title: I would like my money back
records.text: No proper assessment in location or in the sewerNo report or COSHH for baitCamera didn’t work No plan follow up or progressNext independent pest controller actually showed the difference between your controller and a professional I would like my money backUpdate:I returned a missed follow-up call on Monday 16 to Jodie. Jodie called me back on Wednesday to ask questions about what I had written above and to state that without me providing a copy of the ( professional) pest control report there was nothing more she could do. I refused to provide the report as I had paid for it and there should be something she can do without My 3rd party report. I will pursue this issue along other lines

records.title: Prompt response but the price 👀😮 !!
records.text: Prompt response and the person that attended was superb but the price you charged, £146 was utterly extortionate for 15 mins work popping out a pane of glass and putting it back in again.

records.title: Expensive
records.text: I requested assistance from an emergency plumber to fix a small leak on my heating system. On the positive side, when I mentioned I thought their fees were high, they immediately offered a discount. Also, a plumber came within a few hours and was honest with me about his work. On the negative side, even with the discount, their fees were high. They did not give a guarantee with the work. The plumber stopped the leak, warning me that the fix might be temporary and, if so, the job would probably require a full drainage of the heating system and a new valve. In reality, a very slow leak started again within an hour. I found another plumber who came the next day and who did a lasting repair in ten minutes at a reasonable cost. Using Able Group was an expensive mistake.

records.title: Came on time and polite
records.text: Came on time and polite, but the work has not completed, as saying we have to get parts. Is it not the part of work to get the part and fix on continuity, not charge again call charge?it seems too expensive.

records.title: Rude customer services. Will not use again
records.text: The electrician came in the alloted time and explained the pricing before starting. The problem was fixed although with an unattractive solution. The next day we had another electrical problem in the same room which seems to be a coincidence!On speaking to customer services the woman I spoke was rude and abrupt. She argued with me about why I hadn't called back after they left a voicemail sooner. I was at work on a intensive care unit so could not get back to them for some time.

records.title: Extremely Expensive while trying to…
records.text: Extremely Expensive while trying to sell alot more expensive and takes away a vital  part for research but never hear back 3 days later when I told it would have been sooner.

description: AMA offer a comprehensive range of waste services across the UK, and specialise in helping our customers to gain the on-site assistance that they need at a price they can afford. Our range of waste services encompasses a variety of different aspects, from skip hire to site clearance, whilst we can also supply muckaway services such as grab lorries and tipper lorries to help dispose. Whatever your budget and requirements, rest assured that AMA can provide a solution - supported by our network of depots across the UK and the expertise of our large, experienced team.

records.title: Skip delivered and placed on drive in…
records.text: Skip delivered and placed on drive in correct spot even though I was not there. It was collected speedily and I would recommend.This was around Xmas and New Year but didn’t cause any issues.

records.title: Very organised and efficient
records.text: It was easy to phone, picked up quickly, very helpful agent, and the skip was delivered within a couple of hours...the plumber was impressed!  The collection was also very efficient given it was Christmas week and the skip was collected right on schedule.  The drivers are very skilled as well as they had to cope with parked cars  and a narrow road. Brilliant.

records.title: Great skip hire company - good value
records.text: Great skip hire company Ordered short notice and skip was with me following day. Delivered by a very skilled driver who had to be precise loading into garden. Uplift no trouble again and another lovely driver who arrived within timescale given Would defo recommend

records.title: Very pleasant and polite men and the…
records.text: Very pleasant and polite men and the lady on the phone was very helpful

records.title: Very quick to deliver
records.text: Very quick to deliver, the driver was very friendly and a smooth collection so very pleased with the service I received.

records.title: Very good skip hire experience - thank you.
records.text: I hired a skip from AMA Waste and was very pleased with every aspect of delivery and collection.  The driver was friendly and efficient and his vehicle spotless and appeared well maintained. AMA Waste would certainly be my first choice if and when I need to hire a skip in the future.

records.title: Efficient office service
records.text: Efficient office service.  All details logged on the system so when speaking to different staff, all are aware of them.  Polite and friendly and drivers notify you when on their way so that you can reiterate instructions of skip positioning if you’re not at home.  Super job!

records.title: Just brilliant.
records.text: Just brilliant.. needed emergency skip for a sudden shortening of time to completion date on a three generations house. You saved our bacon thanks so much. Prompt service into a tight spot. Two great drivers 🌟🌟

records.title: Building Diy
records.text: Ordering was easy ,very easy to deal with extended our hire.When collection arranged was on the day I said.

records.title: AMA Skips…
records.text: Great set of drivers.Very helpful and patient considering very difficult access to site.Ben (Newcastle supporter) in the office was brilliant and a great help.Recommend the company to anyone.Great rates aswell.

records.title: Good service.
records.text: Easy to talk too, passed on requests to skip hire company. Kept client aware of situation when , in this case, skip was not for customers home address but relatives.Delivered on time and collected promptly.Drivers polite and helpful.

records.title: The office staff are very helpful the minute you say you need a collection they tell you and give you a very quick ime to collect The office staff are very helpful…
records.text: The office staff are very helpful especially a lady called Eron , she is always on the side of the phone , no computer answering the phone , I will always us this company.

records.title: Good service but point deducted for poor communication…
records.text: Good service and the man bringing the skip/taking it away was very helpful. Communication about delivery time from head office was however poor. Had we been told it would be the end of the day (rather than the beginning as booked) that would have been fine but lots of "it will be with you in a hour" from lunchtime onwards was very frustrating and meant the day was wasted. Honesty would have been a better policy. The skip service itself we are very happy with.

records.title: Stupidly ordered one.
records.text: Stupidly ordered one.. cancelled day later due to crazy t and c s… nearly 2 weeks on after in writing being promised a refund within 3-5 working days still no refund!!! Currently compiling a file for trading standard to pursue possible deception. If no refund is made by 14/6/23 I’ll be issuing a court summons. Displaying this case online advising public to stay clear.

records.title: The company is doing well  but I should…
records.text: The company is doing well  but I should have given  you 5 star if you really explain to me that you don't take matters without. extra charges

records.title: This hiring of the skip was done at…
records.text: This hiring of the skip was done at short notice I was very pleased with the service from beginning  to end

records.title: Service was great
records.text: Service was great, we did pay extra to take a mattress but it was left when skip collected however they did come & collect after a phone call

records.title: Well done AMA
records.text: I gave you 4 stars because delivery and collection problems were sorted by AMA. If AMA hadn't got involved with local skip hire, both would have failed. This proved that if I had gone directly to locals I would probably still be waiting.

records.title: Easy to book delivery date
records.text: Easy to book delivery date. Drop off driver was very efficient. The only downfall was that the collection date had nit been logged so I had to contact. Following the call the skip was collected within a couple of hours. Despite that I would recommend.

records.title: Great customer service and competitive price
records.text: Great customer service and competitive price with other skips in the area. Only marked down on score as the skip lorry has left some damage on our driveway where the feet were used to counterweight lifting the skip onto the lorry

records.title: Prompt friendly service
records.text: Prompt friendly service. Skip arrived nice and early.Knocked you a few points off because of a confusing email and because 2 different staff gave different advice re the disposal of plaster board. Was informed not possible to skip this but after my plasters queried this I was given alternative advice.

records.title: Skip delivered promptly on ordering and…
records.text: Skip delivered promptly on ordering and was placed exactly where required. There was a 24 hour delay in picking it up and unfortunately the lorry was too large to gain access thereby extending the delay by another 24 hoursThe operatives were cheerful and helpful D Knight

records.title: On delivery and collection the company…
records.text: On delivery and collection the company were advised that I had put a covering over the newly completed drive where the skip was to be placed to protect the drives finish.  I requested that once the skip collection had been done would they put the covering into the skip as it was no longer required.  They advised that this would not be a problem and when I got back home and the skip had been taken away all was clean and tidy and my new drive was left as required.  Well done AMA Waste and Thank you.

records.title: A thumbs up 👍
records.text: Very quick with delivery and the gentleman that dropped it off was very helpful and polite. Easy to arrange a pick up date however the gentleman that did collect it was rude and not very friendly at all. Other than that I would recommend to a friend.

records.title: Skip hire
records.text: Fantastic company highly recommended.I would of gave 5 stars but I was meant to get a replacement skip yesterday but it didn't turn up until today.So a phone call or text would of been great to inform me of this.Apart from that really happy about everything else.

records.title: The service was in providing the skip…
records.text: The service was in providing the skip though it took extra time to remove it back. The most annoying point for us was to get passed the skip because it occupied the whole drive way. Most of our other items couldn't be delivered in time. Overall the service is good.

records.title: Delivered on time and placed as…
records.text: Delivered on time and placed as requested.  We could have had more information about how long we had access to the skip and it wasn’t always easy to obtain information on the phone.

records.title: Good customer service all round
records.text: Good customer service on the phone. Lorry arrived on time. Driver friendly and professional. Cleared it all efficiently. 4* but would be 5*, except for the price! But then, waste clearance is an expensive business these days.

records.title: Disappointed customer
records.text: I had. Booked an Am pick up which was not honered having been given the option hence missed my doctor's appointment not very happy A phone call would have made a big difference to my circumstances.

records.title: Now resolved
records.text: Unable to get through on their provided telephone numbers so am left with a full skip still in my drive (should have been collected 5 days ago) and causing us real parking issues.Not sure what I should do next as the company delivering the skip are unable to take it until authorised by AMA. UPDATE:::::::::Despite being unhelpfully told there was no problem with the telephone lines (response to original review comments) I am relieved to say I have now got through on my first attempt today and have been told by a lovely chap that lines have been extremely busy and I received an apology for the inconvenience.I have changed my review to four stars on the basis that the skip was delivered quickly, and the two gents I spoke to today and during the initial booking were charming, polite and informative. I didn’t get the first persons name but Josh K restored my faith today. If the skip is removed without further issues I would  use AMA again.

records.title: I booked for grab lorry to remove our…
records.text: I booked for grab lorry to remove our waist from site. I phoned up on the day of removal they assured me it’s on way. records.title: Communication could be better

description:
Moorland Heating Limited is a long established Plymouth based company with a vast experience of installing and maintaining all types of Gas appliance. We work quickly and cleanly to service or replace any existing system to the highest standards and ensuring your system is both efficient and safe. Our boilers come with up to 10 Year Guarantees.
We cover the following areas: Plympton, Plymouth, Plymstock, the South Hams to Ashburton - including Ivybridge, South Brent, Buckfastleigh, Totnes, Wembury, Bantham and Salcombe. And we  are also proud to serve our East Cornwall customers in Saltash and across to Liskeard. 
We offer a range of services to Landlords - please see our website for details and prices.
We also offer a system cleaning service which will help keep your boiler and radiators running at their optimium efficiency.
In addition to our Heating services, we offer a comprehensive range of Plumbing services - please see our website for details.
We keep our Engineers up to date with technical and safety training using our own in house training facility. We are Gas Safe registered.
If you would like further information on any of our services or for us to come to your home to do a quotation, then please do not hesitate to contact us.
You can now also get an Online Boiler Quote on our website - this will give you an indicative price for your new boiler. And we are proud to provide Fixed Price Quotations to our customers once we have completed our survey.
We offer an Emergency Call Out Service - please call 07793 148902 outside office hours.

He stated that the had cleaned the fluid filter and there was no sign of any greater build up of dirty material and that the system should get progressively cleaner until it was next drained and refilled. There has been no recurrence of the gurgling. It was a benefit to know that  the engineer had serviced my boiler previously.If asked I would always recommend Moorland Heating as an efficient and courteous business whose charges are reasonable. Japanese Knotweed Ltd is the UK’s trusted company for providing surveys, treatment and removal services of Japanese knotweed and other invasive weeds.

Free Surveys

Planning Consultation
Immediate Eradication Excavation Works
Herbicide Management Plans

records.title: Do not recommend- Hard to get appointments. Lazy service.
records.text: When we first moved into our property part of the terms were that the previous owner would pay for a knotweed eradication programme. So we moved in with a prepaid contract with Japanese Knotweed Ltd worth around 15K. It was to supply treatment to the surrounding gardens (around 4) for 3 years and ourselves for 5.I have to admit I have never found dealings with this company anything but frustrating. I am always made to feel like I they are doing me a favour. When we first started organising appointments JKL wanted me to individually contact all my neighbours and organise a single appointment per year so it was convenient for the technician (and cheaper for JKL). I immediately said no. They had to contact each neighbour individually by phone or email and organise single appointments that were most convenient for each individual household as they had been paid a lot for this service. This put them out a bit and I got calls telling me private details about my neighbours regarding value of equipment in their sheds etc. This shocked me as it was unprofessional and in violation of privacy laws.It has now been 3 years and the service has only got worse. I always have to call at the begging of summer to organise visits. Appointments are few a far between so hard to get. They will ONLY come if they are in your immediate area. They will not do evenings or weekends so you have to take time off work for a 5 minute spray. They do not chase up for feedback or to rearrange appointments. I have noticed that a lot of the positive reviews are from people that simply sent in pictures to check if the plant in fact knotweed. It seems that JKL are very good at giving good initial service to gain contracts but once they have been paid the service is very lazy. I would recommend looking at other options or at least not paying upfront.

records.title: Suboptimal service.
records.text: Staff are always helpful on the phone but I have to always be the one that chases. Considering we have employed them to continue a herbicide treatment plan dates are Very limited and often inconvenient for us. To be honest I wouldn’t recommend this company to others. Once our plan runs out I would look to use a different company with more flexibility and better customer service.

records.title: I have no problem with the actual …
records.text: I have no problem with the actual service I have received, or with the front line staff of this company. However I feel this company takes advantage of a difficult legal situation for homeowners.  I  discovered  a tiny patch of Japanese  knotweed on our property, a long way from the house, which I could easily deal with myself, but when I tried to buy some herbicide at a local garden centre I found out there is a completely over the top legal requirement for only specialist companies to deal with this, and dispose of the waste, Japanese Knotweed becomes a problem if you ever want to sell your house, which you must declare, so homeowners are forced to engage these sorts of companies to get rid of Japanese Knotweed  at huge expense. They seem to charge the same to get rid of one tiny plant as they do for a major infestation, which I think is unfair. I think this is an unbelievably overpriced service for so little in return. One visit, to investigate, and one visit to spray a herbicide on a very tiny plant with a few leaves, which kills the plant in the first visit,  nothing else needs to be done, and we are still going to have to pay a huge sum of money for years of unnecessary visits and a guarantee to be Knotweed free, which we have to have,  ,which seems very poor value for money.

records.title: Some of the staff at this company need…
records.text: Some of the staff at this company need more training. I was communicating with Tom O'Connell to book a survey and I wanted some of my concerns answered. He gave extremely vague responses to my questions, which was really disappointing. I emailed him again to get a more clearer answer but he gave me the same vague responses. I then phoned him but it seemed he still didn’t understand the question. I simply wanted to know that in the event the vendors try to hide the presence of Japanese knotweed at the property for example by cutting it, can the surveyors still determine if there are any signs of concealment (I know the surveys are visual investigations hence why I said will they look for signs of concealment). He still didn’t understand me. I spoke to my business partner and he agreed that we needed a clearer answer in order to go ahead with the survey. I emailed him again, wording the question slightly different but he gave the same vague answer he gave the day before. When I asked him that if he didn’t understand the question could he ask one of his colleagues and tell them to get back to me, he told me to contact him. I mean we spoke yesterday and you didn’t know the answer then so what is the point of calling you again???? I was extremely frustrated with this encounter. I contacted another company and they were able to explain my queries in depth. They explained that the even though the survey is a visual inspection the surveyors will look for signs of concealment such as barrier membrane present on site, dead canes placed in garden areas, leaf bleaching. This gave me the confidence that this company knows what they are doing. So we are now using them to carry out a survey at our property. We are a buy to let company and if Tom was able to answer the questions provided to him properly, then we would have used this company not only for our current property but for future properties as well. I still don’t understand why Tom couldn’t have just asked someone if he was unsure. It’s extremely unprofessional from Tom. In terms of constructive feedback the company needs to give him further training on how to deal with queries he is not sure about. I also recommend the company train him in how to write emails properly and professionally as it felt like a teenager was responding to the emails. This gave me the perception that he doesn’t have the appropriate skills needed to carry out his role. I recommend customers who are thinking of using this company to think again and use other companies who are willing to give clearer answers.

I did eventually decide on a patio door as I did get at a good price the next day.I then had a call as I had generated x amount of sales and was entitled to vouchers that they would leave with me. I still don't have the vouchers. They take everything back with them.They came and again quoted for a front door and 3 windows. I would need to remortgage to pay for them. Again I had the hard sell. Called the office who could do it x amount if I purchased there and then. Still way too expensive.All that said, I am pleased with my patio door at the price I paid.If you're willing to put up with outdated sales tricks and the hard sell, then choose them.

records.title: The guys installing the windows were…
records.text: The guys installing the windows were great, the after sales...not so much.I was contacted by someone from "Customer services" who wanted to offer me a voucher for further work, conservatory, doors, etc. I said I didn't think there was anything in the near future and mentioned we had a couple of bits of snagging which needed attending to. He said that because I was busy they would contact me in a couple of weeks. he was quite pushy regarding the additional work. Needless to say no-one has contacted me regarding the snagging.

records.title: Communication
records.text: I like the quality of the windows. The workmen were thorough. Communication was not great. We asked for the old windows to be left and they were taken away. The scaffolding was here for another week given that part of it was on thr neighbours roof.

records.title: 3 stars
records.text: 3 star because the company fix issues with windows in less then 40 days and person which arrived was very professional. new windows with many defects in windy weather I feel wind around seals and hear whistling noise, windows scratched, trim cracked etc Is joke  £8500 windows but I think they not worth even half of price, I will uploading video on YT about quality of windows,take you shi....t windows back.

records.title: Okay
records.text: Installers were pleasant.Despite all the prior visits, installing intentions were not made clear.

records.title: Feedback on window installation
records.text: 5 single windows and 2 window bays. Standard of work, politeness of sales, surveyor and installers and quality of product all as expected from a professional company.Unhappy with security of some of the windows if left ajar.Some rubbish left behind and rooms not clean after install.Had to get some corrective work done, as some windows not closing correctly. Had to wait 3 weeks for this to be done, but all working okay now.Overall, installation good, but customer service after sales is a bit hit and miss.

records.title: The installation was great
records.text: The installation was great, we then reported trouble licking the door. We were told someone would come out. Now one month since installation we can’t lock or unlock the door from outside. Nobody available to help for 5 days. Not good enough after service

records.title: Window Fitters very courteousand…
records.text: Window Fitters very courteousand professional in their work.few issues from the start  wrong measuments for some work to be carried out to completion leaving us with an unfinished job for sometime we were promised the best of the best in what they do and everything would be seamless not quite I'm afraid. We felt somewhat deflated during the  whole process but we put on  brave face and went along with the it all we had no choice but not too.we are pleased with the end project but that's only down to the fitters doing the upmost to save the embarrassment of the company they work for. Just to sum it all up we don't think we would use them again for our work

records.title: Great work - terrible spam caller
records.text: The work they did was fantastic - our new fascias, soffits and guttering are lovely and we got a nice discount for agreeing to do some advertising for them.  Just as well because they're pretty expensiveHOWEVER, they will now not stop calling me to offer discounts on new work despite me repeatedly asking them not to and telling them we won't be getting anything done any time soon.  If I get one more phonecall I will be reporting them to trading standards

records.title: After sales issue
records.text: We were very impressed up to and including installation, but within a day or two the front door developed a bad graunching noise when opened or closed. I was advised to lubricate wirh 3-in-1 oil, which I did twice, but the noise has beome unbearable. I phoned to ask for a service call, but despite pleading they have been unable to offer me a date earlier than 3 weeks ahead! The after-sales service is totally unacceptable.

records.title: Window fitters were exceptional!
records.text: I have given three stars as unfortunately we were given five separate installation dates and these kept getting cancelled at the last minute to the point where we never thought we’d get our windows. Sixth time round however we FINALLY had our bay window and back door fitted by two lovely lads Craig and Daniel. I can not praise them highly enough. They were on time, efficient, tidy and very polite informing me of the process they needed to do and they were even concerned about if I had somewhere warm to go and wait whilst they fitted everything. Very conscientious even ensuring our puppy did not get out of the back gate. Craig and Daniel are an asset to your team and if I have any windows needed in future I hope they are the fitters that come back. Five stars for the fitting team of Craig Lambert and Daniel Gooch!!

records.title: Surveyor incorrectly measured my windows
records.text: I agreed to have new windows on the understanding my expensive wooden plantation blinds could be reused. The lounge ones have been refitted successfully but the bedroom blinds can not be refitted as there is a gap of 25mm all the way round each blind . I phoned your company about this problem and was assured Byron would telephone me. This has not happened which is a poor reflection on your business. I have contacted the blinds company who have quoted me £350 for infill beading. All this should have been taken into account by the surveyor

records.title: Good quality, poor communication.
records.text: The windows and doors are very good quality, made a huge difference to retaining the heating in the house. Installers were polite and very clean, very impressed.I put 3 stars because of communication problem, seems like a company-wide issue. - Scaffolding arrived a day earlier (did not let us know)- installers told me "on monday someone will come to inspect" (as we had a scratch/chip on the front door - still waiting for a replacement.) They did not turn up.- Email received from installation manager advising they do not always come out. (making it out that i am bothersome to them)- Scaffolding are still up two weeks after installation, no one informed us it will be there that long and no date of dismantling.- no date or timescale for the replacements.I am not sure if I will use them again.

records.title: I had 7 windows installed on the 11th…
records.text: I had 7 windows installed on the 11th November.The workman showed up at 11am moaning as they had been despatched from Leicester, when i was informed the workmen would be local from Newbury.The surveyor had misjudged the job and make it hard for the installation, but the chaps did a good jobThing is the rendering was done in brown and i ahve a white house, it looks unsightly and a very poor job.i have called to complain and was told by my installation manager that it is impossible to hold every colour of rendering, sure it is only brown and white needed.Can not believe the installation team carried on knowing how awful it lookedi have complained and waiting for a call back, i am sure it will comeStay away, i paid a lot of money for a very unprofessional finishThey even offered me a refund if i allowed my windows to be used in advertising, which i declined as my windows would not get them any future work

records.title: Glass damaged from rollers
records.text: Glass damaged from rollers, misty 3 inch by 20 inch lines going down Glass. Due to have 3rd lot of replacements.  Also very hard to clean, very smeary cloudy,streaky when sun shines. I've used Mr muscle, warm water and detergent, white vinegar, alcohol rub,paper towel, lint free cloth,micro fibre cloth, cotton pillow case squidgy nothing stops the smears it horrendous.  I'm 63 and cleaned windows for 50 years.

records.title: Shocking Service
records.text: Despite being assured by the sales rep that everything would be left in order in completion of the works to our four former windows, a supposedly two day job ended up taking nearly two weeks to resolve and then only because we undertook some work ourselves. Once the work the FHI had been employed to do was done we were left with damaged rendering, roof tiles and missing sealant.We had to continually chase up various managers to get a resolution. Invariably promised phone calls or visits were not made and there appears to be no continuity or joined up thinking between the various trades. ( Why not send out a team fully equipped to resolve all possible eventualities in the first place?)We will never employ to FHI to do work for us again and would advise others to do the same. Shocking service for a supposedly professional firm.

records.title: Really disappointing all round
records.text: Really disappointing all round. We were sold the dream by the sales person and were totally let down. The apprentice managed to drop one of our 4 windows on the installation date and it took nearly 6 weeks for the replacement to be delivered. The installers left our home in a mess on their first visit and lost a part of our blinds when taking them down so had to replace, this all despite us being told by the sales person that they’d clean the windows and leave everything immaculate.Then to add insult to injury, our newly plastered cornicing in our lounge cracked during the final window install and the company would not accept any liability for this despite it clearly being from the window above being replaced. This company was not cheap and we went with them because we were promised a first class service which we absolutely didn’t get. I certainly won’t be recommending.

records.title: Well done Jaz Powar
records.text: Jaz Power arrived on time,worked continuously until he was requested by company to assist elsewhere.He was polite and professional and worked hard getting the old door out and installing new door. He informed Jade would be arriving to take over from him and that is what took place. Jade was likewise professional and continued to complete the job leaving it looking so good. Showed me how to work door and completed  paper work.

records.title: The wrong sized pane of glass
records.text: The two window fitters were very pleasant,clean and tidy good workers who did an excellent job, but having waited a considerable time for the actual fitting of the w indows including the visit of two surveyors the size of one of the panes of glass was wrong. We now have to wait a further six weeks for the glass to be fitted,unbelievable!!

records.title: Quote took over 4 hours to do at home
records.text: We have not had windows fitted yet, but had Dominic come round yesterday to do a quote which turned into a pushed sell  (we very much asked for a moment to digest alone to think if we wanted to go ahead to fix the price). I believe the quality to be good but was not aware of it to take over 4 hours to do the quote which included discussing why the windows/service/this company is a good option. I work from home so if i was made aware it could take 4 hours I would have organised differently. Dominic was finishing off paperwork in the kitchen whilst we were cooking dinner! I think the company should re-evaluate how long their quotation and sales pitch should be, happy with 2 hours max.  Definitely let the customer know roughly how long it will take before booking a consultation. Not a complaint to Dominic, he was great, just company feedback.

records.title: Went through the whole process of…
records.text: Went through the whole process of introducing the company, their product, measuring up only to be utterly amazed at a quote of £14000 for 5 windows and one door. I certainly had better things to do than hear that rubbish. Got the quote down to £5900.Come on guys that sort of painful “we’re going to do you a favour” tactic don’t work anymore.I will remove this review but my price is £2000 perhaps we can negotiate.Don’t ever come to my door again.

records.title: My experience was not very good
records.text: My experience was not very good, the supervisor was extremely rude to me, accusing me of not answering phone , when I said the signal is very bad, he said"don,t give me that" this was said is an abrupt tone, even the guys fitting the windows said he is always very abrupt with customers. I will say that the fitters were good and very pleasant.I dont think the quality of windows are that good either as sills are a bit flimsey and the windows are hard to open, also I noticed a cracked window sill after 3 years of installation (hedge was covering) this damage was done on installation and I was told that I would have to pay for another window sill. I cannot recommend this company but I guess you get what you pay for

records.title: Good but with problem
records.text: Although we are pleased with the windows that were fitted, scaffolding was left up for a week after completion. I contacted the office twice with no reply, and it was only when I contacted my lawyer for advice and sent a letter, did the scaffolding get removed.This scaffolding was preventing me from parking my car on my drive.

description: Established for over 25 years, family run and members of The British Association of Removers we are amongst the leading providers of quality Removals and Storage solutions throughout Essex. With offices in Chelmsford and Burnham on Crouch, we specialise in Local, UK,  European and Worldwide Removals and offer a Premium Storage Service. We also carry out Piano, Safe and Machinery Removals and offer a Safe disposal service.

records.title: Incredible service from start to finish
records.text: Incredible service from start to finish, helping to take so much stress out of our move. Jaime and Josh were super efficient packing everything up the day before, then Stats, Adam, Jaime and Sofia carried out the move on the day with incredible professionalism. All of the team were super friendly and took care of everything. Genuinely couldn't be happier!

records.title: Professional & polite people from start to finish
records.text: Telephoned TFM to enquire on carrying-out a collection on our behalf of an art-installation comprising of 21 mirrored/glassed wooden units & related items from a north London manufacturing works, for return to our Essex depot. Excellent response & competitive quotation from Ralph, and collection date agreed. Collection & blanket-wrap / tie-securing within vehicle all carefully carried-out on the day by Josh & Jamie, upon arrival at our depot all items placed safely by them into our warehouse, for us to export case-pack. Highly recommended and would definitely contact again for any such future work. Thank you TFM, best regards, Nick, Pennex Ltd.

records.title: Brilliant 100% Service
records.text: Brilliant 100% ServiceI cannot thank TFM enough from start to finish the team  were  very professional. We would definitely use them again.

records.title: Highly recommended
records.text: My first time using a removal service and it really does make the day a lot less stressful. Stats and Sophia reliable and friendly. Super competent, nothing seemed to phase them, even carrying a heavy recliner sofa down 2 flights of slightly narrow stairs from my flat on the 2nd floor! Patient and helpful, assisting with that inevitable small bit of last minute packing on the day. Also no hidden or extra charges, what I was quoted is what I paid.

records.title: 100% recommend
records.text: These reviews are what led me to book our removal with TFM & they did not disappoint. The team were wonderful & so efficient. From start to finish everything ran like clockwork & they removed any stress we had around moving. The whole team worked so hard & did it all with a smile. Nothing was too much for them & they really went above & beyond with their assistance. We would recommend them as a company 100% & can’t praise them highly enough.

records.title: We highly recommend TFM
records.text: We highly recommend TFM.  What a great service from start to finish.  The team were so friendly and efficient and made a stressful moving day as smooth as possible for us.  Nothing was a problem and all our furniture and belongings were delivered safely to our new house with care.  Many thanks to Ralph and all the team.  Excellent service.

records.title: Fantastic company and would 100%…
records.text: Fantastic company and would 100% recommend! I had their packing and removal service and I must say that they were so quick and tidy!From start to finish Ralph, Josh, Sarah, Stats, Sofia and the rest of the team were outstanding. Very helpful, reasonably priced and professional.

records.title: The moving
records.text: The moving. Could not have been any better the team was so good at the job they was so professional i am sorry  forgot all there names Sofie and Josh I am sorry I remember the top man  but they was the best so a  very big thank you ******.

records.title: Highly recommend TFM Removals
records.text: Great service from start to finish. The estimator was knowledgeable and the person who delivered the packing boxes gave me great advice on how to pack up. The team were on time on the day, protected all my carpets as they moved about and carefully loaded and unloaded everything. They were friendly, polite and really helpful. It made a stressful day much easier. Thank you to everyone.

records.title: Great service from start to finish
records.text: TFM were wonderful during for the entirety of a recent complicated move: emptying my parents house in the south of England and delivering to two addresses in Scotland.  The entire team were patient, understanding and professional throughout.  The whole process went smoothly and TFM made things as stress-free as possible.  Thoroughly recommended and after bad experiences with other removal firms I will be using them again if I ever need a big move again.

records.title: Not as good as expected
records.text: I'd like to start with the positives. The owner was very helpful when I was enquiring and his guys on the day were very polite. I did have a couple of struggles however. I had only moved the previous year using another company and so assumed the service would be similar however I was told on the day that bubble wrapped fragile items could not be taken (I then had to load in my car), lampshades had to be removed from lamps, the washing machine could not be disconnected (I begged them to do it as I am on my own and had no option). At the other end I had asked the guys to connect my washing machine at my own risk and the chap looked and told me he couldn't as it needed isolators. I then had to buy these and find a plumber  pretty quickly - when he came he didn't need the isolators and just connected the pipes so I feel I was misled and this has cost me c£50. Maybe this is all in the small print but as I said I had expected a similar if not better service from this company based on all the reviews that I had read but in reality it gave me more challenges than I needed at a stressful time. It wasn't a bad service, just decidedly average.

description:
Experts in deep oven cleaning, we get rid of built-up soot and grease in hard to reach places missed by everyday cleaning. You can relax and leave the cleaning to us, with Oven Support you get an exceptional oven cleaning service.

We use the most effective and innovative oven cleaning techniques to keep your oven sparkling and working longer. Specialists in electric oven cleaning, gas oven cleaning and range oven cleaning, we also clean other kitchen appliances such as microwaves, extractor fans and barbecues.

records.title: Simon attended my property today to…
records.text: Simon attended my property today to clean my oven. Such a professional and polite young man who did a remarkable job. Thanks so much

records.title: How Clean!!
records.text: How Clean!!WOW!! I've got a new oven Josh did a wonderful job..thankyou. He was running late but rang me to say..A lovely polite, cheerful & generally nice fella.My verification code 4678 I put wrong one down

records.title: Very pleased
records.text: Daniel was very thorough and efficient from the point of contact informing me if his eta.Very clean and tidy no mess left.I now have an immaculate double oven looks like new.Daniel was very professional and thorough throughout.Friendly manner but not intrusive.An excellent ambassador for the company.Thanks Daniel

records.title: Amazing Service
records.text: Amazing service from start to finish and my oven looks brand new and your employee was very friendly and knows his job

records.title: Was running late but kept me informed…
records.text: Was running late but kept me informed of new eta. Satisfied with results left everything clean and tidy. I use this company regularly, good value for money.

records.title: Very good job
records.text: Very pleased with the price. Deposit paid on order and balance paid a couple of days before work. Got a phone call half an hour before arrival - earlier than expected but not a problem although it might have been. Did a good job - only took 45 minutes and oven looks like new.

records.title: Impressed with the outcome
records.text: The person cleaning the oven was proficient and efficient. He gave me good advice on my oven and cleaned it to an excellent standard. The oven was in a horrific state, so he did what he could to make it much better than what it was. It certainly was a challenge.

records.title: Would Recommend
records.text: Great job thank you! Simon did an amazing job, the oven is like new. Super friendly and polite too. Will definitely use again. A++

records.title: Professional from start to finish
records.text: Professional from start to finish. Oven is gleaming. No mess left behind

records.title: Absolutely recommended
records.text: The man that cleaned my oven did a brilliant job. It's like new. Very polite. Easy process from booking to cleaning. Thank you

records.title: JOSH WAS FANTASTIC
records.text: JOSH WAS FANTASTIC, SENT ME A TEXT TO LET ME KNOW WHAT TIME HE WOULD BE HERE, DOWN FALL WAS THIS WAS 1HOUR LATER THAN THE 11-2 TIME SLOT. OUR OVEN LOOKS LIKE NEW :) IV GIVEN 4 STARS ONLY DUE TO THE INITIAL CALL WHERE THE COMPANY TRIED TO SELL ME DIFFERENT THINGS, TO ADD ON!! ALL IN ALL HAPPY WITH THE SERVICE

records.title: Amazing oven technician
records.text: Dale was amazing, and my oven looks great however when it comes to the office staff it is quite confusing and conflicting information, and an hour for an oven such as mine is jokes. Felt proper bad that he was working so late on Christmas Eve but nethertheless a fabulous job all round.Only giving 4 stars due to office lack of coordination, changing appointment after stating it was the only one available etc

records.title: Cancelled my bank card just in case
records.text: I booked my cleaning for the 24th December between 8am-12pm, I paid the deposit. The morning after I booked I was called at 9am to pay the remaining balance, this concerned me and after I paid on my debit card I cancelled my card. I read their FAQ page and it says to pay upon completion so I was very wary. I was also wary when they said they weren’t coming at the selected time slot but between 12pm-3pm. I’d read some reviews that they didn’t show up at all and this again concerned me. To the point where my Fiancé was doing his whole ‘told you so’ piece. Fortunately, they called at 1:30pm said they were on the way. Came and cleaned it, it was incredible, I could see into my oven from the outside! I thought I would wait to write a review after I had used it to make sure there was no chemical smells! There were not. It’s still gleaming and was a super quick service. The only downsides are the upfront payment and the time slot you pick isn’t actually an option.

records.title: Oven clean
records.text: Despite what other people have said I had a good experience. Tony phoned to let me know he was on his way and turned up on time. He did a great job on my oven & hob which were very dirty. Only negative is that the sales team over charged me for items I didn't want so am waiting for a refund.

records.title: Oven looks great!!
records.text: Oven looks great!!! Nice to have someone who will chat to you throughout the job and still take pride in what he was doing, would recommend anyone to contact and have clean done

records.title: Quite satisfied with the oven cleaning…
records.text: Quite satisfied with the oven cleaning but disappointed that the controls on the top do not appear to have been cleaned and my husband wiped the shelves down after Jacob had left because they had smears on them.I’m not sure if the grill element in the roof of the microwave was cleaned and there was a lot of marks on the sides

records.title: Overall good
records.text: I was initially skeptical about this, as it seemed too cheap and convenient, but overall it went well. We booked a double oven clean for end of our tenancy and the landlord was very happy with the result. The cleaner who attended was polite and thorough.Some negatives: I found the website misleading, it tried to make it seem cheaper than it was. When booking I was told "someone will phone you soon to confirm the appointment". They mean someone will phone the day before the appointment, which is not the same thing as "soon", so it was not very clear. They also try to sell you other things on the phone, which is annoying.

records.title: Great clean on complex oven
records.text: Great clean! Patiently spent aaages working out how to take apart complex oven door panes to clean - a real faff but great job in the end

records.title: What a transformation!
records.text: Although I'd booked for the afternoon, the chap turned up in the morning calling me an hour before to say he was on his way.He was quick and very efficient, our double oven had built up over time with a lot of burnt in grime, which was a bit embarrassing, but less than an hour later it looked like new again!A brilliant job and will definitely use this company again.

records.title: Excellent clean not so sparkling telephone experience
records.text: The cleaner (Logan) was excellent and his work ethic was top notch. He did a great job and we now have a sparkling range oven. The 4 star rating is not for the work but for the way the call centre kept calling, emailing etc trying to get more placed on the order, if they backed off a bit it would be five star review . Also need to up their payment methods to make it a safer and more secure one.

records.title: Your staff member is a delightful young…
records.text: Your staff member is a delightful young man and has cleaned my oven excellently. I amNot pleased with office administration re timing of appointments . Rearranging my medical appts to suit your visit caused undue stress and inconvenience . A customer should always be considered and I found this not to be the case .

records.title: I was pleased with the clean,till the…
records.text: I was pleased with the clean,till the cleaner broke the glass on the oven door.I had no communication from the company unless I did it had no time scale as to when the glass would arrive it took 7 weeks roughly to get my glass,now I've rung the company and they r sending some one out today which I'm very pleased with

records.title: The guy did a great job very…
records.text: The guy did a great job very professional the only reason I give a 4 and not a five that he arrived at 3.50pm and when I ordered the service I asked for a morning appointment only found out it was a afternoon appointment the day before .I have no problems with the man that did the job as he had no control on the organisation of the appointment

records.title: The clean was great but unfortunately I…
records.text: The clean was great but unfortunately I was badly let down by the booking experience which went badly wrong and resulted in me waiting in twice with no appearance before finally they turned up. This wasn't the fault of the cleaner as he did a very good job.

records.title: Oven Clean by Dale
records.text: Oven Clean by Dale. Slightly chaotic to get a time narrowed down but he was communicative and polite. However the oven looks absolutely amazing. Looks brand new. Such great value for money. Would use again.

records.title: Your agent was on time   Yes
records.text: Your agent was on time, polite and efficient, clearing his stuff away after he had finished his work on my oven.  I am very pleased with the result.

records.title: Extractor fan and hob cleaned to…
records.text: Extractor fan and hob cleaned to perfection by Dean who also cleaned my oven a few weeks ago. Only reason dropped a star was because of the pushiness of the office trying to drum up more business. Take note!!!

records.title: Tony was fantastic
records.text: Tony was fantastic. Really nice bloke and did a great job again. I’ve used oven support before and will do again. My only gripe is I had my first booking cancelled and when my second appt was booked in I asked for AM as has a busy day. The time slot I got was 12-4!!! Tony arrived to me at 4.10

records.title: Great technicians, customer service needs a tweak!
records.text: Simon did a great job on my oven and left it looking amazing. He was friendly and helpful and also cleaned my extractor fan.The only reason I haven’t given 5 stars is that I have been bombarded with phone calls inviting me to have the service even after I’ve booked it! Also they didn’t accommodate my preference for pm but only told me the day before. Rather than try to resolve the issue they were intent on selling further services which was annoying as I didn’t feel they were listening! So technicians are great - customer service (while very friendly) needs organising and told to be less pushy

records.title: oven clean was as always brilliant
records.text: The oven clean was as always brilliant. But the company needs to review their computer system or staff. I booked this September appointment in April. Every month thereafter I got at least two phone calls asking if I wanted any oven cleaned. The day before my appointment I got six reminders that he was coming all within minutes of each other. 3 messages and 3 emails. 🥹🥹

records.title: The guy was unable to get the glass off…
records.text: The guy was unable to get the glass off the oven door to clean in-between the pains of glass ' plus he didn't clean the light inside the oven also he never cleaned the top of the inside of the oven and there was residue marks on the shelfs sorry but after reading all these so called reviews I am disappointed with the service I received

records.title: Cleaner left chemical residue in oven…
records.text: The cleaner didn't clean off the chemical from the top of the oven.  This resulted in flakes of chemical falling onto food whilst cooking.  I arranged for them to clean it off on two separate occasions, the first one they couldn't get to me before 7 pm.  The second one they made the appointment for an afternoon when I specically asked for a morning.  I then asked for a refund.  So far nothing has been forthcoming.

records.title: Bad.
records.text: First time using this company and although the oven cleaner was amazing the company itself and customer service staff are not what i want to be deal with again. Still waiting on refund for mats i never asked for nor got.

records.title: Cleaning had to be Redone by someone else
records.text: The cleaner who turned up was friendly and polite. He cleaned what he said he was able to, but I have since  had my usual regular home cleaner clean all the parts he missed because he had specific safety rules. This meant I was charged for a microwave clean that couldn't be cleaned and I have had to pay another £50 to someone else to finish cleaning the cooker

records.title: Great clean! Too pushy in sales
records.text: The gentleman that came to clean the oven was super!absolutely no issues at all with that.The sales department found very pushy.. as in pushing products etc..it’s good to have prompts but less pushy please

records.title: Be aware of services requested
records.text: The range ovens where left immaculate, the hob clean was good. The operative excellent.The issues arose with the office who dealt with the booking, incredibly pushy with there upselling, almost aggressive no notes placed on the account around the discount given for the hob clean, not 2 minutes after the operative left the office was on the phone asking for more money straight away to cover the hob clean, whilst a good job was done it was not an amazing experience all the way through their process !

records.title: Not a bad job.
records.text: Your operative was polite and did a tidy job, but not quite complete as he failed to clean the ceiling of the oven, which wasn't noticed till he had gone.Also seems to have mislaid a small grid used to keep flexible oven floor liner in place.(not a big deal, but a bit of a nuisance)

records.title: Horrific customer service
records.text: The customer service here is appalling.  Lied regarding attendance at my property and they had noted an incorrect number and tried to blame me. Zoe was the office person I spoke to who does not know anything about customer service and stopped short of calling me a liar. They had the audacity to ask me to pay in full prior to anyone attending my house with refunds being within 28 days.The reason for the stars is the guy Tony that came out the next day to clean my ovens was brilliant. I would never recommend oven clean to anyone. If you could get Tony on his own then I would go for him.

records.title: Good clean, confusing company
records.text: Firstly the actual oven cleaning was good - William rang ahead, worked quickly and then was on his way.I booked on ovensupport.co.uk which caused confusion because the website is different from ovensupport.com and the TrustPilot page for ovensupport.co.uk warns about it misusing the TrustPilot badge, in addition to various reviews claiming the website is a scam, so I almost filed a claim to get my deposit back. However on the day it all went ahead and I settled my amount after work was done.Happy now but they need to clear up their situation with websites and TrustPilot reports as it just looks very dodgy.

records.title: My appointment was cancelled three…
records.text: My appointment was cancelled three times. On the 4 th appointment the oven cleaner arrived as planned.Cleaned the oven and combination cooker in 30 minutes.On the surface looked clean but on closer inspection when he had gone found that the roof of the combination cooker looked dirty. Also hidden areas around door dirty.I cleaned it again and it is now shining.

records.title: Not thorougly clean did left bits all…
records.text: Not thorougly clean did left bits all in doors, he had a blade to clean hob but left bits untouched, I had to show him, left kitchen floor covered i  burnt oven bits !!!did not remove any of thr knobs to ckean, definately wouldnt recommend

records.title: Outcome was a good result
records.text: The chap who carried out the work was excellent, efficient and professional. I spoke to someone yesterday on the phone to enquire about time of visit. He went through the script about the visit including how to pay etc which I had already gone through previously and just wanted a time. He asked that I allow him to do his job. I found him abrupt and not listening. I nearly cancelled the appointment due to this phone call. The outcome and performance of the chap who carried out the work was excellent.
