records.title: Attention to detail.
records.text: Prior to oven clean, was hassled somewhat to sell extra items on cleaning, not impressed by that. On the day the Oven cleaner was professional and very polite i can't fault. the finished oven and extractor clean was good but attention to detail knobs not removed from oven and cleaned, even top of oven not cleaned well, this is flat convection top oven. Simply put attention to detail was lacking. this process isn't cheap.

records.title: Cleaner was polite and pleasant
records.text: Cleaner was polite and pleasant. I was upsold on the hob being cleaned. However once gone and further assessing the lack of quality is evident. Still grime on the hob racks, the oven door and control panel wasn't cleaned. Really disappointed as the inside looks spot on.

records.title: I had 3 ovens and 4 microwave ovens…
records.text: I had 3 ovens and 4 microwave ovens cleaned .The technician turned up on time and was very pleasant.However on inspection after he had left I found the appliances to be still dirty. There had been insufficient attention to detail compared with previous oven cleans I have had.I was suspicious because he was very fast indeed.Could have been so much better with a little more care !

records.title: Performance
records.text: Turned up when expected, was not overly impressed with the final result. Tops of ovens still uncleaned . Hob not fully cleaned as dirt / grease had been left or moved into the gas inlet resulting in low / no gas supply for two rings . When booking was sold oven mats which were not supplied at time of cleaning  . Apparently in the post . Operative pleasant enough . But for the money paid expected better quality.

records.title: I didn’t like that having promised my…
records.text: I didn’t like that having promised my oven being cleaned before Christmas, it didn’t happen and no effort was made to let me know. I tried contacting company and got no joy.Eventually a cleaner came by today and did an excellent job but no thanks to the company. I will deal directly with him from now on. The actual company made no effort to contact me at all.

records.title: Sort out your booking team
records.text: Actual oven clean and professional approach of the cleaner should be five star but can only give three due to the constant bombardment of phone calls from the booking site. This firm seems to have a policy of upselling, I booked and paid for an oven clean 5 months ago and have had dozens of calls in between time despite asking for the calls to stop and constantly telling then I’m already booked in! Shame really as I would happily have stayed with them but I can’t cope with the harassment from the booking office

records.title: Keep to the booking time
records.text: My requests for morning bookings keep being changed to afternoon slots after the first contact. Originally booked before Christmas the visit was postponed until January as the cleaner could not come until the afternoon.On 11/1 William arrived at 11.50 but left at 12.40 without saying goodbye and/or asking if I was happy with the clean.

records.title: Cleaner was not happy to remove the…
records.text: Cleaner was not happy to remove the oven door saying that sometimes the plastic down the side breaks and told us if that happened he could not take responsibility. Surely most people want the doors and glass cleaned. Oven was cleaned very well and he did somewhat reluctantly remove the doors and clean the glass without damage.

records.title: Oven looked clean when first seen but…
records.text: Oven looked clean when first seen but then noticed the top of the inside of the oven was still dirty.The oven cleaner also had dirty greasy shoes walking back and forth on our hallway cream carpet causing this to stain.

records.title: Great clean but disappointing customer service.
records.text: The cleaner we had was a brilliant person- truly great and the oven looks super. I cannot fault them or their service. The company as a whole left us feeling let down- we booked for 8-12 deliberately as we had plans in the afternoon. Then the business day prior we were told we’d get 12-3 slot and then there was limited communication regarding when the cleaner would arrive— twice I had to chase it myself and information was slow to come. In the end the cleaner got to us at 7pm. There was very little that the company did to make us feel valued or to put things right. It is unlikely that we’ll return to using this company, as despite the beautiful clean— the other side of things leaves a lot to be desired.

records.title: Not the best
records.text: Not the best, had better , wire rack supports not cleaned very well. Ovens themselves  fairly clean although cleaning residue on  kitchen unit doors and dried on inside of ovens . Wouldn’t use again .

records.title: Wowcher purchase
records.text: I arranged via Wowcher to get my ovens, hob and extractor cleaned by Ovensupport.  However, when their operative came in July 2024 the chemicals used broke an integral piece from my main oven door.  Someone else then came out in August 2024 who said I needed some doubled-sided heat resistant tape.  I rang this company every week, sometimes twice.  However, the tape wasn't ordered until at least October and then I rang the company again weekly to then finally get someone to come out on 04.12.24 and fit the tape (original operative).

records.title: Excellent job from Tony but not from the customer service.
records.text: Tony did a great job with the oven clean. However the arranging of the appointment wasn't good and the people I spoke to were more interested in trying to sell the products than actually hearing the customer requests.

records.title: Have this on monthly payment and always…
records.text: Have this on monthly payment and always having to chase to get my oven cleaned quick enough to take payments but rubbish for arranging a clean. Plus last person sent was training someone used all my kitchen towel for cleaning was training someone and didn't clean it fully

records.title: The cleaner did a fantastic job of the…
records.text: The cleaner did a fantastic job of the oven and I'm really happy with it. The guy that came out was polite and professional. I do not want the service again. Please delete me from your system. The day before the appointment I spoke to a guy who told me I had to pay extra, because I live on the 2nd floor. I wasn't aware of this charge and told him I didn't have the money and then said he would charge me £10 extra. Then he acted like he did me a favour. He tried to get me to commit to another clean at £55. I declined the offer. I've paid £70 for a double oven clean this time! I'm not interested in rebooking. Please delete my details.

records.title: Sloppy Job - Series 1. Episode 2.
records.text: Following my last 20/11/24 Trustpilot rating Oven Support Ltd have responded and have revisited to assess the clean and the damage to the adjacent kitchen unit doors.The assessor, who was the original cleaner, assessed his own works and apologised several times for the poor standard of cleaning.  He acknowledged that there was damage to the unit doors but suggested that the damage may have been caused by heat from the oven and that I had only noticed it whilst inspecting his work.  This is a ridiculous suggestion as the oven and units have been adjacent for 7 years, why would there be damage just now?I asked the cleaner what spray cleaner he used and he told me that he does not use any corrosive products but he failed to confirm what the actual product was. Whatever the product was it has damaged the high gloss melamine face of the unit doors and discoloured the aluminium control switch and the stainless steel trims.   Should such a product be used in our homes without fair warning and what are the risks to our health?The assessor said I will hear from Oven Support Ltd to discuss a resolution, I have heard nothing, wait for episode 3.

records.title: Very disappointed with the oven…
records.text: Very disappointed with the oven cleaning. A lot of things I expected to be cleaned were missed. Seals weren't cleaned there was still dirt and burnt food in between the doors and ovens. I did send an e mail with pictures,after having spoken to them by phone. I sent 3 messages and they didn't have the decency to reply. So don't go here they are only after your money and don't care about customer satisfaction. I will have to finish the cleaning myself.£65 for a   bad job . Another Rip off Britain case ! After a reply from them on the 29th November saying someone would contact me to review my complaint it is now 10th January and still no contact ??? What does this show.!? They don't care. !

records.title: Bad customer service …
records.text: The cleaning was good but the inner glass door shattered while the operative was cleaning it, I wasn't worried as he assured me they would replace it. In fact I got a phone call soon after saying I would get the new glass in 3-5 days. That was 5 weeks ago and when I have spoken to customer service they say they have emailed the company supplying it but have not received a reply and that they will email again and get back to me, so far I have not heard anything.  So it seems a good service as long as nothing goes wrong.

description:
Carpet Bright UK offers exceptional carpet, rug, curtain, mattress and upholstery cleaning services to domestic and commercial customers across London and the Home Counties.
We're a professional carpet and upholstery cleaning company established in 1995. We offer fast, effective, and affordable cleaning solutions with long-lasting results, working closely with our customers to ensure their individual needs are met. Our industrial steam cleaning machines and team of certified technicians guarantee high-quality workmanship with every clean.
Why use Carpet Bright UK?
We only use eco-friendly natural cleaning solutions. Our super-quick carpet-drying system works within two hours. We will never pressure you to buy or offer you a service you don’t need. Our certified team takes pride: you’re guaranteed a great job on the day. Carpet Bright UK’s technicians offer exceptionally high standards of customer service. We’ll always tell you clearly what we’re going to do before we start. We’ll make sure to arrive on time: punctuality is our watchword. We offer a no shrinkage guarantee. We are fully insured.
Areas We Serve
London,
Kent,
Surrey, East Sussex,
West Sussex, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire & Essex.

records.title: Alvin the superstar
records.text: Alvin turned up on time and ready to go. He explained the process, including the do’s and dont’s and did a fantastic job! The carpets look as good as new. Thank you Carpet Bright and thank you Alvin.You made my 92 year old father in laws day. Matt

records.title: Highly recommended!
records.text: As a loyal customer of Carpet Bright UK for the past couple of years I can’t recommend their service highly enough—it’s truly exceptional! The team is lovely, ensuring a smooth experience from booking to the actual carpet cleaning. The quality of their work is fantastic - we have a big hairy fluffy dog, but after every cleaning you’d never know he’s around because every corner is left spotless.

records.title: Alvin was a star
records.text: Alvin was a star. Arrived bang on time was very polite and friendly and did a fantastic job on our bedrooms and staircase and now 2 hours later the carpet is almost dry. I will ask for him again.

records.title: Brilliant company
records.text: Brilliant company. Quick to respond and book me in. Daniel the person who cleaned my carpets was amazing. Thank you Daniel and Carpet Bright UK. Jo

records.title: Yani,  Amazing carpet Man 🥂
records.text: Yani,Was very thorough, courteous , professional & did an amazing job. Our carpets look amazing.Thank you Yani you were a real pleasure to have in our home 👍🥂. Merry Xmas x

records.title: Zac did a fantastic job!!
records.text: I am extremely happy with the job that Zac done yesterday 2.12.24. My carpet is like new. Even my Electrician commented on how clean it looks.I would highly recommend Carpet Bright UK.Thank you.

records.title: Zac was helpful and professional
records.text: Zac was helpful and professional, gave good advice about what to expect from the clean. Would recommend, thank you

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. Arrived on time with a top quality industrial steam cleaning machine, guy worked solidly, did a great job and left. Very happy with the whole service (the waste water that was thrown away was filthy!) Thank you for the cleaning. I can honestly highly recommend.

records.title: Willingly give this review - Efficient positive service - Professional  result and Dan was a pleasant Operator -
records.text: Dan arrived at the time stated. Really pleasant young man, helped me move a table I couldnt manage, I appreciated the gesture. He removed a mark on sofa seat which from delivery, the Store Representative told me it was the weave of my new G Plan electric recliner, suggested I should use a light brush - I followed the advice, unsuccessfully and disatisfied with the follow up, I used a well known upholstery cleaner a few times over period of time. The mark remained. Dan has brought my sofa to, a good as new appearance. And -  really made my day by getting rid of the horrible mark - when the sofa dried, the mark had/has totally gone. (The mark, originally, gave impression of a bucket base rim being stood on the seat) Really appreciated Dans efforts - so pleased with sofa results. I have Carpetbrights Card for sharing! Thank you to Natasha, for supporting me with information - Regards

records.title: Dan A true professional. Very happy with results
records.text: Dan came from out his way to cover a sick employee and was amazing.  Rang to say on way, polite and very accommodating of our needs. Very satisfied with results he was extremely professional and done a fantastic job. Very happy

records.title: Daniel was superb
records.text: Daniel was superb - arrived early - got the job done quickly and efficiently - very happy

records.title: Impressed with Yani who cleaned my…
records.text: Update: Posted too early, after a further check there was one stain that remains and would be good if we could have Yani come by and spot clean that stain.---------------Impressed with Yani who cleaned my lounge carpet, all stains removed and took no more than 1.5 hrs.Will use again in future.

records.title: Ease of quote, booking & work.
records.text: Ease of quote, confirmation of booking, arranging of time/date. Faster than expected and Zac was lovely - even arrived early. Left with cleaner carpets, nice scent and put furniture back so nice & tidy. Recommend. Thank you.

records.title: Great technician - stain removal could be better
records.text: The technician was great and very helpful, going over all the areas twice when asked to go over them again. However, a lot of the stains didn’t come out despite his best attempts.

records.title: My first experience of using this company
records.text: My first experience of using this company & I would certainly use them again. From my initial phone call to the finished carpet clean the service was excellent.Zac, the technician was efficient, courteous & knowledgeable. The company is highly recommended.

records.title: Carpet cleaner
records.text: Kieron my carpet cleaner with pleasant and did great with cleaning my stairs landing and bedroom carpets.

records.title: carpet cleaning Aston Abbotts Bucks
records.text: ibere cleaned my dining room hall and stair carpet today.he was pleasant and helpful. discovered insect damage and he applied insecticide.Not all stains removed but overall pleased with result4 stars only as he was late but this was due to being given a job 2 hours drive from base with an8-9am start

records.title: Cleaning carpet
records.text: Stain removal was done efficiently and Zac Dimitrow was polite and family

records.title: Ivan was good and tried his best to…
records.text: Ivan was good and tried his best to remove the marks from the carpet

records.title: Andy was great!
records.text: Andy was great, on time and very efficient.  He did a good job on the couch, however there were stains he couldn’t remove and that was due to us leaving the stains too long before being cleaned.

records.title: I just had my carpet cleaned with…
records.text: I just had my carpet cleaned with Carpet Bright and I am pleased. My carpet smells, looks and feels cleaner. The carpet is fluffy and softUnfortunately the red wine stain wasn't able to be removed, I was disappointed.Kieron was really professional, friendly and helpful explaining everything and the science behind the cleaning! I felt the pricing of the cleaning was reasonable compared to other cleaning sites.

records.title: Super pleased with Carpet Bright
records.text: Super pleased with Carpet Bright, thank you. Super quick and easy to book. Only reason it wasn't 5 star was the strong chemical smell post cleaning and took a little longer to for the carpets to dry. Other than that my carpets look great and would definitely use again.

records.title: Didn’t fix the dog smell
records.text: Efficient booking system and professional technician. The carpets didn’t look dirty to start with so looked similar afterwards. They took 24 hours to dry. I was really disappointed that the cleaning process did not remove the dog smell though.

records.title: Not fully dry yet, but such a big difference!!
records.text: Although not yet dry, it looks great! The technician was very thorough and obviously likes his work! Explained things very well and answered all questions clearly. I have been very happy with previous carpet cleaning by CarpetBright.

records.title: 20 year old carpet clean
records.text: Carpet Bright are amazing! They made my 20 year old carpet look young again. Everyone I dealt with, from scheduling to technician, was friendly, knowledgeable and polite. I strongly recommend them!

records.title: GREAT SERVICE
records.text: My carpets look great.  Carpet Bright were easy to contact, gave an instant quote and stuck to it.  Rhys arrived on time and was really helpful in moving furniture and did a very good job.

records.title: Carpet Cleaning
records.text: Punctual, very polite and a great service. I was disappointed that a stain could not be fully removed but it has been on the carpet for 3 years.

records.title: My technician was friendly
records.text: My technician was friendly, prompt and very efficient. Everything was exactly as he had explained. Our carpet looks and smells good!

records.title: Always efficient and professional
records.text: Always efficient and professionalAndy was polite, efficient and the carpets look great!

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Ibere gave a very good service, but took a while to get started. Carpets were left looking really clean.

records.title: Feel deceived
records.text: The service carried out was good but I feel disappointed with the carpet guard offered When offered the additional treatment to my carpet at £60 I thought that this would be a full treatment by a form of machinery However all I got was the operator walking round with a spray covering the carpet Hard to understand the cost charged ?

records.title: Not bad
records.text: Overall most marks came out of the carpet. Slightly frustrated as in original call I explained one was water damage and they did not highlight this would be problematic until arrival when I had already paid….Cleaners were very polite and communicated well.

records.title: Not as good as expected
records.text: I booked Carpet Bright to clean a lounge carpet which is 3 years old.  I do have a carpet cleaner but thought I would get it professionally cleaned.  I was able to book the technician to come a couple of days later.  He was a very nice man and arrived on time.  However, although clean, I felt my carpet cleaner would have done the same job.  I expected the pile to be raised and most carpet indents to disappear but was told that would not happen.  The carpet was only just dry in 24 hours.  I then bought a stiff garden hand brush to lift the pile.

records.title: Total lack of accountability
records.text: I would advise any prospective customer of Carpet Bright to be extremely careful with the company. While their service met expectations, the technician spilled a large quantity of water on the entrance mat of the apartment building, causing temporary damage (it dried off after several days). The technician recognized the fact and the damage was witnessed on the spot by 3 people - but we only recorded videos and took photos after the fact.Reporting this to Carpet Bright, they denied all responsibility and pointed out that "the onus is on the claimant to provide proof beyond reasonable doubt that the damage was actually caused by our technician".In other words, if you observe any damage, make sure you immediately record a video with the technician confessing the issue, otherwise you're likely to have to pay any repair bill yourself.

records.title: Not as good as first expected
records.text: 2 very grubby bedroom carpets cleaned by Andy. Very efficient, fast service. Extremely pleased & my wife thought she had walked into a different house. Thank you. Highly recommended.UPDATE: When carpets dried, it does not look as cleaned as expected. Bits missed. Stains still there. And customer service is terrible. 3 days now and no return of calls or emails having sent pics.  Not recommended now.

records.title: Didn’t listen and act on the brief
records.text: We chose a reputable company as had suffered a lot of damage due to a house fire, with melted roof tar and muddy firemen’s boots in the house. There was no guarantee but the company felt optimistic. A standard clean was carried out at £540 with no special attention/treatment on the tar. I have been left removing it by individual spot treatment since. If I had done this before they arrived the end result would have been better. Very disappointed ☹️

records.title: Over rated company
records.text: Engineer came on time to the site, I helped him with the gear, not a problem. Asked for the protector to be applied by the technician by the name of Kevin but he said this carpet does not need it? Then I called Hannah to ask ' are the tops of the stairs meant to be cleaned or the whole step' she replied the whole step which she then told the technician, he then says oh I don't know where my mind was. I went to the site today once the carpet had dried and still saw stains on the steps, I don't think the protector was applied as I put some water on the carpet and it did not pebble, 10 stage cleaning process I don't think so. I asked for 10 percent off my first order which was not applied and was told it would be applied to my next order. Being a landlord I would would not use them again. Very over rated company to be honest

records.title: Unhappy with this company.
records.text: I arranged for this company to clean some stains from a client's carpet. The client informed me that the company despite being paid to clean a whole bedroom and hallway,  only cleaned the stains. This, they did do a good job of, but they did not clean the rest of the landing and bedroom. The company claims that the client told them not to clean the other areas. The client contacted me to find out why they had not cleaned the other areas. The company suggested that clients are often untruthful, and  that carpetbright  were not wrong as their technician had written down what had been said. They did offer to go back again, but my feeling is that for £100 plus VAT to go into a house set up their equipment, do a job and be gone in under 40 mins (as recorded on CCTV)  is over the top and I will never use or recommend  this company. I would like to have seen better customer service, and feel that a discount should have been offered.

records.title: These guys are spammers on other…
records.text: These guys are spammers on other websites and I'm not sure I'd trust many of the formulaic 5 star reviews on this site.

records.title: Two cream rugs, not cleaned
records.text: I sent in two rugs (cream, one deep pile) that came back with visible stains and had clearly not been washed, only vacuumed. I returned them the same day with the delivery driver after showing him they hadn’t been washed. They went away for another 3 weeks, and I kid you not, came back in the same condition. I specifically asked for a deep clean and for them to be done off site to ensure they’re well cleaned and dried. Sadly very disappointed that 6 weeks in total of ‘cleaning’ that never happened, and £300 later I’m stuck with rugs that I have to redo. Unbelievable.

records.title: So wet after cleaning. 3 nights in spare room!!
records.text: Could not move into the room for 4 days.The carpet was so wet it took ages to dry.I phoned after 24 hrs. Told to call back later but the guy wasn't there ( family emergency) .Yes the carpet is clean but the service was terrible.1st appointment delayed a day ( Covid)Operator arrived 90 minutes early, we were luckily just arriving home. Platitudes when I rang. Promised a call back from the complaints department which I'm still waiting for.Would NEVER use them again.

records.title: Sent one person round to move and wash…
records.text: Sent one person round to move and wash carpets when he left had not done under bed also left black spots wrote to carpet bright nothing back just had a call was told they had photos of my carpet being cleaned none of the photo were of my home .then he offered me £50 off next clean I said there will not be a next clean

records.title: Will never use them again
records.text: They left the carpet of the landing where they had plugged the machine in front of my neighbour's door full of stains. When I called them immediately after they left and my neighbour complained, they said it was probably my neighbour (who is also the landlord of the building) who had stained the carpet. After I insisted on the phone, they agreed to send somebody to have a look at it but suggested a date when I was abroad. I then contacted Daniel 3 times to rearrange the visit but he never responded to my messages. They are not only unprofessional. They are also rude.

description:
Test your home or business with our simple easy to use DIY Asbestos Test Kit. We offer a fast, simple, cost effective complete solution with support 100% of the way. 

Each kit comes with all the personal protective equipment needed to safely take samples, all of which which meets or exceeds the guidelines as set out in the Control of Asbestos Regulations and the Health & Safety Executive.

The Asbestos Test Kit is designed to be safe and simple to use, simple to follow instructions are included. Fits through most standard letter boxes. Text alert when certificate available and online portal to track progress of order.

To find out safely, quickly and easily if material contains asbestos, we will provide you with the following:

• DIY Testing Kit, suitable for home or business use
• Accredited UKAS Laboratory certificate
• 100% support throughout the process by our dedicated  knowledgable team, use our live chat or pick up the phone
• FREE Return postage

records.title: Excellent Service The instructions on the test kit were…
records.text: The instructions on the test kit were clear and really  easy to follow and the service was  quick and efficient.

records.title: Quick and easy results
records.text: Quick and easy results. Good communication via txt and email.

records.title: Great experience, easy to do, quick results.
records.text: Easy to order direct from company. Clear instructions on how to register and how to collect samples- suggest writing the details on all the bags before using them.Took approximately 5 days in post, receive notification of delivery, and then less than 24 hours to get the results.Results were laid out in an easy to understand form.I did the six samples for £120. Glad we did this as we now have complete peace of mind throughout the ceilings which were highlighted as a potential risk on our house survey. Shall look to do more i.e. boiler flagging, chimney, garage when we move in.

records.title: Waste materials
records.text: Clear and easy process and rapid results.However, there is a lot of plastic waste associated with the testing (plastic sheet, gloves, overalls, etc), much of which some users may already have. This results in not only a lot of plastic waste being disposed of, but also a significant extra cost. Would it not be better to have the protective gear as an additional extra, rather than a compulsory component of each single package.

records.title: efficient service
records.text: kit was easy to use, and the service was prompt and efficient. Sample posted on a Saturday to arrive Monday, paid for same day testing and had result back Monday afternoon. Excellent communication throughout the process from ordering, to checking that I had received the result.

records.title: Highly recommende!
records.text: My sample was very time sensitive. When the USPS let me down by delivering my “Priority Mail” days late (no surprise there), I wrote to Asbestos Sampling to please expedite my test, and they came through same-day. They’re great.

records.title: Simplicity and Efficiency!!…
records.text: My experience was really great because everything was simple from initial contact, the speed of response along with ease of IT registration. Once samples taken, a first class delivery meant sample was viewed and checked in less than 1/2 a day with result immediately sent by text and email. Would 100% recommend!.

records.title: Brilliant 5*
records.text: Brilliant, ordered Tuesday, received testing kit on Wednesday, sent it back via recorded delivery on the same day and had the results on Thursday afternoon. I did pay for the same day testing and I paid extra for the postage but worth it. Very clear results and although the instructions look dawning at first, just follow the steps. Would definitely use again in the future if necessary.

records.title: Quick and easy
records.text: The test collection kit gave great instructions.  The process was very easy.  I was notified the day my sample was received and got my results one business day later.  Now I can do my home repair with my mind at ease that I won’t have asbestos exposure.

records.title: I received my results in the time frame…yes
records.text: I received my results in the time frame I was quoted. The report was easy to ready. The sample test was affordable. I’m a real estate agent and the buyer backed out after the home inspection because of “perceived” asbestos. Now I can confidently move forward with another buyer. I will recommend your company in the future. Thank you,  Christine Czekalski Spece

records.title: It was good
records.text: It was good.  Just the shipping took 8 days due to us living in canada.  Once they received the sample it took 3 days to reply.

records.title: The kit was easy to use
records.text: The kit was easy to use, fill out, and submit for testing.  I was a little disappointed that it took over 72 hours.  I'd email asking if there was a problem, and less than an hour later I received my results.  Had I gotten the results within the 72 hours, I would have given 5 stars.  I'd definitely use the service again.

records.title: Very good turn over time
records.text: Very good turn over time, but the change of address was a bit awkward along with more digits than boxes for reference.

records.title: Efficient, but expect your results to take 3-4 days, due to Royal Mail.
records.text: I had three samples tested.  I posted the sample on Monday and they received them late Thursday that week, presumably due to the slow 'First Class' service from Royal Mail.  They processed the results on the same day though.  I found their submission form to be confusing as it does not have enough boxes to enter the code they provide.  I (stupidly) forgot to include the submission form and had to email it; they promised to attach it to my results, but it took several emails to get that done.  I'd use them again.

records.title: All went well except the results were…
records.text: All went well except the results were not sent in 72 hours as advertised.  After over a week we had to reach out to receive the results.

records.title: Wonderful test kit and great turn…
records.text: Wonderful test kit and great turn around time. Only 4 stars because the advertising Free shipping is misleading.  Says in fine print below that you pay shipping but ordering the kit is free shipping. Also it would be nice if they had informed which post office providers actually mails the kits. Had to run around a few hours while the offices called their management to ask if they are able to just to be told not sure

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, sampling kit that was sent had very clear instructions and good quality. Used the fast track service and once samples were received at the lab we got the test results and certificate same day. We were let down by post turnaround which took 4 days and would recommend using next day delivery with Royal Mail. Customer services very quick in response, can’t fault the testing service and would you again if needed.

records.title: Clear instructions and full kit
records.text: Clear instructions on obtaining the sample and dispatching for testing. All equipment needed was supplied. It would have been a 5* but it took a couple of days longer than expected (although, in fairness, we did not take up the "urgent" option).

records.title: Great turnaround.
records.text: Service was great, received lab within the estimated time frame, report is well laid out & easy to read.  What could use work is the website, needs a link for registering kit. It would be great if the website had more or better info on sampling.

records.title: Quick results, awkward postage
records.text: Can't complain about the speed of the results. The samples were tested the same day they were received, and the results were emailed to me immediately as well.  The only issue I had with the whole thing was the pre-paid envelope. I ordered a ten sample kit, and the envelope was far too small to post all ten double-bagged samples without risking it splitting in transit, so I put the envelope inside another postage bag and paid for recorded delivery. A bigger envelope should really be supplied for the larger kits. Otherwise, no complaints.

records.title: Simple instructions and fast turnaround
records.text: Instructions were easy to follow and results came back as expected for 72 hour promise. Samples arrived at the lab Monday afternoon and results received afternoon on Thursday. Only worry was the sample bag seal ripped when I tried to open the Ziploc bag. Luckily a second larger bag is included to put the sample bag in.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service - clear instructions for sampling & quick processing. Only dropped one star because when I had selected an upgrade to fast track, it wasn’t obvious that this had happened & I was actually sent a text to ask if I would like to upgrade, after I had already paid for this service. However, when I emailed to check I got an immediate reply to confirm the upgrade, which was reassuring! Thank you for a speedy service.

records.title: I found the instructions and PPE easy…
records.text: I found the instructions and PPE easy to use. Although the one size fits all was way too big i was able to tie up the extra length.Once the USPS finally delivered the samples, the testing and notification was less than 48 hours.

records.title: Fast service and got the result (not…
records.text: Fast service and got the result (not the one we wanted!) the same day they received our sample.You receive very comprehensive instructions and a full set of protective clothing to be able to take the required sample.

records.title: Excellent service & advice
records.text: The process of taking a sample, sending it in, and getting my results was straightforward and seamless. It's a 5 star service. I've given four stars because the kit was sent to my old address rather than my new one. Something to do with shopify pay, I suspect, even though I corrected the address on my payment information.

records.title: Good Service but had to check what the result meant
records.text: Overall the service was very good although I did end up paying a little more than the headline advertised price. The only real negative thing is the use of acronyms for the results/certificate. I assumed this was telling me no asbestos found but had to do an internet search to confirm this is what the acronym meant.

records.title: A difficult service to review.
records.text: Kit sent very promptly.PPE good, but you may well need goggles too.The company took quite a long time to deliver results.  Samples were sent first-class on a Thursday, results came through 11 days (6 working days) later.  They said that the Post Office were late delivering the samples, but that seemed a long time to me.One would expect that this service is heavily regulated, monitored and therefore I assume that the results are accurate and reliable.

records.title: Five stars = perfection
records.text: Five stars = perfection, so no one gets that. With your same day service including acknowledgement of the samples received, the simple process to send the samples you're the next best thing. Oh and I got a negative result! Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Speedy Result
records.text: Really quick turn around on the result, so now we know what type of asbestos we are dealing with. I would recommend the testing side of it.  I requested help with quotes for removal/disposal, but this didn’t work so well.

records.title: Good test, slow post
records.text: It took 11 days from the time I posted the sample to get the result, but this was  due to a postal strike, not the fault of the company, which responded very quickly when I emailed to ask how things were going. The evidence suggests that the test was conducted entirely professionally. Happily the result was negative – No Asbestos Detected In Sample. A great relief.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: The results are written so small they are difficult to read. Enlarging them cuts off some of the report. You also can not use the report to show code enforcement so l wasted $35.00 plus postage.

records.title: skeptical with result, no human interaction
records.text: The instructions for collecting the sample weren’t completely clear or detailed, and the lack of detail in the report makes me skeptical of the result. I’d want there to be more interaction with staff/employees to directly ask questions, confirm sampling approach, etc.  It just felt like I was in the dark and alone in the process without any interaction with a person.

records.title: Zero context for results
records.text: Took the full 3 business days to process. Results contained no explanation or context. Bag says to include multiple samples and only one of ours was tested.

records.title: Whats quantifiable level???
records.text: As far as the collection pkt. and instructions, A+. Our results were great news except for one sample that showed <1% positive. We are questioning your small print at the btm of certificate that states that <1%is below the quantifiable level; what does this mean? We take the results seriously and hoped to get more a more discernable response.

records.title: The only downside was the delivery of…
records.text: The only downside was the delivery of the sample, from a royal mail 1st class box took a week. I appreciate it says there may be delays, but when I enquired they said it could be 10 days. First class? I think they should highlight this very explicitly and also use a service that offers better times as standard. Apart from that it was ok

records.title: Need clearer results
records.text: The reason I am giving you this rating is a) . We had to chase up the results because Scope did not even let the laboratory that they had received the samples. B) when you sent the certificate you never said that that chrysotile was asbestos.

records.title: All good and simple process
records.text: All good and simple process,  read the instructions in full first. missing a star because the sample bags were missing so had to improvise. and another because the gloves are so small and tight, they both ripped putting them on my tiny hands, had to improvise,  lucky the samples were clear

records.title: Test worked, but bad system.
records.text: Con's: constantly asked at every stage to upgrade to more samples or "fast track" through the lab.  Instructions were not clear on how to package the sample, only when reading through their website did they say that it had to be double bagged.Pro's: Everything provided in one package, easy to send off, quick response from the lab once package was recieved, allow's entry on phone number so recieved a text once sample was ready.

records.title: Did not get next day delivery service I…
records.text: Did not get next day delivery service I paid for and I don’t think it makes it clear when ordering that certain tools instruments are not included and doesn’t tell u at time or ordering what you will need.I also didn’t think instructions to take sample were one hindered percent clear.

records.title: Good & not so good service
records.text: Good & not so good service. Prompt test results on same day samples were received. However, analysis didn't specify % of asbestos present, especially in bitumen cutback adhesive, as it can be anything up to 85% - I feel it's important as I'm planning to remove it.

records.title: Package delivered incomplete
records.text: The sample came quickly, however I ordered and paid for 2 and only 1 sample bag arrived. I emailed , no one responded. Eventually I managed to get to speak to someone and they send the other bag. When it came to taking the sample, it turned out there was no instructions included in the bag....managed to take the sample anyway, sent it on and got the results quickly . 3* for this reason.

records.title: Everything was going fine up until the…
records.text: Everything was going fine up until the point of getting my results. Wasn’t 24hr as advertised - more like a week. I had to email, phone and contact Amazon before I got my results. Their reasoning? They don’t check social media frequently. Their phone also just goes to voicemail and their livechat is unmanned. Kit itself is good - shame about the customer service.

records.title: Good service but long turnaround
records.text: Easy service to use, well thought out and packaged. However, it was a 10 day turnaround from sending samples to recieving results. Not quite what was advertised, hence the 3 star review.

records.title: Reasonable instructions?
records.text: Reasonable instructions. Very quick and efficient. Wasn't happy with caveat in certified report. Who's the expert? Instructions should make it clear that this statement will be included in the report, if the sample is clear of asbestos. However, they should also be more exacting, clearer and include photo's of how to gather sampling accurately to give your client confidence.

records.title: The speed of the kit arriving was…
records.text: The speed of the kit arriving was fantastic, I sent it off the same day of the kit arriving and they received it and tested the next day! However disappointed that their was a IT difficulty and the results should have been emailed to me, but I had to email in to get sent the results. Would use again however would be mindful of the results issue.

records.title: The turnaround was quick and with…
records.text: The turnaround was quick and with helpful explanations.  However, much of the safety gear was missing from the pack that was sent out to us.  An explanation was given to us and is understandable under the current climate.  However, we weren't given a discount on the regular price for the missing PPE items.

records.title: 2 negatives, but really positive.
records.text: I have 2 reasons why I have only given a 3 star review:1- on the website it says they test the sample the day they receive it, and send results straight away, it has taken over a week for the results to come. 2- when the results came, it gave the name of the type of asbestos, but no guidance as to how dangerous it is, or any advice on how to deal with it  Other than that, they pack came quickly and it was very easy and straight forward to take the sample and send it off.

records.title: Fast service, low specificity
records.text: Fast service and easy to use and understand, however the standard testing does not give you an indication of how much of the asbestos fibres were in your sample as a %. If you want this level of specificity, worth finding a company that does it.

records.title: The instruction booklet was quite good…
records.text: The instruction booklet was quite good although isn't clear about the need for you to provide your own eye protection and the items delivered didn't quite match what was in the booklet. For £50+ I didn't expect to have to pay my own postage either to send the samples back.

records.title: Asbestos Sampling let down by Royal Mail
records.text: The kit is sent via royal mail so there's no guarantee it's arrives in 24 hours. My kit arrived without any instructions so there was further delay in having to contact Asbestos Sampling. They confirmed there was an issue with instructions being supplied with it's kits recently so had to get them to email the instructions instead. Once the samples were posted back, only got the results in 48 hours, as again, having to rely on royal mail to get the samples to Asbestos Sampling. Otherwise I'm happy with the results.

records.title: Not 72 hours results
records.text: Said 72 hours results. Sent on a Friday. They confirmed receipt on Monday (after I asked). Didn’t get results until Friday night (after I asked again). We finished our project before we got the results back.

records.title: Bad address on pre printed envelop
records.text: Apparently the address on the preprinted envelop was wrong or it had to be forwarded to another location. USPS wasn't clear exactly why it had to be forwarded.

records.title: Don’t expect results back in less than…
records.text: Don’t expect results back in less than a week.No option to send the sample back quicker, first class envelope apparently took 6 days to get to their Lab (no way of proving otherwise). Paid for fast results but still took until the end of the day. If you can wait the extra few hours save your money, the normal process gets the results back the next day anyway.

records.title: Good service but results are inconclusive
records.text: The service is well organized but the lab has only identified the fibres which is somewhat ineffectual in this case as it is the material that dictates the removal method that must be used. If you could include material information in the finale report that would be great! È.g. not only CHRYSOTILE but CHRYSOTILE cement.

records.title: Took ages
records.text: Took ages.  Royal Mail they said, but not sure it takes 10 days for them to delivery a jiffy bag...

records.title: Ignored by customer service
records.text: The test kit was comprehensive and had everything I needed to gather samples (PPE, containers, disposal bags, etc).The results (digital) were detailed and of professional quality.However, I paid for a printed certificate as part of my order (£3.99).It never arrived.I then followed their customer support process to enquire (online form).They didn't respond.I then emailed instead.They told me that they would send it to me.It never arrived.I then emailed again to chase this.They never responded.With zero support, I won't be using them again.

records.title: Some hiccups...
records.text: Some hiccups...Quick results but the address on my certificate was wrong, so it is useless to show tenants or prospective buyers. I've thrice asked for this to be rectified, and am still waiting for a corrected certificate. Secondly, I think the return postage should be prepaid. When handling potentially hazardous material you don't want to be going to the post office as well. Other companies offer a prepaid return envelope.

records.title: Sample not received?
records.text: Sent off sample,chased after a few days was told it hadn't been received check again in a few days. Checked again still not received was told it must have got lost in the post. Was sent another kit posted off another sample. Next day got the results of the first sample that they never received!!Very professional.

records.title: Sampling kit arrived with no sample…
records.text: Sampling kit arrived with no sample bags included. Eventually found contact number for company on confirmation e mail (not visible anywhere on website) and called. Male answered and apologised for missing 4 x  bags but stated ordinary zip lock / freezer bags would ok to use as replacement. Kit submitted to laboratory 17th May and now 28th May with no update. Still waiting for results and wondering if should have used another company.

records.title: No instructions with the pack
records.text: No instructions with the pack. E mailed to get instructions no response. Finally rang and got the instructions e mailed. Then realised there was no sample form enclosed, so had to ring back and get that e mailed to me.Once i had everything the process worked, but frustrating having to chekc and ring for everything.

description:
We make security simple with NO MONTHLY FEES and we're local to you!

We visit your property and show you the systems that we have available. We will advise you on the best options to suit your property, but leave you free to choose which system you would like a quote on, with no obligation.

If you decide to use our services we provide hassle free installation and as much free tuition as you require before leaving your property.

We provide ongoing technical assistance should you feel it is required. Our friendly approachable staff are always at the other end of the telephone to help if needed.

We use the very latest technology to provide simple to use systems at affordable prices. All our prices include installation by professional fitters. We also take the time to connect your new security systems up to your home devices (T.V, Tablet, Phone etc.) to give you peace of mind wherever you may be. 

We offer FREE security surveys to see where you may benefit from the latest security technology along with a no-obligation quote on carrying out the work. 

Interest free credit, Buy Now Pay Later and other finance options are available. and Local

records.title: A satisfied customer
records.text: The operative turned up a little earlier than expected. Which was a pleasant surprised. He confirmed what he was going to and where the CCTV cameras were going to be fitted. He then got to work on the installation. He worked without stopping until the job was completed. He then tidied up and showed me how the system worked.

records.title: This company is first class
records.text: I found the service throughout very easy to go along with. The chap who came to assess my requirements was understanding , listened to what I wanted and explained various installions possible and never put me under pressure. The engineer who installed my wired system was very tidy working in and around the house. He installed the system as I wanted. And he installed tv connections and mobile app . I was and am very pleased with the whole job … enquiring to completion

records.title: All staff have been professional and…
records.text: All staff have been professional and polite at all times. Nothing is too much trouble. Staff are very knowledgeable.

records.title: Seamless, fast experience.
records.text: From the initial visit, then surveyor and finally the fitting has been a seamless and extremely fast experience.Thanks to each of you but must mention the fitter Martin. Wouldn't know he'd been here. Quick fitting and absolutely no mess left behind. Thanks to you all.

records.title: Brilliant 5 star service
records.text: I had my system fitted inn 2019 and was negative about contact issues on the first day, the company put that right, since then I have had to contact them a couple of times with first class response. Today messaged in a problem due to a change of router and get a call back almost by return from Iran who was absolutely brilliant, involved another person who was technically in the Premier league and way too clever for my simple brain. They will visit after the Christmas/New year holidays to sort my problems out for good.

records.title: Professional
records.text: Went about their business very professionally and new their business inside out.Every detailed explained and details given for after sales service.Left me very confident of full support from a professional company.

records.title: A job well done
records.text: From when Jeff called to explain everything in a pleasant knowledgeable way to Jamie saying goodbye after a job well done the whole process was amazing. All staff involved were friendly, patient and extremely knowledgeable. We now have a superb system installed and wish to say a big thank you to everyone.

records.title: Home alarm
records.text: Chris the engineer who fitted our alarm did a fantastic job for us. He was very polite and explained the system with great patience. He left our property clean and tidy so a big thank you to Chris.Thank you Eyesec for a really great system and thank you to all your team for all the work done , With 3 dogs we needed an alarm system that we could use with the dogs still able to move around the bungalow .

records.title: Installation carried out efficiently…
records.text: Installation carried out efficiently with minimum fuss and no mess at all.The work was carried out by Martin to our total satisfaction.

records.title: Chris upgraded my system in an …
records.text: Chris upgraded my system in an  efficient and friendly manner.Everything was explained clearly with all questions answered. Didn't take too long and I'm very happy with the upgraded system - thank you

records.title: Martin worked quickly and explained how…
records.text: Martin worked quickly and explained how the system worked.

records.title: GOOD SYSTEM WHEN SET UP CORRECTLY
records.text: I found Andy and Ben who installed my system friendly and they left my property clean and tidy. The new colour night vision cameras are great. It was only a few hours before I realised that there are several problems. Frustratingly it is going to be over two weeks before an engineer can visit to rectify these issues.Recording the local animals and birds is not my idea of A CCTV system.

records.title: Upgraded Security
records.text: Both Geoff and Andy were friendly, professional and attentive. There was no extra pressure to upgrade my system. When I had made my decision everything was organised to accommodate my extant appointments and preferences. There was no mess left behind.The installation was carried out and tested efficiently. The difference between the upgraded system and the original was remarkable.I would have given 5 stars, but the Freeview box, which was disconnected to make access to the control box easier was not reconnected afterwards. I did manage to make the reconnections but with some physical difficulty. To be fair, andy was feeling somewhat unwell because of the heat and this was the only problem.I would have no hesitation in recommending Eyesec.

records.title: Good, but not quite as promised
records.text: Engineer who changed the cameras was polite and helpful. System works well but not as described by the salesman. We have to turn notifications off during the day as the cameras pick up every movement which we were told it wouldn't.

records.title: System and personnel
records.text: The personnel and the installation both were fine. The system works well but I would have liked a written booklet to explain the settings. I was told but its a lot to remember.

records.title: Fitted and working well.
records.text: Fitters were due to arrive around 2, but arrived at 3.30. They set to and did the job with a minimum of disruption. They were cheerful and friendly and did exactly what had been planned by the original salesman and subsequent engineer. Afterwards they put back all that had been moved. I had left the house by then, as I was due out at 6.30. Drilling creates a certain amount of dust which had to be vacced up the following day, but otherwise all had been done and the cameras are doing their job. Very impressed with the night view.A user's handbook would be helpful.

records.title: Ryan was very pleasant
records.text: Ryan was very pleasant. He was very polite and respectful and competent.I did not expect the system box would be so noisy. And the flashing red light is annoying.I hope that the technical team can help me with this.

records.title: sold the wrong product
records.text: sold the wrong product. Spoke to the company and was advised I' d be called back, but no call back! No trust in this company at the moment?After speaking with the company they handled the issue in a professional manner and returned my deposit in a timely manner.Thanks

records.title: Our fitter Ross
records.text: Our fitter, Ross, ended up being here for 8 hours. At no time was he unpleasant or rushing to get away. He stayed until everything was up and running and a handover given. A credit to the company.

records.title: Late arrival due to snow but very satisfactory.
records.text: Late arrival due to snow but very friendly pair of workers.Problems with faulty  fittings delayed completion, but all were fixed.

records.title: Replacing our aged alarm...
records.text: We wanted to replace our aged alarm system and integrate it with easily accessible cctv. Eyesec came out and advised on positioning of cameras and sensors, enabling us to find our balance between cost and functionality. A couple of days their installation engineer did an excellent job of installing the cameras where required but concealing the cabling.

records.title: Installation was very good
records.text: Installation was very good, cameras just need an tweek to make everything A1.  Usual service is very quick, so just need to contact the team to sort.

records.title: Image quality and system functionality excellent.
records.text: Sales demo was very thorough, fitters arrived with the wrong system, quickly rectified and system as ordered fitted the following week. Image and system functionality is excellent. Highly recommended.

records.title: Did not get enough time to understand…
records.text: Did not get enough time to understand the working of the cameras need more instructions on working the system please  John Carney

records.title: Good contact from the company
records.text: Good contact from the company. Quick installation from the Rep coming out to the installation. Installer was friendly , informative and patiently explained the workings of the cameras and system .

records.title: All people involved in the installation…
records.text: All people involved in the installation were professional and explained the process clearly. The after sales service has been excellent.

records.title: Spent time getting right and spent time…
records.text: Spent time getting right and spent time showing me how it all worked.

records.title: No issue
records.text: No issue. Nice clean install.

records.title: Your engineer was on time and was…
records.text: Your engineer was on time and was polite in his manner throughout the stay in my house,His work was clean & tidy.  He provided a good , comprehensive explanation of my new camera system.Overall I’m very happy with Eyesec and would recommend them to my family & friends.

records.title: The system fit was perfect and the guy…
records.text: The system fit was perfect and the guy gave us full instructions. The sales rep was not as good.when asked if fitting would be best left until after the house was rendered she said no because if we waited then there would be problems with the render guarantee . WRONG. So now the system has to be dismounted and refit .

records.title: The brick at the rear of my house was…
records.text: The brick at the rear of my house was damaged during installation.

records.title: Overpriced
records.text: We’ve had the cctv for 6months now. Disappointed and feel it’s been over priced. Motion detectors on the cameras don’t always pick up people coming and going, so we don’t get notifications. Then other times they are set off by cats and birds, which we were told wouldn’t happen.

records.title: Customer service
records.text: After sharing my experience with Eyesec in a review here I have received a phone call from them and just want to say I really appreciate that, we had a chance to explain situation from both sides, I may consider using their services in a future as it definitely shows to me that they care about their customer service

records.title: We were given wrong information.
records.text: We were given wrong information from there rep about having the camera's set up on my mobile phone we did not have wi fi, But speaking to a Directer of the company who was very good at sorting problems out for us we now have wi fi, we would like to say a big thank you to Roxanne.from Sheila & Brian.

records.title: Poor Customer Service
records.text: The DVR kicked us off about and asked for an admin log in. I've tried emailing, I've tried phoning and no one gets back to us. They say the CCTV video stays on the system for 30 days but we get 2 weeks at best sometimes not even that.We're supposed to have a members number we can contact them on but none of the paperwork has this number, just the generic customer service number which they seem to ignore.Edit: Following my 1 star review I was inundated with calls to fix my issue and sort the problem out. They were apologetic and resolved the issue.Edit2: Following my Upgrade to a 3 star review, Eyesec replied quoting a number of times (no dates - I assume this is all pertaining to the date I originally left the 1 star review... as that is when I started receiving responses) in an attempt to discredit my rating.So for a clearer timeline...I first tried to contact Eyesec via their website "Contact us" page regarding the issue of is being logged out of the admin account (for which my personal username and password didn't work... the admin details were never shared with us) I don't recall the exact date, mid to late august.Having received no response I called on the 1st September 2021 @15:00 and left a voicemail.Following a further two weeks of no response I called again on the 15th September 2021 @08:32 leaving another voicemail.Still no response - so I posted a review and had 5 phonecalls before the day was up.

records.title: Good Product and Installation....Need to address some Administration Aspects
records.text: I would rate the product and the workmanship of the installation engineers as very high and have no issues whatsoever with this aspect of the company. However I feel that the organisation let themselves down in two "customer support areas".Firstly in Customer Liaison. The salesperson who initially visited, and prior to scheduling an installation date and time, gave the clear impression that work would be completed by 4.00 pm. The morning installation was changed at the request of the company to the afternoon. The engineers did not arrive until 3.45 pm and although they worked tirelessly there was still quite a lot of work to do by 7.00 pm. Unaware that the job would take so long, I had to ask them to leave since I had another appointment that could not be rescheduled. They did however return the next morning and completed the installation within a couple of hours.I would have thought it appropriate that some forewarning be given regarding the estimated installation time and any late working.Secondly Quality of Operating InstructionsAlthough the engineer explained and demonstrated the system the only instructions left were the product instructions provided by the manufactures of the cameras and recorder. Although I appreciate that each system they install are probably slightly different to each other, I would have thought that a General Instruction sheet could, and should be, compiled by the company has a “memory jogger” covering the common points of a system, particularly given the cost of the system.I would reiterate that the engineer’s explanation and demonstration was thorough but like most of these things when at a future date you need to clarify or reset something this often when the details have been forgotten. I therefore believe that a General Instruction Sheet(s) would constitute a significant improvement to this particular area.

records.title: Recent experience
records.text: HHmmOkay, so looking for home security from a good supplier, chose this one due to the mosly rave reviews so contacted them online.Nice guy,Jonathan called said he could do next day 12.00 to 12.30, sure enough 12.30 came and in steps Steve, nice enough guy , told him straight I want home security but I dont want wires all over the house, what can you do?He said sorry we dont do wireless systems, he said even the PIR's are wired up.I questioned this and he repeated it so I politely showed him the door. went onto the Eyesec website where it says they do 'fully wireless sytems' and showed the wife to make sure I wasnt hallucinating.next thing phone goes and its Jonathan, tells me there's probobly  been a mix up in communication and he will call back when hes found someone else to schedule a visit, still waiting over a day later, so Im treally sorry guys but its a 2 from me.Update18th June, okay since this review Brendon from Eyesec called around and gave me everything I asked for in the first place so I dunno what the first visit was about maybe he was just having a bad day, anyhow we went right through the house and found solutions to all my concerns for both Alarm and security Cameras and I now have prices for both, dont know yet if ill pursue but my faith has been resored in Eyesec at least.

records.title: Poor sales experience
records.text: I have had quite a journey with eyesec and non too favourable.I am aware of the impact customers reviews can have on companies so I will be fair and factual but I must voice my concerns on how I feel I was misled with the quotes received and whilst this was packaged up as a fantastic deal, it was no such thing.I agreed earlier this year for the company to send a sales rep to demo their product and provide me with a quote.  I appreciate that they have a job to do and there was going to be a lot of sales tactics going on.  After two hours the rep had gone through her pitch and provided me with a quote.  A very high quote which, I decided not to sign up to despite her trying to close the deal on the day.Fast forward 4 months later.  Eyesec contacted me to ask if I could give them some feedback on my appointment and the quote received.  I informed them of the very long meeting and the price which I concluded was far too high for me and did not want to purchase the product.  They agreed and also agreed the quote seemed high, they asked if they could send a manager to come and see me as they could give a much better price.  I reluctantly and maybe somewhat naively agreed and was promised the appointment would only be about 20 minutes.An hour and a half later and after a lot of hard sell and an offer of a significant discount which would come out of their marketing budget so they could make the deal work for me, I couldn't believe that they actually quoted me a higher price than earlier in the year.  When I challenged them about it and showed them the paperwork, the situation became uncomfortable and the manager proceeded to tell me that the original rep must have quoted me wrong in the first place..So much for them coming out again to give me the deal of the century, had I not had the paperwork (which I had to ask for as she did not offer to leave it) then I could have been out of pocket quite significantly.To conclude, I was absolutely aware there would be a sales pitch, I take responsibility for agreeing to a second visit but I was disappointed that they seemed to be taking me for a ride with the price and it seemed almost unbelievable that they did not do their homework and check what I'd been quoted before despite the fact that following every visit the rep has to call the deal in at the end of the appointment.  Will not trust this company again unfortunately.

records.title: i have had the security cameras 2…

records.title: A completely smooth move, for which we probably paid more than necessary
records.text: The 'move' (it was not a complete house move, just a shifting of some belongings from my late parents' place) went completely smoothly in every respect. Five stars for that.However, due largely to inexperience, we had booked much too large a van (we filled less than a quarter of the space), two men where maybe only one was really needed, and probably twice as much of their time as was necessary anyway. I am not certain how much needless cost this entailed, because the pricing structure is quite opaque, but my hunch is that we probably paid something like twice as much as we need have.When booking all this, I did explain to someone I now believe was the proprietor roughly what we expected to need to move. He did not even suggest that I might have been over-ordering. I think it might have been useful if he had at least mentioned the possibility.Anyway, better to have too much room etc than too little, I suppose!PS.   Finest Van telephoned me to discuss my concerns. They gave me a very modest refund, which I took as a welcome gesture of goodwill, although it made no real difference to the economics. They are good to deal with, though, and, having learned my lesson, I would be content to use them again if the need arose.
