records.title: Super helpful and friendly service from the start
records.text: Super helpful and friendly service from booking to the collection itself. Prices were competitive as well. Unfortunately, there was some confusion with the quantity of rubbish being collected, therefore the price increased, however, Bryan was super apologetic about the confusion, so they gave me a reduced price for the inconvenience. Overall, pleased with the service, and would recommend to anyone.

records.title: Good, would use again
records.text: The two guys who collected my declutter items were great and worked hard, booking was easy and Bryan kept me informed, the only niggle is it seemed quite expensive but I liked they say they give appropriate items to charity shops (rather than everything just going to recycling tip). Would use again.

records.title: The two Dans(!) who came to clear the…
records.text: The two Dans(!) who came to clear the flat were kind, reassuring and couldn't have been more helpful. They worked really hard moving awkward pieces of furniture and really knew their stuff. Thank you Dan and Dan ! Unfortunately I wasn't told  beforehand by head office that the washer dryer machine needed to be disconnected by a plumber or that paint pots would cost £4 each to remove ..but all in all a good job and nice to know some things will go on to another home or be recycled . Thank you JustClear .

records.title: They were very efficient and had really…
records.text: They were very efficient and had really great communication via email which made things really easy. Only one thing that I struggled with and that was that they arrived 40 min early. Luckily the manager was in at 8am that morning. However we have classes running and I did request to arrive at 9am. This could have resulted in no pne being there.  So that’s the only thing that wasn’t very helpful. Apart from that they were great! And would book with them again knowing that they could arrive very early and plan for this.

records.title: Poor Initial Service But Good Company Response
records.text: UPDATED: I had a bad experiece with Just Clear [detailed below] but Brendan O'Shea, the company CEO, has been in touch to rectify the situation and has been exemplary. I have obtained a suitable refund and also feel that my complaints will be acted upon. As a result I have updated my rating from 1* to 3* which is an average of the following:Initial service 1*Response from Company 5*---------------------------------------------------------------I chose this company as they had 5* reviews across the board. Even when they asked for payment up front (and my internal alarm bells went off) I stuck with them. I wish I hadn't. They charged £200 to take away a settee and armchair before noon on the designated day but by 11 had not turned up. I had to call a couple of times (after being told they'd ring back and didn't) and eventually spoke to a manager who said they'd be there by 2pm (when I should have been at work) and he agreed to refund me £50. They did turn up before 2pm but weren't very professional (the younger one kept jamming his fingers and complaining when trying to get the stuff out of the doors) and I wasn't impressed after paying £200. I never did get the refund. When writing this review I discovered I didn't have the option to rate the branch I'd used. How convenient! Avoid. Avoid. Avoid.

records.title: Let down last minute
records.text: Arranged and paid (bank transfer) for some items to be taken from my elderly mums house. £168 to take a table, couple of chairs and some rugs. Quite expensive but It had to be done on that particular day as I had time of work to sort it out to let mum move back home after a fall. They cancelled the day before leaving me no time to sort anything else’s out. They have tried to remedy but timeline didn’t work. I would probably give them another chance but would be a little wary unless you can be flexible with times.

records.title: Very responsive company, unfortunately turned up late
records.text: Very responsive company and nice drivers. I was booked in between 9 and 12 but was collected late around 1.30pm which caused a bit of stress as I was moving.

records.title: You were 90 minutes late arriving
records.text: You were 90 minutes late arriving. The charge of c £500 is steep for about 45 minutes work. But the job was done and the team was polite

records.title: Amended review:
records.text: I had a bad experience with Just Clear, with poor communication and no show. But I have amended the poor review I originally gave them on 31 October because they have gone to great lengths to apologise, and also to offer me compensation in the form of free clearance. I appreciate these efforts. We all make mistakes sometimes and they have demonstrated that they care and want to put things right. Ivon Asquith

records.title: Quick clear our, massive delay in getting to me.
records.text: The pick-up of our house items was very efficient itself. But huge mix up with timing and delay on Just Clear part which meant a bit of chaos during my working day.

records.title: Terrible experience at first, but the company leadership have gone to great lengths to correct this.
records.text: Update:I have revised my review from 1 star to 3 stars in light of how their leadership team responded and followed up on the situation - Brendan and his team have done a stellar job and it is obvious that they have great passion for not only their brand but also their customers. My bad experience is clearly an anomaly and one they have gone to great lengths to correct which is encouraging to see.To summarize what happened:I used to work in the industry (junk removal) so know all too well how to calculate volume, estimate labor required, etc. However, sadly when asked Just Clear for a quote to remove 4 cubic yards of garden (green) waste from my front yard, the representative from their bookings team (Beth) attempted to overcharge me, first in terms of volume and then by wanting to add additional labour when I called her out on overestimating the volume (I gave the specific amount and she wanted to charge for a lot more...).I queried this with her, explaining that I really do have no more than 4 cubic yards worth of green waste to clear and it is conveniently located in my front drive, meaning the van reverses in & throws it in the back (10 - 15 minutes worth of labor max so no justifiable need for the extra labour), but sadly she did not respond well to having her estimates challenged and insisted "those are our prices" with a take it or leave it attitude / reaction and this cost the company my business (insignificant as that particular bit of business may be). To back up my point, one of their competitors (Clearabee) did the job for significantly less.That being said, the follow up by Brendan and his leadership team has been stellar and as a result my view has changed from "will never use them" to "willing to ask for a quote next time I need something cleared".Perhaps some training needed for the staff in the bookings team - when a client specifies not only the type of waste, but also the actual volume of it to be removed, there's no justification for giving a quote which completely ignores this information...

records.title: Hopefully more reliable in the future
records.text: Never had a worse experience. Booked for a sofa removal day before I was set to move out. They confirmed the appointment for same day, but never showed until the next morning. edit: I was given a sincere apology and a full refund + more for my trouble, and I'm glad that they have said new measures have been put in place to ensure a situation like this does not happen again.

records.title: Tried to change collection details after payment
records.text: My previous review, based on the speed with which the booking was confirmed, was 5 stars. However, shortly after confirming the booking and taking payment, Brendan twice attempted to change the day of the delivery, which I thought was unprofessional and quite shady. As a result, I did not feel comfortable using Just Clear and have requested to cancel the booking.

records.title: Clearance Cowboys!!!
records.text: I went ahead with Just Clear on a recommendation from an estate agent. They were expensive compared to all the other quotes I’d obtained but I thought it looked professional and they presented an eco-friendly image. The team of two arrived and was very polite and professional, I had a garage to be cleared as I was moving home. Whilst 70% of the job was done I overheard the driver on the phone to the boss being told that the van (diesel by the way- not sure how this is eco-friendly!) had to be returned back immediately. The driver was apologetic but he had no choice but to leave me hanging. Although he left a member of staff to help, I was left having to hire another van to step in on short notice to clean up the mess Just Clear had put me in. On top of that they kept pushing me to pay. I phoned the company and left a message to discuss payment and the job but no one got back to me. I was then emailed to pay an extra amount (£72 more than what was originally agreed), I made the bank transfer and hope never to deal with this company again. Absolute scam artists. Avoid like the plague!!

records.title: 3/10 for effort just not great on the…
records.text: 3/10 for effort just not great on the follow through and final.Additional charges levied as it took the team longer to clear the load. However they unwilling to take additional items well within their additional charged time.

records.title: Poor experience for me unfortunately
records.text: Seems they reported my review illegitimately to hide it:Poor experience for me unfortunately, maybe it’s not normally but for me it was :(

records.title: Bad pricing
records.text: Bad pricing, super expensive and they’ll try add extras for paint after saying they take anything.

records.title: A Very good Service and the chaps were…
records.text: A Very good Service and the chaps were polite and very professional.

description: Professional gutter cleaning company providing residential and commercial gutter cleaning services.

records.title: We have today had our gutters cleared…
records.text: We have today had our gutters cleared by Lucian Sfarcioc in Basingstoke. What a great service and nice guy. He was very thorough and gave some good advice about installing an additional down pipe to help with excess water in one area which I will act on. We have used this company before and would definitely recommend them and Lucian!

records.title: Blocked gutters sorted
records.text: I rang for a quote and received a response the same day over the telephone, a big bonus to get this sorted on a Saturday. I was kept up to date with my appointment via email, and via telephone on the day my gutters were cleaned.A gentleman arrived and treated me and my property with respect which was much appreciated. I would definitely use this company again for future work needed.

records.title: Booking was easy
records.text: Booking was easy, and due to weather our appointment had to be rescheduled, again easily and quickly sorted.  I then had to go out and retuened to find our gutters were cleaned. Great service.

records.title: Really happy with the service
records.text: Really happy with the service. This is the second time I've used Ben's Gutters and they made time for me on Xmas eve! I'm extremely pleased with the quality of work, communication and general excellence. Thanks especially to Norbert Weis who I hope will come back and do them again next year.

records.title: Ben’s Gutters Ltd - Jason Newcastle
records.text: Opted for the Full Clearing and Cleaning Service. Jason from Newcastle arrived on time and did a great job. Polite, courteous and very thorough. Appointment was booked for 10 Jan 2025 but managed to squeeze me in earlier on 30 December. Great Professional job all round. Communication from start to finish was excellent.

records.title: Excellent work by Ben's Gutters
records.text: The men who visited us - Lee G and Jordan W - did an excellent job - and went over and beyond the call of duty by showing us photos of our gutters - blocked by pigeon faeces.  They gave us advice

records.title: Guttering cleaning
records.text: The process from booking to paying to having the work carried out was simple and straightforward. Each part of the process put me in touch with friendly, professional efficient team members. I would not use any other company for this work in the future.

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: We weren't at home for the rescheduled appointment, but were happy for the work to be done.. I was phoned beforehand & asked for permission to enter the garden, which I was happy with, then I was informed after the work was completed.

records.title: A trustworthy Company
records.text: The work completed by the cleaner from Ben's Gutters was friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable. The previous week the allocated cleaner had failed to attend. The manager took a lot of trouble to ensure that the job was completed on time the following week. The cleaner drove from Bristol to Bideford.

records.title: Had some problems with moss filling up…
records.text: Had some problems with moss filling up my gutters, so I decided to search on line for a company to sort things out. I was impressed by the outlay of Ben's Gutters, so I paid the going rate, and this morning, Shaun turned up with his van and ladder. After dealing with the back and front gutters, Shaun showed me the photos, and the gutters was as clean as a whistle.A perfect job, well done, in a very quick time by a guy who was curteous and friendly thoughout.I will certainly come back to Ben's Gutters, the next time my gutters are filling up again.Peter.

records.title: After a few re-arranged appointments
records.text: After a few re-arranged appointments, it went very well and the work was accomplished quickly and effectively

records.title: Friendly and helpful service.
records.text: Arranging the cleaning was straight-forwards enough, unfortunately there were a couple of hiccups with the first two dates arranged, but our property name is a bit obscured.  Once the found though, the cleaners were friendly, helpful and efficient.  Would use again

records.title: Gutter clearance
records.text: Thorough job, with clearance confirmed by digital photos of each section of gutter. Checked and confirmed that the gutter joints and clips are sound and down pipes clear. Waste bagged tidyly.

records.title: Very simple booking service and a…
records.text: Very simple booking service and a friendly customer focussed experience. Overall, a very positive service.

records.title: Fast to respond
records.text: Bens cleaners were fast to respond and set up appointment.  The cleaner arrived at the time they said they would and was polite, friendly respectful and efficient.

records.title: Your operative Norbert Weis was…
records.text: Your operative Norbert Weis was brilliant. He did a good job and was very friendly and cheerful wouldn’t hesitate to have him back whenever needed

records.title: Good Experience
records.text: Using Ben's Gutters has been a very positive experience, the chap that did the work was knowledgeable and gave good advice on maintenance of the gutters. He arrived on time and worked dilegenty. Will book again.

records.title: Having used Bens Gutters last year I…
records.text: Having used Bens Gutters last year I was confident that they would do a good job and they did not disappoint. In this era of rising prices I was pleased that the price was the same this year. The cleaner arrived bang on time and did a thorough job and was a real asset for your company

records.title: Quick, Efficient & surprisingly worry free
records.text: Phoned up for a quote & from our verbal description they gave us one that seemed reasonable considering other quotes we've had elsewhere.Decided to book & when we gave our details, they remembered us...from 2009!! (We can't even remember ever phoning them, but they remembered we had a flat roof round back)Was told a date they'll arrive & they phoned up the day before (~6-7pm) to confirm & gave us an expected time of arrival (it was early - between 7:30-8:30am).Peter turned up exactly 7:30 & after a quick chat to confirm the job to be done, got straight to work. Finished in about 1hr & cleared up a majority of the mess (some bits on drive needed a bit of a wash down as they got trodden in a bit)Payment is NOT done personally but Peter told us the company will get in touch for payment (they called following day). We're not ones who like giving card details over phone but they sent an email with details on how to pay over website (not tech savvy - don't even have email so got son to do it all for me). Everything went smoothly & he got receipt of payment within minutesDefinitely keeping number handy for possible future work

records.title: Polite, prompt, professional
records.text: Bryan Kelly was right on time, considerate and honest in his assessment as there were some difficult to access areas at the rear of the house. However, he was able to carry out the work conscientiously with minimum fuss. He was polite in his interactions with us and the work was done efficiently.Thanks, Bryan

records.title: Sam Hawkins from Bens Gutters was very…
records.text: Sam Hawkins from Bens Gutters was very polite and efficient today when cleaning our gutters, understood the problems we have and sorted it all out. Hope to see him next year.

records.title: Langdale Road
records.text: Ben's Gutters man came a little earlier than expected and cleared the guttters around our semi-detached house with his special equipment. The job was completed quite quickly. He checked the result on the video screen attached to his machine. He appeared to be satisfied with the result and it is the case that in spite of heavy rain since the work was done the gutters no longer overflow.

records.title: Professional team
records.text: Everyone on the phone was polite and helpful. There were a couple of dates changed but I was kept informed. Marcin who came was very efficient and neat and tidy. He showed me all the gutters via the camera and he found a little plastic pot that was blocking the gutter. On time, polite and informative, really happy.

records.title: After a cancellation due to bad weather…
records.text: After a cancellation due to bad weather I was quickly given another appointment. Kevin Rowe turned up promptly and was very courteous. He did a great job on checking and cleaning, and gave feedback on what he had done. Very pleased with the service provided

records.title: Gutter Repair and Clean.
records.text: The leak from a gutter joint is now sorted and the gutters, facias and soffits were all cleaned. I have a window cleaner who uses a similar telescopic brush system and he brings his own water supply in his van. My water is metered and the operative from Ben's required use of my water supply so bear in mind that cost is over and above. Pleased with the result of the clean and repair though.

records.title: Operative Sam was great, but booking system not so much
records.text: Had it been for Sam alone, who came round today, it would have been 5/5. He was great - professional, courteous and friendly and did a very thorough job. I was really pleased with the service he provided. However, my dealings with the office to set up an appointment in the first place left a lot to be desired as two appointments were cancelled at the last minute and new dates given without consulting me, despite me saying at the outset that I had limited availability and needed to agree a date beforehand.

records.title: Feedback
records.text: See many bad reviews and queries on Price - so take time to place the order and ensure all details are fully supplied - like taking the waste away. Seem to be Edinburgh based. Cannot complain SAM from Whitehills did a good job and was very polite and accommodating. Normally do all the gutters myself house, garage , cabin, so job done 8out of 10 compared to myself, as I normally wash the gutters all out, Have gutter caps/gaurds on all down pipes which are tied to the gutter bracket. Would use them again subject of ensuring pre-agreed price.

records.title: John did a great job
records.text: John did a great job. There was efficient communication on booking and clear explanation of the work that was done on the day. Today, after John cleaned them, the gutters i can see look much healthier than they did yesterday!

records.title: Fair
records.text: The guy was pleasant & completed all the work requested.  Had a small leak on one of the corners but this was fixed.

records.title: Great job
records.text: Would have been 5 stars except that our original appointment was cancelled, then rearranged and on another occasion nobody arrived. However, when they did arrive they did a brilliant job. Alex was personable, polite, explained what he was doing and worked swiftly and efficiently. Certainly the best option for our tall house!

records.title: The process needs some work!
records.text: It's the 2nd time using, the 1st time I wasn't there but I was here for the 2nd time, I think the guy who turned up did a reasonable job although missed our highest gutters and hidden ones, All the rubbish from the gutter was left on our flat roof so I am having to clean that up myself and the call center keeps ringing me every day chasing for payment even though I have confirmed payment each time

records.title: Gutters not cleaned properly initially, resolved on further visit.
records.text: Booking was fine, gutter cleaner turned up spent around an hour.  I checked the gutters after and it looked like they'd hardly done any work. Contacted them by phone and was told I'd get a call back but haven't received anything. Update - resolved few days later, cleaner came back and covered missed sections.

records.title: quick and reliable
records.text: i recently contacted bens gutters on a friday and they were scheduled to come out on the following Monday being the last call of the day.. unfortunately due to unforeseen circumstances on their part,  they could not attend due to issues with ladders. They attended the next day early in the morning to carry out the work and Daniel was polite, courteous,quick and cleared the guttering above the conservatory. No mess was made and the job was finished within 20-25 minutes.

records.title: An average at best service
records.text: An average at best serviceI got Ben's Gutters in to clean my house's gutters. I've read other reviews from them where they've received before and after pics, 5 star quality service. The operative they sent out for me was in and out in less than half an hour. £150 for half an hour's work feels quite expensive. One plus is they did arrive on time.In the future I would probably look for a more reasonably priced company if this how long the work actually takes.

records.title: 5* for cleaner Jason from Newcastle. 1* for everything else.
records.text: 5* for cleaner Jason from Newcastle. 1* for everything else, so met in the middle. We have had a, mixed, experience with Ben's Gutters.Our first appointment was cancelled last minute. At our rescheduled appointment, the cleaner showed up, stayed for 10 minutes max, refused to do one gutter saying it couldn't be done and the others barely cleaned at all bar a mild scrape through the middle of the muck in them. We called back to try and get someone back out, and after another THREE back to back cancelled appointments, and two weeks later, the company sent out Jason, who was absolutely spot on. Stayed for way longer, cleaned every gutter, including the one we were told couldn't be done. Hosed them all through and kept us informed of exactly what he was doing throughout the entire process. Annoying that the rest of the service has let the overall score down, because if we had Jason from the get go, it would have been a 5* review.

records.title: As an older lady
records.text: As an older lady, alone,I had no means of determining whether the gutters needed cleaning, but thought it proper to do so.One side of my gutters was completely clean ..so paying up front cost me a lot of money for nothing. Had the property been seen for a quote, surely it would have been cheaper. Regarding the service  and punctuality, no complaints

records.title: Payment requesting method made me uncomfortable
records.text: Service was great and the young man who completed was very polite. The payment method was strange and didn’t feel secure. Phoned and texted by different numbers asking for payments. In the world of scams I will never pay for a service from an unknown number or text message. When I phoned the number off the website I was cut off 3 times. Need to review payment method. Wouldn’t recommend due to this.

records.title: Happy overall with service
records.text: Happy overall with service. Gutters cleaned and disposed of in our green garden waste bin, very respectful worker. Be aware of the quotes, make sure you get everything documented and included in the quote.  I have nearly been charged and extra £50 to take down and replace bird spikes which was clearly documented and included  in the original quote.

records.title: rebalancing be wary review last week
records.text: I wrote a review last week entitled be wary, I would like to put the record straight to a degree. As another review highlighted communication can be an issue. I would say they did come as originally agreed, they seem to do a professional job. On balance would I use them again, yes

records.title: I’ve used this company in the past
records.text: I’ve used this company in the past. Are these reviews on TrustPilot based on individual franchises under the Bens Gutter brand? If so, I think it’s not clear to people looking for a service to base experience on global reviews rather than local teams!

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Appear to be a very professional outfit with sign-written vans; automated email and text responses and invoicing and an 0800 number. The guys answering the phone were pleasant and friendly.What I am disappointed with though is that the lack of movement on the price.I was quoted £135 (which I of course have paid) for "what could be 2hrs work", they said. The chap came and went within half an hour.I rang, hoping they could do something for me due to the short duration, perhaps 10% off on this occasion but no.It's a shame and in my opinion, a short-sighted way to run a business.For the sake of what, £10-£15, they would have left a happy customer, ready to return next time. Instead, I am disappointed in the lack of flexibility and will definitely not be returning, nor recommending. Too expensive for what it is.A shame.Update:Following this review I have now been contacted by Ben's Gutters and have been offered a £25 refund. This, I am grateful for. Thank you.

records.title: Ben's Gutters will clean your gutters
records.text: Ben's Gutters will clean your gutters, but they told me (looking at my roof from Google Earth) they could fix my two leaks, and they only fixed one - they couldn't reach the other. They can supply a person with a long ladder, so are OK if that's all you need.

records.title: Gutters and washing
records.text: The organisers were rubbish but Ty who did the work was excellent. I would recommend them even though they mucked up times and you can always get through to them on the telephone to speak to.and they are very polite. Once again I can only praise Ty for such good work.

records.title: I hired them based on TP reviews
records.text: I hired them based on TP reviews. They were to clean the gutters and clean the conservatory roof. Gutters were done ok but as a manual job it was difficult to tell how much had been removed. Would have preferred them to wash the gutters out afterwards. Anyway OKThe equipment they used on the conservatory roof was very low tech. A brush (only one size used)with a supply of cold water. They said they were not allowed to use chemicals. Wasn’t suggesting anything other than a little detergent to help remove the grime. Consequently the conservatory roof looks very similar to its prewashed condition. The guys tried hard but the equipment wasn’t up to the job. The company were not Impressed when I complained and took £27 off the bill even though I sent pictures of the work. Felt it should have been moreIn summary. Gutters ok. If you have a conservatory roof that needs more than a “wash” I would clarify your expectations more than I did in order to avoid my experience

records.title: OK at best, and disorganised. I'll try someone else next time.
records.text: I would love to be able to give as good a review as some of the others on here. Got a hand written note through the door, saying they are in the area doing gutters. Checked the reviews and the seemed great. Called them up and the sales agent really up sold how great the service would be. It was OK at best, and that was after 2 visits. Didn't clean the gutters fully, and then said that was what was booked. Didn't clean the conservatory roof and had to come out again to do that, and despite having a 2nd opportunity to step up the gutter cleaning they left the job at that.

records.title: Extra payment rip off
records.text: Arrived on time. Cleared the gutters with extended pole. Didn't appear to check down pipes or swan necks. No big deal as I don't think there is a problem with them. Payed the bill online. Now asking for an extra £25 for sealing leaking joint.This consisted of a small smear of sealant at the sides of one bracket. Approx 2 minutes work and a minimal amount of sealant from a nearly empty tube £25!!!

records.title: Don't ask for feedback after they do a…
records.text: Don't ask for feedback after they do a job for you because they just do not reply. I have emailed 3 times to both their operations and customer service email and nothing! I don't even know if the work was completed.

records.title: Not impressed
records.text: Not impressed. First guy was rude and could manage a grunt at me.  Wasn’t happy lots of dirty areas. 2nd guy came back cleaned better and explained other areas that had some sort of acid issue off the rain. Total rip off. Get your local guys to do it. Will never use these guys again

records.title: Unfortunately job was not completed on…
records.text: Unfortunately job was not completed on the agreed date and there was no communication from the company.  I had to call them, to be told that there had been problems at a previous job, meaning I would not be attended to.  Gross inconvenience to myself and neighbour.  The company assured me that I would be contacted the following day to provide a two-hour time slot.  This call never materialised.  They unexpectedly turned up however, on a freezing day, and to no surprise could not complete any work because the guttering was frozen.  Now advised that at some point next week I will be contacted.  Not impressed.  I will update.UPDATE:  Job completed.  No compensation offered in respect of the inconvenience caused and being out of pocket financially by booking time off work  to be there at the time of the initial appointment - that they failed to attend.

records.title: Job done to a good standard - but.............
records.text: Job done to a good standard, but he just dumped all the rubbish at our front gate. Also piece of sunroof damaged which I'll need to get.

records.title: I've used this company many times now. No more.
records.text: I've used this company many times now. When  first started with them, they spent one hour doing the job and did it well. This time, they spent a maximum of 25 minutes doing the job, and left rubbish from the gutters all over my front window sills and my back porch.  They have definitely gone downhill. They will have to prove to me that they can be trusted. At least they came back to clean up the mess!  But it is obvious that they try get more money for less time. Not worth it any more.

records.title: Expensive and not well done
records.text: Easy to book appointment and the allocated worker turned up on time. He removed the debris by hand, I was not impressed that on some occasions he leaned his ladder on the gutter. I would like to have seen photos of the clean gutters, as other companies have done this in the past. He ran water along the gutters but DID NOT check the downpipes and the the first rainfall after his visit showed one to be blocked and the gutters overflowed. An expensive price for a job half done. I would not recommend this company.

records.title: Dissatisfied
records.text: The guy from Bens gutters arrived one hour earlier than arranged.The whole job took 5 mins and cost £77.I am shocked at how expensive this service was. Surely the time the man was there should reflect on the price charged?Needless to say I won’t be using Bens Gutters again!

records.title: Rubbish job
records.text: Nikolay was polite, nice man. At the price charged I expected a much better clean. Only equipment was ladders and a long brush attached to hose, no way is it possible to get a decent clean with the equipment he had. Conservatory roof looks worse than it did before this suppose CLEAN.Nikolay worked hard but I could never recommend as I have had better job done at half the price, cannot write what my wife said !!Also, I asked for all UPVC to be cleaned when getting quote, at price I definitely expected to get what I asked for, sadly not, now have a mixture of dirty and slightly cleaned upvc. Not good !!

records.title: The initial contact was great and…
records.text: The initial contact was great and appointment arranged very quickly,  but alas the wheels well and truly came off when the local boy got involved. So much expectation so much hope ...for now...lost.

records.title: Contacted Bens Gutters for two of our…
records.text: Contacted Bens Gutters for two of our sites. Payment was taken upfront and had to chase for invoices. Only received one to date.Have tried contacting on the phone and no response. Emailed and no response.We found out that one of the down pipes at a block was not cleaned (more like all the debris was put down this pipe when cleaning the gutters) and we had damage from the rain water overflowing. We had to pay again for cleaning of this pipe.  Would not recommend them at all.

records.title: Billed me for work not even carried out
records.text: They wanted payment up front which I refused to pay until the guy turned up. The guy then turned up on time but took one look and said he couldn't do it. It may take more expensive equipment like vacuuming the debris out and the company may quote me. Later I got a bill for the work that wasn't even done! *edit, two ignore emails and then FB messenger I'd sent - the person sorted it as it had been marked as completed! So they cancelled the bill and offered to do the more expensive job but I declined.

records.title: No show
records.text: Booked job on 11th June, for today (20th June). Yesterday received an email with 2 different times lots within 6 minutes of each other.  Today at 1716  a text message to say they could not do the job today, and someone from the office would be in touch.  Wonderful service... not.Mr A Myerscough Update:  the company rang me this morning after i had respindec to their request  for more informTion ans 2 phone calls to answerphone and offered a new vist next week. I therefore cancelled any future involvement with the company.

records.title: VERY EXPENSIVE
records.text: Work and organisation all ok but quoted £240 on the basis that 2 men needed because involved ladder work but in the end neither guy helped the other with the ladder work. Job was about half hour on site and accepting some travelling time the job was very very expensive.

records.title: Not as thorough as hoped for.
records.text: Guy arrived promptly at 8am to sort rear gutters, left promptly at 8.15, personally don't think as thorough a job as I was expecting was done as there is new weed regrowth visible less than 2 weeks after the job. Unaware of the downspout being checked for free flowing as they claim to do as assumed he'd use hosepipe for that which was untouched. Unlikely to use their services again.

description:
About the company:
Fantastic Services Family started its journey back in 2009. It all began with a meeting of two like-minded individuals, company founders Rune Sovndahl and Anton Skarlatov. Rune needed a cleaner and Anton ran a cleaning business. Very quickly they both realised they shared a vision and could deliver cleaning services in a much better way, by working together.
With two laptops, a sofa to sit on and a shared mobile phone, a small operation was born. The aim was to build something simple but deliver the best service possible for both clients and cleaning crews. We call that philosophy 360-degree happiness.
From these humble beginnings, we've now grown into a multi-operational business offering a wide range of services to homeowners and commercial customers alike. We've continued to add more domestic services to enhance our portfolio and due to increased demand, these additional services have grown into their own separate brands.

records.title: Fantastic end of tenancy clean
records.text: Fantastic end of tenancy clean! And a very competitive price.My flat was cleaned, through Fantastic Services, by Tidy Home Services Ltd, and they did a fantastic job.Turned up 5min early and with all the necessary equipment. Cleaned everything to a great standard, even cleaning all the mould out from the grout between the shower tiles. Called me 30min before finishing so I could come back and inspect the finished property.Fantastic Services then called me later in the day to ask if any issues and confirm that I was happy with the cleaning.So yes, am happy with the cleaning. Reading the other reviews - perhaps it depends on the cleaners that are sent? But I am very happy with the clean I got, and with the price vs. other providers (included a discount).

records.title: This was my first window cleaning service
records.text: This was my first window cleaning service to be used in many years.. the cleaner did a fabulous job, leaving all the windows gleaming.  It didn’t take long.I’m delighted with the work done and don’t hesitate to recommend this firm.

records.title: Very polite and professional service
records.text: Very polite and professional service. Kept their mess to a minimum and cleared everything away swiftly after finishing the job. A huge improvement on how our conservatory looked before - very pleased!

records.title: I enjoy my house to be clean
records.text: I enjoy my house to be clean, specially after the end of the Year period. The person send from Fantastic Service is a lovely and mindfull person, I really appreciate her.

records.title: Chris the cleaner was polite and very…
records.text: Chris the cleaner was polite and very efficient. Followed direction and was fully cooperative. 5 hours of work was not necessary. We would welcome more flexibility with the amount of time we are charged for.

records.title: Very good cleaner
records.text: Very good cleanerHouse a lot better cleaned than with previous cleaner Would appreciate if I can get her regularly

records.title: Sarah was thebest cleaner we’ve…
records.text: Sarah what was the best cleaner we’ve ever had I would like to keep her all the time.  She went out of her way to do extra over the Christmas period I was a very pleasant polite and professional

records.title: Showed up for me to clean my house on…
records.text: Showed up for me to clean my house on the day before New Year’s Eve and talked through over the phone. A very reliable and reassuring service

records.title: We had a EOT clean mid-Dec 2024 and the…
records.text: We had a EOT clean mid-Dec 2024 and the team were punctual, thorough and communicated really well. Was surprised at some of the reviews here - our experience was positive.

records.title: Really efficient and very diligent
records.text: Really efficient and very diligent. Made a huge effort to tidy up every bit of the garden. Really good experience

records.title: Great but late
records.text: Great cleaning service - very professional and thorough. Only thing that cost a star is that the cleaner was 2 hours late (not his fault), so better communication from central office is needed if cleaners are running late.

records.title: Prompt and fairly efficient cleaners.
records.text: Morning cleaner was prompt and fairly efficient but left some areas not cleaned or dusted properly but it did save me quite a lot of time and effort.  Carpet cleaner the same afternoon was a bit late, but efficiently and quickly dealt with the agreed rooms and I was pleased with the result.

records.title: Cleaners supplied at short notice
records.text: Fantastic Services were able to provide cleaners at short notice to clean kitchen and bathrooms after moving into a new (to me) property. They did a good job on the bathrooms and the cooker. I did ask that they clean inside the kitchen cupboards and drawers but I discovered later that wasn't done. May have been a communication error on my part, perhaps should have been clearer with instructions. Happy overall though.

records.title: The building clean was difficult and we…
records.text: The building clean was difficult and we had to discuss and plan the works which didn’t integrated with us and the cleaners, The day two works which was the upholstery and kitchen cleaning went very well and was left in a great condition and very please, we should done this earlier in the year to allow for the upholstery to dry,We looking forward to having a cleaner this Saturday for a 4 hour clean and we hope this will work fingers crossed

records.title: Requires two visits
records.text: Edited - updated from 1* to 4* based on resolution from customer service. Charged for first half hour only. Not 5 star as my plumbing issue is not fixed. But I felt the process was easy, the technician seemed knowledgeable and customer service eager to help to ensure customer satisfaction.  I had a problem with the kitchen sink and requested a plumber to fix the problem. I was pre-charged 110 for an hour’s time. The plumber came, spent 10 mins on inspection, told he does not have materials to fix (a pipe with non return valve), asked me to book another visit and left. I was not expecting this. I was expecting the plumber to get the material and fix the problem and charge for material and extra time.Inspections usually do not take an hour and company is cheating people by charging for a full hour.I have had jobs done through other sites and never had this problem.

records.title: Good cleaner today
records.text: Good cleaner today. She missed one room. But think the house is new and still finding her way

records.title: I have to make the Hungarian guy among…

records.title: The cleaner is good but always has a…
records.text: The cleaner is good but always has a cold ,running nose, cough,sneezing. She does as she's asked. I have told the booking agents to send me a another cleaner if my regular cleaner still has cold next week.

records.title: Customer Experience
records.text: Customer Service staff courteous & helpful. Problem is workmen do not always give notice of delays or no shows. Compensation should be given as refunds for the related job & not as future credit.

records.title: CLEANING LADY DIDN'T CLEAN THE BATHROOM SINK 😪
records.text: THE CLEANING LADY DID A VERY GOOD JOB 👍 BUT SHE DIDN'T CLEAN THE BATHROOM SINK VERY WELL.😪  I GIVE HER A 4.5 RATING.

records.title: Today’s cleaner was good
records.text: Great cleaner today. Efficient and thorough, asked for more tasks as she had cleaned the house before the time that FS recommended we book.

records.title: The company is very expensive and the…
records.text: The company is very expensive and the membership too expensive at £89 as it does not work out beneficially if you only use one or two services and sometimes you have to pay the same price as non-members, but as I have been offered membership at a special price I will renew.  My cleaner who came on Monday was excellent.  Very hard working indeed and very cheerful.  A delightful young man.

records.title: It was good as a starting session
records.text: It was good as a starting session. He was very receptive to the things i wanted done. Above all, he came with a good energy, a good frame of mind, and i was glad to have him in my house. The slippers i offered him were grotty, and will get new ones for him next time. He also used his own disposable gloves

records.title: Good quality of work by tradesmen and good customer support
records.text: I’m happy with the quality of work by the tradesmen and will be trying out other services in future.The support team are polite, professional and able to resolve issues very quickly. Booking of services is made easy through the company app. The credits offered once signed up as a member were a bit confusing at first, credits cannot be applied to the same category of service as you can only use them once for each main category of service so best check with customer support team on the use of credits and the advantages of membership.

records.title: I got convinced to get the £80 Membership...
records.text: UPDATE: I have updated the rating from 1 star to 4 stars because their customer service team responded within days to this rating and refunded me the £80 without any argument. Further, the original cleaning job was always good (as mentioned in my original review). I got convinced to get the £80 per annum "membership". I received £30 off from an end of tenancy cleaning. In retrospect they overcharged me slightly even with the discount. However, the cleaning job was good. Fast forward a few months later. I asked for a quote on a move in cleaning, a quote on an oven cleaning, an electrician quote, and a quote on a garden/fance repair job (different time periods). The company was consistently way way above and competitor and when I indicated I would not go with them they immediately offered a 30-50% discount. Even so, they were STILL 10-20% above any other competitive quotes. Fast forward 11 months...they charged me for another £89 as they have an automatic renewal (that they do not tell you about during the phone call where they pressure you to sign up to that annual membership). The renewal apparently is charged our 1 month before the 12 months expiration!! In my view this is borderline to a scam and the membership is utterly worthless. Get them on a job by job basis and do NOT agree to the first price they give you when they call you first. A bit of a Turkish bazaar mentality this company.....

records.title: Aftersales recovered the situation and retained me as a customer
records.text: I had an a two-person end of tenancy clean- they turned up one hour apart, on foot with shopping trolly bags. I originally went with this company because I saw a van and it looked professional.  I noticed damage to my cooker after the clean. After contacting the customer services my complaint was handled quickly and to my satisfaction. In business, sometimes things will not go according to plan but - what’s important  is - how they're addressed. It was addressed well in this case and I will use a range of their services again - including cleaning - albeit not the actual cleaners I had on this occasion.  Thank you.

records.title: Bed Bug Pest Control
records.text: I was allowed to ask lots of questions and wasn't rushed. I was provided with all the information regarding my upcoming service. The only problem was that the young man's voice sounded muffled and i had to ask him to repeat himself.

records.title: The lady was punctual and polite and…
records.text: The lady was punctual and polite and cleaned thoroughly… I have no complaints…. Her bed making is a little untidy and she failed to plump up cushions on sofa…. Other than those two very minor points I am totally satisfied

records.title: Fantastic Service to clean your Bank…

This is the problems where founders are from different country and have no British values but only money making mindset. Finance department have no ethics....Updated on 30.10.2024 Gigi Taylor from FS have apologised and refund is being made, including Rene who sent a message on Linkedin and looked into it so that these do not occur in future. There are few who took it serious and provided better support to Customer.

records.title: Almost Fantastic!
records.text: Second time we've used Fantastic Services and they don't disappoint. The window cleaner did a great job and the house cleaner was fantastic, very diligent and couldn't fault her.Sadly only four stars because the first cleaners who turned up arrived two hours late (and only contacted me twenty minutes before arrival despite calls to the office to find out where they were) and then wanted to argue about what they were and weren't supposed to do.But Fantastic are on my radar and we will use them again.

records.title: Cleaning staff require a lot of supervision
records.text: This week’s cleaner complained that our house was dirty; we’ve had cleaners from Fantastic Services for 3 of the last 4 weeks, including last week. Last week’s cleaner (we get a different one every week) left an hour earlier than booked because she didn’t think there was anything to do. This week’s missed quite a few areas in the bathroom. Fantastic services have phoned to discuss improvements to our experience.  I am under the impression that they are keen to get this right.

records.title: Pushy marketing
records.text: Pushy marketing. If you're seeking a quote, and dare to leave one item unpurchased on their website and they will hound you to complete it. It's really off-putting and drives you to use a different company.

records.title: The clearance is great but the charge…
records.text: The clearance is great but the charge for taking heaves away in bags is too high. It makes the service unaffordable and they rely on you just not wanting the leaves in bags at the end for you to deal with. £55 per bag is far far too expensive and make it more than the actual clearance. It’s more than it costs for companies to come and take rubbish away. Won’t do it again.

records.title: Sofa cleaning
records.text: For the price I was expecting a deeper cleaning. The result is ok though.

records.title: Cleaning
records.text: The carpet cleaner was excellent very good changed my whole carpet . However the cleaner wasn’t great didn’t clean to the standard I expected and also wanted to charge more for no reason we’ve had cleaners who’s had less equipment do a better job

records.title: The plumber who came was good and…
records.text: The plumber who came was good and managed the job but asked for a handyman to come at the same time which was a nightmare. Poor communication from your office - difficulty in reaching you. Too long to write on this. Handyman never came- plumber did job himself but was annoyed.

records.title: Such a disappointment … but with a happy ending
records.text: I had a window cleaning booked for this morning at 8.30, at 7.30 I received a text informing me that "due to bad weather " the window cleaner wouldn't be coming and I would have to reschedule the appointment.  There was no bad weather, it wasn't raining and hasn't rained all day, in actual fact it was been ver pleasant for December and the sun was actually out. All day I have tried to contact to someone and everytime I've called I receive a text to say someone will call but it is now 16.20 and still not had a call. When I did manage to speak to someone earlier they said they could rebook it for the 27th December, what good is that when I needed the windows done for Christmas. Last weekend I had a handy man book to fix a door, the appointment was for between 12 & 5 by 6 O'clock no one had come despite me receiving a text from the handyman saying he was on his way. When I called the office I had to rebook that appointment too, so I waited in all for nothing then too.This company used to be good and I have recommended them to many people in the past as I have been a customer of theirs for years but I would definitely never recommend them again. UPDATE:After seeing my review a very lovely lady from Fantastic Services called me on the Monday morning regarding the problems I'd have the previous day and couldn't do enough to try and help me (however, I've still not been able to get my windows cleaned as they have no appointments available). But she refunded my services and also sent me out a very lovely hamper. She really went out of her way to try and put things right which was very much appreciated. And went a long way to restoring my faith back in the Company. Katty was so pleasant and friendly, it was hard to stay angry. Thank you Katty.

records.title: Carpet cleaning
records.text: Despite the best efforts of the cleaner the stains were not removed.

records.title: Terrible customer service splitting hairs over refund of time worth £4.50
records.text: I had a new regular cleaner turn up 2 hours late and then do 45 mins less time than I'd paid for. Turns out her previous job finished 5 mins before my service was supposed to start and the journey is over half an hour away - so it was never going to happen on time. I was expecting some kind of refund or apology as I subsequentally changed my regular time to an hour later and cut an hour off the service as she'd actually done a very good job in the 3 hours... no communication came.. Eventually I complained about the loss of time and asked for a refund of the time not used - 45 mins - eventually after being pushed to customer service they agreed to refund for 30 mins saying they 'round up' the time lost - I pointed out they had in fact 'rounded down'.. they then said if it's for 5 mins or less then they round down so the decision still stands... I've just pointed out that 15 mins is not 5 and they have been arguing with an unsatisfied customer who has cut an hour off her service as a result of their scheduling and they were arguing about £4.50... pathetic, and terrible customer service!!UPDATE: since the public review I have now had my whole session value refunded, which is great, but shouldn't have taken me to make my views public to get some compensation, when all I wanted originally was the extra £4.50. That was acknowledged by the customer service rep that it had been escalated to.

records.title: Every effort was made to resolve issues I flagged
records.text: Update: After I shared my previous review, a senior member of the customer support team (Gigi) reached out and made every effort to resolve the issues I raised. I'm grateful the team went above and beyond to reschedule the service. I'm very satisfied with the quality of the service provided.Previous review: Extremely likely this company is fraudulent due to their sketchy business practices.I signed up to their membership because of a promotional deal and booked two services to begin with. The first cleaning job was horribly done. No clue how they found the person they sent to my house. The second job was meant to be rescheduled because the service provider showed up late, yet they immediately charged me a cancellation fee because the delay meant the service provider would have to come another time. Their agents argued with me over the fee on multiple calls because they believe the delayed arrival was still within an expected timeframe and made no attempts to find any middle ground. The service I paid for has not been provided, they have refused to reschedule the service without an additional fee, yet they're claiming to be owed more money in the form of a 'cancellation fee' (for a service that I didn't cancel). Now, they have gone silent for over a week while holding on to money for a service that hasn't been delivered.Never using them again. Save yourself the time, stress, money and trouble and don't use them. Be warned - they charge you in advance for a service you might not be happy with, it's seemingly impossible to get a refund and they charge the card you have on file for fees that are not pre-authorised. If you expect a job to be completed between 12pm - 1pm, they believe they have every right to show up at 12:58pm because that's the 'arrival time'. If you try and call them, you're left in a loop of automated messages. If you try and amend a service through your online dashboard, there's no confirmation of your request. A member of their team calls you (whenever it's convenient for them) and then uses marketing gimmicks to try and sell you more services before finally agreeing to make the changes you initially requested.

records.title: Hit and miss but generally good
records.text: I think they are great when it comes to small jobs like cleaning and moving. I've used them a couple times for those services and have 0 complaints, the service has always been great and the staff were very efficient, friendly and professional. I took a risk and used them for a big job, to do the flooring in my hallway, which cost £655, I had to buy the flooring, underlay and trim separately, which was £258 so the service was £913 in total. The floorboards were laid okay but the finish was shocking and I'm unbelievably disappointed with the finished product and refuse to believe the worker is a professional. Without going into too much detail, he nailed and glued loose pieces of wood together for the trim and didn't cut them properly so some are sticking out overhanging the wall. The transition strips, don't cover the metal strip between the rooms. He was an hour late, didn't finish and had to come back another day then was 2 hours late. I had floor spacers from a previous job and he took them up and kept them all. I didn't realise he had stolen them until afterwards. He didn't take the waste with him so 2 weeks later I'm still trying to get rid of the wood.After complaining they gave me a refund of £115 for the service and £46 of for the additional materials that he asked me to buy didn't use. After the refunds, I spent £752 in total but I will need to remove the trim and transition strips and have it corrected.My honest opinion on Fantastic Services would be they are fantastic for small jobs like cleaning or tasks under £100. They are responsive and helpful with complaints and I appreciate they do what they can to make good when things don't go well.However, because their workers are contractors and sole traders, the person who is actually assigned to do your work could be terrible and so to me it isn't worth the risk if you're having to part with a significant amount of money. I wish I hadn't used them for my flooring but I will continue to use them for cleaning and odd jobs.Also, a point to note: If you pay for the yearly membership you get £300 credit. The credit works by deducting £30 from each purchase. So if you have £300 credit and buy a service for £200, you will still pay £170 and it will deduct £30 from your credit. Just FYI if you're planning on signing up.

records.title: Matters were resolved in the end
records.text: Updating my previous review. Whilst the experience hasn’t been great, the customer services team has contacted me to try and resolve the issues. I was very grateful with the resolution and was provided with a refund- Thank you to Rose for helping me with this. ——//////———///////———My appointments were rescued frequently and Prices quoted are always higher than local businesses. Recently booked a patio cleaning service. I said to the agent two cars could fit into the driveway. He put that on the system as the measurement. Two men then came to clean the patio and said we will charge double the price because my patio was bigger than 20m2On the phone to fantastic services for ages and they said It’s no one’s fault because the agent didn’t say the price quoted for 20m2. In the end I had to leave it as was too expensive. Local company quoted me £80 to do the patio cleaning. Best price fantastic services gave me was £130

records.title: Got a quote and was charged more than…
records.text: Got a quote and was charged more than quoted. I’m not happy about this I asked for a refund and got nothing I won’t be using this company again

records.title: Guy was nice but credit system is a bit…
records.text: Guy was nice but credit system is a bit of a scam

records.title: Be careful when signing up for the membership
records.text: I was very disappointed by the service I received. I was quoted numerous and varying prices for a one-off removal service that I needed. I was then encouraged to sign up to the year's membership without being told that this "membership" would be annual and recurring. I was shocked to see that Fantastic Services had been taking £89 per year from my account for the past years without me knowing about this. I was never informed about this when I initially booked my one-off service. I am not someone to leave reviews in general but I want to help others not fall into this trap. I would highly recommend not using this service. Update on 29/11. After leaving this review, I was contacted by Fantastic Services and was refunded both of the years of my membership. Sadly, it had to get to this stage of leaving this review for this to take place, but I do appreciate that they took action. I hope in the future that the sales team are very clear with clients on what membership involves (including a roll-on payment) so that others do not end up in the situation that I did.

records.title: They were lovely and friendly but their…
records.text: They were lovely and friendly but their tidying up was unsatisfactory. Compared to the previous service.

records.title: A Disappointing Experience
records.text: Two very polite and pleasant gents came to clean my oven. The first disappointment was that they didn’t take the shelves and doors outside to a van to soak. They did it all in the kitchen in a big metal box. When they finished I briefly checked both ovens. They appeared to be very clean. However, when I came to bake later that day, I noticed they hadn’t given me a new oven liner (which was promised), and the glass doors were scratched, as was the grill pan. I know my oven is quite old, but it wasn’t scratched at all before. I chose Fantastic Services, after reading the ‘excellent’ reviews, as my usual oven cleaner had retired. I’m sorry to say that I won’t be using them again.

records.title: Got Scammed, Never use this company again
records.text: Claim to fix bathroom light and install cooker hood for £330.Installed cooker hood too high without reading manual and refuse to fix it.Took one look at bathroom light and say he will visit another day then send another quotation for light fix.Edit: They have offered 15% refund in exchange of not having 1 star review. So here it goes 3 stars.

records.title: I’m leaving
records.text: Mixed experience. Some great cleaners, some terrible. Customer Support is not great when you have an issue. I have one appalling experience, and the support was so bad I have decided to leave. It’s expensive, and the customer support you receive is not worth the premium price.

records.title: Standard has fallen just pushing membership

records.title: I got a nice clean but what on earth…

records.title: Didnt want use them as they wanted to…
records.text: Didnt want use them as they wanted to be paid UPFRONT in full , for a service they hadnt even yet done or the opportunity to see a decent attempt of a furniture  clean. A company i use a lot or a family member maybe only then , which they are neither I am old school , i would have gladly payed a          non refundable deposit as a verbally contractual over the phone booking,

records.title: have used their services around 6/7…
records.text: have used their services around 6/7 times over 4 years. Very inconsistent level of service, some professionals are nice and easy to work with. Some come in late and did not even call. Customer service is poor, the specialist just said: oh my colleagues are already on this case and hung up my call. Better off googling individual small companies for cleaning service.

records.title: Not so Fantastic...
records.text: Not so Fantastic...Once they get you as a customer if something goes wrong, expect it to be dealt with inefficiently.Unfortunately I had a terrible experience. I was convinced to join Fantastic Club as I booked for an End of Tenancy clean (EOT) to move into a new property (which was already a stressful situation).This cost me £313 with a FC discount. A lot of money for an EOT clean but the cheapest quote I got out of 4. They say you pay for what you get... and yes, it was certainly poor.My experience was that the cleaners did not meet general expectations of what FS promoted in terms of there End of Tenancy cleaning service (this was a move-in clean for me). The cleaners did not do a full oven, dishwasher, washine machine and fridge clean. Skirtings were full of dust and hair, and the toilet showed dirt around. I took several photos moments after the cleaners left to demonstrate the poor cleaning job. The cleaners caused damage in my bathroom (a leak appeared out of nowhere and I was not immediately informed. I Unfortunately found this and cleaners were quick to tell me it was a leak before they rushed out the door). I called FS 10mins after the cleaners rushed out the door and they re-booked me a re-clean for 4days later. The re-clean was CANCELLED BY FS 20mins before it was due to happen in the evening, at my inconvenience. FS informed me via messaging rather than a phone call, but did not fully explain the cancellation at short notice. They did not call me to re-book this in. Poor customer service after they make a sale. I was huegly let down. Due to proximity to Xmas and my removals arriving, I had to source a local cleaner who was far cheaper yet did a better job than FS - she was not leaving until I was absolutely happy with the oven, dishwasher and washine machine. It was a week battle with FS customer service to get a partial refund after providing many images, another cleaners invoice and constantly calling and messaging. They are quick to get the sale, but very slow when you have a problem. In terms of the leak, they are sending out the plumber with a caveat that "if the plumber finds the leak is nothing to do with the cleaners, I will get charged". They already made claims my leak was not caused by the cleaners, despite them not being the ones staying in the property to know when the leak appeared! This is not booked in for another week and a half. So the bucket I bought will keep catching the water until then...It couldnt get worse that this! Oh but it did... then just hours after Christmas day I recieved an email from the head of customer services saying I'm going to be "charged for cancelling a service 48hrs before it was due to take place". I had not cancelled nor booked any more services after the horrific experience I have had so far. The plumber is what they are looking to send out in the New Year! I refused to book any more services with FS. It has been an absolute nightmare over what is a most stressful period of moving home a week before Christmas! After back and forth negotiation via messaging for a week, the partial refund I got on Xmas day was going to be the reason I did not write a bad review, but it was an email hours later from their Head of Customer Service claiming I will be charged for cancelling a service I didn't even book, was the last straw for me!! It was Greystar (huge global property developer) who recommended FS through their residents app, if Greystar wants to continue with their high standards, then FS should not be their recommended service company. Well, I will now be writing to Greystar... I am hugely disappointed.

records.title: A Very Poor Cleaning Service
records.text: Booked for 1pm and after booking I received a confirmation of my booking with arrival of 1.00-2.30pm. They should mention before you pay that the time you book for is not necessarily the time they will come. It was not a problem for me personally but I imagine it would be for many busy people.The property was empty and had had a deep clean only two weeks previously when the tenants moved out. This was just for a general clean to spruce it up a bit for the new tenants. I had written on my booking that the main focus of the cleaning was the kitchen. I asked the cleaner to wash the glasses and kitchen utensils and wipe out the kitchen cupboards. I had booked for three hours cleaning and after two hours the cleaner called to say she had finished ( I do not have a problem with cleaners finishing early if the do the job quickly). When I went to the property, the glasses had been washed and left to dry in the rack but all the other utensils were still sitting on the worktop untouched, where I had left them for her. Nothing else in the kitchen had been cleaned (worktop, sink, cupboards, microwave, floor, etc.).Other than the two bathrooms, the rest of the property looked untouched. Even the cleaning products I had bought and placed on the coffee table were still in the exact same place.A very disappointing service and I am afraid I could not recommend Fantastic Services at all for their cleaning. There are much better cleaning companies out there.

After fitting, Coral called by to check that the door handles were the best match achievable to other kitchen items with willingness to change if required. The Coral rep had it down as 13.00 so we had given up and were out when he finally arrived. We had to rearrange the appointment. Internal communication fault!2. I was present when the original booking slot was arranged by the surveyor as 12.00, so for some reason Coral changed the time and only told us the night before. External communication fault!  The quality and fitting of the product were both excellent, but the organization needs to sort out it's communication internally and externally.

records.title: They were friendly over the phone and…

The person didn’t communicate that they wanted us to send a door choice and even when we sent something they still didn’t get back to us. Not good.

records.title: Products are great but be careful who…
records.text: Products are great but be careful who fits them. We had two crews first day, one set were great, the others not so great, damaging tiling in a bathroom and not admitting to it. Good crew had to spend an extra day resolving first crew issues and then on last day the bay windows did not fit as had been measured incorrectly. Was then told it would be 12 days before a replacement frame would be ready, when it arrived it did not match the opposite window in the bay. Finally resolved today but no apology for inconvenience and incompetence plus a refusal to fix bathroom damage referring to terms and conditions. I run my own company and have always believed in good customer service, sadly I have not received this from Coral.01/02/2023 Addendum - Called Wendy on 27/01/2023 and she informed me to expect a call from a Director - still waiting14/02/23 Letter received from Instalation Manager today

records.title: Not impressed with the aftersales service so far
records.text: After my recent installation, I noticed a problem, reported this and got a vauge assurance that I would get a call back to fix it soon. After a few days, I emailed to politely ask about the lead time. This was a week ago and I am yet to get a reply / call back. To be honest, I'm not impressed with the aftersales service so far. If I had been aware of and notified Coral of the issue prior to paying my bill (several thousands of pounds), I'm certain that I would not be waiting an unknown amount of time to get a response. Considering it is Coral's goal "to provide excellent service at all times for new and existing customers", it would be a good idea to follow up on concerns raised and have the decency to confirm lead time expectations, so customers do not feel forgotten about.

records.title: The work was fine
records.text: The work was fine. I can’t speak to how it lasts as it was only just done, but it seems well done and effective. It looks good. Professional demeanour was not so great — a lot of sitting around before they even got started and then the team of four left one man basically to do almost everything. Some black tarry blobs needed cleaning up from the floor later, and some of it left small stains that I can’t shift.  The lead up was fine — a salesman talked me into doing more than I really wanted on my limited budget, but that’s my fault. The date was bumped back at short notice but only by a day and it didn’t matter to me — it would be more of an issue if I didn’t work from home. So all in all, everything is fine, the work was good, there were some minor inconveniences but that’s all.

records.title: Mixed results
records.text: We chose Coral Windows because of good reviews in Which? A lot of the process went smoothly, and there was always a quick response to our telephone queries. The window looks good. However: A - It was not fitted on the date arranged. We were expecting the fitters around mid-day, but rang Coral when nobody had arrived by 2 pm, to be told it was not possible to fit it that day. Coral should have contacted us as soon as they knew the situation had changed. The following morning the fitters arrived with only 2 of the 3 necessary pieces, so again the job could not be done. It was completed on the third attempt. B - We were looking for windows with a low U value, ideally below 1. Coral Windows lowest was 1.4 (which is actually par for the course. The only company to provide under 1 charged literally twice the price). 1.4 was written down on our contract. However, when the site visit was done, we were told that the U value would be 1.6, and that is the lowest Coral do. The salesman asked us to consider the WER ratings instead, which were satisfactory, so we went ahead but we felt we had been misled. (The window is the first part of a full bathroom renovation, so we did not have a lot of time to arrange a replacement).

records.title: Frustrating communication
records.text: We moved to a new property last year that needed new windows and doors - some urgently so we split the installation due to needing to look at finances. Our first order consisted of 9 windows. front door & patio doors. 9 Windows all fitted on time as we had been told. Comes to following day when doors are due in, waited in ALL day to have to call to be told that our patio doors are in fact not ready! we were given different excuses as to what the issue was depending who we spoke to. They fitted the front door after some grumbling from us as we had been told it was going to be fitted anyway! We waited 2 whole months for the patio doors - with very limited communication as to timescales, initially saying would be a few days then the next week and on and on it went. They absolutely do not call back when they promise they will which was a theme throughout both installations. If they had been upfront about it we would have been fine but the installers left all their trim and mess as beleived installers were coming the following day - this lay in our driveway for 2 months! Overall we were pleased with product. One handle was scratched and had to be replaced, 1 pane of glass was manufactured incorrectly and was replaced, hinge to front door perpetually came loose but the last guy to come seems to have fettled that so we thought we want our others to look same so we asked that they do the next lot which included sash windows. They don't make the sash windows - they outsource them (according to the fitters). We were not given any confirmation dates for scaffolders and only knew of them coming when awoken by them on our roof. We had specifically instructed Coral NOT to walk on this roof due to the nature of the tiles there. Thy had not brought enough scaffold and had to go away with half of it up. We were then told that our windows were not actually ready so not clear why scaffold was going up. On day of installation one window had wrong colour furniture on it, and they used wrong colour sealant despite asking us which colour and so it had to be re-done. Beading on one sash was protruding and sharp.  When the issues did get rectified we had a guy call to arrange this and even though we agreed date due to our work schedules, he called on the day he originally wanted to do it and was a little pushy about coming that day - with me literally having to say NO ONE is physically HOME! After they finished it was late (after 6) and advised the guy who called the following day we would pay that day or day after due to being at work until quite late. We woke to a snotty email and voicemail about not having paid yet...even though I had said when we would be able to and still on the day we said we would have paid by. We spent 18k with these guys. Communication was poor throughout and wished we had not used them after this. I had also recommended them to a friend after first windows went in - she was advised we would get a free gift for recommending and her having work done but this never materialized, so am sure this was nonsense. No recompense offered for time wasted waiting in, poor communication or little more than a half hearted sorry. They were frustrating to say the least. I guess if you can deal with this they are fine.

records.title: Out of pocket due to company incompetence - I would not recommend
records.text: PROS-	The salesperson who came for the initial visit was knowledgeable and not at all pushy which I very much appreciated. -	I was quoted a decent price for x4 large windows, a small window and composite door-	Every time I called the main telephone number, the staff in the office who initially took the calls were friendly, professional and helpful. -	The Installation team who came were great – hardworking, friendly, professional, clean and tidy. The day of installation was a long and hard one for them, however they still left with a smile on their faces.-	There were a few issues with the installation, however this was quickly rectified with a follow up visit within 24 hours of the issues being reported.CONS-	I was advised by the surveyor that I would be given a date of installation by a certain date, but this did not happen and I had to call numerous times over a 2 week period, as the planning team failed to return my calls. When I did finally speak with them, they said they were waiting on information from myself, which was not correct. I also fail to understand why it took them so long to return my call to tell me this.-	My first installation date was cancelled with less than 24 hours notice.-	The second installation date came with further issues – the team were supposed to arrive between 8am – 10am. At 10.20am I called the office asking where the team were – I was advised the teams were running an hour late (I would have appreciated a courtesy call to advise me of this, rather than having to call them to find this out). When one team arrived (2 people) they raised concerns regarding the limited time they now had to complete the work, due to the size of the job. They were sent to a job before mine by management, but was very confused as to why, considering it was stipulated on all paperwork my job required a full day and a team of 4.
