No work was carried out that day which meant I was now out of pocket from job earnings, as I would have to take a further unplanned unpaid leave day from work to accommodate.-	I was given a new installation date for the following week and the work was carried out. When I raised that I was now out of pocket due to the fault of the company, this was dismissed by both the Installation Manager and Senior Installation Manager. Overall there was some positives as highlighted above. If the installation date was only rescheduled once, along with lack of follow up calls, that would have been somewhat ‘ok’. However, as I am now out of pocket due to company incompetence, along with the dismissal from management to give any compensation for this at all, I would not recommend Coral Windows to others, nor would I use them again.

records.title: Fair
records.text: Replaced 2 windows for my elderly parents (one has motor neuron disease and is wheelchair bound) wrong colour frames, burnt inside window cills, left all furniture in the middle of the room UPDATE. COMPENSATED PARENTS AND APOLIGISED

records.title: Used Coral for replacement glass as an…
records.text: Used Coral for replacement glass as an interim before replacing the units later this year.  The survey and installation were pretty good but the quote and scheduling the installation itself left a lot to be desired.

records.title: Unprofessional Engineer & passive aggressive
records.text: Follow up 29th Nov 2024. Having had a member of the Senior Management Team out to review and discuss the event that happened, I am happy they are serious about ensuring their staff uphold the standards expected. However it is disappointing that this occurred, especially over a mask.I had a Coral Engineer out to do some remedial work. I asked if he was happy to wear a mask (provided by myself) while inside the property; his response, ‘not really, but’. I explained that a vulnerable person lives at the property and we are still doing the surgical mask thing. If it is an issue then I can ask for someone else to be sent. ‘No its fine, go on’, was his response. Coral have been aware of their being a vulnerable elderly resident at the property since the quote stage and that I have requested all to wear masks.He popped to his Van but when he returned he had swapped the surgical mask for his snood. I asked if he could put the surgical mask back on as the snood is not as safe. You can see straight through a snood, you cant a surgical mask.He refused because apparently he wouldn’t be able to breathe with it on as it would fog up his glasses. He just entered a warm property from outside where it was 2C; they will fog up! Wipe them down maybe? I told the Engineer that if there is an issue with him having to wear a mask then it will be best to have another engineer come out, as I cant risk my parents’ health.He then passive aggressively went on a rant saying; ‘tell you what, I wont wear my glasses, I wont wear any of that, f#*k me, I’ll just try and do it blind, its alright’. During this rant, he threw is hat, snood, and glasses on the floor! Due to his attitude I asked him to leave. He replied, ‘no its fine, no its fine’ (regarding his willingness to now wear the mask). I had to tell him several times to leave. I don’t think I have ever had a Contractor behave in such a foul manner towards me. This was an experienced Coral Engineer as he was out working on his own, in a Coral branded Van.This also takes me back to the quoting stage with Coral and their Surveyor. When I asked him if he was ok to wear a mask while inside the property, his response was ‘If I have to’ but with a very blunt tone. I personally would not want one of their employees to become passive aggressive with me, within my own home.A product/installation review will follow in the near future.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: The fitter was late and didn't phone to notify us if this. We rang after 1.5 hours. He eventually turned up 4 hours late and was unapologetic, blaming his company for estimating the time wrong on the previous job. We paid promptly the day after the work was completed but nonetheless were chased for payment within 3 working days because the company had failed to register the payment.

records.title: We trusted Coral with building us a new…
records.text: We trusted Coral with building us a new Conservatory some years ago. We also purchased a new front Door fitted by Coral. At the time of Building our Conservatory I would have written a very positive Review.NOT NOW ! We have had to call Coral back 3 Times now to repair a water leak in our Conservatory - it still leaks despite assurances that “it should be fine now !”.We now are expecting (Hoping) that Coral arrive soon, as promised, but we have had to wait weeks and weeks because the Coral staff were “so busy” ????We purchased from Coral based on the Sales pitch and praises for the Coral owner, John Volente ???? Very poor Customer Service ! Never again will we trust Coral !Geoff Burrow, Castleford.

records.title: Lost paperwork…
records.text: After securing my business with what can be described as old school sales tactics. I agreed after some negotiation to let them do the work. I was happy and we had agreed a figure on the extra Costs after survey. At this point all went down hill. They lost my paper work, after assuring me the build would be done in July. They came back with a date of October which I declined and decided to end my interest. I had booked my summer holiday around the work being done, but moreover had rung 3 times to check the build was still ok for the 5th of July to be bounced around weeks before. Disappointed.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: Firstly tried to charge me a ridiculous amount for one window and when I didn't get back to them called me every few days for weeks, eventually dropping price. I don't like this way of doing business, just give me your best price, rather than wake me up on night shift and disturbing me on holiday.I've had the repair team out around five times, with them replacing the mechanism a couple of times and finally the window. It's still left with riser blocks, which they say are standard but I've not seen any other company use them. I have little confidence that it won't break again.In their defence they have responded each time I've phoned but why can't they get it right first time???I was left with a shut window, unable to open, in the summer heatwave and an open one, unable to close, in the depths of winter! I also had to take days off/turn down overtime for each repair, costing me more than the price of the window.I need all my windows replacing now but will be looking elsewhere.Sorry Coral.

records.title: Not the quality we expected
records.text: We didn’t get quotes this time for replacement of upstairs windows as we had heard good things about Coral. The initial sales man was good and reassured us that the product and fitting would be much better for the slight extra cost. The price was ok for us so we booked. The fitting is really what let them down. The salesman was very dismissive of the work we had done before, saying that Coral would make do rather than covering everything with upvc as our last fitter had done. Unfortunately this was not the case. The fitters were very noisy, messy and did not really clean up after they had finished. A loud radio blaring music out all day, at one time outside the back door where someone was trying to home work. They also broke tiles in bathroom and an alarm box outside and seemed to have used more caulk and upvc trim to cover up all their defects. We have no idea what is going on under all the caulk and upvc, which incidentally, also ended up on walls and floors. The windows look ok as long as you don’t look too carefully at the bodging they have done to the surrounds and walls. Not impressed.

records.title: Poor workmanship
records.text: I had a front door fitted by Coral and to be fair made a very good job of it ( different workmen) ,so I decided to have more work done by them . And I did just this, several months later.However I’ve waited a year to post this following review as I felt so traumatised by the  workmanship of Coral windows that I didn’t want to have any more work done by anyone ever !The guys that came to replace my windows and french doors were most disrespectful of my house and property. They acted most unprofessional, yanking windows out by force , and left me having to repair stuff after they had come out again to repair it , following installation.  The pictures speak for themselves , some  of this was redone by them ,following me producing these pictures, but this is how they had initially left it . Not acceptable at all. I had them throwing old bits of window out from upstairs , throwing dregs off tea onto my plants, and leaving copious amounts of debris around outside including old window bits and lots of screws! Bricks were dislodged and the french doors were built on the loose bricks , a tiled windowsill was broken and left until I complained and they put a new plastic windowsill over the top of it … an absolutely waste of money !I thought I’d done my research on this company and at the time couldn’t see a bad review . I understand there is always a chance of some damage when having new windows but not to this extent . Make your own mind up ,but please do your research prior to having expensive work done .

records.title: 2 months wait to fix issues.
records.text: Had some windows and a new door installed all with guarantee but has anyone tried getting someone from service to come out and fix issues, currently quoting just under 2 months waiting time and you have to be available all day.

records.title: Stressed
records.text: I phoned yesterday to ask someone to come repair a leak to my canopy and was told I will have wait two weeks because of staffing problems well i do know we are living in a stressful time but I feel like I'm not important this is the second time I've had trouble with leaks last time water was coming in and I had to complain then

records.title: We attempted to use coral earlier this…
records.text: We attempted to use coral earlier this year and was very disappointed with the service. We had to have the work ceased after it became evident that the installers were not undertaking the job to a very good standard. They were cutting corners and the company weren’t interested in rectifying the Problems caused by their workers that ultimately lead to us having to get a wall fixed.

description:
PSS International Removals are one of the UK's leading specialist international removal companies. A family-run business they have over 40 years experience helping people and families move from the UK to countries all over the world.

Popular European destinations include Spain, Portugal, Italy and Cyprus. Overseas destinations include Australia, New Zealand, USA, Canada and South Africa.

PSS International removals accreditations include BAR Overseas Group and FIDI FAIM Accreditation. They also members of International Association of Movers and recently won the Euromovers top bookers award.

Check out the international removals reviews and visit the website to use the free online cost calculator to get an estimate for your move.

You can also call freephone 0800 988 3711.

records.title: Good experience with PSS, really recommend them
records.text: Very good experience with PSS. They were giving me clear instructions step by step from beginning, relay the  job between their staff (made me a bit confused sometimes on who to follow though). The collection/packing staff were especially polite and professional, packing every thing carefully, neatly, and promptly. Good start so far when all items collected away from London. It still has 18000+ kilometres to go to get to my home in Auckland New Zealand. Hope it will be a smooth track-able journey, and not take too long time after collection on 17 Dec 2024.

records.title: They did a great job
records.text: They did a great job. Super efficient and considerate. Made me feel very confident Hope they are as great on the US side

records.title: I was getting answers to my questions…
records.text: I was getting answers to my questions very fast. I had many questions and the person who was helping me, answered all of them and was polite all the time.

records.title: Great staff
records.text: The 3 gentlemen who came to collect our belongings were extremely helpful and went above and beyond to help us with a smooth removal.

records.title: Emigrated Australia to Scotland 5stars
records.text: From the quote and set up these guys walked me through the entire process. Communication was first class and every querie, worry or question were quickly eased with just a phone call or email. Service at the delivery end was flawless also arriving early and quickly unloading placing item in each room as required the guys were great even asking if there was anything else I needed moved around once everything was inside. Total professionalism start to finish from price to execution flawless!

records.title: It was a difficult assignment
records.text: It was a difficult assignment a three story house plus a cellar -- and stuff to be moved from each floor, packed, labelled, lifted outside.  Some heavy loads,  The two man crew were superb.  I wasn't a great director and already exhausted when they arrived.  I've been dealing with a bereavement.  They were patient and accomodating.   Top marks.

records.title: Fast to respond and communicate
records.text: Fast to respond and communicate, professional and polite. Helpful when the was an error and quick to resolve

records.title: PSS made move to Canada a breeze
records.text: PSS made our move to Canada as simple as an international move could be. The office staff were great to answer all of our questions and removals team were incredibly quick, delicate and patient with our chaotic organisation. We’ve now landed safely in Canada, the shipping manifest made the “goods to follow” form easy to fill out for customs. Overall it’s been a very good experience - thanks PSS!

records.title: Great customer care received
records.text: Great customer care received from Austin Young and Charlie Bambrough.  Few hiccups with DHL not delivering when they said they would, however pick up of boxes for sea freight went very smoothly.. now we wait and see how long it takes them to get to DXB.  Air freight next also through PSS...

records.title: Best removals company
records.text: Mark and his crew were outstanding, nothing was too much trouble for them They were so professional and a credit to your company We highly recommend them to anybody Boss guys !!! Thanks so much again lads 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

records.title: They put their back into delivering on…
records.text: They put their back into delivering on time after a slow start. Leigh, lined up the necessary channels. Allowing an 86 year old to enjoy her surprise birthday gift.

records.title: positive experience
records.text: Overall a positive experience. The initial enquiry was easy & they were very responsive. Survey was completed in a timely manner. When my account then was passed over to an account manager it seemed I had a few people contacting me rather than just one account manager, which confused some things and I felt there was some areas of miscommunication, however quickly rectified and very responsive to messages. The crew that picked up my possessions, couldn’t have been better, courteous, polite, worked quickly, no fuss and handled everything.Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Generally very good!
records.text: Generally very good although some of the communication could have been clearer. I felt I had to ask for clarification of points that could’ve been explained earlier in the process. This is the first time I have had to ship more than a couple of boxes abroad and it’s quite convoluted. Otherwise all good and the packers were great.

records.title: I was recommended to contact PSS by…
records.text: I was recommended to contact PSS by Thakeham Antiques in Dial Post as their recent experience shipping to Australia was very positive.  However, it was slightly different for me as I was sending family antiques to my grandchildren as a 'living inheritance'.There were three certificates I needed,  CITES - from HMRC, LAPADA and valuations from a reputable company.  There was also a time factor to be considered and Australian customs to be navigated.The latter being very robust.  I had considerable help and kindness from the ladies who were managing my shipment  but for them, too I think, it was new territory. Now it's on its way and I'm hopeful that the outcome from Australia will be a good one.

records.title: Efficient packing and reasonable rate.
records.text: Lovely efficient couple of guys arrived and set to with energy! We’ll need to see how things arrive in Australia before a final judgment!My only negative comment was that PSS in Croydon said all our own packing would be opened and re-packed. On the day that didn’t happen in reality. Just a cursory check.had we known, we would have been more careful ourselves about labelling.

records.title: The commugt servicenication is quick and…
records.text: The communication is quick and efficient However,  there were so many bits of paper , I had to keep checking everything was signed snd sealed. Also the insurance was not a quote in advance more 'this is what you need to pay '. The final bill will be more than I thought. Overall good service ... just a tick sheet on forms was definately needed. Thanks

records.title: Everything after the second viewing has…
records.text: Everything after the second viewing has been superb. Peter was very clear and helpful with advice, to Ross getting my box’s delivered and sorting our date and advising us as a priority.  And a great job done by will and colleague collecting and wrapping our things. Only one down side was the initial video call and estimate we had, seemed to be confusing and totally different to the actual home visit from Peter.

records.title: Great experience overall
records.text: Moved from UK to Italy. Great experience overall. Every step has been handled professionally. Good communication with all staff involved. Items have been packed and labelled very well. Moving team in Italy also did an excellent job. It took almost 5 weeks to complete the move. But Considering the price is competitive and everything arrived safely. Would give 5 stars if they can give a bit longer notice for the arrival date.

records.title: From Hong Kong to the United Kingdom
records.text: From Hong Kong to the United Kingdom, after the goods arrive at the British port on 26/8/2024, they will not arrive at the British home until 25/9/2024, which takes a long time. It is recommended that the package be delivered to the customer's home within a maximum of one week after arriving at the British port. Things I appreciate: The customer service staff from Hong Kong, Liz, and the customer service team from the UK, Teresa, are very efficient and courteous in their responses. The two shipping partners were cordial and courteous.

records.title: Southwater Move - 4/12/23Very pleasant and helpful team
records.text: Very pleasant and helpful team. Good communication skills.Good equipment for labelling & QR codes for tracking your boxes & household items etc List of itemised boxes provided  for signature on site before leaving the house. Good packing materials provided ! Made a difficult experience much simpler & more customer friendly.

records.title: Awesome and very organised
records.text: Mike and Nick were awesome and very efficient and organised. So efficient in fact that they packed some things that we didnt need shipped, including the cling wrap and padlocks for our 6 suitcases ha!!

records.title: Great service
records.text: The team of packers arrived on time and were professional. I was impressed with how quickly they packed the house and transferred our belongings into the container. The container was delayed due to traffic. I would definitely use this service again.

records.title: Amazing service …
records.text: From the 1st phone call to the last every one was very helpful, polite and answered all my questions.The baggage person that came to pick up was very professional, called me 1/2 hour before he was going to come. Would highly recommend PSS International Removals

records.title: First Shipping Experience made easy by PSS
records.text: Shipping for the first time, I had a lot to learn. I found the PSS systems easy to follow and use, and the support from the staff was outstanding, with a nominated person always available to promptly assist.My propertry has been collected in the UK but I have not experienced the shipment or delivery in Australia yet.An area for improvement was the pickup, where this function has been outsourced. The service was not as caring or professional as expected.

records.title: Overall very happy but better communication required.
records.text: Overall I was very happy with the price, service from Joel the driver, and when able to get through on the phone, happy with the help I received. There needs to be better communication, replies to emails. I didn’t receive a message the day before as arranged, therefore, had to subsequently cancel, which meant having the boxes cluttering the house for several more days. The actual process was easy and I think very good value for money. I will update once I have my belongings on the other end!

records.title: Professional team. Good experience overall
records.text: Austin Young gave me very good customer service, a very Quick response to all my queries. Good understanding of customers' needs.. The guy (unfortunately I don't remember the name) who picked up the shipment and the one who came to dropped off the boxes, both are very friendly and helpful. Very professional team, easy to deal with.

records.title: a good move!
records.text: The PSS team arrived on time, they were helpful and alerted us to any breakages. We were blessed with good weather which was lucky as they had no floor covering material to prevent carpet smudging in the event of rain. All in all the move went well - no complaints

records.title: Swift collection and delivery from London to New York
records.text: Swift collection from London and delivery to my son in New York. 5 days I’m total, including the  weekend! We did find the numerous official forms a challenge to complete, but the team were on hand to guide us through and ensure they were completed accurately.

records.title: The rest of my belongings had to be…
records.text: The rest of my belongings had to be collected the next morning, as the crew had picked up another boxed pickup the evening before, so all my household goods would not fit in on the first run as planned. It was really inconvenient, as I had plans to be away from home, but I had to stay in an empty home and borrow blowup beds to stay there the night so a crew could come back to collect the rest of my boxes the next day. It woukd have been helpful had I been given an approximate time. So aside from this hiccup, I would have given the 5 star rating. The crew were great and very apologetic, and I would still recommend and use again if needed.

records.title: Orange NSW Australia to Lincoln…
records.text: We moved from Australia to Lincoln. The guys who collected and delivered our belongings were polite, helpful and well organised.  It was great to have our furniture unpacked and put back together.  The driver was also very helpful with the delivery.

records.title: Movers great, office communication awful
records.text: People on the ground were great. The movers were friendly, brisk and efficient. They made life very easy. The people measuring my stuff were good as well. Partners at NZ end likewise. They even pointed out a crack in my table so I could claim.However, in between the communication was woeful. There were delays, but at no point were these communicated. I received only one email that wasn't prompted by me, despite multiple delays. When I raised this the line I got back was always that they can't control delays. My issue was never delays, rather the lack of communication.  If you use these, be aware you will have to push for any replies from them. They simply do not communicate, nor respond to requests to improve this.

records.title: Good customer service, poor package handling.
records.text: The customer service as we arranged shipment was awesome, 10/10.Sadly though, our shipments arrived totally bashed, broken and with the contents spilling out. They had to be taped up by the delivery service prior to us receiving them. Contents were broken.I have more items to ship from the UK to the US but would not use this service again. The response I received after my complaint was that, 'the packing cases only contain the contents...' The packing cases provided, were not fit for purpose.

records.title: Feedback
records.text: I thought your staff were very professional, quick to responds to queries and followed instructions I gave re contacting my sister.I would have given 5 stars but the courier you chose initially (DHL) were woefully. Also,the boxes sent were not very sturdy. The boxes delivery person just knocked at the door, left a note and walked away. Luckily I heard him and chased after him. He literally did not wait even 10 seconds.The couriers you appointed after DHL were good.PSS were great but the couriers let you down.

records.title: Missing, broken or damaged.
records.text: Initial customer service was great, However once we were allocated a handling officer commumication reduced. Price doubled from initial quote (and we ended up not taken the car). We were charged another £800 when container got to the port - this was another unexpected cost. The work men appeared to be efficient, I had packed everything together in the hope it would be easier for them to pack as recommended. Staff encouraged me to go out and as I had lots of jobs appreciated the thought. Took less than quoted, ended up being just over half a 40ft container. Once recieved nearly all pieces of furniture was damaged, TV was broken and several items missing. On closer inspection of the inventory was not detailed. When unpacking we found spanners with christmas ornament - most were broken. Tried to chase but due to poor inventory very difficult. Have tried to pursue but with no luck.

records.title: Moving Back Home
records.text: Dealt with Tom, very personable. His quote changed to double original amount, no explanation, this was relayed to me by Charlie, Tom was away, and had made an error.  My shipment had been collected and I was on a strict time frame, so really didn't have the time to get shipment returned and get more quotes. Tom also mentioned a refund as I did my own packing. No refund received.Goods left UK 13.3.23 arrived Melbourne 11.5.23, communication with PSS's agent was really slack. Didn't answer phone calls, message banks were full.All communication then had to be through email.Queries they had with my custom forms and signature, I answered, they never let me know the outcome. Basically all boils down to poor communication, and as I booked and paid PSS, I hold them responsible.To cap it all, 14.7.23 my goods finally arrived in Tasmania, and 5 of my 18 cartons are damaged.Not a happy customer, I'm afraid I will not be recommending their services to anyone.

records.title: Delivery was delayed a month after it…
records.text: Delivery was delayed a month after it arrived in country. There was a lot of communication about when the delivery would be in country, but once it was in country another month of delay was introduced (additional 50% delay) Be careful of timelines provided regarding the shipping, they should include the complete delivery timeline.

records.title: Communication and customer experience not great
records.text: I feel my experience left a lot to be desired. Moving is such a stressful experience as it is and there are lots of little things I felt were not handled well. 1. I asked for a few options on the quote for different packed volumes. You have to select one of the options, but no-one explained that actually this nullifies the other options, so it was a bit of a shock when my final packed volume was half of the initial estimate, they offered only a tiny rebate and not nearly as much as what it would have been if I had chosen the lower quote option initially. 2. We put a lot of effort into getting everything ready to be packed and arranging and pre-packing things as efficiently as possible, but I felt that the packers packed the boxes quite loosely (despite me clearly explaining that we wanted to keep it as tight as possible). There was one box that was being closed up half empty and thankfully I noticed and was able to stop them and give them some extra things to pack in the space. 3. Very little communication from PSS once the shipment left the UK. No handover information from PSS, just an email from the South African handler (who had misspelt my email address, so I wasn't receiving this information, but fortunately they had sent it to the backup email address as well and that person happened to notice and forward onto me).4. A few days before expected delivery, the South African handler sent me an email to say 'Your shipment is on hold, please contact your shipping provider". They couldn't give me any further info, this is despite the fact that PSS actually owed me a refund, so there was no documentation or fees outstanding from my side. I immediately got in touch with my move manger, and then didn't get a response until later in the day when I chased again and all they said was that it was sorted - no explanation or apology for the distress caused. Overall, I think I'd try someone else next time.

records.title: All the process was handled very well... BUT
records.text: All the process was handled very well, the move itself was done on time. However, on transit, two pieces of large ceramics broke. Pieces that had come from Peru in a container with no issue and broke during the short journey from the UK to Netherlands. Clearly packing was not to a high enough standard and is done better in Peru.

records.title: inherited goods (unaccompanied)
records.text: our situation - a shipment of inherited goods from Sussex to Texas - did not seem to fit the normal  'mould',  so the PSS forms and procedures needed some amendment.   No-one was travelling  and the sender/shipper is not the same person as the recipient.We are still waiting to hear if they can put our shipment in a container shared with someone else's goods.  This could be a long wait which they did not warn me about.

records.title: Friendly staff but little communication
records.text: The men helping with the packing and loading were very helpful and friendly. But we had very little communication from PSS, the lorry driver didn't arrive until 1pm, not his fault, but PSS didn't let us know. We have also had some breakages, that we discovered when unpacking, we haven't finished yet, so don't know if there are any more breakages.

records.title: So far so good in terms of logistical…
records.text: So far so good in terms of logistical communication and professionalism.Obviously will wait for my final observations when boxes delivered home thank you

records.title: My experience with PSS for the past…
records.text: My experience with PSS for the past month has been somewhat stressful. JJ was the employee assigned to my emails to help me ship boxes from the UK to Spain. There were several emails he didn't respond to and the ones that he did were vague and didn't answer all my questions. I was confused about documents that needed doing and was also asked for a payment but hadn't received an invoice for the final amount due. Nothing felt clear, the emails and website were confusing and I didn't feel confident putting my trust in this company. It was coming up to the date that my boxes were being collected and I was worried I didn't have the right documents/hadn't paid. I didn't know whether to give my boxes to the courier as I wasn't sure they'd be accepted in Spain through customs. My boxes were being collected on a Monday morning so I couldn't get in touch with anyone as it was the weekend.I managed to find Ross Dunlevy through Facebook who connected me to John Moynes. They were both very helpful and responded to me on a weekend when the offices were closed. Since then, John has been supportive and explained everything to me. I really appreciate both men responding to me in their own time!My boxes have been collected today so fingers crossed everything goes accordingly for the next part of this process.

records.title: Helpful staff, terrible insurance process
records.text: Very helpful move manager at PPS, however a combination of delay and insurance handling led to the rating.Some insights on my experience that may be helpful to others deciding.Move from UK to Australia: Timeline: 7 months door to door (main reason for delay given - the war in Yemen).Price: Original quote ~£1,600Total actually paid once insurance, mandatory and optional fees were added: ~£2,600.  Had we paid all optional fees this would have been £2,700.Insurance: Cost of insurance - about £900.My estimate of cost to replace damaged items: £540.RCS Initial offer to settle: £10.50 (net of excess)RCS Final offer to settle: £150 (net of excess)Emails exchanged to finalise: 83Time taken from notification to payment: 18 weeks, 5 days - most of which was waiting for replies.The process for claiming seems designed to frustrate you and make you give up - as it ultimately did for me.There is no written complaint process - PSS refer you to their insurance provider, and their insurance provider refer you to PSS.The advertised free alternative dispute resolution available through BAR does not apply to insurance claim disputes.Due to the legal structure of the cover, this insurance is not subject to ombudsman jurisdiction - you are just stuck with whatever final offer is made unless you want to go to the time and expense of court.----Edited to add: Time taken to respond to Trustpilot public review: 2 daysTime taken to respond to internal complaint: 51 days

records.title: Started off well.....transit time DOUBLED, little accountabilty
records.text: **Be warned** PSS were extremely helpful at the start with great communication, prompt estimate and delivery and collection of boxes/belongings. However, after collection communication became scare, estimated delivery time went from 8-12 weeks to 20 weeks from London to New Zealand. On contacting PSS, they took no accountability and kept referring to their T&C's. My issue is the lack of communication to alert us of the significant increase in transit time. They informed us once the ship left the port. Too late to find an alternative solution. My daughter has to now live out of suitcase for 5 months.  Don't be fooled by the helpful staff at the outset, as once you no longer have your belongings you have zero control and they claim they don't either.....its all up to the shipping companies.

records.title: Additional costs, threats to withold goods without payment.
records.text: We recently engaged PSS to complete our move from the UK to Australia.An online quotation was completed, with video of all property. A price was then provided and paid in full prior to commencement.The packing service was good and was completed efficiently, pleasingly there was no breakages upon arrival even with the most fragile items. The goods arrived within the timeframe provided and from an operational perspective the service was good.However, unfortunately while the goods were in transit we were presented with two sets of additional costs.Firstly a week prior to anticipated delivery PSS issued an invoice requiring additional payment of cira 400GBP for an alleged increase in volume at packing.No notification was provided at the time of packing (some 4 weeks earlier), and PSS were unable to substantiate the additional volume alleged (note no increase in container size). While seeking additional information it was repeatedly stated by PSS that our goods would be withheld if payment was not made.We felt we had little option but to make a payment out of concern for our good, and eventually we negotiated a reduced payment of circa 200GBP.In addition, upon arrival the local delivery partner advised of port fees. While the port fees were excluded from PSS's quote, PSS did provide a guide, and the final cost was almost double the guide provided by PSS. The local provider evidenced that the port fee charged was known and stipulated to them by PSS.

records.title: Use another company
records.text: We paid PSS to deliver our precious things within three months, it took 6. The box we did receive late had been repacked and somethings were missing from this. I know it was repacked as it was a totally different box and not my writing. We were told one box was lost, it took a lot of effort to get only £75 out of them. I suspect damage may have occured as watching the man load them into the van did not fill me with confidence. PSSinternational didn't really deliver a good service, their excellent communication stopped after we paid. I would struggle to recommend or use them again, however we did receive some of our stuff and for that we are so relieved as there was a point we thought we would have it all lost.PSS should remember they are dealing with peoples most dear things. If they outsource, then they can't qualify control. I wouldn't use them again.

records.title: No good for musical instruments
records.text: The move was fine for the most part. However, I specifically asked them if they could move saxophones, and they said they had lots of experience. When the saxophones eventually arrived they were wrapped in a thin layer of paper which is in no way good enough. Saxophones are very fragile and need to be packed carefully before shipping. Everything else was fine and worked well.

records.title: PSS - disappointing
records.text: PSS International shipped our possessions from Eng to NZ. Communications with PSS were good, they came on time (on the hottest day of the year) and seemed to pack things carefully. However, several boxes went missing and a few items were damaged in transit. Some items did not merit as much wrapping at they got, whereas some other more valuable fragile items were under wrapped and got broken i.e. floor length mirror. Re the missing items, it took me 3 months of chasing PSS for them to confirm that their 'warehouse search' was complete and I could finally pursue my insurance claim with their recommended broker - Removal Claims Service (RCS) - who I am also now chasing. It's been quite time consuming chasing PSS and RCS to resolve...

records.title: Moving from the UK to the US awful
records.text: We moved from the UK to the US in November 2023, and PSS Removals used packers who crushed our things as they packed them- metal light fixtures were bent, they folded a foam standing mat and broke it to pack it, they dragged a workout machine and scraped the leather and wood all up, packed the dishes so they were all together and half the set broke. It was so upsetting to unpack. And then the insurance which they force you to buy quotes you prices for buying used items on ebay and won't include shipping costs, so you can get 4 replacement plates for $30 with $30 shipping (cost new is $150), and so they give you $30. And the shipment was delayed 3 or 4 times as they couldn't get a ship, so I had to pay an extra $1000 for 'increased shipping costs'. I fought this charge with the UK Ombudsman and lost as 'they are not in control of shipping costs' though they are in charge of relationships with shippers to get their cargo actually shipped on time.

records.title: Beyond disappointed. I'd recommend finding another company for international
records.text: From a grossly delayed haulage and delivery (nearly three weeks since arriving in port from Australia and approved by customs, 3 weekssitting there with no update!) - the only reason we got delivery confirmation is that I followed up on email five times.Then when it came to the delivery. It was an hour late with no call or anything to inform us. The gents were polite and efficient but did not unpack our items as per our booking (what we paid for), leaving us with 43 boxes and expecting us to keep them for 14 days because that's the soonest they can get someone to pick them up. Oh, and expecting us to pay £264 for them to pick them up, even though we paid for unpacking, reassembly (which never happened) and removal of boxes...The whole service by PSS has been unsatisfactory. I would never recommend anyone to use them. Very disappointed!

records.title: They smashed my most valuable…
records.text: They smashed my most valuable possession, charged me a fortune to insure It knowing I packed it my self and then refused to payout. The damage looked very much like it was none deliberately.

records.title: Avoid at all costs
records.text: Avoid at all costs. Can’t give them one star because at least my packages arrived (although weeks late), but this company is a disaster at every step along the way. I was told my price was an “estimate” and they would weigh and measure the packages after delivery. That never occurred, and I never received a new invoice. They got my delivery address wrong on the waybill despite me calling and emailing to correct. I was guaranteed a two-hour pickup window be fire purchase. After purchase, I was given a seven hour window instead, and the pickup still didn’t come within that window. My shipment was accidentally categorized as commercial and I went through hell with DHL trying to properly categorize it as personal. I still haven’t been refunded the extra charge for “commercial” shipping. Customer service is polite on the phone but does next to nothing to help after hanging up. I must have called PSS at least 20 times before my shipment was delivered. After all this, they admitted wrongdoing and offered a £35 refund. That’s approximately 7% of what we paid, and doesn’t even reimburse me for all the time and money I spent on long distance phone calls.

description: Safety Sign Supplies is the the UK's premiere source for safety signs, warning signs, construction signs, door signs and custom signs

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery! Ordered on 23rd December and arrived 24th December.  Was expecting it that quick.Very happy with product.  Will use again :)

records.title: The signs were exactly as required
records.text: The signs were exactly as required, delivered promptly.They look as if they will last for many years, the price was very competitive.

records.title: Quick delivery
records.text: Quick delivery, exactly what I ordered and plenty of choice

records.title: Brilliant service
records.text: Brilliant service - very speedy, quick customer service when I had a query and well made signs.

records.title: Great customer experience
records.text: Excellent products. Great customer service. They ensured that I was able to sign off on the look of a custom made sign and they still dispatched it the same day, with next day delivery. Impressive. All items were packaged well too.

records.title: The booking process was seamless
records.text: The booking process was seamless, and getting the test done was quick and easy. I made the booking late at night and was able to get assistance the very next day, just 2 miles from my location. I received the results that same afternoon. The examiner was not only professional and kind but also had a lot of experience, which made the process smooth and reassuring.

records.title: Good quality signs that will last
records.text: Good quality signs that will last, delivered quickly.  Not much more I could ask for.

records.title: Standard stock vinyl signs are excellent in all respects
records.text: Standard stock vinyl signs were easily ordered online, and promptly received by First Class post in a rigid A4-size card envelope.The various vinyl signs supplied are all of excellent quality, with very clear text and bright colours.Superb service in all respects - thank you.

records.title: Prompt efficient service and delivery
records.text: Prompt efficient service and delivery. And at a very reasonable price. Very happy and have forwarded their details to some colleagues who've shown an interest.

records.title: Signs are perfect
records.text: Signs are perfect, all exactly as ordered, even the custom one. Will definitely use again. Delivered super quickly,via next day courier. 5*+ Thanks so much!!

records.title: Easy
records.text: Easy to deal with and a quick service.

records.title: Easy website to find what you need
records.text: I bought 2 of one sign and 2 of another separately, both arrived when expected. They were easy to find on the website and easy to order. Also great customer service! Thank you

records.title: Quick response to questions and timely delivery
records.text: Quick response to questions and timely delivery of custom consistent quality product. It would help if they could offer 76mm clip for metal posts which is the right size for the most common lamp post size - we have to source from another supplier.

records.title: The sign is great
records.text: The sign is great. I would have liked it slightly larger but I guess people do not want a too intrusive sign on their doors.Edit: thank you for writing but returning the item is impossible as I already used it.

records.title: Was very quick and easy to order the…
records.text: Was very quick and easy to order the safety signs via the website. The website was easy to navigate and I found what I needed easily. The signs arrived super quick (next day) and were just what was needed.

records.title: Speedy delivery
records.text: Speedy delivery - Delivered the next day. The online  help service was very helpful and resolved the issue quickly

records.title: Great Service
records.text: Quick reply, even judt after Christmas holiday period.

records.title: The sign was just what we needed
records.text: The sign was just what we needed. Arrived promptly but I can’t tell how it lasted, as it was stolen after a couple of days!

records.title: All delivered correctly and in decent…
records.text: All delivered correctly and in decent time

records.title: warning signs
records.text: delivered on time ,goods perfect, will use again

records.title: Prompt service
records.text: Prompt service, good product

records.title: Custom-made No Parking Sign
records.text: Efficient service. Only 3 days from ordering to delivery. Sign well printed and as expected. This sign will be stuck to a blank plastic sign board and will be permanently displayed outside in all weathers. Not sure about adhesive quality and anti-fade properties. Only time will tell.

records.title: Will purchase from here again
records.text: Fairly easy website to navigate.  We have placed 2 orders now. Would have preferred an option for next day delivery - standard takes about 4-5 days to arrive. Was a little confused that I'd used to different companies at first as the items arrived as 'Viking Signs' even though I'd ordered from Safety Signs Supplies! Labels are well packaged and as described on the website.

records.title: Bespoke Signs
records.text: I had a specific requirement, not met by the array of standard sign designs on the website, so asked Viking Signs to help.  One simple email explaining my requirements resulted in a bespoke design being mailed back within three hours.  One further exchange led to an agreed final design and 4 days later the 27 different signs arrived at my door.  Excellent.

records.title: Online sign ordering
records.text: Overall the online ordering was easy to do apart from being able to see a visual mock up of my requirements. Often description in text of what you need does not come over clearly with a finished article. After a few tweaks the sign was just as required and delivered within 2 days of order confirmation. I recommend safetysignsupplies with confidence to any new customers.

records.title: Signs for office block in London
records.text: Very helpful when it came to arranging bespoke signs. Also very helpful when we changed our mind as what we had ordered simply did not work. Credit Note was issued without fuss, and new order dispatched. However, I would say that it was difficult to gauge the actual size of the bespoke signs we ordered from what was shown on screen; it was a case of waiting to see what was delivered before we could actually say that it worked, or not.

records.title: Great - But Could Do With Improved IT Functions
records.text: Customer service was outstanding, as was the speed in service. My only criticism is I received no order confirmation by email which left me unsure as to whether my order had gone through, and from what I can see there is no way of checking order history / order status on account section. If facility is there, I don't think it's particularly clear.Overall, very happy and would highly recommend. Many thanks.

records.title: The service and delivery are excellent
records.text: All my inquiries and orders have been dealt with a professional and efficient manner. I had one slight issue with emailing the sales email account but this was resolved quickly with a simple phone call to the sales team. Overall experience is excellent and being kept up to date with order progress by email is fantastic as it reduces time having to expedite orders

records.title: Fast turn round
records.text: Fast turn round.  I ordered before noon and got next-day delivery.  The only problem was the confirmation email was not sent until late in the day and I became concerned that my order had been lost.  A small problem and easy to fix.  I wold recommend this company.

records.title: Safety signs for fire exit door
records.text: Good range of products - almost too many choices so care needed to find best to suit requirements. Also need to be aware that delivery cost & VAT will inflate prices first shown. Other offers not explored for cost comparisons, but should consider for high cost purchases.  However signs as ordered arrived by mail very quickly, and helpfully had not needed staying in and signing for. They were of good quality and as expected. Will be happy to come back again.

records.title: It was much smaller than I thought.
records.text: It was much smaller than I thought.Should have read the dimensions properly. It's not useful for what I wanted it for

records.title: I was unable to log on although I had…
records.text: I was unable to log on although I had an original pass word. I was unable to request chance password. In the end I had to ring. The order was dealt with very well. I received the goods a few days later but no invoice. As I have to claim expenses I wasn’t too impresses.

records.title: The sign I ordered came promptly.
records.text: The sign I ordered came promptly.I was a bit disappointed initially with the stickers I’d ordered, but Vikingsafetysupplies quickly send me replacement stickers more suited to my needs, free of charge.So I’m very pleased, both with the product and especially with the after sales feedback!

records.title: Not Very Impressed!
records.text: The order was placed on Thursday 21st February and not shipped until Monday 25th. Why an earth should two adhesive labels, total cost £2.69 + VAT be sent by Royal Mail First Class SIGNED FOR post, (£3.95). Because we were not in when the Postman tried to deliver the package, we then had to make a special journey to the local Sorting Office.

records.title: Bad delivery service
records.text: Product was fine but paid an exorbitant £12 for next day delivery as it was urgently needed and got a message on the morning saying it had been delayed until the day after. No contact from the company to refund the next day charge or even apologise only had an automated courier email. not good enough in an age of internet reliability Update: Resolution from safety signs was very good so they redeemed themselves although it shouldn't have happened in the first place

records.title: Could be better
records.text: The initial ordering process was helpful and delivery quick but expensive.However, the signs I received were quite poor quality, thin and just not up to a good standard really. Especially for the price paid and cost of delivery considering how lightweight they are.Won't be ordering any more.

records.title: Good product
records.text: Very happy with the product, the only dissapointment was that I ordered the few stickers I needed on the Friday morning as I needed them for the Monday morning and the postage was 1st Class Royal Mail. I was a bit disapointed that the stickers were not dispatched until the following Monday evening.

records.title: Why no fixings? Why sell a sign without them?
records.text: Why sell a sign, with no "fixings", which in my prior experience are supplied by all other sign suppliers.An inconsiderate, careless, non-customer focussed lack of detail - most surprising.The sign was absolutely fine, just as expected, minus the fixings!

records.title: Quick delivery, not great quality item.
records.text: Very quick delivery of the bespoke self adhesive sign I ordered but the vinyl was very flimsy and rather than the red colour being red it was more of a faded red/ pinkish colour.Need to be better quality for the money and to match the excellent delivery time.

records.title: Still waiting 5 days after payment
records.text: Still waiting 5 days after paymentCalled and was told it was with royalMailNothing about chasing for me or a tracking system for meDisappointed to have a questionnaire before the order was arrived

records.title: Got it right in the end
records.text: Sent over a copy of what we needed, sent through really quickly within the time scales advised. When arrived was not correct, contacted and advised a new lot would be sent by Fri, but didn't turn up until the Mon.

records.title: Creased.
records.text: Sign creased along top. Envelope not bent so must have happened before being posted. Would have preferred a non creased one as  for a present and cost quite a bit for what is essentially an A4 sticker.

records.title: I thought these signs were quite …
records.text: I thought these signs were quite expensive for what they are and the postage charges were high - so two 4" x4" cost more than £9 delivered.  The quality of the product was fine

records.title: Meant to be 2 Stars only
records.text: Wrong material sent. Replacement was promised on overnight delivery but order didn't arrive until Thursday. Even then the postage was underpaid by £6.Not a good first experience.

records.title: Got what I wanted
records.text: placed my order but it didn't arrive on the specified date, however I contacted the supplier and a new delivery was sent out which arrived the following day.

records.title: OK, could do better
records.text: I ordered 2 small signs and 2 stickers but the packaging, although 3 times the size of the largest items, was too narrow so my stickers arrived with several creases in them.

records.title: Easy to order but a flaw ensued
records.text: Easy to order. Delivery process good. What is a let down is NO invoice was raised at the time of purchase and some 4 days later i still have no invoice

records.title: Difficult backing paper to remove.
records.text: The backing paper on the thin vinyl signs are very difficult to remove, it took me ages to put up the signs.The thicker luminescent ones were no problem.

records.title: Sign Value good for material specification
records.text: Great customer service team, willing to help always friendly and give great customer advice for people who have never purchased from them before.

records.title: Average
records.text: Good delivery, quick.The quality wasn't great for the price, thought they may have been a little thicker, but they do the job

records.title: Service altogether not good enough
records.text: Service altogether not good enough - wouldn’t recommendSpoke with Darren today- who tbf tried to ring me a few times until we managed to talk today. Having discussed the issues in depth-It was agreed Amy’s wording of the emails wasn’t great & a little bit of training needed moving forward. I’m a fair person & can only speak as I find-good or bad. You don’t have a bad track history & do genuinely seem to care what went wrong. I’m sure this won’t effect your business moving forward. Best of luck. Angela

records.title: i bought 3 signs 2 worked ok the 3rd…
records.text: i bought 3 signs 2 worked ok the 3rd one did not work at all just peeled no sticky

records.title: vinyl signs
records.text: I ordered some vinyl signs which have a paper backing which is not straight forward to unpeel as the paper layers peel in two, leaving a cover on the sign.      We were about to send the signs back when we managed to remove the second layer of paper which is awkward to do. The sign stick well if you can remove the paper backing.

records.title: Over priced
records.text: I must admit for £27.80 inc pp I was expecting a little more than 2 floppy stickers ! I thought for the price brushed steel effect would mean a little more rigid quality, the glue is weak and I have had to adapt them onto a rigid board but doubt they will last long outside.  Poor value for money in my opinion.

records.title: Wish I had gone to eBay!
records.text: Urgently needed a sticky solution to a hanging job so I rushed online, found what I was looking for and ordered, order process simple, item dispatched the next day, could of been same day as item instock and just needed being put in an envelope! thankfully Royal Mail delivered the next Woking day, opened packet and wow what a rip off! Really disappointed with what I had paid and received, opted for another solution to hang my sign and binned the product, looked on eBay and could of purchased similar for under half the amount! Sorry won't be using you again!

records.title: Not what I expected
records.text: Not what I expected. Not clear on sizes on the website hence all too small to make a difference and quality is poor would have been better just downloading signs for free as they don’t look professional either

records.title: Something missing from the description
records.text: Though I chose the plastic sign with screws, it did not come with screws and a hole in the plastic to screw the sign on the doors which was why I chose the plastic in the first place.  You may need to specify it comes without holes and screws perhaps.

records.title: What I saw isn't what I got
records.text: The sign that arrived was not what I had ordered (there were some minor but annoying differences in the wording). Shame because the quality was good and I just don't have the spare time to send it back with all the associated palaver!

records.title: Goods delivered to wrong address
records.text: Unfortunately the goods were sent to the wrong address; they were subsequently collected and delivered to the correct address, and staff were helpful in this respect, however the delay meant that we are unlikely to use this supplier again.

records.title: Order wasnt delivered in full s
records.text: Ordered 4 directional fire exit signs and associated brackets. Signs delivered 2 days later...great although no sign of the brackets. Call and promised them next day...but no show, still waiting......very poor!!!

description:
Hello Services Ltd was established in 2019 with the mission of providing high quality home services to customers throughout the country. We offer a vast range of services, including Cleaning, Moving, Handyman and Clearance Services, as well as selling packaging materials. All our staff are professionally trained and fully vetted so that they can provide high-quality service 7 days a week. 

Furthermore, we are able to provide short notice services so that when you have an unexpected problem or need something done fast, we can help! All our work is guaranteed to ensure customer satisfaction and we strive to leave each customer with peace of mind.

records.title: Excellent Service
records.text: We booked a couple of days before the system was quick and easy to understand. Saya was friendly and professional, she talked me through her process and made sure that I knew what products she was using as well. She was very kind and did a fantastic job on a number of appliances in our home.

records.title: A highly professional clean
records.text: Ismail and Ali were great. My father (92) moved house a week ago. The house was left in a disgusting state by the previous occupant and needed a thorough clean. Ismail and Ali arrived on time, were polite, professional, efficient and kind and patient with my father.  They did a fantastic job especially on the carpets. They also completed the job in less time than I had expected.all in all a harass free experience. I would highly recommend them.

records.title: Bobby and his team are the best
records.text: Bobby arrived at my property, surveyed and noted every detail, and then he and his mates started working. The results were better than I expected. He certainly takes pride in his work and provided all the equipment. I am honestly more than impressed with this team's work. A+.

records.title: Hello Services team Helen = great results
records.text: Team Helen were really professional. They came on time and worked non-stop. Everywhere I look, the results are great. The conservatory is particularly excellent, and I can't fault them for anything.

records.title: Saya was amazing
records.text: Well done to Saya and her team. I am honestly very impressed with their work. She did an amazing job and followed all of my instructions perfectly. Amazing results, bravo!

records.title: I booked cleaning and moving with Hello…
records.text: I booked cleaning and moving with Hello Services, they gave me a good rate and delivered both services to an excellent standard. I will use them again.

records.title: Better than I hoped
records.text: After a long bout of ill health, I had fallen behind on my cleaning and was embarrassed about it. I made a booking a few days ago, and Saya arrived today and did an amazing job. Everywhere now looks great, better than I had hoped! Saya was lovely and kind, and very understanding of my current limitations. Would 10/10 recommend to anyone thinking of having a professional cleaning service done. Thank you so much Saya.

records.title: Punctual and professional
records.text: Office staff were really speedy at responding to emails - I easily added on a couch steam cleaning with no fuss at all. Team Yamba arrived exactly on time and listened carefully to the complexities of the cleaning service required in my new flat. Did a great job and really made it feel like home, would definitely recommend.

records.title: Great clean and good prices
records.text: I booked for end-of-tenancy cleaning with Hello Services. The landlord was happy, the results were great, and the price was affordable. 10/10.

records.title: 11/10 service from beginning to end!
records.text: I am more than impressed with the deep clean move-in service I recieved from Bobby and team. They arrived early, worked so hard all day, did a really thorough clean and exceeded my expectations, which made our moving in experience even better! Bobby and co. We're so friendly and proud of the work they were doing. I have recommended Hello Serivces & Bobby to friends and family already.If you are hesitating like I was, look no further! These guys are the real deal! Hello Services were the first to respond to my many enquiries sent out, they had last minute weekend availability, quote was in line with other quotes I had received, all products and equipment were provided, and the rest of the service consistently followed. 11/10!Thanks again everyone 🙌

records.title: Zaher was professional at his job
records.text: Zaher was professional at his job, but can sometimes be forgetful. As a result, Hello Services arranged a second visit to make up for the disappointment. Now, my oven is shiny and my washing machine is fresh. Not a bad service imo.

records.title: They did a very satisfactory job
records.text: They did a very satisfactory job! I was very pleased with the cleanliness and I'm extremely grateful for everything they did! I will be using this company again, and I will recommend them to everyone who needs a cleaner!

records.title: The overall performance was good but should pay more attention to minor parts
records.text: The overall performance was good. The first impression after the cleaning was clean and shiny. However, it seemed that the cleaners had overlooked some minor parts. For instance, the kitchen fan extractor, fridge, oven, washing machine were thoroughly cleaned but the microwave oven left much to be desired. As there were still stains on the upper part of the oven's compartment. In addition, the bed rooms, toilets and bathrooms have been done very well but the inside of the bathroom drain covers were uncleaned. Hope the cleaners can work more comprehensively next time.

records.title: Great Clean
records.text: After a shaky start, with cleaners being over an hour late with little update or communication the team arrived and completed a great job. My landlord was there to inspect the property upon completion of the clean and was happy with the job done and couldn’t find any issues.

records.title: Very Satisfactory
records.text: Apart from the cleaners being given the wrong time to arrive, the process went well. The cleaners were thorough in their coverage of each room so that on completion there was no doubt that all aspects had been covered.

records.title: Mostafa’s Loqman team were lovely
records.text: Mostafa’s Loqman team were lovely. Mostafa is extremely accommodating. I had a logistically difficult clean (lots of boxes due to moving in) but he managed to instruct carefully how the clean should be carried out. Will definitely call again in the future.

records.title: YES…
records.text: Two delightful Portuguese men arrived on time and were ready to work. And work they did - we are very pleased and would recommend - when looking around the empty apartment before starting we were told the spots that might not come out like the limescale - and it was obvious that they had given it a really good go. Also the people who I spoke to on the phone were lovely and helpful

records.title: I was worried but they delivered
records.text: I had requested for a long list of cleaning services as part of a deep clean for the entire home. The day before I was told that there was no team available but Michael pushed to find a team for me. The team that arrived on the day did a really good job considering it was just two of them for the whole house. Thank you so much!

records.title: Zaher and Yousif
records.text: The guys Zaher and Yousif were here promptly- actually early which was very much appreciated - and worked tirelessly all afternoon. Both were highly professional, courteous and friendly and did absolutely everything they could to save my poor bathroom (left in a state by the previous tenant) Great effort applied. Both were sweating at the end!

records.title: Hello Cleaning Services
records.text: Saleem & his team were very friendly & good, the only reason they didn't get 5 stars is because I had to tell them to go over some bits again. I feel if you are there in person the service provided is good, otherwise could be a bit haphazard.

records.title: Great clean but a bit pricey
records.text: I used Hello Services to do a pre-sale clean of my deceased father’s flat.  This was a mixed experience.  The lads from the MD Scotland team who came to do the clean were great - very pleasant and hard working and they did a really great job.  The flat was sparkling by the time they had finished. However I feel the cost was very pricey for the number of hours allocated to them.    I also found it very frustrating having to do everything online - I could never get any answer when I tried calling the company on the phone to discuss my requirements.

records.title: The team did a great job of the end of…
records.text: The team did a great job of the end of tenancy cleaning. The house looks great. We would have given five stars if they hadn’t arrived late, giving the reason that you didn’t have a contact number prior to leaving.

records.title: Very prompt service
records.text: I did all the arrangements online the payment and the information was very easy and they were able to come the next day. Ali turned up exactly on time at 8 o’clock and he was very friendly helpful clean and careful. The carpets look lovely I’m v pleased thank you.

records.title: Overall quite clean
records.text: Overall quite clean, done lots of work on mattresses and carpets. Carpets remained quite dirty, which is likely to do with the carpets, rather than cleaning. Mattresses became much cleaner. Though some areas were not cleaned - e.g. on top of kitchen counters. I have cleaned myself after. originally I booked for before I move the furniture in, but they cancelled on the day.

records.title: IKEA wardrobes dismantled and reassembled
records.text: I would've given the handymen 5 stars, but felt slightly let down by the admin side of things as I didn't receive confirmation that they would actually turn up on the day or any instructions about what sort of preparation would be required on my part.  Fortunately they did turn up and did an excellent ob.

records.title: After an initial miscommunication with…
records.text: After an initial miscommunication with the cleaner and difficulties with the office,  I was delighted with the results of my deep clean and would highly recommend the cleaner who did an amazing job with my fathers house which was very dirty after his passing. I can’t recall his name but he told me he covers Edinburgh & Glasgow for the company so would recommend him alone. Willing to forget the contact throughout the day with the main office though . Unlike the cleaner who was excellent they really need to brush up on their personal skills when dealing with customers

records.title: End of Tenancy Cleaning Service
records.text: Loqman and his team came to my property to conduct an end of tenancy cleaning. Most of the work cleaning had to be in the kitchen especially the oven and I must admit Loqman and his team did a great job. My oven look close to new.

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Excellent, very clean exactly what I was hoping. Literally looks like a brand new flat again. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars because they didn’t wash the plates but that can be overlooked

records.title: I had my sons flat cleaned in glasgow
records.text: I had my sons flat cleaned in glasgow.  Yusuf and his team have done a very good job. The communication from the entire team has been very good

records.title: I used Hello Services for a deep house…
records.text: I used Hello Services for a deep house clean for a second time.  From beginning to end, it is a very professional service from the confirmation to the reconfirmation to the tip-top service provided by the cleaners.

records.title: As much as they gave a Good clean to my…
records.text: As much as they gave a Good clean to my kitchen  and bathroom  however  I paid for my carpet  to be cleaned  thinking  it would  be a professional  job no it wasn't  don't offer a service if you don't use a professional  machine , had to do my own carpets after..... also I they took my bleach and toilet  roll

records.title: Too expensive for the results
records.text: Negatives:The clean cost £450 pounds, that is because I bought a deep clean and I added services like cleaning carpets, a sofa, a mattress, blinds and windows, oven etc.Whilst those extras were done fine, the deep clean itself neglected a lot of areas: the entire house was not vacuumed and mopped as you would expect with a deep clean (kitchen floor was not vacuumed or mopped, neither was the entrance way). Bathroom has shelves that were not wiped down or dusted, bathroom bin was left full - actually nearly overflowing. Living room had multiple surfaces that were not dusted. Kids rooms were not dusted.I started off paying for a base deep clean for 3 bedrooms, one bathroom, kitchen, living area even though this house is really only 2 bedrooms, with a tiny box room.Positives:Easy to book, easy to add on the extras (though every tiny things costs - they would not even wipe down walls without charging an additional £30 on top of the £450 I already paid, even though it was a "deep clean")The areas that I did pay extra for, were well done except for the windows where there was a lot of dust.Overall, I wouldn't use this service again. The price is too high for the results in my opinion.

records.title: Arrived two hours late
records.text: Arrived two hours late.  Was here for 1 1/2 hour more like a clean than a deep clean..was charged for cleaning interior windows but was not done disgusting no furniture moved,  Kitchen worktops not cleaned properly..absolutely waste of money.

records.title: End of tenancy cleaning
records.text: Sardar and Shahid did a great end of tenancy cleaning for my 2 bedroom flat. I had no other option, but to advance the timing of the job to be started 2 hours before my scheduled time as the cleaners had another job to go to and would not agree unless I shift the date so, I agreed to an earlier timing. Also, there was a 30 minute delay with me having to simply wait at the property with the job being declined and for guarantee to be taken off to start the job as there was too much limescale and mould in the bathrooms. However, everything worked out and the 2 of them did amazing cleaning in 2 hours time. I would definitely recommend Sardar and Shahid. Thank you.

records.title: I booked a one-off deep house clean
records.text: I booked a one-off deep house clean. Smit team were very professional and arrived on time. On initial review, it looked well cleaned, the shower was cleaned particularly well. On closer inspection there were some areas that seemed to have had less attention. Some areas I ended up rehoovering & rewiping. Overall good job but not quite to the quality expected from a ‘deep-clean’ service.

records.title: Good but missed a few things
records.text: The team didn’t seem to be properly informed about the full agreed service.. missed a few things that should have been steam cleaned and left a few grease spots in the floor. Otherwise the remaining service was good, nice staff as well, too bad for those details that pose a service difference.

records.title: Strong Storage Boxes
records.text: I ordered boxes which I should of received for next day delivery as order was placed before 3pm (deadline).  It didn’t arrive until 2 days after.  I emailed customer service who said they would look into it, and refund the delivery cost I paid, which I didn’t get back the refund for delivery.  Then the  boxes I ordered was 5 extra large, and 1 extra large tall box, it was missing. They did send 1extra large box (next day delivery), but it still wasn’t the extra large tall box.  The only positive thing for me, the boxes are of very good quality and very strong.

records.title: Not worth the money, decent communication, intimidating staff
records.text: Booking the service online was quite simple to do, on the day of cleaning I got a call to say they were on their way. Three men turned up and the main guy was shown the flat. I had booked an end of tenancy cleaning. I was told this would take 3 hours but was done just under 2 hours.The flat was cleaned however very obvious wall marks were left and light switches were left when this had been on the cleaning list.I contacted the company and was told this wasn’t included.What I will say is I think they should tell you who is coming to clean as I am a 27 year old woman and three grown men turning up by myself was quite intimidating, had I known I would of had someone else with me. I also don’t think the amount I paid £240 was worth the cleaning the flat received.The men were nice enough but I personally wouldn’t recommend as I don’t feel it was worth the price and I didn’t personally feel comfortable with three grown men by myself.

records.title: Deep clean
records.text: I booked hello services for a deep clean. The team were friendly. The quality of the clean was only ok as they missed a few important areas, but when I asked them to redo the dirty areas they came back and finished. I did have to finish some of the cleaning myself though. If you’re booking hello services I’d recommend giving a thorough inspection after the clean, and they are very happy to come back and correct.

records.title: Not great but okay.
records.text: I had an end of tenancy cleaning but it was only okay, they did a good job with some things, a mediocre job with others but there were also things they didn't do, despite being on the list, in my case they didn't wash the sink or try to take the mildew from the bathroom ceiling. The service was a bit disorganised too, the gentleman cleaner came to have a look around and asked me what needed doing, but they should have the details of everything they need to do because you receive an invoice as soon as you confirm the job weeks before, so that left me a bit paranoid because they should know. He also had to go and do another job as soon as he arrived, so he had double booked, and left his partner alone to do most of the work which is why I'm guessing they missed things and some things weren't done well. I text him to see if he wanted a copy of the invoice but he ignored my message. He came back right for the last hour or so. I probably won't use them again honestly.

records.title: Gone for a three given the cleaner had…
records.text: Gone for a three given the cleaner had was a five but dealing with the company is a straight up 1...The cleaner was outstanding but had been given poor information by the team directing him, he did his best, couldnt do some of the jobs but this was not his fault, what he did was outstandingDealing with the company and office is a nightmare as many of the reviews below have said, no one seems to know what is going on, promises of calls back never happenMy advice would be to go with someone local to you, trying to coordinate with an office in London just doesn't work, what should have been a one day job with minimal fuss turned into a two week saga. Again this seems a recurrent theme with the reviews below, I should have read these first!

records.title: Deep clean
records.text: I had a deep clean . Much of it was well done. Didn't realise they'd not bring own cleaning products or cloths. Needs to be made explicit. Would think for the cost then they'd supply own .Beds weren't moved so had to do that myself and also left smears on the windows so I've sorted those as well.Also left my electric fire out of place and had to put back together as they'd moved it and it had come apart. Thankfully was easily sorted. Wish I'd been around to check before they'd left but was trusting it would all be done without the need. Least its generally cleaner.

records.title: Overpriced for what you get
