records.text: The two cleaners were polite and completed some jobs very well (such as the fridge, oven, extractor hood and shower), however I was shocked at how little was included for the deep clean service and the short amount of time that you get the cleaners for. I paid £275 and was left quite disappointed with the state of the place, I would have saved considerable money just booking individual services on their own. I had to point out a few things to them at the end that had not been done and I noticed even more after they had left. The company should make it much more clear before you book that a lot of basic things are not included in the Deep Clean and/or that there is a time limit. The manager that came at the beginning and at the end also tried to suggest that because I had a shower and a bath in my bathroom that I was meant to pay for two bathrooms rather than one, which is does not say anywhere on your website.

records.title: No initiative & they want things to be quite clean already!
records.text: They do some good, some bad. I got them to do an end of tenancy clean in a house 200 miles away from me, so I couldn't be there. The house had been fully redecorated, just needed kitchen, bathroom & floors to be cleaned. I thought they might be sensible people & use their initiative to figure things out, or call me if they weren't sure of something - nope - it's not like that at all!! You only communicate via the guy in the office.They will only do really specific things; will not touch the boiler at all if they need to turn it on to get hot water. Will not touch the oven if they think it's too dirty (they wanted an extra £75 on top of the £25 I'd already agreed for the oven - eh????). They complained about the house being dirty (er, they are *cleaners*, right???). Charged me £205 and expected to be there for an hour & a half. Kept the £25 I'd paid them for the cooker that they objected to - said they would keep it because the place needed more cleaning. Seems a lot, what do you think? I did get photos from the dispatcher guy though, which was good. Summary - if your house is already fairly clean & you can be there to organise them then they might save you some time. Do not think that they will go in & do a great post-tenancy clean for you if you can't be there - it's too difficult for them. Ideally you would make them tea, make sure they are comfortable on the sofa, and do the cleaning yourself while they relax.

records.title: I booked in a deep clean and was told…
records.text: I booked in a deep clean and was told it would be 3/4 hours with 2/3 cleaners so I thought that £270 was ok for that amount of time. On the day there were 2 cleaners who actually were here for exactly 2 hours. So I was charged £135 per hour which is rediculous in itself. I also booked to have a set of curtains cleaned at £40 but was told when booking that if they couldn’t be done then I wound get the money back. On the day the cleaner was concerned about getting the steamer near to the window as I have a sofa in front of it, so I told him not to worry about doing them. He said he would do the staircase instead. I assumed he meant steam cleaning them but no, he hoovered them and I’m supposed to pay £40 for that? It wasn’t a deep clean at all. I would expect doorways and all surfaces to be dusted but not al all. I have been trying to talk to someone at this company but nobody will call me. I have been emailing them with no satisfactory reply and have been told in the last  email that they will not communicate with me anymore. Great customer service from a rip off company. If you want a deep clean at a fair price, do not use this company.Update.I finally got a call and was able to express my grievance with a person. They agreed to refund me the £40 which I thank them for. I still feel it was a pricey job but things could have been sorted a lot sooner if I had had a call back instead of repetitive emails.

records.title: Nothing yet
records.text: Order hasn’t turned up in over a week. But the staff at HB have been very helpful trying to get it sorted.

records.title: Not so deep clean
records.text: Paid £300 for a deep clean. The clean seemed rushed and many areas were simply not touched eg kitchen sink, back door, cobwebs on walls amongst other things. Some good work eg steam cleaned curtains but disappointing overall.  Company promised to investigate on 30th June and reply within 48 hours. Still no response. I’d recommend going for a local, trusted company instead.Update: thank you to Oliver in customer services who kindly contacted me, apologised and made a partial refund.  Oliver took time to explain the background to the issues which are now resolved.

records.title: Cheap but did not pass inspection on end of tenancy clean
records.text: Communication via email was prompt. Price felt reasonable. The cleaners arrived on time however the clean done was subpar. It was an end of tenancy and it did not pass inspection. Cobwebs were left on the walls, stains on the cooker, water marks on the kitchen counter. We had to pay an extra cleaning fee to our landlord out of our deposit. Would not recommend.

records.title: There was some confusion
records.text: There was some confusion; Hellovans informed me that the removal company had accepted the order but when I called them an hour before the expected time, they told me that they had not accepted it!Luckily, they were able to fit me in about an hour after the agreed time so five stars to them, but I did feel that Hellovans hadn't done a great job, hence the 3 stars for Hellovans.

records.title: Used these guys for end of tenancy…
records.text: Used these guys for end of tenancy clean.(Smit)At the moment I am unable to write an honest review until I receive the end of tenancy report and see how much of my deposit I will get back.I will change review accordingly. David

records.title: Luck of the draw who you get
records.text: Unfortunately some will ruin it for others. This experience could have been great and I would have happily booked again.50mins late to the appointment, rush job. Didn't clean shower head.Filed in the survey, got contacted for a rebook by hello services, cleaners were 90mins late for the re-clean.They removed the limescale off the tile in the shower that I sent the photo of, but wouldn't clean the others as they were not in the photo I sent after their initial visit.So now I have one clean shower tile whilst the others still have limescale.Pity, if I had different cleaners, this could have been a much better experience.

records.title: Don't Waste Your Hard Earned Money
records.text: I booked and paid over £300 for a DEEP CLEAN after moving into a bungalow that needed a professional clean, 4weeks ago. Turned up an hour late, did a quick flash round with a cloth, hoovered + 'washed' laminate floor throughout (only the bits they could see!), 'ignored' the fact that id asked for window sills/ledges/skirting boards to be cleaned + bathroom was no cleaner than when we moved in - complete waste of money. We did get a 'refund', after complaining, of £30 for the additional £30 we paid for an oven clean that didn't happen + that was it.

records.title: Terrible Admin
records.text: Although the cleaning was great, the admin side was in shambles. I booked a cleaning for 8am and the cleaners were late. They called to apologise and say they typically do not start work until 9am and so were not aware of the 8am time. Secondly, I rang a day before and gave the operator the keycode for my keylock. This was not communicated to the cleaners. Thirdly, after my booking was completed, I got an email for a booking in another location that was not mine. The cleaners for that property were calling to say they were on their way. A total violation of my privacy as my number was shared with people who had no business having it and I had an address, name and quote of a total stranger. Overall, it was not a pleasant experience.

records.title: Not deep cleaned in my opinion
records.text: I wanted a deep clean and stated all the work I wanted doing, however the bathroom ceiling and cladding are very dirty, I’ve tried to do them myself but cannot reach and being elderly darent stand on ladders. Very disappointed.

records.title: I had to supervise the deep and clean…
records.text: I had to supervise the deep and clean and each space needed to be recleaned at least 3 times until satisfactory. They just left in the end with an incomplete clean. I was disappointed that they only used a spray mop on the floor without water or steam so the floor needed to be removed by myself. Disappointed.

records.title: Not worth of it
records.text: It's pretty okay for standard cleaning, but don't expect anything more if you order a deep cleaning from them. For them, deep cleaning means two people spending 3.5 hours doing the regular tasks. It costs close to £500, but it's not worth it. When politely asking about this, they simply refer to their terms and conditions.

records.title: Deep clean is f*ing shallow.
records.text: Went for the “deep clean” and it absolutely wasn’t at all. House remained filthy with a layer of dust. The team were friendly but seemed intent on finishing as quickly as possible rather than doing things properly. Had to spend rest of day dusting down stuff. Customer service told me without photographic evidence there was nothing they could do - my fault as I was more interested in getting my house dust-free. Am sure it’s fine for basic cleaning but don’t pay £200+ for the deep clean as it’s a waste of your time and money.EDIT: I see your response says you have no record of communication. That is entirely false. The fact you accuse me of that is laughable.

records.title: Ordered from Home Boxes before 3pm on…
records.text: Ordered from Home Boxes before 3pm on Friday expected next day  delivery as stated on their website for Saturday. Didn’t happen . Arrived at 5.30pm today .Communication poor , customer service poor and delivery misleading. I wouldn’t recommend

records.title: Shocking
records.text: Book for house cleaning. Three girls turned up not speaking any English. Lady who cleaned kitchen was good. Other two hopeless. Had to get them back twice to clean more shelves and skirting boards as they had not done them properly . Left two stains on carpet.They then sprayed tile cleaner on carpet! Unreal. A very bad and rushed job. They then told me I had not paid the company. Luckily I had invoice on me to show them. Really dissatisfied with your service.

records.title: Speedy Delivery but Low Quality. Akin to a 2AM Takeaway rather than a nice restaurant..
records.text: Everything arrived extremely quickly and for that I was really happy. The 2/5 comes when looking at the quality though, the “deluxe” 1-2 bedroom set is presented as high quality, but single layered cardboard box’s with flimsy handles mean that a box will be incapable of holding its sizes worth of plates or semi heavy materials. The second issue was the amount of packing materials offered in the form of bubble wrap and acide free paper. The bubble wrap is very low quality, and isn’t capable of protecting anything from damage, and comes in such low quantities that I was unable to line the top and bottom of more than two boxes, and was out of paper by the time I had wrapped 20-25 items. The quality is the main issue though, you will need to find a way to sure up the strength of the box’s for heavier items, which I used copious amounts of tape purchased from a different supplier, you will need more bubble wrap, and you will need more paper, just to fill the flimsy box’s they send. One box was double lined and of reasonable quality, but that comes at an excessive price for what it is.

description:
Welcome to the Maid2Clean (R) Website! Premier domestic cleaning & ironing services in the United Kingdom. 

Please note that Maid2Clean is a franchise. As such it is made up of a number of independent businesses and operators. It would be useful in reviews if the particular areas could be noted.

records.title: Easy to set up with a cleaner
records.text: Easy to set up with a cleaner, Maid2Clean set up potential cleaner and arrange interviews. Our cleaner is lovely but if there was a problem then Maid2Clean would sort a replacement or temporary cover.Peace of mind and a clean house!

records.title: This is due primarily to my lady who cleans and interaction with her
records.text: This is due primarily to my lady who cleans etc for me she is very good both with her job and how she interacts with me and would recommend her

records.title: Pleasant office staff who are easy to get hold of should this be necessary.
records.text: Easy to get hold of should there be any reason for a discussion required. Friendly staff and always available.

records.title: Your stuff
records.text: Your stuff, she is super professional and does her job to the highest level of expectations

records.title: Maid2Clean
records.text: I have been with Maid2Clean since March of this year and am continuing to receive a great service from them. They are always extremely helpful when I call to report any issues or ask to change my cleaning day etc. I would recommend Maid2Clean if you are considering using them for cleaning services!

records.title: Syeda N & Maid2clean a sparkling relationship
records.text: Syeda N, is absolutely fantastic, she's not only a great cleaner she is a great person too!The service is brilliant too, Maid2clean ensure clients are matched with the right cleaners through an interview process and continually follow up for feedback to ensure both parties are happy. I would 100% recommend! Thank you.

records.title: Hardworking  and very efficient with a…
records.text: Hardworking  and very efficient with a very pleasing personalityThank you for SladanaSally

records.title: Excellent
records.text: We have had three cleaners in all so far, all have been friendly approachable and thorough.all were on time and very obliging .

records.title: My cleaner Syeda has been cleaning my…
records.text: My cleaner Syeda has been cleaning my house over a year now, we have in that time become friends she does a great job cleaning my home and she is a beautiful person inside and outThank you to Syeda and also Maid2clean crew xxx

records.title: Kirsten is an indispensable luxury…
records.text: Kirsten's cleaning skills are outstanding! She has become a fully necessary luxury I could not do without. She is indispensable. Instinctively she knows which jobs are priority and keeps my flat clean and tidy and welcoming. She is reliable, kind and caring and a pleasure to have in the house.

records.title: Excellent cleaner
records.text: The cleaner provided was excellent but the admin was a bit hit and miss. There seemed to be 2 different factions organising my account however, it sorted itself out in the end, so all good.It seems that it is a 3 month minimum contract which I was not aware of at the start.

records.title: I currently have a very caring cleaner…
records.text: I currently have a very caring cleaner who also listens to my requirements without a fuss. She is so much better than any previous cleaners I have been sent.

records.title: Great communication from company
records.text: Great communication from company, and cleaners all do a smashing job, which means that we don’t have to worry.

records.title: Jill is efficient & pleasant
records.text: Jill is efficient & pleasant, and uses her initiative

records.title: Cleaning with. Eleanor
records.text: After initial problems with cleaning candidates not turning up, Eleanor became my cleaner.  She has proved to be ideal in that nothing is too much trouble for her and my bungalow is now looking spick and span again thanks to Maid2Clean.

records.title: Great cleaner
records.text: Great cleaner, very  thorough and punctual. It’seasy to contact the office and they listen well if there is any problem and resolve it. I would like to have the option of 2 hours per fortnight rather than 3 hours.

records.title: Would not hesitate to recommend Maid2Clean
records.text: Having tried most of the Edinburgh cleaning agencies and receiving either a response to say they could not help or absolutely no response at all, we contacted Maid2Clean. A bit of a false start with our first allocated cleaner but quickly resolved by Maid2Clean with a replacement who is an absolute gem!  We are very happy with her and look forward to her visits.  We are confident enough to entrust her with a key so that she is able to attend, even when we are not around and it is always a pleasure to come home and find a spotless house.Maid2Clean are professional and communicative and reasonably priced.  I would not hesitate to recommend.

records.title: We just had an amazing cleaner clean…
records.text: We just had an amazing cleaner clean our bungalow- she was ultra thorough and such a nice person. She introduced herself the day before and text me that she was on her way to us.  We had experienced several difficulties with cleaners not turning up and the member of maids2clean arranged for her to come as she knew she was so good and that we would be happy with her- a great job!!

records.title: cleaner is excellent
records.text: cleaner is excellent, very thorough and so nice. I'd give you 5 stars if the balance of money we pay was more in favour of the cleaner. You may have had to find her and interview her, but now she is doing all the work

records.title: Maid2Clean are always helpful and quick…
records.text: Maid2Clean are always helpful and quick to link you up with a new cleaner when required. Unfortunately the cleaners seem to come and go regularly. I am on number 4 now after 18 months .One did 3 cleans then unavailable another unreliable often cancelled due to home crisis , another brilliant but after 7 months left.Current cleaner best yet so hope he continues long term .

records.title: Both of our cleaners have been great
records.text: Both of our cleaners have been great, and the company are prompt at responding when times/days need changing - or for anything at all that I've needed to contact them for.Slightly frustrating is being hounded for reviews across various platforms. We have a cleaner because we don't have a much free time in our lives, so the continual cycle of emails does get slightly annoying.

records.title: Maid2Clean Does try hard
records.text: So this is an issueThe cleaner we where giving by this "service" is awesomeThe customer service is quite good they do try and accommodate when there are issues we just seem to be in an area where they battle to get reliable cover cleaners when our regular cleaner is offIt would also be cool if they could contact me if there is an issue with my cleaner but it works the other way around you need to contact them and let them knowThey did refund me for the missed cleans which doesn't happen often just an irritation when it does

records.title: Good reliable service
records.text: An extremely reliable and hardworking individual, who cleans efficiently in the best interests of the client. She seems to enjoy the work and nothing is too difficult to achieve. It's a pleasure to employ someone who provides real value for their pay.

records.title: Good service experience  with our current cleaner
records.text: Pleased with our current cleaner. She is happy to do different cleaning jobs within the time we pay for. We pay the cleaner on the day and the company charge a fee via direct debit which is payable whatever. We think £5 an hour admin charge by the company is somewhat excess therefore the 4 stars.

records.title: Great service and more flexibility would be a bonus
records.text: Great service and straight forward to set up. Had a cleaner whose work was to a high standard. Would have benefited more if there was more flexible options in duration and regularity in bookings (i.e no option for one monthly clean, minimum is fortnightly). Friendly staff.

records.title: Not really experienced in doing all…
records.text: Not really experienced in doing all aspects of housework but is keen to learn and asking if all ok and what else she should do. A lovely girl, very shy but willing to help and learn where to clean and be helpful.

records.title: Great help Maid2Clean. Thank you.
records.text: A replacement for on-going cleaner was soon found - a great help.Although the present cleaner is our second one in four months since we started with the Company. Potential is spotted with the present cleaner.Thank you for your timely help Maid2Clean.

records.title: I am using a cleaner for the first…
records.text: I am using a cleaner for the first time.Maid2clean was recommended by a friend who lives in Derbyshire. Office personal very helpful. My cleaner is very hard working and a very pleasant person to have in my home.

records.title: Pretty good experience for my elderly…
records.text: Pretty good experience for my elderly father. Two different cleaners were excellent over a period of time. Just a small glitch when the first one left the company, and there was a bit of a hiatus before a replacement could be found.

records.title: Good customer service but disappointing cleaning standards
records.text: The best aspect of this company is its customer service (when contacted by phone only). They were fairly quick to respond—within a week—to our request for a new cleaner. Their service also saves you the hassle of finding a cleaner yourself, as they perform basic vetting and arrange an in-person interview before the contract begins.However, we had two cleaners through them, and the standard of their work was disappointing for what I would expect from a professional agency. Neither cleaner was able to clean a bathroom to a satisfactory standard (to name just one issue), and they clearly lacked experience and knowledge about home cleaning. That said, I didn’t encounter any other issues with them.One thing to be aware of is their inflexibility around holidays. They won’t pause or adjust their fees, so if you’re away, you either have to give your keys to the cleaner or pay the agency fee for nothing. Additionally, they require a month's notice to end the contract and charge a termination fee if this is not met.

records.title: WHEN  a cleaner was provided OK …. BUT !
records.text: When a cleaner was provided, maid2clean offered a very good competitive service. However, if the cleaner was unable to turn up, maid2 clean were unable to provide any cover and let me down. No refunds on their service charge were given, just “ credit “ for missed cleans. If a cleaner isn’t available missed clean credits are worthless. Communications between their staff and head office are poor ….I often got conflicting messages from my cleaner and the head office.Regrettably forced to look elsewhere for a reliable dependable weekly cleaner.

records.title: Cleaners not turning up/cancelling frequently
records.text: Whilst I’m sure we’ve just been unlucky, we are now on our 4th cleaner with this service. This is due to multiple cancellations at short notice or not showing up at all without any notice (for the first 3). The standard of cleaning is definitely good but the issues with consistency have definitely tainted our view of the service. Not sure I’d recommend.

records.title: Be warned
records.text: Be warned - not worth it. The cleans were pretty average, the cleaners were friendly and polite and made improvements when requested, but were very unreliable. I was constantly having cleans canceled but was happy to rearrange this directly with the cleaner. The agency did not like this, they wanted to charge fees even without cleaning and wanted all rearrangements to be discussed with them which is not a reasonable ask if the cleaners are rescheduling EVERY single week. Safe to say I canceled the service and still had to pay a month's fee for the notice period.Update: Maid2Clean did reach out to me to apologise for the confusion and inconvenience and refund me for the overcharges which was much appreciated

records.title: Ineffective and don't provide a service
records.text: This company could never send me a cleaner who both showed up and could provide a service beyond one clean, when the cleaner failed to show up on a couple of occasions I was not informed and had to inform the agency. After one clean the cleaner would state they were not available to commit to a regular clean and I would have to chase the agency all the time. I have now gone with another local company who can provide a regular cleaner at a regular time slot.I have changed my review to 3 stars as on reflection I think the poor service was due to the shortage of cleaners and this is not the fault of the agency.

records.title: The young lady cleaned efficiently but…
records.text: The young lady cleaned efficiently but she has a bit of difficulty with organisation. I believe this will soon be settled and I am pleased with her overall standards of cleaning

records.title: My help only did a few days as was ill…
records.text: My help only did a few days as was ill or had personally problems leaving me without help for quite sometime. She then left without notice leaving us high and dry!

records.title: Yet another money hungry company that doesn’t pay workers fairly
records.text: Unfortunately, Maid2Clean don’t pay their workers well at all. This is clear by the fact that they’re average hourly wage for their workers is set at £14. Meanwhile their booking fee is £50. First, cleaning is a hard job - anyone who does their own regular weekend cleaning knows that this is the case. Now imagine someone who is sent out to clean in their own - the job is ten times harder even if they are doing a deep cleaning for a 1 bedroom apartment. Second, the rate of pay is abysmal and does not reflect the labour that goes into cleaning an apartment (especially if a cleaner is sent out on her own). I have had deep cleans on multiple occasions in the past and on all of them, two cleaners were sent out to do the job. My experience with Maid2Clean only tells me that they are money hungry greed filled lions who have no care for paying their workers decently for the labour they do. We live in a Britain that is quickly becoming scraps and the economy is dismal and things will only get worse. Families are suffering in the midst of it all, and compassion is needed now more than ever as everyday people struggle to feed their families / pay their bills / live life. As she worked 4 long hours deep cleaning, I paid my assigned cleaner above £14. To clients who wish to use cleaning services: Please think about the conditions of workers who perform intensive labour ie cleaners, and how the service they provide benefits you more than it does them in their industry. If you’re thinking of having cleaners come into your home, please consider what their base rate is and determine whether it is fair or unfair. It’s all about compassion for your fellow man.

records.title: A bit disappointed to be honest
records.text: A bit disappointed to be honest.  I paid for a weekly 2 hour clean of just kitchen and bathroom.  As it’s just a one person household and I am a pretty clean person plus the bathroom is small that should be more than adequate.  The cleaner overall was pleasant and did a reasonably good general clean but I had to ask that the shower glass needed cleaning and also that the shower plug hole could be lifted and cleaned to remove hair and soap scum etc.  This was not well received even though it was asked in a nice manner for something I assumed would be done.  I then asked for an extra hour and asked if it would be possible for the oven to be cleaned and I would provide a box cleaner which was easy to use and the cleaner agreed they could do this and it would be fairly easy to do with the box cleaner.  On the day the cleaner finished and said the cooker was nice and clean but they hadn’t used the box cleaner provided but their own stuff (you are asked to provide your own cleaning products and I went out of my way to provide the preferred cleaners that they liked to use).   The oven was still dirty with splatters on the glass and the racks were dirty too.  I wouldnt have minded so much if I had been told that they didnt want to use the box cleaner at the start and their alternative cleaner had cleaned the oven properly.   I paid the cleaners charge as I didnt want an argument on the day but then contacted M2C to ask for a refund of the fees for the extra hour and a different cleaner.  Initially I was told they’d look into it then I was told Id get a refund but was not refunded straight away then i just received a refund of a portion of the agency fee.  I emailed again and I was told that because cleaner wouldnt give back the money for the hour I was stuck with it and money couldnt be refunded.  A further email and call and I am now getting a refund through my agency fee hopefully that happens.  Its a shame its taken such a long process to get a refund e.g. emails and calls.  I wanted a replacement cleaner but they couldnt find me one at first as I wanted one to replace the same time and day as I have and when one was found they now not coming as they have transport issues.  So now I have to wait to get another cleaner.  I always try to be reasonable and understand that things happen and Ive thought seriously before writing this but certainly for my region of the country customer services arent great I hope my new cleaner, when I get one, is good as I can see a lot of people do get good cleaners and are happy and thats all I wanted.  I would like to add that they have said they will refund via my agency fee and have apologised for the problems i have had so at least that is fair.NEW EDIT TO REVIEWAfter speaking to Amanda from M2C today 11/11/23 she gets 5 stars from me for customer service.  Was understanding, helpful and went above and beyond to help me out.  She has put right all my issues and hopefully i will get a new cleaner soon.

Company unable to rearrange on a weekend or evening and as a single parent I don't have spare holidays to throw away on weekdays when they might just not turn up, so the entire thing was cancelled, which is somewhat disappointing.

records.title: Disappointed …
records.text: Disappointed that the company had to come back after not doing the job correctly the first tme re survey for cavity wall installation.I then asked the 2 men to go into my spare back bedroom first as there I would put my not friendly dog, they did this at first then after I put the dog in was told by them they needed to go back into this room.Not a happy customer.

records.title: Very pleased with our second visit
records.text: Jordan was the second engineer to come to the property. He was polite and respectful when he arrived and asked what had happened since the original visit. He was very thorough and checked all around the inside and outside of the property and then put bait and filler around as necessary. He explained about what he was doing and why and what we needed to do going forward. We felt that some of this should have been done on our first visit but it wasn't.Very pleased with this experience.

records.title: Efficient and reliable
records.text: Have used these guys before and they are always super nice, reliable and efficient. They know what they’re doing and they have saved me from multiple cases of mice and even a dead rat that we couldn’t locate. Definitely recommend!

records.title: Knight in shining armour
records.text: We had the most helpful and professional service today to help guide us through our pest issue. We phoned less than 24 hours beforehand and there he was this morning like a knight in shining armour. We now have a clear plan and feel secure that we are in safe hands.

records.title: First visit
records.text: Only our first visit so far so will comment more when all visits are done, but Miles today was very friendly, professional and factual, giving us useful tips. So far so good!

records.title: Much better than other companies I've used
records.text: We had had another company come to our property to deal with the mouse problem...but we still kept seeing mice. I was at the end of my tether and decided to give JG Pest control a go.Danny came to us and he was brilliant, really thorough: as well as putting poison down, he was determined to find out how/from where those pesky creatures were coming in.....he then did what was required to put a stop to their visits! I haven't yet booked the 2nd visit - but it's been 2 weeks and so far, we haven't seen 1 mouse!! I'm hoping it stays that way......

records.title: Nick Exley visited us today and was…
records.text: Nick Exley visited us today and was such a lovely and polite guy. He thoroughly checked our house and explained everything really well and answered all our questions. He arrived promptly and carried out his job in a timely manner. Thanks

records.title: Thank you Jason
records.text: Thank you Jason. What a great guy, very helpful he answered all my questions and helped me understand the process. I saw a little concerned at first but Jason made me feel a lot more comfortable. No sightings since his visit, fingers crossed I won’t need to contact the team in the future.

records.title: Christopher Buck …
records.text: Christopher was very professional: he reassured us about the nature of our problem and informed us of possible future preventative measures. All this on new years day.  Thank you.  Would recommend you and the company to anyone else that might need you

records.title: Very professional service from Ethan…
records.text: Very professional service from Ethan today. Shame it can’t be said for the services of PJ pest control.The the guys who deal with the rat boxes perfect, put our minds at rest.

records.title: Very quick service
records.text: Very quick service. Very helpful. Also checked neighbours drains to ascertain if they are coming in that way as we live in a semi detached. Hopefully the poison has worked and no more vermin.

records.title: Chris the technician was great
records.text: Chris the technician was great. He was polite and informative and will hopefully be able to address our problem, which will involve at least 1 future visit, so jury still out in terms of ultimate satisfaction. Initial communication was great, however despite being told I’d get a 30 min warning of the technician’s arrival I got a call from Chris at 7.50am to say he was on the drive!

records.title: The technician was polite and helpful…
records.text: The technician was polite and helpful but left no report of what he had found/did. The office had not explained that a further £ 470 charge would be required to fit a rat proof gate in the drain on top of the £299+vat paid already.

records.title: Alex Jenkins is a very sensible young…
records.text: Alex Jenkins is a very sensible young man. He listened attentively to the history of the problemHis diagnosis  was quite surprising but, on the basis of the old Sherlock Holmes adage 'When everything else has been eliminated what remains must be the case' I am fairly sure it is correct.I  am left with confidence that the problem is being taken care of.

records.title: We’ve hopefully now found the problem…
records.text: We’ve hopefully now found the problem on the second visit, thanks to Phillip. A thorough job in identifying the issue and helping us to resolve.

records.title: New one way valve
records.text: Billy Clarke was prompt, efficient , helpful and informative. The new valve seems to work well. I am hoping this will resolve the problem

records.title: Fast response to initial enquiry
records.text: Fast response to initial enquiry, with assistance on both a Sunday and a Bank Holiday. Knowledgeable and experienced, the man that treated our house was very polite and friendly.

records.title: The tenant was pleased how you came out…
records.text: The tenant was pleased how you came out so quick, blocked holes and put down the poison. Hopefully this will sort the problem

records.title: Tiny feet
records.text: They came out the day we called them and tracked the problem down. They will also be coming back in a few weeks to make sure all is okay.

records.title: Rodent issue
records.text: Called  JG pest control and they were very professional on the phone explaining costs and what their technician would do with regard to our rodent issue.  Ryan arrived the next day as arranged and was informative and professional. He located the source of the issue and explained the best way to deal with the problem. This would not involve poison but required that the outdoor nest location be removed and holes blocked as the rodents would then move away of their own accord. Information was very useful but I would have expected some physical work to have been undertaken in line with the advice as the call out fee is expensive. Ie the holes secured and area dug out.

records.title: Very thorough and efficient follow up…
records.text: Very thorough and efficient follow up inspection and re- treatment, including drain and exteriors.  Thank you

records.title: Arrived early quick
records.text: Arrived early quick, discreet friendly service

records.title: Second time right
records.text: Alex was the second person I’ve had out to survey and treat and unlike the First Gentleman, he took the time to survey the area properly. He inspected using a heat torch and took out a ladder to look on the roof and found what he suspects is the route of the problem. The first gentleman looked for literally, 3 mins and said I can’t help as I see no flying wasps and if you see any activity call back. It was only after calling back I was advised to remove the cabinet. Alex was helpful, showed me the suspected source and treated all areas, explained what he was doing, was friendly and respectful. Advised on what to do as after care and time lines also.

records.title: Technican listened to the problem
records.text: Technican listened to the problem, did a check of the area before putting bait down.Provided a friendly service.Only issue was that the text telling me about his arrival time arrived 10 minutes after he had finished the job.

records.title: Very polite and friendly
records.text: Very polite and friendly. Looked at job and explained process. Surprised having to empty ALL wardrobes drawers etc. Praying that it works well. Thanks Paul.

records.title: Pricey but efficient
records.text: This was a very pricey option in terms of getting rid of clothes moths but pretty straightforward. Very pleasant staff throughout, excellent information provided. All done within the day - let's see if it has dealt permanently with the little critters.

records.title: Great and efficient service
records.text: Did have a little issue of not being able to get through the office when calling, however emailing was efficient at booking in someone to lay bait and also fill in the gaps. Really responsive when emailed and came over for the 2nd visit to hopefully get rid of the pests.

records.title: Rats
records.text: Phillip was most pleasant and courteous.He certainly new his stuff.When the problem has been solved,time alone will tell,then maybe the fifth star will be added.

records.title: Helpful follow up visit
records.text: This was a follow-up visit. All the bait traps were checked, but only in one had any bait been taken. It was decided to relocate one of the traps. It was also suggested that we contact our neighbours to see if they were also having a problem with mice. I asked to check if the mesh i had fitted over the coal shute grating was satisfactory and I was pleased to receive a compliment on the quality of the work I had done. Suggested I ask for another visit in about 3 weeks. Overall a satisfactory visit, but we still have mice!

records.title: A competent individual who got on with…
records.text: A competent individual who got on with the job. Alas 40plus mole hills and no moles trapped following first visit. So the proof will be in the outcome of this second visit

records.title: Rats in the Garden
records.text: As an 80 year old widow, and the world's biggest Rat-Phobic, I needed help. The cost did rather throw me, hence 4 stars, but it was a Saturday. The young man who came, Jordan, was very kind and helpful. He reassured me that no rats could actually get into the house, and checked my garden thoroughly. Bait traps laid around the garden. Hopefully the problem is now sorted.

records.title: Shaun was excellent
records.text: Shaun was efficient, polite, professional and helpful when he came out to carry out stage 1 of the process of rat elimination from our loft.  However there was poor, inaccurate telephone communication  by JG Pest Control regarding the service offered initially around what was needed.  I was told this was  because the person I dealt  with on the phone on 28th Dec. was new to the role.  I was given inaccurate information about the process of elemination in relation to the timing of cleansing of loft.  (This was not Shaun's fault and does not reflect on him or his work done during his visit to the property.)

records.title: Graham who attended site was very good
records.text: Graham who attended site was very good. Your admin however is not very good. I booked a follow up visit and it got cancelled on the day twice! I had to call your customer service team to get a second visit sorted approx 6 weeks after the initial visit. Most annoyingly no one called me to cancel - you just receive an e mail and txt telling you to rebook. If the admin had been better I would have been completely happy.

records.title: High price charged for work done
records.text: I think the price of £480 was extortionate for the work carried out, 4 small bait trays and a look at the drains does not justify that amount of money. I can understand call out fees etc, but I am very disappointed I have been charged so much for the service. What follow up action will be taken?

records.title: Thanks for responding efficiently after…
records.text: Thanks for responding efficiently after I spoke to the receptionist on Saturday. Although Barrie came yesterday to check on the dead rat but unfortunately he couldn’t get the rat out because of narrow passage. There’s flies everyday gathering around that particular area but what he suggested is to use fly spray which I have been doing. Hopefully I don’t hear any more noise in the cavity wall. I shall keep in touch after 3 weeks. Thank you.

records.title: Ref: 550046
records.text: Please note that the rating given is to reflect the fact that the trap in place to date (after 2 visits)  has not caught any Squirrels.I give 5 out of 5 for Steven being ,friendly, polite & helpful & doing all he can.

records.title: Steven C was very helpful and seemed to…
records.text: Steven C was very helpful and seemed to fix the issue very quickly (not resolved yet but our purchase includes 3 follow up visits within 6 months).The pricing from the company is quite high (we have now looked around) and the follow up service isn't good from our experience.Still given it 3 because Steven C was lovely.

records.title: Good technician, but time slot mixup
records.text: The technician was professional, efficient and polite.However, I specifically booked the afternoon slot (12:00-18:00) which was offered to me at the time of booking, and confirmed to me by email from the agent. I was awoken by a text at 7:19am saying the technician was 22 mins away, after I had just driven 12 hours from Aberdeen. There needs to be better communication between the agent and technician.

records.title: Disappointing Service and Unresolved Issue Despite Multiple Visits
records.text: Over the course of the three-month service period, I had four visits from the company. One of the employees attended twice and was outstanding—he truly demonstrated a commitment to customer satisfaction, taking the time to address my concerns thoroughly. However, the other two visits were handled by different employees, and I was extremely disappointed with their approach. It was clear that they lacked the motivation to properly resolve the issue.For the final visit, I specifically requested the employee who had been so effective previously, but unfortunately, I was assigned someone else. This individual seemed disengaged and, to my frustration, did not revisit two of the three areas where rat activity had been observed. A week later, the rats have returned.Overall, I am very dissatisfied with the service provided and feel that my concerns were not properly addressed. Contractually, this now means I am required to pay their fee again for a follow-up visit, despite the fact that the problem remains unresolved.

records.title: Update on previous review
records.text: Update to previous review It’s been three days since Barrie came out on Thursday. But no change. The mouse or mice are still scratching away in the Bedroom, kitchen and living room Under the floor boards and behind kitchen plinths even though that is where the bait is. Still having sleepless nights as all I can hear is scratching 😱

records.title: Danny came out today
records.text: Danny came out today - our second visit - he has found where the mice are gaining entry and told us preventative measures to take -he was great - very upset that this didn’t happen at the first visit ! Ashley was the first person who came out other than a glance in the garden no other areas were looked at ! So have another 3 weeks to go! Of hopefully ridding ourselves of mice! This should have happened on the first visit !

records.title: Adam was particularly polite
records.text: Adam was particularly polite and friendly. Unfortunately, he doesn't work at height and so could not complete the job as the office had sent the wrong engineer. So I give 5 stars to the engineer but unfortunately the office get 0. I could hear them persuading him to go up the scaffold but he is not able to work heights so I was not so impressed they were telling him to regardless of health and safety.  Awaiting a new engineer now.

records.title: Pest check
records.text: The engineer was very professional. He was also confident and courteous. However, I am sure it would be greatly appreciated by house owners, if he used a plastic covering over his shoes or left his shoes at the door.

records.title: Sorted now This company keeps sending me messages…
records.text: This has been sorted now, they just need to make sure they have the correct number and check there email when I contacted them but did not receive a replyThis company keeps sending me messages saying they are arriving shortly when I have never contacted them before. Can't block them and they ignored my request to stop sending messages. This company should be avoided at all costs

records.title: Sebastion
records.text: Sebastion contacted us 12 minutes before he arrived and very quickly unloaded his ladders and attempted to seal of the bees entrance to the soffits. Unfortunately this doesn't seem to have done the job as we have many bees flying in and out. We now are getting bees in our bedroom if we leave the window ajar. Problem is we go away tomorrow for a fortnight. How do we proceed from here?

records.title: They came to sort out the wasp's …
records.text: They came to sort out the wasp's in my garden sprayed  them killed some, came the second time looked at it and said they can't do anything so I used Ant powder which has worked no more Wasp.

records.title: He did nothing more than what we did
records.text: He did nothing more than what we did. However that is understandable. We will call back in a week to book another appointment which is necessary. Otherwise it has been quite pointless expenditure. I'm sure after the second and third visit it will be worth the investment. Thank you. He was a very nice person, so thank you for his efforts.

records.title: Originally happy but now disappointed with follow up support
records.text: Had a little night time rat escapade and JG came round on a Sunday before 12pm to sort the problem! Robin was a superstar in terms of spotting the problem areas and honestly giving us the bottom line scenario of the situation. Muchly appreciated, even if it means I'll never sleep again. EDIT: after seeking more support because the rats are external and internal but apparently this is a different package that I was never told about and I'm being threatened with more charges. Disappointed!

records.title: Customer services good
records.text: After 3 visits we were still hearing mice and so I got in contact with customer services. A further visit was booked in as I wasn’t completely happy with the previous visits. More investigation was done during this visit and possible entry places were blocked off. We are now waiting to see if this has stopped all activity. Customer services have been good throughout.

records.title: Yet to be convinced
records.text: Whilst Darren is lovely, this is the third visit in six weeks as the company has failed to eradicate the rodent problems. Having explained on the first visit where the activity was happening, the traps and poison were positioned in the wrong place. It took my Husband to crawl into the loft to the corner of the eaves to find evidence of rat droppings. Third visit today and more trap's now provided and a change of poison.  Here's hoping the rat finally gets caught so I can get a good night's sleep

records.title: Overall a reasonably good experience.
records.text: Overall a reasonably good experience.The guys who came over were friendly and knowledgeable and customer services were very helpful when contactedEmails and automated customer contacts were very confusing and the processes just didn't work or make sense, meaning more phone calls and emails than should have been necessaryHowever after the maximum 3 visits, 1 rat caught, entry points blocked and poison food gobbled up the rats have not been eradicated and are still getting into our loft.So not sure what I do now

records.title: Nic was much later than we expected and…
records.text: Nic was much later than we expected and got lost getting here. He finished up working outside after dark. Communications with your company are poor. Your invoices could not be opened and needed resending. All in all could be better in customer service. We will see. Our criticism is not aimed at you technicians, but your organisation. Mike Hart

records.title: An illusion
records.text: Same day service and they arrived prompt which was fantastic. They seemed kind and helpful and the person was reassuring the mice problem would be sorted. But, they didn’t move the fridge or washing machine due to ‘insurance reasons’ and only checked under the sink which is not what was advertised on the phone. There was also no follow up appointments and when I did try to book for one they only had weekday appointments when I can only do weekends. Again, not what was originally discussed(my original appointment was on the weekend…)Mice have now come back and lo and behold holes behind the washing machine. My email follow up was also, ignored. I am very disappointed and feel utterly ripped off and devalued.

records.title: The man came littarly there 5 mins 1st…
records.text: The man came littarly there 5 mins 1st visit did not check upstairs same on the 2nd visit.3rd visit downstairs okay this time man went upstairs found droppings and told it was last visit and holes were missed.

records.title: I contacted JP pest control due to a…
records.text: I contacted JG pest control due to a Spider infestation.  I was pleased with the Technicians advice and was reassured that all areas would be treated. He was understanding and polite. I was advised to stay out of the property for 4 hours.  I came back to the property after 5 hours and noticed alot of areas were missed. And I saw a few spiders and all of the cobwebs still present.  I  will definitely ask for a follow up appointment just to go over the property again.  I'm disappointed to be honest at this point.  However my opinion may change in future if a follow-up appointment is done with precision and accuracy.

records.title: Visiting fox in garden
records.text: Visiting fox in garden, regularly visiting and destroying my lawn, after initial spray around perimeter of garden 4 days ago, he is still visiting and making even more mess of my lawn ... next visit booked in for 1 weeks time as that was earliest they could send technician

records.title: Use a specialist Mole contractor
records.text: Was a bit disappointed with recent mole treatment by this company. Was quoted an upfront payment of £420 and told this company would come as many times as needed to sort the problem. I did have several visits and traps laid. The operatives were very nice, and advised that 2 moles were caught, though I was never shown them, even when I asked one chap. However the problem returned only a few weeks post treatment in the exact same runs and I was told i would have to pay for treatment all over again. I got the impression the operatives dealt with all pests and were not specialist in moles. One even initially suggested the hills were vole hills which I checked on google and they definitely were not !!! I have now had to go to a specialist mole catcher who operates on a no mole, no fee basis. They may be good for other pests.

records.title: The operator gave the impression he…
records.text: The operator gave the impression he didn’t have much time and had other jobs to get to. Did not bring any equipment from van. A mole had been caught from the previous traps that were set by another (more patient) operator. The traps were hastily reset but no thought was given to moving the traps to where I wanted where the latest mole activity had been. In the following days, there was more mole activity in the area where I wanted to move at least one of the traps. More attention needed to discuss the customer’s needs and more thought required in future as to where to reset traps.

records.title: Wasted money due to lack of communication
records.text: Good response time and communication from those that came out to us. Big issue is that we spent £180 for less than 10 minutes of time and we were told by the people who came out to us that we could have done the same thing ourselves. I feel like this should have been communicated over the phone prior to having me spend all that money

records.title: I was very disappointed with the visit
records.text: I was very disappointed with the visit. We were not listened to and the caller made up his mind that the rats were entering our property through the drains. The bait was replaced but if the drain was the entry point we were not told as the caller left without talking to us. It took 2 phone calls before a report was e, mailed. Totally unacceptable customer service.

records.title: After two treatment the bedbugs was still there  but had reduced.
records.text: After two treatment the outcome was still not satisfactory the bedbugs were unaffected it apperas as if nothing was done i am so upset having to loose £300.00 of my hard earned money in such a way, i must say the guy that came in for the first treatment made some efforts i must give him that, but the second treatment was a joke the guy didn’t do nothing.when i came jome after 3 hours it was as if i was in a war front been attacked by sworn enemies.

description: MOLLY MAID is the UK's most recognised name within the home cleaning industry. We've been cleaning homes across the UK for over 35 years and know that it's not a one size fits all service. That's why we conduct a free, no-obligation at home estimate where we tailor cleans to each customer's specific needs and quote a price accordingly. It's also the reason why we've been at the forefront of the industry ever since. To arrange your MOLLY MAID profession clean, call 08003777507.

records.title: I was most impressed.…
records.text: I was most impressed by the way the two girls just set about their work.     Every room was well cleaned & has such a nice fresh air about it.  I have now had two visits from Molly Maids and both have been excellent, I am very pleased,  So much so that I have recommended them to a friend.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Sadie and Alice were both very friendly and worked hard. The cleaning was carried out to a high standard.They were also punctual. What more could you ask for?

records.title: Molly Maid cleaners
records.text: Good results,polite workers. However their timing is difficult to manage. They text in the morning of the clean, but although a half hour window is given the cleaners arrived over 30 minutes earlier than planned this week. Luckily I was at home but planning my day is impossible at the moment!I hope that in future they become more consistent.

records.title: Wonderful, reliable, efficient and friendly service
records.text: My Molly Maids have been coming to me now for a few years. When my mum in her 90s moved in with me 6 years ago we decided to use MMs regularly. MM completely understood the need for ensuring we have the same cleaners every time & she used to so enjoy their visit. We also liked the efficiency, friendliness and the quality of the products used which make the house sparkle and feel so clean. Sadly my mum passed recently but I am keeping on the service as I have come to value my ladies and their work so much

records.title: Very efficient
records.text: The ladies from Molly Maid were extremely efficient, friendly and polite could not have asked for anything more.

records.title: great job very professional
records.text: The ladies who came to clean my house as I moved out were super professional, very quick and the house looked and smelt great after...they were also very flexible working around me moving boxes and even split the visit so I could completely empty the house (which took longer than I expected) thoroughly recommend

records.title: Jo and Isabella have been amazing
records.text: Jo and Isabella have been amazing. I work full time and struggled to manage regular thorough cleaning alongside being a mum and double dog-owner. Molly Maid has allowed me to come home to a clean and tidy house: hoovered, dusted, walls windows and mirrors spotless, skirting boards clean. It has literally helped me feel relaxed in my home again. Cannot thank them enough.

records.title: lorna and andrea have been coming here…
records.text: lorna and andrea have been coming here to blanefield for some weeks and we always look forward to there arrival there is nothing like there cheery smiles and there cleaning skills to lift the spirits during the dark days of winter.we wish them a happy christmas and a good newyear and would award them top marks for there expertise.

records.title: Just Brilliant.
records.text: Excellent! Very happy indeed with the super professional service from Molly Maids. Have been looking for a regular home clean for a while and wish I’d booked them sooner. Everything from customer service to the professionalism of the ladies who come has been super. The standard of work is great and the flexibility that Molly Maids offer is fantastic, very happy that I found them.

records.title: Great friendly service
records.text: Great friendly service.  Lorna and Andrea are excellent at what they do. Always on time and dependable, leaving my home sparkling clean. They even like our 2 border terriers. Thank you Ladies.

records.title: I’ve only had 2 visits so it’s early days
records.text: I’ve only had 2 visits and have not yet established a regular pattern of cleaning. So far I’ve been pleased.

records.title: A good initial clean
records.text: A good initial clean just one area could have been done better but everywhere else was excellent.  It is easy to miss things on a first clean so looking forward to perfect feedback in the future

records.title: The standard of cleaning was very good
records.text: The standard of cleaning was very good, however three ladies descended onto us which made the clean seem hurried and chaotic. Our house seemed to have been hit by a hurricane of activity and noise. On the positive side it was over quite quickly, but I would have prefered a much less frantic experience.

records.title: We were very pleased with how the team…
records.text: We were very pleased with how the team worked. I would recommend the company to friends and family.However on this first visit they failed to clean the downstairs loo so hence only 4 stars instead of 5. I am sure next visit will be 5.

records.title: Monthly house clean.
records.text: The ladies are delightful and work very hard.  They will do whatever we ask.  Their cleaning is acceptable but not completely perfect.

records.title: A good experience.
records.text: The two cleaners were very nice and worked well together. Results of the clean were pretty good - a new contract so expect it will take some time to get familiar with the house.

records.title: The girls did an incredible job for the…
records.text: The girls did an incredible job for the initial clean, hardly anything went un cleaned. Fantastic service and will be using them on a monthly basis to help me keep on top of everything! Highly recommend 👍❤️

records.title: Early days yet
records.text: We have only had the initial full clean, plus the first four weekly clean - these were different teams and the experience of the first was really great, the second not quite so much. Also the second team were unable to clean a couple of rooms due to my husband being quite unwell on that day. I am waiting for the next date at the end of October to give a more rounded review.

records.title: Excellent service and very clean
records.text: Excellent service and a very clean house at the end of it. We will certainly use Molly Maids again.

records.title: Good Quality clean at short notice
records.text: Molly Maids were very accommodating with my last minute request and worked with me to arrange for a deep clean of my house before having some work done.Only a couple of minor issues stopping this from being a 5* service - but these are resolved when pointed out.  Will be using their services again

records.title: Roost cleaning
records.text: After a few administrative glitches eg girls not having details of Roost entries, invoice not sent to address requested, very pleased with the service.Girls both very friendly and helpful. Cleaning fine.

records.title: Appreciate  the service. Thank you.
records.text: The two cleaners are very pleasant. They just come in and get on with job enthusiastically. They work well together and have time to share pleasantries without wasting time or being intrusive. The standard of their cleaning is very good. We’ve knocked a star off as  we think it’s a bit pricey.

records.title: Fast, helpful and professional
records.text: This is the 2nd time we've used Molly Maid. The 1st experience was okay, late notice changes due to illness which can't be helped and they scratched my hob, however the 2nd clean with a different team was a completely different experience and couldn't be happier. Lovely cleaners who are polite, fast and helpful. They make light work of a house clean, it's helped my allergies by not having to do the cleaning myself and it makes my free time so much better without having to worry about cleaning the house. Look forward to the next one!

records.title: The visit of Molly Maid was their…
records.text: The visit of Molly Maid was their second what I find is to my requirements, both feeling our way, with the team being two different personnel. It is early days as my late wife was in housekeeping in a five star hotel for twenty five years,hence the expectations are high.

records.title: So far I have found  the girls very…
records.text: So far I have found  the girls very pleasant & helpful,it would be nice if the timing they were coming was just a half hour slot

records.title: Actually cleaning no issues
records.text: Actually cleaning no issuesIn fact very good 5 star 2 hour window for arriving very poor Get this right then I would award 10/10

records.title: Services were used on recommendation…
records.text: Services were used on recommendation from someone who used the serviceStaff were friendly. Got on with job. On first visit bathroom was not deep cleaned upon ringing the office the ladies came back and sorted happy with the serviceLeft message when  second appointment was made did not respond we were not in communication could have been better.

records.title: One or two small issues going to report…
records.text: One or two small issues going to report Skirtings not all cleaned Furniture not movedWood doors require a wipe as stickyWardrobe doors need dusting from top to bottom

records.title: A little disappointed
records.text: A little disappointed,  my shower tap wasn’t as clean as should be, looked like it hadn’t been given that buff clean to get rid of the product,  also had a few hairs on my tiles in the bathroom then can down to see crumbs behind my kitchen door.  Apart from the above the clean was very good,

records.title: Cleaning was done quickly and…
records.text: Cleaning was done quickly and thoroughly.  Cleaners were friendly.  Only negative was the stuff that was used to clean the kitchen floor left the surface sticky when it dried. I have commented on this (not complained) in the hope it can be improved.

records.title: Amazing cleaning team, let down by irresponsible company
records.text: Same as last time- amazing, thorough, polite cleaning team, but let down by the MM system. They turned up without eco products (I booked an eco clean) so used mine.Why does Molly Maid make their teams use toxic chemicals? It’s bad for their health and bad for all of us. Cleaners should not be leaving work lightheaded or with their breathing messed up. Give them kinder products as standard.

records.title: Quit the service.
records.text: I liked the concept of having work done for you but could not justify the expense. I have stopped having the service. The operatives were very nice and I have no complaint in that direction.

records.title: The cleaning itself is great
records.text: The cleaning itself is great, my only gripe is that they cannot accommodate the day of the week I want. And at the prices charged, that seems somewhat unreasonable. I will however be sticking with them as I’m hoping this can be changed sooner rather than later.

records.title: Nooks and Crannies
records.text: I like the fact that they clean well but unfortunately they miss nooks and crannies as they seem to always be in a rush to get to the next job. They dust around things I would like them to pick up the item to dust underneath.  I know that there will be a risk of breaking but if careful that shouldn't happen. Today I had my long window sil in the kitchen left. It's difficult to get a cleaner and Molly Maids are expensive so I expect a decent job. Girls are friendly.

records.title: THE MOLLY MAID LADIES
records.text: It is important to do some tidying up before the Molly Maids arrive, if you can . The reason I only gave 3  stars was, I was disappointed, when I realised that the kitchen was not done as thoroughly as I expected.

records.title: Its important to know they will receive good service
records.text: The initial deep clean was very good.  The first of the regular cleans was too hurried and superficial.  7 rooms (5 of which are large) plus hall, stairs and landing could not have been cleaned properly in under an hour.  I am elderly and need to feel my house has been cleaned well enough as I am unable to do it myself.  The high cost of Molly Maidshould surely ensure a professional service.  I am hoping to receive this the next time.

records.title: Excellent cleaners. Shame MM doesn’t use eco products as standard
records.text: Excellent cleaning team- thorough and hard working and totally professional. Really grateful for their work.The three star review is because the company doesn’t use eco friendly products as standard: it’s not fair on the cleaners to make them use strong chemicals, it’s not the responsible thing to do in general, and given that there are cheap and effective eco options it’s completely unjustifiable.

records.title: When you pay for 2 hrs work cleaning I personally expect 2 hrs cleaning.
records.text: When you pay for 2 hrs work cleaning, and they finish half hour early it would be better if they asked if there's anything else they can do cleaning wise.Instead of just saying, right we're finished now and we're going.

records.title: The Molly Maids have now completed three cleans…
records.text: The Molly Maids have now completed three cleans on the house.  Generally the standard is fine but I would not say its anymore that acceptable.   Due to the age of the house there are some funny quarks which need to be taken into account and we will get a better sense of weather its money well spend in another couple of months time

records.title: Your house always takes hours to clean …
records.text: An expensive service and usually carried out to a satisfactory standard in the past HOWEVER, they insist the house is tidy to their specifications, I have to vacate the place with the dogs. My last encounter they stated “ your house always takes hours to clean “ !!!!  And I’ve been told it’s too untidy. “ the ladies take pride in their work”. My last enquiry leaves me to feel that I live in a pig sty. Finally, paying in advance. Really. I’ll try and find a local person who’s not so picky about the way I live.

records.title: Too expensive for inadequate cleaning
records.text: The 'deep clean' was not good.  I sent an email to highlight exactly what was wrong and then I got my first normal clean.  This time they overlooked more things, like cleaning windowsills in the kitchen which had dead flies; mopping a floor without removing a large mat covering half the floor; not removing a chair and a wire going across the floor on his area which was supposedly mopped.   I was charged £127 including VAT and they were here (2 people) for 1.5 hours.  The going rate for this amount of time is £45.  I cannot justify so much money for inadequate cleaning.  Apart from that the people I had to deal with were charming and attentive.

records.title: First clean
records.text: First clean which cost nearly £400 for a modern 4 bedroom house was poor. Only a basic clean was done which was not satisfactory  in my opinion. I expect a thorough clean for that price. However they did return 3 days later to correct most of the issues after I complained and the owner of the company came out to check aswell which I think is good. In view of the fact they had to return to complete the job I  have given 3 stars. First clean would have got 1 star for value for money. Punctuality not great either but I think this was because the owner wanted to be there and her time was restricted. However there was no communication that they were arriving at 1.15pm rather than 11am. Second set of cleaners were much better and more friendly so will give them a further chance with the planned monthly clean. Overall reasonably  satisfied after return clean.

records.title: Quite good, but.......
records.text: Actual cleaning service good and quick however staff are clumsy and not aware at handing new tech like IoT, Alexa, etc. and this can cause problems for the householder.

records.title: The cleaning is ok but nothing special
records.text: The cleaning is ok but nothing special. Because of how they charge, it is as expensive as an accountant's hourly rate, which is ridiculous.

records.title: The Molly Maids arrived with all their…
records.text: The Molly Maids arrived with all their gear, they were polite and pleasant, keen to get on with the job.  They worked quietly and were obviously well used to what they do.  They warned me that they were swabbing the hall floor on their way out and it would be slippery.However, the carpet around the tv stand does not appear to have been cleaned, and the kitchen worktop was not very clean, though the crumbs under the toaster had gone, the hob did not appear to have been cleaned, but perhaps this is not part of the remit?  The glass front of the cooker was smeary, and a small glass topped table in the conservatory also.  Although the framed photographs in the bedroom had been moved, the glass over the photos had not been dusted.I have the impression that the Maids are efficient and capable young women, but very rushed in what they need to do.

records.title: They are okay. Expensive & not deep clean,just general wipe downs
records.text: Missed dusting shelves, didn’t bleach toliets, surfaces were just wiped down rather than cleaned, didn’t move any furniture, just clean around them

records.title: Cleaning
records.text: Two ladies for one hour is not good value for money. They did the basics but other things seem to be undone. They asked if I wanted two guest beds made up and i said yes, thank you. On the other hand without asking they put away a lot of pots and pans off my draining board, all in the wrong places, I spent a lot of time on my knees searching for pans I needed and then putting these and other things back  in the right places. Not fun at 91! Various items were moved for dusting but again not put back in the right places.

records.title: A good service and it is useful to be…
records.text: A good service and it is useful to be able to get someone in at short notice. The organisation is efficient and the cleaning is adequate but not quite as thorough as I had expected. It is also very expensive.

records.title: Not the Best
records.text: Yes the house looked nice when they finished but they didn’t move any funiture not the dining chairs so under the table didn’t get mopped nor under thee chairs in the lounge. The mop (a vilify) wasn’t up to the job for a Cardene floor. So no good cleaning only a rinse really, didn’t put enough cleaner in the water. Just didn’t move anything even the bin in the kitchen. For £ 65 weeks we were not very happy. So we won’t require the service again,                 Regards mr and Mrs Milner                    5. LE8 8TF

records.title: Expensive
records.text: Clean was ok and cleaners friendly but no bins were emptied and time taken reduced each clean (3 hours, then 2 hours, then 1.5 hours) despite flat fee of £66  so I’ve cancelled as a crazy amount to pay on an hourly basis.

records.title: Communication was poor
records.text: Communication was poor, rescheduling appointments at last minute. Cleaning was good but patchy with some areas like windowsills untouched.Cleaner turned out to be allergic to dust and cancelled further appointments at last minute.For a company with such a good reputation and high prices this was all most disappointing .

records.title: Furniture not moved to clean behind
records.text: Furniture not moved to clean behind Curtain pelmet’s not cleaned properly needed to be vacuumed Furniture tops not dusted

records.title: Very expensive for an average clean, and terrible admin
records.text: I used Molly Maid in Northern Ireland, for my daughter who is imminently expecting a baby. The booking process was poor, with the person getting mixed up between phone and email communications, and in one case, referring to me by the wrong name and chasing up another enquiry entirely. Two people came for c3 hours for a 5 bed house. That works out at c£70 per hour per person. I know there are uniform costs etc, but my own domestic cleaner has all necessary insurance and clearance and charges a quarter of that. It’s really really expensive for what it was, and the clean was bang average. They had to go back and re-do some elements. I won’t be using them again.

records.title: Would Not Recommend
records.text: Been using MM for a few years. It used to be good service, same people regularly. In the last 9 months we've had a 15 minute trip, rubbish put in our recycling that is not remotely recyclable (or ours), sinks not cleaned, sides not wiped etc. We sent time stamped pictures, and we're simply told 'Thanks, we'll pass that on.' Not 'Sorry this wasn't up to standard, would you like us to come again?' Or 'Sorry this is not up to standard, we'll do 15 minutes free.' We would likely decline, but the fact that it's not offered and has been consistently poor is very disappointing.We also had the lovely experience of a confidential work call being interrupted whilst the lady looked for the bathroom.Really gone downhill, looking for a new provider, would not recommend.

records.title: Like paying £25 for a big mac
records.text: You pay for the job rather than the time. So we had 4 cleans with our team and they both cleaned the house in 45 mins. So equates to paying 2 cleaners £80 per hour as an equivalence. Obviously because of this everything was rushed. If you wanted extra cleaning you had to pay for a deep clean. We had the deep clean, it was awful. Organised cupboards were cleaned and then had items just dumped back in. The cleaning of our oven was poor too.On a plus side the cleaning ladies were always pleasant and fun to chat with.

records.title: Terrible head office experience
records.text: I'm based in Glasgow and hired Molly Maid to do a deep clean and then a normal clean, then tried to set up monthly cleans, but I've had nothing but trouble trying to communicate with their office.- Initial contact was via the website, but had to go back and forth between phone and email to get it sorted, no booking system.- Setting up the 2nd clean was a nightmare, they would call or text me on different numbers, and email from different addresses. Their office hours were all over the place, I once immediately returned one of their calls to be told that they're "not in the office atm" in the middle of a workday.- The cleaners were extremely late to their appt on the 2nd clean, was quite stressful and they had to leave in a rush.- They set up a recurring monthly clean but didn't tell me what day they'd set it up for. I contacted them but got no reply then they text me saying my Jan appt will be moved but I was never told when/if I had appts in the first place.- Now out if the blue they've said that "due to high demand for Molly Maid Services, we are unable to accommodate in your area anymore", I can only assume their palming me off since they had 2 appts for me booked already.Just a real source of stress all round, feel like they're taking the mick.The actual clean being decent, and the cleaners being lovely has bumped it from one to two stars.

records.title: Used twice do not recommend
records.text: Used twice - first time did not turn up for the full allotted time. Thought it was a genuine mistake. Second time turned up for even less time. Quality of cleaning was not great with basics missed (shower not touched). Considering the price was nearly twice what others charge this was inexcusable. When I emailed to say I was terminating our agreement and how disappointed I was I received no reply. Given they no longer turned up they obviously received the message.

records.title: Overpriced and didn’t even clean…
records.text: Overpriced (£340 3 hours/2 cleaners) and didn’t even clean everything we asked them to do… porch or conservatory not touched. Freezer not cleaned. Show heads not done or cupboards upstairs. Cupboards downstairs still had dirty marks left. They don’t clean ovens (which we were told upfront). Very disappointed.

records.title: You may have to give them a key if you are not at home
