records.text: I enrolled Molly Maid Services while my husband was receiving radiotherapy cancer treatment. This he was receiving everyday during the morning times, for the short time whilst he was at home he needed the extra house cleaning services that Molly Maid provide. However on one occasion they had a cancellation and wanted to clean the house in the morning when John was not there (even though I agreed an afternoon service). They wanted a key for access and I told them that he was not happy about someone being in the house when he was not there. As they were not able to attend the morning they did not return for the afternoon as planned and were not happy that I did not pay for a service that they did not supply. Just to be aware that you have to be very flexible about timings and that you may be asked for access when you are not there.

records.title: Charged weeks after cancelling, didn't refund us.
records.text: We cancelled because of the ludicrous price, especially compared to what they actually pay their staff. (Hint: They pay them virtually nothing!)They kept taking payments, we rang up to ask about this and they said they would refund us. Still haven't had a refund since that call.Would not recommend, just find yourself someone local.

description: PlumbNation is an innovative leading retailer of plumbing and heating supplies, including boilers, radiators, bathrooms and much more. PlumbNation provides the very best quality products at the most competitive prices possible anywhere in the UK. PlumbNation's safe and secure website has been specifically designed to offer a quick, easy and informative shopping experience.

records.title: Excellent flat-pack bathroom vanity unit
records.text: I bought a flat-pack bathroom vanity unit and wash basin from PlumbNation. I have never had a flat pack unit so well packed and very easy to assemble.  They even provided extra parts for small itmes (screws, dowels etc) in case one got lost.  There was a small issue, not PlumbNation's fault, which they very quickly resolved.  After sales service was excellent.  Now built, it looks very impressive.  I am now looking to see if it will fit also in another bathroom and will be happy  to order another if it will.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: I purchased a bathroom cabinet from PlumbNation that was supplied by Ideal Bathrooms. After a short period of time the sliding door was not sliding over as it should so you could not easily get the contents out. I contacted Ideal Bathrooms and they said I would have to get PlumbNation to send them the details before they could look into it. I messaged Darren at PlumbNation to tell him the situation and he said he would sort it and he did immediately. The cabinet was out of stock so I got a full refund. I would like to thank Darren for his speedy response and help in sorting out a problem that could have been very long-winded so a big thank you to Darren.

records.title: Issue sorted quickly
records.text: Original item sent was missing some parts so contacted plumbNation . I got a very quick response from Liam who sorted out my issue with no problem.Thanks again

records.title: What an excellent bunch of people
records.text: What an excellent bunch of people, friendly, knowledgeable and very helpful. Liam and David sorted out a badly ordered (my fault) macerator, collecting the old and delivering the new within 24 hours. They were recommended by a plumber mate which sais it all. I gave 5 stars because there aren't 10!.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Ordered a new system boiler tank, which was ordered and delivered without any fuss.  We then had a wobble and were considering swapping to a combi boiler so contacted Plumbnation to enquire whether this would be possible as we had damaged our packaging.  I spoke with Darren who was really helpful.  We ended up keeping the tank but I was very impressed by the overall service received.

records.title: Excellent prices for good quality goods.
records.text: Purchased a rainfall shower and it arrived next day. Good quality, excellent price. Not used yet but so far ticks all the boxes.

records.title: Thermostat order
records.text: I ordered a wi-fi thermostat for my boiler which arrived very quickly (within a day). However, it turned out to be incompatible so I requested a return. Again, quickly I was contacted by Darren who was very friendly and clearly took me through the procedure to return the goods and get a refund. I was very impressed from start to finish

records.title: Great customer service …
records.text: I’m extending my home so searched online for a boiler and cylinder. Plumbnation prices were good and their website easy to follow so I placed my order. I received an email advising me that my order was cancelled and I need to reorder which I did. Woke up a few days later to see the cylinder was ordered twice, my heart ached. I called Plumbnation and explained what happened to Abdul who immediately recalled one and gave solid advice for when the delivery came. He initiated a request for my refund and made my heart feel at ease all with a cheerful disposition and a willingness to help. I called again and another gentleman took my call who was equally polite and ready to assist. Refund pending and I’m not extremely concerned about it just because Abdul and colleague made me feel as though they cared and understood.Extremely pleased because I know that good service leaves a lasting impression. Well done to all especially Abdul 🤗🙌🏾

records.title: Oliver in the customer services very helpful
records.text: Oliver in the customer services department was very helpful, when I made an error, his comms were first class. I’ve ordered two items and would recommend this company

records.title: Excellent customer service and communications
records.text: When things go wrong, that is when a personal experience is important. For me, Plumbnation customer service excelled. Initially, I found the companies 'manage my order' web page would not work, but they provided a back-up that linked me to Hamza, their customer adviser. He very quickly emailed me back and arranged a replacement to be dispatched to me the same day. I now have a replacement item and only a few days late. Many thanks Hamza for your help.

records.title: Excellent customer care
records.text: Had some issues with a third party delivery service once the parcel hadn’t arrived past its expected date I had calledUp and Hamza picked the phone up and was amazing , got straight to it for me and checked what had happened, realising the issue and  had already sorted another delivery date soon as possible. Excellent customer care service

records.title: Google link lead me to incorrectly…
records.text: Google link lead me to incorrectly order the wrong shower.One call and quickly sorted out by a helpful Liam.

records.title: Good company but DHL lets them down
records.text: Good products, website and prices but delivery by DHL lets them down. No prior notice and left the towel propped up against our front door after dark. The second time DHL turned up neatly half an hour before their stated delivery time. Luckily I was in.

records.title: No date or time given for delivery
records.text: No date or time given for deliveryTherefore they kept cold calling hoping someone was in by chance? 2 failed delivery's and still no date or proposed delivery window. Room for improvement with this procedure, I've asked for it to be redelivered and fingers crossed it will be soon. That's now sorted, appointment agreed and delivered as promised.

records.title: Happy that the product arrived ok but…
records.text: Happy that the product arrived ok but the series of order status emails were terribly inaccurate. Emailed for help twice but had no response. Final oddity was an email quoting an estimated delivery date in January…whilst the product had already arrived a few days earlier. I can understand that deliveries are a bit hit and miss at the moment but it would have been nice to have received some advice when needed.

records.title: Good product; good price; good customer relations.
records.text: The web site was very easy to use and the cylinder was at a great price. The communications via email were good and showed a phone number so one could call for assistance which I did. there was some confusion about the delivery of the cylinder that was compounded by the close to Christmas date and my relatively remote location however this was solved satisfactorily quite quickly. Good product; good price; good customer relations.

records.title: Good delivery but poor process left us confused
records.text: The ordered item arrived on time even though there had been no confirmation of order for next day delivery. When the confirmation finally arrived it was on the next day that the delivery was actually due. This stated that delivery would be made the following day – one day late. It was therefore a surprise when this urgent item suddenly turned up on the expected and original 'next day', albeit unannounced and by then unexpected.

records.title: Supply and delivery of Worcester 4000 boiler
records.text: Using the online site was very easy. I  reduced by 1 star because the bottom of the packaging the boiler was in had become very wet and collapsed. The only thing that stopped it coming out was the plastic strapping. There doesn't appear to be any visual problems with the contents. Boiler being fitted next week. More care required during transist

records.title: The disadvantage of not living on the English mainland.
records.text: Despite paying extra (for delivery on a specified date) when ordering on Wed 11th Jan, the 'fan-assisted plinth heater' failed to reach the Ship2Man warehouse in time for me to be contacted (so I could pay the additional shipping fee by close of business on Friday 13th). This meant the package didn't leave the UK on the ferry until Monday night - landing on Tuesday. It was finally delivered to my premises on Thursday 19th Jan. Ah well - live and learn.

records.title: Good supplier. Easy to deal with.
records.text: Easy to deal with, very competitive prices and excellent prompt dispatch.  But very poor delivery courier who failed to deliver as promised and failed to inform me. They are impossible to contact without a tracking number (that was not supplied to me) and no phone contact available - please use a better organised more professional courier.

records.title: Older house newer CH control system
records.text: I have used Plumb Nation b4 when I 1st improved my heating system. Having changed a couple of radiators I needed 2 more remote wireless TRVs. Found item, easy; ordered online, easy; delivery as promised; fitted and paired to existing controller, easy; job done.1970s house CH system all on one loop; 1 radiator on all on. Options 1) rip up house floors and ceilings and put in 2.or 3 loops, redecorate etc. 2) install system like Evohome wireless TRVs and programme temp vs time for each radiator/room. It works well, easy to adjust, can be done remotely, I don't. Great during lockdown when I was on own.

records.title: Let down by a poor carrier service                         PlumbNation provided exactly what I…
records.text: PlumbNation provided exactly what I ordered at a competitive priceUnfortunately the delivery company were useless They announced on Friday that they were not going to deliver  and would deliver up to two working days later without giving any reason. They then advised on Monday that they would deliver between 3.12 and 5.12, I could not take delivery but it was impossible to contact them to change times as they were too busy!I was rescued by a neighbour who took in the package but PlumbNation needs a better quality carrier!!

records.title: Take care of your customers
records.text: I’ve used Plumbnation with no trouble. This order we were missing a part of the order and unfortunately I could not get them to answer the phone nor did they reply to two of my emails. Fortunately the delivery driver turned up three days later with the missing item but according to him he tracked back himself to see why he had this spare box in his van which means that Plumbnation have still not dealt with my query emails. Plumbnation, be careful with being uncontactable after service this can easily lead to the loss of good customers.

records.title: Very good value
records.text: You are very competatively priced but the site did not show a specific dimension I needed to know. It was good that I could speak to you on the phone and although you could not give me the dimension, you did give the manufacturers contact details and they gave me what I needed.As a result I did order from you and the products were delivered within 48hrs. It would have been nice to have a clearer indication of roughly what time of day the delivery was likely to be.The products arrived in good condition and I would order from Plumbnation again.

records.title: The boiler I ordered was in stock where…
records.text: The boiler I ordered was in stock where most others had none. Price was a bit more expensive but not too much. Delivery was excellent, had to pay £20 but well worth it, arrived the next day. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is because the boiler had a few minor marks on it and a small dent. Not enough to make me send it back though. Excellent service.

records.title: Returns process is painful and non existent
records.text: Bought toilet seat but as they call soft close and normal “standard” I picked a wrong one. The return process took about 3 weeks just to get authorisation and then the seat was returned to me by Evri with no explanation . Do yourself a favour and go shopping elsewhere . They will do anything not to refund .finally after leaving this review I got my refund . Shouldn’t take a bad review

records.title: ALL OKAY BUT AFTER SALES SERVICE NEEDS SOME IMPROVEMENT
records.text: After reading some of the reviews regarding non-delivery, poor communication, lack of after-sales service etc I was apprehensive about placing an order. Miraculously the order arrived in good condition and on the date I'd requested (which I'd paid a £10 surcharge for).I've deducted one star because the order confirmation took too long to arrive and my email query regarding the order confirmation was not replied to. I could also not get through by telephone. This prevented me from arranging time-off work to take the delivery. I had to call in sick instead which wasn't ideal.

records.title: 14 day return
records.text: delivered as said ,the only problem i have is company has a 14 day return policy,so you must arrange a gas fitter first.but in meantime if the gas fitter cancells for some unknown reason and goes past your 14 days ,you lose your money if he finds anything wrong.

records.title: Ordered from Plumbnation as their…
records.text: Ordered from Plumbnation as their prices are competitive. Most items were supplied without issue. However, 2 items arrived damaged - replacements were authorised quickly but as they rely on 3rd party suppliers to arrange delivery, the replacements were delayed.

records.title: My earlier review was perhaps a bit…
records.text: My earlier review was perhaps a bit premature and more the fault of the couriers. Have today received notification that a replacement cistern is on its way. Just hoping the packing is better as previous box looked like it had been dropped from a great height! Despite the ‘fragile ‘ tape all around the box.

records.title: My order arrived on time and in good…
records.text: My order arrived on time and in good condition. I have rated 3 as I was really disappointed with the returns service. I had registered my return and returned the item quickly. Unfortunately I had to chase plumbnation to process the refund despite waiting a full 9 working days from confirmation that the item had been received. I would have expected more rapid confirmation and to not need to chase. Thanks

records.title: Lack of communication
records.text: Overall experience I would say not a problem but it all started on the after sales.  I'm due delivery on the 23/5/2024, I rang in for an ETA, but instead, I'm being told it's on hold awaiting my ID verification, which I have to provide. I wish this was advised at the time of order and when I was making my payment so I could look out for an email.Problem has been solved thanks to Ahmar who has been exceptional. Thank you

records.title: The ordering process was fine Delivery…
records.text: The ordering process was fine Delivery date agreed I waited in all day to no avail Contacted plum nation to be told my goods had not been despatched due to some mix up despite being told otherwise I asked they now be given priority but was told not possible and they would arrive 2 days later which was the case I would have expected next day delivery after their mix up

records.title: Awful customer service
records.text: They give you an estimated day of arrival so i wait in all day, nothing arrives.I call the next morning the girl quite surly said she would call me back- no call.I call the next morning and am told it will be delivered today and it was. Awful customer service, they should update and keep customers aware of whats going on like the rest of us do.

records.title: Packaging not fit for purpose
records.text: Tanks arrived on palettes, and we unloaded to the pavement rather than the property. This would have been ok, the straps to palette were secure, but white plastic straps around tank boxes were ridiculously loose (20-30cm slack), the tanks were in cardboard sleeves with a cardboard lid at both ends, without being properly secured it was not possible to move these long tanks without unpacking them in the street. The tanks for upper floors then had to be carried unprotected.

records.title: Unreasonable Return Policy
records.text: I bought a Grant boiler, a mag filter and a flu in preparation for installation in my house. As is common, my installers could not schedule the job for about 3 weeks and when they arrived, they advised that the flu was the wrong model.I bought the correct model from PlumbNation but then found they would not accept return nd refund for the one bought in error. I explained the situation and the fact that I had spent over £3500 with them but they just ignored my e-mails and calls.

records.title: Appalling communication
records.text: Appalling communication. Expected delivery was 19th. Received actual delivery on 21st. No communication at all until day of delivery. No idea of time of delivery. When delivery notification received it was not clear from whom the message came. It did not mention PlumbNation or radiator so had to guess.

records.title: An ok experience
records.text: An ok experience , 1st time I had used them , boiler arrived a day later than expected even though I was given email confirmation of the day before (very annoying) , plus the box was very much in distress , although contents were fine . Not the best overall experience , but ok

records.title: I have ordered from Plumbnation before…
records.text: I have ordered from Plumbnation before and normally very good However one part came damaged. I had to report and send pictures and then wait so far over four days to see what’s going on. I would have preferred a replacement sent rather than a wait for over four days and still waiting. It came damaged - proof was shown - a replacement and answer should have been given quicker - unfortunately I will have to shop elsewhere from now

records.title: Delivery delayed by over a week
records.text: Delivery delayed by over a week.  My customer had no heating during this time and the only option to me was on line.  Courier poor.  Customer services helpful (thank you) but communication poor.  Would have been much less stress to shop elsewhere in this case.

records.title: Dumbfounded  . rang plumbnation several times…
records.text: I  rang plumbnation several times (having been cut off twice after a long wait) prior to my delivery,to change the day as l would be at work and you require a signature, and l would need help lifting it.  I was told it was sorted  and the day changed.  I got home only to find a neighbour had kindly taken receipt of my cancelled delivery ,and carried it in for me as l am a lady pensioner. What was the point of bothering. Had nobody been around it would have been a waste of fuel , time and where would my delivery be?  The card posted through my door said. LEFT AT NO 52 AS INSTRUCTED. Never happened.

records.title: NOT GREAT WHEN THINGS GO WRONG
records.text: Spent £250 on an item that never arrived. Bizarre story from the courier APC about a waybill being tracked without an actual item. Many calls to Plumbnation went unanswered, but eventually got someone who arranged a replacement and it arrived four days later.

records.title: Trouble getting a refund!
records.text: Trouble getting a refund!Faulty goods returned. Months have passed and I am yet to receive my refund. Despite numerous follow up emails.I finally got the refund. The team were pleasant. My gripe here is the processes set by the company which made this a slow and arduous task.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order. However when requesting a later delivery date due to limited storage availability, despite being told this was fine, received an email to say order was being delivered on a day there was no-one home. Was told the order was already loaded (the day before the delivery day) which was denied by the delivery driver who said there wouldn’t have been a problem waiting a further 48hrs if he had been asked, which he hadn’t been. Frustrating as it required a hurried exit from work in order to be at the address for the delivery time frame.

records.title: Ordered 4 Myson Radiators - Took a month to arrive
records.text: Had to chase up Plumbnation after 4 Myson radiators never arrived.  Customer service guy was pretty helpful and investigated.  Eventually received some emails keeping me reasonably informed of estimated arrival.  In all it took exactly one month for the radiators to be delivered.  They seem fine - brand new and packaged.  City Plumbing actually fulfilled the delivery with makes me think I should have just gone to them in the first place.  Plumbnation appear to be part of the same group as them.

records.title: Best price for Oso cylinder
records.text: Best price for Oso cylinder, but did not have the one I wanted in stock (120L) and would not give a price for this, so I bought a 150L instead which is ok but really I wanted the 120L. Delivery promised on Monday but did not arrive because the order had been lost, so sent out again for delivery following Monday as I was away on Friday. Delivered on Friday. Ah well not bad but sorry cannot give 5 stars.

records.title: Boiler didn’t arrive on selected date…Read ON
records.text: Boiler didn’t arrive on selected date How ever after a rude email it was delivered on Easter Saturday by a really helpful nice lad. If the co just kept you updated on the delivery I’m sure they would get. Far less low stars

records.title: Bad delivery company
records.text: The website, process and product from plumbnation were really good, can't fault them. However, the delivery company they use called DX were absolutely terrible, the single worst experience I've had with any delivery company.

records.title: Bad packaging
records.text: The order was delivered timely but the packaging was a disaster. This was a 25 kg toilet bowl which was inadequately secured inside a cardboard box . The materials for packing may have been adequate but the bowl had become loose inside of the flimsy outer cardboard box and was and rolling inside it. Fortunately it appears not to be damaged but the problem had been recognised by the local delivery driver who was careful with it.

records.title: delivery was poor
records.text: delivery was poor - didn't arrive when it was supposed to.... couldn't find the house in this day and age!!when i redirected it to work they didnt readdress the parcel, so i had to be quite agressive togetit sorted

records.title: Poor Customer Service when things go wrong !
records.text: Orderd a Gledhill Tank from Plumbnation on the 14th March 24 to replace a failed/leaking tank that was 10 years old. The Website indicated 10-12 days for delivery. So we made allowance and expected it to arrive within 2 weeks assuming the time scale was working days. However i was subsequantly provided a dispatch date of the 8th April which is 16 working days. On the 8th i was notified that the manufacturer had dispatch and it was expected on the 9th. Arranged for someone to wait in all day and the plumber to arrive the following as the leaking tank has corroded and needed several repairs to stem the leak.  No delivery received so i called Plumb Nation cusotmer services 10th and Kirsty confirmed the dispatch and delviery date. She informed me she woudl find out what was happening and get back to me. Nothng that day and on Thursday the 8th i recieved a short email confirming my enquiry and they woudl respond within 48hrs. No call received by late morning on the 9th so i called customer services again. This time i am told that Custoemr Services can not call the manufacturer as they have another department who does that and that department called Gledhill yesterday but had not had a response ( i have to question call or Emailed?) i was told that there was nothing further they can do and awaiting to find out if Gledhill have dispatched or even manufactured the tank. I haev asked for a response by the end of the day but like a good politican Cusotmer Service continued to reply that they would get back to me when they get a response themselves from Gledhill. Clearly Plumbnation have poor processes for dealing with enquiries and in the arrangement of drop shipping products. I wonder howmuch the Senior Management and Shareholders know of this and how it will affect future businesses as the Highbourne group own several other Plumbing Sales businesses.  Perhaps i will try a CEO to CEO call with David Evans. I have used Plumbnation previsouly with no issue and wihile issues do occur the way thsi has been handled is highly dissappointing, i am now unlikely to use them again and would receommed other to consider alternatives. I must point out that Kirsty was pleasant and apologetic, not so the gentleman i spoke with today. If he work for my company he would be recieving further training!

records.title: Don't advertise next day delivery if you don't have stock
records.text: Ordered thermostat says next day delivery. Checked order after 2 days not even dispatched, "your order has been sent to manufacturer" -if you don't have stock don't advertise next day delivery! I had someone booked to fit this item! Catherine on Customer Services was fantastic but I wouldn't order from them again

records.title: Order received wrong and still not resolved.
records.text: Placed my order and paid for a specific delivery day, which it was delivered on, but I had no update on this or a time frame. Part of my order was wrong, and this was reported straightaway at 8.30am on Thursday. I needed this part for a job on the Monday, and told the team I needed this ASAP, it hasn't been replaced, so now I've had to use my free time to source the part elsewhere.Poor service from order placement to after care.

records.title: I have received nothing so far
records.text: I have received nothing so far.  10 days in, 5 days after I had an email that part of the order would arrive within 24 hours - nothing has been delivered,  no CCTV of attempted delivery and no reply to my emails.  Also: when the order was placed all items were in stock, later transpired one item wasn't - not a disaster for me as a DIYer but if you are trying to deliver a service to a customer or have an urgent job to do I would avoid this company.

records.title: Item not delivered
records.text: One of four items ordered was not delivered on the day specified, it took three calls to get it chased, by which time I was told it would be there next day, three days late and I was already installing so had to source a similar part locally. To add insult to injury, I was told I wouldn’t get my refund until the part was back in the warehouse, even though they knew it hadn’t been delivered and was with their courier for return.

records.title: Very poor service.
records.text: Very poor service.I ordered a rad, on a phone call to a plumb nation staff member who confirmed that the item was in stock.15 minutes after making payment I received an email advising that the rad was not in fact in stock and would be subject to a 2 week delay as a minimum.Had I been made aware of the accurate stock position, I wouldn't have placed the order.Even after being made aware that it was not available, the website continued to show it as in stock.I was refunded swiftly, which was one positive aspect.

records.title: Quick delivery of item poor returns service
records.text: Quick delivery of item - problems arise when trying to return something.  Takes weeks to get a return authorisation code and then a further 2 weeks for refund to be actioned - and only after multiple calls and complaints. If I hadn’t called so many times I probably would still be waiting for my refund.

records.title: Don't believe delivery dates on website
records.text: Whilst pricing is competitive,  the website showed a delivery date of 2-3 days for a product I was later informed was on back order when delivery was delayed a second time forcing me to buy a higher priced product to complete a bathroom. Plumbnation were unwilling to price match to the original product despite the issue their lack of clarity caused at original order and then again with an estimated delivery date which was a delay  and would have been acceptable but still wasn't achieved, leaving me to call up on that date to find out about the issue.

records.title: It's not worth the stress
records.text: It's not worth the stress of ordering with Pumbnation! We ordered a radiator, which we had confirmed delivery for, which next arrived, which was confirmed for 3 days later, which never arrived, then we got an "order complete" email! Clearly, Plumbnation don't hold stock of items, they source elsewhere and then get shipments made. They don't answer their main line phone, the "Office is closed" - all day! However....The 2nd star is for the benefit of the doubt, they have answered my emails, and have suggested a refund is now on its way. So, simply, it's not worth the stress to order from PN - try elsewhere

records.title: I paid £10 for delivery day to be…
records.text: I paid £10 for delivery day to be Monday 9th January , goods arrived a day late on Tuesday . The goods were not what I thought they were and I called up twice and have emailed once now to get a returns number , but am still waiting for a reply .

description: Local experts with 24 hour emergency response across the UK. Wherever and whenever there’s a problem Dyno-Rod fly into action. We offer our services 24/7. Whether it’s your home, your business or industrial premises, we have the expertise and the specialist equipment to fix your problems and get things back to normal.

records.title: Good assistance and service
records.text: The guy arrived within the scheduled time slot, spent quite a while working on and removing the blockage. Provided a lot of advice on next steps, reporting problem to drainage provider, ensured that toilet, sink and shower units were all working before he left.  Very happy with service.

records.title: Excellent Service from Dyno Rod
records.text: Contact Dyno Rod early this morning concerning a blocked drain and they contacted me almost immediately to arrange an appointment.Stewart from Dyno Rod contacted me by phone just after 09.00 and advised that he would be at my home within the hour.Stewart arrived just before 10.00 and set about clearing the blockage in our external drain.The work was successfully completed and I must say that I found Stewart a very courteous and friendly guy and would like to thank him for a job well done

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Excellent. Very polite, professional but also friendly. Efficient, got job done properly and checked everything was in order. Outside drain now working very well and kitchen sink drains easily. Many thanks

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Easy booking, turned up when they said they would, called before they came, all good customer service. Their operative knew what he needed to do and cleared the blockage within half an hour, and took a lot of care to clean the whole of the outside drain system. Very good service.

records.title: Happy with work done
records.text: Able to attend soon after my request for help clearing a blocked/backed up sink and odour in the house.Patiently spent time investigating then dealing with a big blockage. Explained what was happening throughout. Good price for the time and effort spent and result. Thanks! 😀

records.title: Central heating system Flushed
records.text: We had our system flushed today the engineer was Carl Trotts who was very professional and knowledgeable. Carl explained any questions we had without issue . Carl called to give us ETA and kept us updated throughout doing the job.

records.title: Strongly recommend Dyno-Rod
records.text: I booked a plumber to fix a bathtub leak. He showed up on time, was very professional and polite. He qas able to identify the cause of the leak and quote for fixing beforestarting work. The Plumber came across as very knowledgeable and competent, and fixed the problem very promptly. I would highly recommend Dyno-Rod.

records.title: Aaron from Dyno was fantastic
records.text: Aaron from Dyno was fantastic – he sourced and fitted a new shower pump just before Christmas with impressive efficiency and speed. He worked cleanly and professionally, leaving everything spotless. A big thank you to Aaron for his excellent work, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Dyno for their reliable and high-quality service.

records.title: engineer superb
records.text: engineer punctual friendly ... never stopped workingexplained what he was doing.tidied upa credit to dyno.rod.Manan Anwari is his name

records.title: Fast, efficient service
records.text: Dyno-Rod were great. Got straight through to them on the phone on a bank holiday, and engineer was friendly and efficient. Arrived within 3 hours and got our blocked drain sorted quickly. Price was fair too, considering it was an emergency call out. Highly recommended.

records.title: Austin came out today and was very…
records.text: Austin came out today and was very helpful and polite.he came early morning and the job took him 5hours.alot was to do for him he realy done his best and solved the problem.thank u.im happy for all the work

records.title: Arrived on time pleasant and polite…
records.text: Arrived on time pleasant and polite gave us a price prior to commencing worked quickly and efficiently and tidied up after completion.Absolutely no complaints as a very satisfied customer.

records.title: Un-blocked 50yrs worth of limescale…
records.text: Un-blocked 50yrs worth of limescale clogging upstairs waste pipe in less than 10 minutes!, very good and very reasonable price too...would have been 5 stars but unfortunately the first chap who came didn't have the right equipment to di it then and there, requiring a 2nd visit..didn't charge for the 1st one so really not complaining..juat unfortunate

records.title: The guy was great
records.text: The guy was great, tried a lot of stuff to try and clear the drain but it looks like the blockage might be on or over the boundary. We have contacted the water company and they are due to arrive shortly. The work done by Dyno Rod was very good.

records.title: Booked online
records.text: Booked online, booking confirmed via email and text super quick and they came out the next day. They were friendly and polite and sorted out issue really fast and were really thorough making sure it was definitely sorted. My only quibble was that the online booking didn’t quote me a price so I didn’t know how much until they arrived.

records.title: Job done, nearly perfectly
records.text: The team arrived as scheduled and completed their work quickly. The team was knowledgeable and friendly and my only (very) minor complaint was that they did not dry the floor in the areas where they had been working.I'd rather give 4.5 stars, as I really hate to drop a whole star off their rating, but to me 5 stars only means that they delivered the expected service with complete professionalism, and they *just* missed on the latter point.

records.title: Great plumber. Stressful appointment bookings.
records.text: The actual plumber was absolutely fantastic - great service, very accommodating, friendly and definitely knew his stuff! Cleaned up after himself as well. No complaints at all about that part of the service.The appointment booking wasn't such a good experience. No-one turned up the first day - or let me know why (I had to phone them to find out jobs had over-run and so they had booked me into the next day instead without even asking if it was convenient. So I had to take a second day off work (at short notice).  I was booked for a morning slot - but the plumber arrived mid afternoon due to his previous job over-running.  Everyone I called throughout all this was very friendly and helpful, and to be fair, they had fitted me in the same week I needed help - but the lost time and wages wasn't ideal. May be better if they could schedule timings better!Very reasonable prices though.  I would use them again - just wouldn't put so much trust in an appointment actually happening on the day scheduled.

records.title: 2 visits ro unblock drains and then cut roots
records.text: 2 visits. One to unblock and clean drains caused by root blockage. Second visit required high powered machine to cut roots. Both works done efficiently with friendly guys.

records.title: Came out within 2 hours for a clogged…
records.text: Came out within 2 hours for a clogged up drain Very quickly unclogged charged £180.  The engineer was friendly and efficient.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Dyno were great got the issue sorted unfortunately I had to wait another day because city Teqnical services sent the wrong contact number to dyno but Tecqnition from dyno was extremely professional and courteous so extremely pleased with there service

records.title: Colin May arrived listened to my…
records.text: Colin May arrived listened to my problem . A very pleasant worker who is a credit to your firm . The problem was solved in a short space of time. My only criticism was the cost £180 for less than 30 mins work . I appreciate travelling time etc . However I was a happy person & if & when it happens again I will be calling you . Thank you

records.title: Successful on the second day
records.text: I waited in vain the first day I was booked but the second day I had my drains unblocked successfully. Operator was friendly and explained what he was doing and why.  He was pleased to wash his hands with soap and water afterwards

records.title: Ross waa friendly
records.text: Ross waa friendly, tried several parts but was unable to fix our flexi pipe and give us options on what we could do. Installed new tap

records.title: I am hoping that the Dynorod engineer's…
records.text: I am hoping that the Dynorod engineer's visit has solved the plumbing issue. I will be in touch if not but so far it appears to have been resolved.

records.title: Great work replacing a toilet
records.text: Great work replacing a toilet. Tim worked really fast and efficiently to get the job done with no mess. Arrived on time, phoning beforehand.A few administrative issues with arranging quote and appointment but they were quickly rectified with phone calls to the main office. This was unusual though as I’ve dealt with Dyno many times via British Gas Homecare  and they’ve always provided a great service. Although this job wasn’t covered by the homecare agreement, it was great that they were able to advise and still do the job at what I think seemed a pretty competitive rate, also providing a guarantee for the work done.

records.title: Update Shower Finally Fixed.
records.text: After use for a few weeks no leaks from shower.  It looks like it’s finally fixed.  If future problems develop as recommended by Dyno Rod will upgrade to ceramic shower tray.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Fantastic process, very easy and professional, engineer was polite and helpful. My only issue is the price of £165 for 40 minutes of work.

records.title: Great, but better communication need from head office
records.text: Iain W was great from the moment he arrived polite and courteous, unblocking our kitchen sink in no time! Booked online and didn't hear anything from the office to hear of Iain's arrival until he rang 20mins before he arrived, so room for improvement there.

records.title: Still can’t use shower that Dyno Rod…
records.text: Still can’t use shower that Dyno Rod fitted as it’s still leaking.   Had an email from them informing me that fitter and supervisor were on annual leave so will provide me with an update when they return.  Hopefully that will be on 28th October tomorrow. Will update.

records.title: Great service from Dyno-Rod today
records.text: Great service from Dyno-Rod today. Technician very helpful, efficient, friendly and thorough. He was later than planned, as he got held up on another job, but that's understandable and the call centre kept me fully updated.

records.title: When requesting a call out I was offuam…
records.text: When requesting a call out I was offuam or pm, I chose am. 4 calls to number given engineer  arrived after 19.00.He was efficient & polite, resolved my problem promptly.DO NOT OFFER TIMES IF THIS CANNOT BE COMPLETED!!!

records.title: An expensive visit
records.text: I called British Gas to have a dripping tap repaired under my Homecare Complete cover.  BG contracts the plumbing out to Dyno-Rod.  An appointment was made for the same day, which was amazing as it was just after Christmas and New Year.   The engineer was polite, knowledgeable and extremely good at his job. I've dropped two stars in this review, which is not in any respect a reflection on the engineer.  I paid a £60 excess for the call out, which I was expecting.  However the tap was unable to be repaired.  The 2 free replacement options were extremely old fashioned looking, nothing like the tap being replaced, so I had to go with the 3rd tap which was the most similar to the one being replaced but carried an additional charge of £60.  So the total cost of the visit was £120 which is a lot of money to pay out on top of the homecare cover.  I'm now seriously considering cancelling the plumbing section of the Homecare cover.Following the response from Dyno-Rod, I accept their comments.  I did make it clear that their service was speedy and the engineer was excellent.  It would have been a 5* review without the extra cost.

records.title: Not sure if I’d use them again
records.text: Brilliant engineer who solved the problem for us.   But we were booked for Friday before 6pm, I rang at 5.50pm asking why no one had come and was told that he still had 4 jobs before us!  We were then promised Saturday morning and he arrived Saturday at 5.15pm.  Ok, no big problem, but he then had to charge us extra to what we’d been quoted because it was a weekend!  No issue with the work or the engineer but the booking process and communication seem to need a review.  And I can’t find ‘contact us’ on the website to dispute the extra that we had to pay.

records.title: Previous ’fix’ was not the issue.
records.text: We removed our toilet to have limescale drilled out of our down-pipe as the camera investigation showed that was the issue causing a restriction for toilet waste. After a massive inconvenience and great expense, 14 months later we’re back in the same position with a blocked toilet. Can’t build up 22 years of scale in that amount of time. I had an appointment booked for today, 13-18:00, got a call at 16:00 to say they couldn’t come. Very frustrating.

records.title: Colon May - excellent
records.text: Colin was 5 stars as he dealt with the issue and was informative and polite. But the 3 stars goes to Dyno/British Gas for the lack of communication about the delayed visit. Delayed by 4 hours and I twice had to call.Like I say, do not penalise Colin for this review. Nothing wrong with how he worked and I understand he was stuck on an emergency issue prior to this visit. He was also on shift since 6am today without a lunch break he said.

records.title: No tidy-up done
records.text: Trivallis the housing association, requested that Dyno-Rod - South Wales.But having said that, he was quick and polite. I didn't get any warning that your "agent" was coming to sort out my kitchen drain. The only downside was I had to clean up the drain grill/cover and ensure the run in, from the path was clear of leaf matter. The only downside of that was I had taken a fall down my stairway a couple of weeks ago and it was difficult to say the least doing a minimal clean up, with a broken fibula right at the top next to my knee, they can't set that in a cast! So I have to take a fairly strong pain killers. Never the less it isn't your "agent's" job to care for me so I just got on with the clean-up while your "operative" sat on the phone in the van.

records.title: Problem getting quotation
records.text: Engineer attended, all very efficient. He identified the cause and location of blockage BUT still waiting for quote to clear blockage and been a week now. Phoned 3 times to chase.NOT GOOD

records.title: Efficiently cleared problem.
records.text: The gentleman was very efficient, polite and personable.  He had the issue cleared in no time at all.Had I not have to await an appointment for over ten days my review would be a five, no question.

records.title: Very average
records.text: Dynorod Turned up late the crew didn’t have a camera in van as it was in the ‘other van’ the call-out fee and first hour is £180 I thought that was to clear the drain it’s expensive. Crew spent 15 mins filling the pressure washer tank with water as ‘we have to travel empty it’s legislation’. Never convinced by what they were saying. Fortunately cleared drain in one hour. I paid on the guys phone as they have no card machine which seems unprofessional. Also I got no receipt as I need to claim this money back so now I have to chase around for one. All in all got job done but Mickey Mouse. For the future I’ll buy a Karcher jet wash and attachments (screwfix) and clear myself after watching them.

records.title: Quickly solved, but late
records.text: The problem was solved at the price agreed. But having booked a 1pm-6pm slot before 8.15am the same day I was disappointed that no-one arrived until just after 6.35. I had no updates, save for a duplicate text at 4.15 reiterating that someone would attend between 1-6. A generous price is charged and for for this I would expect better communication.

records.title: Blocked Toilet
records.text: Turned up quite promptly. Tried to clear the toilet but the blockage was a plastic cleaning block holder!!!! So not cleared properly but can use for pee only now, no loo roll! DIsappointed as he wouldn't put down manhole covers leaving my 74 Yr old partner to do it. Still had to pay full fee £180. !

records.title: Good service, but annoying SMS messages & poor follow on quote.
records.text: Good service in that they came out on the day & fixed the problem, thanks Andy.Expensive though & immediate payment is odd; cash, card or bank transfer.Constant & needless SMS messages are a nuisance especially at 4;30am! They need to stop this.Quote for follow on work was initially wrong, then when I pointed this out, they said we needed more video work done to locate the fault (we didn't-this has been established in the first visit) at a cost of almost £400!Can't help feeling they are trying it on.

records.title: Repair after Damage to property by Dyno
records.text: Generally the work that was done was good. However they left the old material on my driveway together bits under the bath. The company had previously damaged my home and this was their repair that they only did after I took them to the Ombudsman

records.title: The booking service is really good and…
records.text: The booking service is really good and quick, I was told I had wipes down my toilet to which I know for 100% I never use them ……… The blockage was done in 20 mins from outside my property… And the dirty gloves were left on the floor outside my property! I would use dyno-rod again I just hope my problem has been resolved

records.title: Quick and Efficient service
records.text: I contacted Dyno-Rod via British Gas Homecare. I got an appointment for the next day and Dan quickly confirmed the problem. He returned the following afternoon with the relevant part and fitted the pump quickly and efficiently. I had scored this service as a 4*. However, after one day of a working shower I was back to square 1 today with no water coming out. When I phoned Dyno Rod the person taking the call didn't seem at all concerned that I had been charged for a service which failed after one day!Following a further visit from another operative I now have a working shower.  Have upgraded my rating to 3*, which reflects the time it took to resolve the issue.

records.title: The booking process was very easy
records.text: The booking process was very straightforward. The service received could have been better. We wanted to jet the pipes but the guy spotted another issue non pipes related and didn’t want to do what we asked. 1 week later we had to call them out again   Hopefully the problem will be resolved with the 2 bd visit but unfortunately this results in 2 call out charges.

records.title: Simple unblocking job went wrong …
records.text: Great guys completed the work today repairing the pipe work to our shower which was accidentally drilled through by Dyno, leaving us without our shower for 5 days. Just need the ceiling repaired where they accessed the pipe work, which I’m confident will be completed soon.Just very disappointed to be charged 1 1/2 hours labour for an unblocking job that actually only took minutes! Did not expect to pay for time taken to repair the issue caused by Dyno!

records.title: The franchise company booked to visit…
records.text: The franchise company booked to visit me today and cancelled on me today seriously need to brush up on their customer services telephone manner!! So rude and couldn't wait to talk over me continuously, rushing to have her say, not listening to our situation and couldn't wait to put the phone down to end the conversation. Just awful and has left me quite upset.

records.title: Too expensive
records.text: The guy was very pleasant, my and telephoned prior to calling.  My problem lies with the charge £170, for 15 mins which includes, arriving using a plunger, going back to his van to get the paperwork, paying and signing, the problem was solved with a £20 plunger which you can purchase from screwfix, try this first, not the workmans fault but British Gas are ripping people off for this service.  I was made aware of the cost before the visit.

records.title: Disgruntled Lloyds Customer
records.text: It took 24 hours to fix my problem. I had buckets catching dripping water from my hall ceiling. Having called Dyno three times, they still couldn’t give me an appropriate time; only 0800-1800. Eventually a guy arrived and he was courteous and confident. He was 5 star, the telephone service was 0 star. That’s the reason for an average of 3  star

records.title: Not Greatly Impressed
records.text: Engineer came out as planned but mis-diagnosed the leak. He thought it was the magnetic filter on the heating. Net result was that it carried on leaking for another week. We were away at the time. He had to cut holes in the kitchen ceiling to locate the leak. Said it was a 2-man job. Booked an appointment for Saturday. I was still away and arranged for someone to let them in. Nobody came or called. Eventually came on Monday and made the repair.To add to my concerns, when our insurer’s came out to assess the damage they asked if our artex contained asbestos. I didn’t know and they have sent a sample for testing. Still awaiting the results.

records.title: Communication could have been m better
records.text: Communication could have been much  betterAppointment was  arranged Thursday afternoon and for 8-6 Friday.Received Confirmation phone call Friday 8am for that morning.After I called at 4pm I was told everything ok. Driver phoned me  at 4.30 to say 30mins was coming from Morecambe —-never arrived.  I rang again at 7.30 and they tried to contact him Without success. I had stayed in all day for nothing!Rang the web site. Given local office number so tried this and answerphone saidthe office was closed till Monday!!!!! Except for emergencies.I called local office following day  at 9.15.again, they did answer said would come Saturday morning. After further call from me at 4.00 the man arrived at 5pm (Saturday afternoon)  I made 7 calls to 2 offices.The man who did the job eventually was very good.No blame from my side for him.

records.title: Had to have them out 3 times to resolve…
records.text: Had to have them out 3 times to resolve problem, one big bill later, cracked bathroom tiles and enamel on toilet bowel scratched. The guy that came out was friendly and professional but to have them keep coming out at my expense due to not having the right machine and have damage feel like I’ve been ripped off, since having this done others have said the same

records.title: Not great service
records.text: Not great service. Booked in advance appointments on 2 occasions and failed to arrived. 1st one just didn't show up, 2nd one called at 7pm to say the shop had shut so couldn't get the parts (that was an 8 to 6pm slot).Finally the work is done and engineer said he could do a small part of the pipe as he ran out of materials,  do I want him to go get more! Overall pretty poor

records.title: Poor Service
records.text: Marcus came to repair toilet that wasn’t flushing properly. Very polite and professional, explaining all aspects of the job which he completed quickly without fuss. ***Had to recall Dyno as toilet not flushing properly. Apparently the flush was connected incorrectly and there was a piece of excess tube that had been left floating in cistern and it had got stuck in mechanism which stopped the cistern from refilling properly. Very disappointed ☹️ ***

records.title: Unable to find an issue
records.text: So contacted the company as it has excellent reviews, had an issue with a blocked toilet. I was told the charge was £180 and this was the price on whether or not the blockage was cleared. I was given a 9am-5pm window for a call out. I did ask if a possible shorter time window could be given due to work commitments at the end of the day but was told that was not possible. Waiting till 4pm I had to cancel the engineer due to work commitments and when I called to reschedule they told me I could have a shorter call out window between 8am-1pm the following working day (this would have been helpful to know beforehand).  Engineer arrives with his plunger and rod does his normal checks and could not find an issue. Eventually I was told that a pipe going into the vent stack was too far in and that toilet tissue was getting in the way. Bearing in mind this has not been an issue for the past several years. When I mentioned this had not been an issue in the past I was told he was not sure how this had not been an issue but it was the only explanation. I was also told I would not be able to get the standard 3 month guarantee. Overall disappointed with the outcome and service I received.

records.title: Slabs repositioned causing a trip hazard
records.text: The fellas that arrived were fantastic, had lots of good communication and they resolved the problem, we think. The guys had to lift a few slabs to access our man cover drain.They power jetted the blockage. Great. However, when repositioning the slabs, not so great. In honesty, they’ve made a mess and trip hazard. Despite feeling uncomfortable, we gently raised concerns  and in all honestly felt it wasn’t received positively. However Rob agreed to try and improve the slabbing, once he told me it would need sand and cement, which fortunately I had and allowed him to use. The slabs were improved but are still unstable and wobbling when walking on them. We’re genuinely not ppl that complain but we feel this is wholly unacceptable. Happy to discuss further before making a formal complaint.

records.title: No guarantee for work carried out or…
records.text: No guarantee for work carried out or pump purchased. Work took twice as long than expected. Over two days. Extra £100 over quote requested. No water available for bath/shower between visits. Card payment demanded along with personal details eg security code. Engineer nice.

records.title: Awful communication
records.text: Awful communication - turned up on third appointment. I had to call them to discover they weren’t turning up the previous two occasions. Despite saying they are open to 6, when I called at 5:10 one evening everyone had left leaving me to wonder if they coming or not. When they did arrive (not at the appointed time - I was given differing versions of events) it was fixed quickly.

records.title: Dyno wasted my whole day
records.text: Reported fault 4days ago to British gas, plumber came out from Dyno at 5,50pm made a few adjustments to toilet cistern flush and was gone in 5 minutes saying to phone dyno if we had any more problems, as soon as cistern refilled started overflowing again  if he had bothered to wait he would have seen it, absolutely wasted day waiting in for them had to rebook through British gas

description:
Helpling is an online marketplace that helps match you with reviewed and insured, local cleaners. Payment is all done online too, so you'll never need to worry about cash again. 

To book, all you need to do is pop in your postcode, choose the time that works best for you and browse the cleaners available in your area before booking. Simple.

records.title: Super clean and happy with the service…
records.text: Super clean and happy with the service - thanks!

records.title: Helpling makes it easy!
records.text: Helpling makes it really easy to find people to do various tasks for you. For example, I found an insured cleaner within 5 minutes and they did an excellent job.

records.title: Easy way to find local cleaners
records.text: Easy way to find local cleaners - with no strings attached! We loved using Helpling to find a cleaner for our home, and found one quickly by selecting the days and times we wanted cleaning. You are then able to choose between cleaners in the area, whose profile and ratings you can see before accepting. Payment is taken via credit card right after every clean, and cleaners can set their own rates which is great. Highly recommend.

records.title: Easy to deal with, reliability and efficiency.
records.text: Using Helping UK through their website is very easy and the communications is great. Both the people I have used have been efficient reliable and hardworking. The costs are reasonable and there are no hidden extras. So far, I can’t fault the experience is using Helping UK or the cleaners they have sent me. Certainly, much better than our last company who were very disorganised, you never knew who was coming and the quality of work was questionable. I’m very pleased I changed to Helping UK

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: The first cleaner I had wasn't up to scratch, so they sent over my current cleaner, who is a proper professional.  She's always on time, very friendly and extremely thorough.  She cleans for the whole allotted time and my house always looks sparkling afterwards

records.title: Love Helpling
records.text: We have been using the Helpling platform for the past 3 years to find suitable cleaners. We absolutely love using Helpling as it's super simple for customers to use. You can easily amend your bookings, communicate and chat with the cleaners and have great visibility over your invoices and pricing. The costumer service is also very helpful and always responds promptly to any queries raised. We definitely would recommend Helpling!

records.title: Great and helpful team
records.text: Since I started living alone, I haven't made a big mess, but it's been missing a bit of freshness. I found these people on the Internet by accident, and they made my life easier. Whenever I contact them, they very easily find an appointment that suits me, and they do everything perfectly. Once there was a small mistake, and they came as soon as possible to correct it. Great team, very skilled, and responsible.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: First time using the app. I found it a little tricky to use, however someone was always on hand immediately on WhatsApp to help, and they were brilliant. The cleaner I hired was exceptional. Brilliant at her job, and such a warm and polite person too. Prob the best experience of this sort that I have had regarding hiring a cleaner from an online service. Whole process felt very human. And I will defo use Helpling and hopefully the same cleaner again!

records.title: Seems great!
records.text: This is just a review of starting up with them and using their booking procedure as I haven't been given a cleaner yet, but it's a really easy to use system, people can set their own price and there is just a small fee for using their services, and you chose how often, and when you want to use their services for. Very happy so far!!

records.title: Great experience once i managed to get…
records.text: Great experience once i managed to get a cleaner booked it was easy to use .. only point i would mention is that there seems to be a shortage of cleaners if sometimes takes a couple of booking before your job gets picked ... but once allocated a very easy experience

records.title: Great tool for last minute clean
records.text: Great tool for last minute clean. You have the security of the app and can find really good cleaners!

records.title: My cleaner up to date 31032022
records.text: My cleaner has being every week on time or early.  She is very friendly, approachable and fun.  Although she speaks little English only Portugese, but somehow were managing. The quality is very good and the cleaner exceeded my expectations this week, she did all the rooms very well. Thats my kitchen, bathroom, lounge, 2 bedrooms, hallway.

records.title: Great place to get cleaners in London…
records.text: Great place to get cleaners in London and I like the reviews as it helps you choose the best person for you. The only downside if you need to book at least 48 hours in advance (even if there may be available cleaners for your date / time), and sometimes cleaners cancel last minute with no notice, and the platform is not helpful in that situation. Overall though, I love using helpling!

records.title: I found a good cleaner on Helping
records.text: I found a good cleaner via the platform and I am happy with my first clean. However, the platform can be improved as the interfaces are not helping when you need to do changes to your requests. I hope this will be taken on board as a constructive feedback, as I found it difficult to connect with somebody for support while trying to cancel request.

records.title: A useful platform
records.text: A useful platform, I needed a one off clean and was able to find someone for my second choice of date. It was very easy to make the initial booking but I found it difficult to edit it afterwards. The cleaner that came was very friendly and did a good job.

records.title: Great to have a cleaner app
records.text: Great to have a cleaner app . Some cleaners are brilliant others not so good. Always hoping to find a good regular cleaner. App works well tho!

records.title: Complete ease of use and excellent cleaning service!
records.text: The booking process was very easy, communication was clear, and the app was easy to navigate. Our cleaning was done brilliantly, and we would definitely recommend this service to others.

records.title: Andrea is a great cleaner
records.text: Andrea is a great cleaner very thoughtful and kind and nice to talk to and is a good cleaner she has also helped with tidying and housework too which I appreciate

records.title: Great reliable cleaners
records.text: Great reliable cleaners . We have irregular cleans and even if it’s a different person they always do a great job!

records.title: Pleased so far!
records.text: Pleased so far. The app is simple to use, and everything can be done over the platform keeping things easy. Our cleaner was friendly and efficient- we will keep using them.

records.title: First time use and very impressed!
records.text: Helpling have been excellent in being efficient and providing good cleaners. They also provide VFM!

records.title: Recent cleaning 2 sessions so far
records.text: The cleaner is very thorough.  She does not speak very good english but we both try.  The cleaning is of a high standard.

records.title: All worked well
records.text: All worked well. Just the menu and usability could be a bit better in my opinion

records.title: Very useful app
records.text: Very simple and easy to use app. Needs to improve functionality for 5 stars

records.title: Useful app for finding quick and cost…
records.text: Useful app for finding quick and cost effective cleaners

records.title: It was easy to book and reasonably…
records.text: It was easy to book and reasonably oriced

records.title: Helping website works well and it’s…
records.text: Helping website works well and it’s easy to reschedule etc- much improved from a few years ago! It is quite expensive. The cleaners are generally good but seem to prefer doing a light wipe rather than a deep clean. For example I’ve had about 6/7 different people who even if you give them 3 hours just to do 2 bathrooms, will just say it’s done after 1 hour and leave. But it’s not really really clean- if you see what I mean.

records.title: Tried a few cleaners with Helping
records.text: Tried a few cleaners with Helping. There are a range of cleaners in my area, varying in price. The first cleaner I had wasn’t reliable and always complained about the work. The second was ok but she decided she didn’t want to clean houses anymore. I’m on my third one and he did a good job during his first clean with us, I hope he will be our new cleaner. Helping’s customer service got in touch with me and I’d say they were friendly enough.

records.title: Helpling is the one to go to for ideal cleaning needs.
records.text: I tried Helpling for the first time last month and found them incredibly helpful to accommodate what I needed. Masha, Helpling’s Customer Services in particular was really good and efficient. Nothing was too much trouble. She worked out a plan for me which was ideal. Their team of cleaners are vetted and have proved to be both wonderful and reliable. I would highly recommend Helpling for anyones domestic needs. Thank you. GDW

records.title: I find the Helpling website very user…
records.text: I find the Helpling website very user friendly and their cleaners have been reliable and of a good standard.Also they have always responded quickly to any problems or technical issues which have then got resolved quickly.They seem to care and look after both their cleaners and their customers.Definitely better than the last online company I used before!

records.title: We had a few bumps at the beginning…
records.text: We had a few bumps at the beginning with a couple of cleaners, but Hassle were very quick to react - the customer service is good.

records.title: Expensive
records.text: My cleaner this time was great. I find Helpling to be very expensive but worthwhile if I’m desperate   Better to get someone through a local advert or recommendation so that you are paying direct. Helpling works for me if my regular help is away.

records.title: It's a bit confusing
records.text: It's a bit confusing, really. I didn't get the level of cleaning I expected and I'm not sure I want to give it another go since there are so few rangers available with many reviews and I wasn't placed with one that had many reviews. I'd like to cancel future cleanings

records.title: Hit and miss
records.text: I rarely get the cleaner I select, and have had experiences where cleaners just didn't show up. Helplings has been responsive and has provided discounts after these experiences, however it has felt a been hit and miss with getting cleaners to come. When they do come, the experience has been good.

records.title: It's OK
records.text: It's OK, but would appreciate to have more flexibility for how often I want my clean g to be. Currently it's just weekly or bi-weekly. Monthly would be nice too.

records.title: The first time I tried to set up a…
records.text: The first time I tried to set up a clean I got no responses, however doing it through the app was much better than the website and I now have a wonderful cleaner!

records.title: Vast range of average cleaners
records.text: Lots of cleaners available with lots of different prices, but I've tried a few and none of them have been great at cleaning.

records.title: The result was alright
records.text: The result was alright. But unfortunately I rarely get the cleaner I request..

records.title: It's ok
records.text: It's easy to book a cleaner but then things change. I didn't confirm a cleaner they offered because I didn’t want, and the website confirmed it for me :SI cancelled and confirm the next cleaner they suggested and that was fine, but later on I realized they charged me the full rate although I supposedly had a first time offer. So, you know, not bad because eventually you'll have your cleaning service but nothing else, not easy to contact them neither.

records.title: Cleaners have changed constantly and…
records.text: Cleaners have changed constantly and the quality of cleaners really vary.Once we found a good one she left the platform and it took us three further attempts to find a new ones. One a cleaner even brought her kidIt would be more useful to pick the cleaner ourselves as this feature has changed on the platform. Sometimes the prices for cleaning seems to be too expensive for the quality of cleaning

records.title: Good company with some flaws.
records.text: This time around when I booked a cleaner she was very reliable and so far things have gone smoothly. Previously when I tried to book a cleaner they cancelled within 24 hours, I was not informed I had to get a one off cleaner which cost me more money. Helping did not seem bothered considering if it was the other way around and I had cancelled within 24hours I would have to still pay.

records.title: Not straightforward, but good in the end.
records.text: It wasn’t as straightforward as I’d hoped to book a cleaner - the cleaner I selected cancelled, and then a replacement was selected for me at the wrong time. It took several phone calls to get my booking changed back to the original time I had requested. However, the cleaner that was finally sourced was great - she was on time, super friendly and did a really good job.

records.title: Great idea and some good cleaners…
records.text: Great idea and some good cleaners there. Unfortunately cleaners come and go too often. I have to find a replacement at least twice a year. Because of that I have to have 2 cleaners alternating their visits so that I can have more reliable schedule.They also send SMS notifications at 1am and refuse to switch them off. Waking me up at 1am is not very helpling.

records.title: Helping is good but if the cleaner that…
records.text: Helping is good but if the cleaner that you send a request to can't accept, the website will automatically allocate a new cleaner to you. For example, they randomly allocated me a cleaner who had 1 star reviews. It's also not easy to cancel the service if you no longer require it. All in all, I think 3 stars and there could be some improvements

records.title: The application is not very helpful.
records.text: The application is not very helpful.We can't cancel on the app, I need to go to the website to do it. After the cleaner is assigned I can't see the rate and the price per hour. When I write a message to the cleaner the cleaner doesn't received our when she text me I don't see in the app but I have a notification that I have one.The address in the app is correct but both cleaners said that the address are wrong so they arrived very late.

records.title: 3 cleaners I found on Helpling were new…
records.text: 3 cleaners I found on Helpling were new to UK and not speaking English at all. I believe Helpling should advertise explicitly the fluency in English or any other language of cleaners as this is a key factor in helping with communication of what needs to be done in cleaning. Especially now that an additional 1.5£ charge per even has been added

records.title: Cleaners can be good but you are stuck with this website
records.text: Cleaners can be good but you are stuck! I've found 3 or 4 bad cleaners and with terrible no-show experiences as well as lazy who wanted to leave before the time is up, though now we've found someone really good. So it's a bit of luck. Problem with this website is, that once you sign up you have to do at least 9 cleans with them and you might not want to because you don't like the service! So it's a bit difficult in that sense.

records.title: A very easy to use service, but beware the insurance policy!
records.text: A very easy to use service, but beware the insurance policy! You are liable for any damage up to £350, unless you can get the money from the cleaner who damaged the property (practically impossible given they're not Helpling employees). We had a bad experience with a cleaner who caused a lot of damage and Helpling didn't even reply to us regarding the incident.

records.title: Great cleaner and service but appalling…
records.text: Great cleaner and service but appalling the amount Helpling get and what the cleaner gets. Paid £70 for 4 hours. Cleaner got £40, Helpling got £30. Misleading as the booking shows £1.50 booking fee so you'd assume the rest goes to the cleaner. Surprised they're getting away with this. Shame on you Helpling

records.title: Great, easy concept, but unevenly cleanings
records.text: Smart system, very user friendly and easy to book cleanings which I’m a big fan off. Would love to give Helpling a higher rating but due to the different quality between each cleaner (often low standard unfortunately) I cannot. Will still use for last minute cleaning needs/one offs and really like their whole concept!

records.title: Ridiculous booking service
records.text: Ridiculous booking service - all there is a name and absolutely nothing about the person!

records.title: Won't use Helpling Again
records.text: Used on two separate occasions and had the same outcome. Generally poor and over priced cleans. Both cleaners have been slow and required extra time, and both have not been able to communicate in English even thought their prior messages were in English (likely Google translate).Helpling didn't want to support and as soon as the money was transferred for the clean there was silence.Will go direct next time.

records.title: Don’t pay the cleaners enough
records.text: Whilst this is a good service in principle, they cannot wait to find ways to take extra money from you. The platform is designed to get you to accidentally book multiple sessions (but not cancel them) or not easily cancel or amend your slots. The reminders come after the cancellation window has closed so you’ll find you’re suddenly expecting a cleaner you hadn’t booked. I got fined 2/2 times. The cleaners also complain about not getting enough of the cash you pay. You’re genuinely better going direct. I’d never use again.

records.title: Not Great When You Have a Problem
records.text: My partner and I have been using this service for a few months now, and up until Friday it has been good.Friday the cleaner we had booked for missed her recurring appointment, without giving any justification or notice. I immediately contacted Helpling half an hour into the appointment, explaining the situation and asking if it was possible not to charge for the booking since it didn't take place.I tried contact them via WhatsApp, no reply. Calling? Lines are closed? Email? I am now on my third and I still didn't get a reply, not even an automated one.Meanwhile, the money was taken from my account, and I'm out of pocket for a 3h booking that didn't take place.While I'm sure that Customer Service is busy, I would appreciate AT LEAST a message acknowledging the query and when I can expect a reply. And given that they've taken my money for a service that was not provided, I'm expecting not only a swifter way of dealing with complaints but also a full refund.Summing up: great company and service if you have everything running smoothly, not so great when you have a problem and need to contact customer service.

records.title: Useful, but app needs work!
records.text: The concept is good and useful, however the app has so much going wrong with it that needs immediate improvement. Not being able to delete booking requests yourself is the main issue. To have anything deleted, even pending requests, you need to message customer service which is a huge pain and is not always very responsive and quick. The search results for cleaners is also lacking, most of the time I can't find any cleaners, even though if I wait a few days someone within my requirements will assign themselves to my booking, so where were they when I was searching to request to start with?In addition, having a look at invoices - the company takes quite a lot from the total payment. For example, from a £29 payment, the cleaner only gets £20; £8 goes to a service fee, and a platform/support fee... and considering the platform is not very technical and you are unable to make any changes through the app, I'm not sure what this fee is going to.

records.title: Cleaner stopped turning up
records.text: Cleaner stopped turning up, and then the app didn’t allow us to cancel the booking in progress, didn’t allow us to change the date of the next booking forward a week, didn’t allow flexibility to add extra time on next appointment and didn’t allow allow us to choose from more than 6/7 alternative replacement cleaners. Incredibly frustrating system to use.

records.title: No insurance from helpling on small items damages
records.text: Cleaner broke a couple of low value items (round 20-30 each) but helpling only covers damages over £310, lower valued items insurance is covered by the cleaners own. These items are not expensive for us but might be for the cleaner and the cleaner denied wrong doing and she did a good job on the clean other wise so we don’t want her to pay for them. So we lose out eventually. Other website covers insurance which is better.

records.title: They have provided no advice
