records.text: They have provided no advice, guidance, or communication around the current Covid-19 pandemic. No information on their website, no emails sent, nothing. It’s not clear how customers should be making sure cleaners don’t suffer financially whilst also limiting movement and risks. Suggest they stop taking their percentage cut and offer us a way to financially support our regular cleaner.

records.title: Reliability and continuity issues with little to no notice
records.text: I’ve tried to like this company, I really have but the service continues to have one huge flaw which is reliability and continuity of cleaners - over the last 3 months in particular, I have had several last minute cancellations (usually on the day of cleaning) culminating in the cleaner informing me on the day of cleaning that she couldn’t come and that she could no longer clean because of private client work.

records.title: Customer service team very poor and the…
records.text: Customer service team very poor and the staff quality can be underwhelming. I've had damage to my property through poor cleaners who have never admitted fault, therefore I have had to pay to fix it myself. Helpling should be more proactive - for example, if my cleaner cannot come for the clean, they should call me to ask if I would like a replacement cleaner and find me one at a similar price.

description:
Professional Property Preservation Services
Kingston Preservation provide damp proofing and timber treatments for dry & wet rot eradication to residential & commercial customers throughout Edinburgh, East Lothian, West Lothian, Midlothian, Fife and the Scottish Borders. In addition, we are specialists in the conversion of damp under-pavement cellars in Edinburgh’s New Town into dry usable spaces.

Damp Proofing & Timber Treatment in Edinburgh
For over 25 years, we have been undertaking all aspects of damp and timber treatments, for a wide range of clients in the Edinburgh region. Our damp proofing, dry & wet rot timber treatments and mould removal are all guaranteed for 30 years. Free surveys of property requiring treatment.

Cellar Conversions in Edinburgh’s New Town
We have developed our own processes for converting damp under-pavement vaulted cellars in Edinburgh’s New Town into dry and useful spaces that can be used for a variety of purposes, such as storage, utility rooms and offices. Perfect if you are looking to increase space in your property.

records.title: We are really happy with the job
records.text: We are really happy with the job done by Kingston Preservation they converted our 2 under street cellars into fantastic dry space the job was done quickly and to a high standard of workmanship and at a fair price we have no hesitation in giving the company a 5 star review.

records.title: Kingston was sourced by our neighbors…
records.text: Kingston was sourced by our neighbors to deal with a water damage issue in our common stair area, affecting 3 floors- not an easy job. Their report was clear and understandable, and since we were claiming insurance, they dealt with insurance company on our behalf. Not only did they sort the water damage, but they also handled all the admin directly with our insurers. A great job done, made to look easy. Everyone is delighted with the quality of the finished job how the admin was processed. Highly recommend this company.

records.title: We were struggling to sell our flat as…
records.text: We were struggling to sell our flat as the Home Report had a "3" marked for dampness. We contacted Kingston; they surveyed our flat the next day at no charge. They sent the report the following day, our solicitor got their report attached to the Home Report, and we got an offer a week later, which we accepted. An amazing service! We had tried 5 other companies before stumbling upon Kingston Preservation.

records.title: We are pleased with the service…
records.text: We are pleased with the service provided by Kingston Property Preservation to repair the rotten and deal with the woodworm in our property. They were easy to contact, explained everything clearly, and answered all our questions. The job was done at a good price and with a high standard of workmanship. We have been very impressed and will be recommending the company to friends and family.

records.title: We are very happy we chose Kingston to…
records.text: We are very happy we chose Kingston to undertake the job to sort the rising damp in 3 rooms in my mother's house. We were initially advised by our solicitor to use the company, and we are pleased we did. All stages of the job were excellently managed, and it went exactly to plan throughout the 5 days of treatment. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the Kingston team to sort your dampness issues.

records.title: A 5-star job done by Kingston…
records.text: A 5-star job done by Kingston Preservation in sorting the dry rot issue we found in our house in Dalkeith. We had no idea how to deal with this, and we consulted 5 companies. Kingston was by far the best in terms of price, knowledge, and understanding of our issues. The job was done to perfection—big thanks.

records.title: Thank you to the Kingston Team for…
records.text: Thank you to the Kingston Team for sorting the Dry Rot in our house. We had issues selling the property, and Kingston sorted the rot, allowing us to sell within a week. An amazing service! We recommend and endorse Kingston Preservation.

records.title: I would like to thank all the workmen…
records.text: I would like to thank all the workmen and admin team at Kingston Preservation for the quality job in turning our 5 under-street pavement cellars into fantastic usable space. The job was done quickly, at a good price, and to a high standard of finish. Great job! We needed to utilize this space to clear stored items in our basement flat, which is not the biggest. Thanks again, guys, and a 5-star rating from us.

records.title: A great job was done by Kingston…
records.text: A great job was done by Kingston Preservation in waterproofing and renovating our under-street vaults--6 of them. We were very happy with the initial price compared to other quotes, and they did not disappoint us. It was a pleasure dealing with the company, and the quality of the finished job was amazing. Thank you all at Kingston Preservation for doing an amazing job.

records.title: Go to compliment the team at Kingston…
records.text: Go to compliment the team at Kingston property Preservation for a fantastic job in transforming our damp under-street cellar into a games room for our children. A faultless job done to an amazingly high standard and at a really good price.

records.title: This is all are Fake Reviews!! This is SCAMMER!!
records.text: I had a very disappointing experience with Kingston Preservation & Alpha Omega Invest. I lost $300, and it's clear now that this is a scam. Their website looks professional, but it's all a front. Be careful—don't fall for the fake promises or the fake reviews they post to seem credible. I trusted them, and they took advantage of that trust. Avoid at all costs!

records.title: Useless and frustrating…
records.text: We had a guarantee with Kingston Preservation to fix the mould in our outbuildings. They came a few times, never stayed more than a few hours and failed to fix the problem. On both occasions they left a mess, lost our house keys and refused to answer our calls. We tried to call them about the guarantee but they blocked my number and ignored messages. Seriously disappointing - avoid at all costs. In process of sorting legally.

records.title: Stuart owes me thousands
records.text: It’s so interesting to see all these recent positive reviews. This isn’t representative of Stuart and the experience I’ve had of Kingston Property.Stuart owes me thousands of pounds because both cellars he converted for me are damp and unusable and for the past 3 yrs he’s ignored requests to repair them He took my money and didn’t deliver on his contract and couldn’t care less. He’s unreliable and untrustworthy if things go wrong. Avoid!

records.title: Phoned them several times to arrange…
records.text: Phoned them several times to arrange for them to look at my tanked cellar which has damp areas . Even though we have a 20 year guarantee they never turned when they said they would. Very disappointing- wouldn’t recommend.

records.title: Terrible - unusable cellars
records.text: I had 2 cellars converted by Stuart in 2021, one into a gym and one into an office. In under a year there was green and black mould growing in both. Stuart returned and added some vents which made no difference. They are now overgrown with mould, the electrics have blown as a result, the spaces are unusable with the roofs ready to collapse and the furniture in there ruined. I’ve made numerous attempts to contact Stuart to either have them re done or receive a refund under the 10yr “guarantee”. He usually turns up and tells me they’ll sort it but this has now been going on for over a year. Please don’t use this company.

records.title: Update to Aug Review
records.text: This is an update to my review back in August. Stuart responded to this in Oct to say he was rectifying both cellars. He has rectified one of them, although the process was painful with him having a lack of control over electricians, painters etc. The 2nd cellar is yet to be done. We’ve had a text exchange today and Stuart has told me he’ll try to fit me in  but he’s booked up with new work till the middle of March. I find this disgusting - happy to rave about his new business pipeline but not willing to put right issues of his making.  So just be aware of what you’re dealing with here. I suspect this is all poor management and someone who is very badly organised but it does come over as a distinct lack of care and consideration once he’s got your money in his pocket.

records.title: TERRIBLE!
records.text: My experience is the same as others I have read here and on Facebook. 15 year guaranty/warranty isn't worth paper it's written on. I've lost track of the number of times they have returned to rectify one cellar (the other is fine) and it's still damp. Stuart McAlpine does not return calls. He responded to one text message on 1/9 to say they were all on furlough, which couldn't be true because one of his workmen picked up keys from me in order to make good on the reappearing damp. He hasn't returned my keys or responded to my requests for them. Police and Trading Standards next.No photo description available.

records.title: I have now instigated bankruptcy…
records.text: I have now instigated bankruptcy proceedings against Stuart McAlpine trading as Kingston Property preservation for his failures to complete work under guarantee and to pay the subsequent court order granted against him.Update:  Are you denying you received court papers last week via your address in Dunbar?  I understand your ex-wife, of same address, was declared bankrupt earlier in the year.Further update:  Really...?  I will resend the recorded delivery proof.  The intimation has been served correctly to you as set out in Act of Sederunt (Sheriff Court Bankruptcy Rules) 2016 SSI 2016/ 5(4). I will also share details of the hearing so that others customers who have not had appropriate services delivered (some of whom appear on this review site and others) so they can join as creditors.

records.title: Poor quality work & worthless guarantee
records.text: Kingston Preservation “damp proofed” our cellar a few years ago. We now have so much mould on walls and stored items that we will have to stop using the space. Despite numerous phone calls, emails and messages, they have not replied. The guarantee is useless. Charlatans.UPDATE May 23 - No response to multiple messages but have spoken to Kingston staff working at other sites in the area and been promised that our work would be rectified but nothing has happened.

records.title: Avoid at all costs
records.text: Waterproofing of 4 basement cellars completed in late 2017. Leaks in 3/4 within a matter of weeks. Numerous workmen visited to fix the problem - only after repeated calls, however, and with each new worker blaming the previous one for the leaks not being fixed. Calls and letters were eventually ignored and we now have completely unusable cellars, the contents of which were ruined by mould.Our neighbour also used the company to work on their cellars, some of which have also leaked and calls to rectify ignored. Useless cellars, useless guarantee, useless company. Also interesting that similar negative reviews from pre-2020 seem to have disappeared…Edited for reply:I have not received an email. I submitted a phone number when contact details were requested. You can call me on that if you would like this to be resolved.

description:
TKStairs.com are a Hull based, stair manufacturer selling to the trade as well as to the public across the UK.
Trading since 2003, Tkstairs works on a fast turnaround CNC machined staircases.
Tkstairs manufactures stairs from a wide variety of timbers and delivery throughout the UK.

records.title: Apart from the helpful person when we…
records.text: Apart from the helpful person when we called to talk about what we needed, the product arrived promptly, was packaged securely and was easy to fit.  It looked beautiful without the danish oil but looks even better with it.  Love my new staircase.

records.title: Everything  from order to receiving…
records.text: Everything  from order to receiving goods was spot on, thank you so much

records.title: An awesome product easy to install and…
records.text: An awesome product easy to install and fits together better than other products on the market

records.title: Stairs was perfect well made and good…
records.text: Stairs was perfect well made and good quality . Informed of progress any questions answered proffecianly and delivered on time thanks will definitely use in the future

records.title: An easy and enjoyable experience
records.text: An easy and enjoyable experience, delivery on also. Great product.

records.title: I have never fitted stairs before and…
records.text: I have never fitted stairs before and needed a set for a renovation we are doing so being unsure I rang TK Stairs, Paulina was super helpful ensuring I had covered everything needed. The stairs were delivered within a week and I fitted straight away and they look great in situ (Oak strings, hand rail and newel posts complete with inset glass balustrade)Would definitely use again.Mr & Mrs Seager

records.title: Definitely use your Company again
records.text: Definitely use your Company again. Good delivery as well very helpful. Thanks again. Peter.

records.title: Absolutely sterling service from start…
records.text: Absolutely sterling service from start to finish. Adapted the original plan with no trouble at all and new drawing sent very quickly. Needed some more newel posts to alter the design further once in place and they were delivered within a few days. Really cannot fault this company and will look forward to using them again for future developments. Wayne was particularly helpful throughout so kudos to him and a big thank you from me.

records.title: So helpful
records.text: So helpful, always ready to offer guidance and solutions.Great knowledge of their products.Special thanks to Wayne....

records.title: Good customer service and price for…
records.text: Good customer service and price for product

records.title: I ordered a set of ss that's what…
records.text: I ordered a set of stairs that's what was delivered exactly as I ordered Please excuse Mr being flippant but I am pissed of with all the emails looking for feedback After all if you go into a green grocery to buy carrots and buy carrots do you have to  fill out a form to say how orange the carrots was If the email or whatever I am posting on is actually being read by a human being please call me on 07960005172

records.title: Great Staircase, easy to use stair calculator
records.text: I ordered my staircase after using the calculator, the process was pretty straightforward. Delivery was as advised, we did have an issue with the supplied newel post, however once we contacted TK Stairs, they made and dispatched a replacement very quickly. Would definitely recommend using this company.

records.title: Lots of digs in woodworking but filler…
records.text: Lots of digs in woodworking but filler will get over it   But generally very well made

records.title: Great  service by design team and…
records.text: Great  service by design team and produced within given timeframe. Excellent product.  Only issue was delivery with only one person the driver  and so at very short notice had to get extra pairs of hands to help off load from road side to get inside property. Wasn’t informed of this until delivery email arrived. Lucky I had some good friends to call

records.title: Prompt and helpful delivery
records.text: Prompt and helpful delivery. We bought the redwood pine 3 turn staircase for a new build and it came as measured. Sturdy construction and excellent price. Note, if you are installing as a new build, it is worth priming the treads before installing as these quickly mark when bare wood.

records.title: Great custom 2 return staircase design
records.text: Great staircase design. Some of the timber is of suspect quality, but nothing that some gluing and sanding couldn't fix. When a glass pane shattered, they replaced it immediately - no quibbles. End staircase looks amazing. You do need more than a modicum of woodworking skills. I would use them again

records.title: Stair Kit
records.text: The stair kit arrived earlier than as promised and I was kept informed throughout the day by the delivery driver.Very easy to assemble by myself. My only quibble - and why it didn't rate 5 stars - is the use of parcel tape on the protective wrappings. Unfortunately, this was used on the strings and a couple of treads and risers as well. I had great trouble getting this very sticky mess off - took about an hour. I recommend you don't use this in future.

records.title: Well made quality stairs
records.text: Well made, great quality stairs. Delighted with the product. Lovely staff and good comms. Only gave four stars because delivery was a bit of a shambles. Called to make payment and arrange delivery to find it was already booked for a day we weren’t going to be there. Rearranged to a different date but later found they couldn’t deliver then either. Brilliant when they arrived in pristine condition. Thank you.

records.title: Ordering easy
records.text: Ordering easySpeedy serviceExcellent dimensional accuracyDelivery Driver very helpfulGood Price for Budget Stair - a little more glue would have been good on some joints

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, good communication. Stairs were well made to exact measurements. Could of done with some instructions on how to assemble the parts of the stairs that were in pieces hence loosing one star.

records.title: Great to deal with
records.text: Fast service. A couple of minor details, which I put down to a miscommunication, but was easily fixed. Made a small recommendation about packing, and was surprised to receive a thankyou for my input. 10/10 will do business again.

records.title: Very helpful company
records.text: Very helpful company, great crm process linked to quoting, fast response and fast and efficient delivery. Everything you want in the company apart from their attempt to change the spec to a lower and cheaper spec post order and deposit which left me questioning business ethics unfortunately. otherwise it wold have been 5 stars.

records.title: Quick service
records.text: Quick service, 7 days from ordering to delivery. Some of the engineering a little off resulting in a couple of the risers having a 3/4 mm gap to one side . But overall happy with price and sirvice.

records.title: B.Thompson Joinery Ltd.
records.text: With placing order on line I was a bit worried as only seeing pictures etc but when the stair arrived on site I was very pleased with the product and the finish on the stair risers etc and the over all finish of the stair case. I have been quote for another project and hopefully the workmanship will be up to the same standard.

records.title: Great comms and help
records.text: Great comms and brilliant assistance with tech issues. But sent wrong panel pegs and parts of someone else's order. Other than that, would reccomend.

records.title: Delivered stair on time
records.text: Delivered stair on time. 1 piece of glass replaced quickly due to being wrong size. Stair parts look good although not fitted yet.

records.title: Very easy to configure your stairs…
records.text: Very easy to configure your stairs using their software. Stairs arrived on time and undamaged. Happy with end results.

records.title: Third time I've used TK and as always
records.text: Third time I've used TK and as always, brilliant quality and value I knocked 1 star off because I waited until 7.30pm for a delivery in a shop renovation.

records.title: Tk stairs was great to deal with
records.text: Tk stairs was great to deal with. Good product too- just let down by the delivery company they use - surly and not helpful in unloading to the ground

records.title: Very happy with the service and the…
records.text: Very happy with the service and the product. Only thing that was a little inconvenient was the rout out for the tread nosings were a couple mm too tight and had to let each one in. Apart from that very happy.

records.title: Customer Service and initial design was…
records.text: Customer Service and initial design was friendly and helpful. Communication and delivery was great. However main newel post had all sorts of rebate cutting errors which required connecting along with one in the string. You can obviously inspect the quality of the product on delivery but don’t come across these issues until well into installation. Didn’t expect to get a router out for a machine cut product. Also adding costs to time joiner was on site.

records.title: Delivery was on time with helpful driver.
records.text: I don't have much of an issue, only complaint would be maybe you should dry fit joints as a few of the routered bits were far to tight and really struggled to fit together without being trimmed . Overall though the stairs were of a reasonable quality for price paid.

records.title: Certain routed trenches where not deep…
records.text: Certain routed trenches where not deep enough to accommodate mating part. Otherwise a good tidy job.J. Kool Engineers

records.title: All was fine but handrail was full of…
records.text: All was fine but handrail was full of shakes which had been filled badly. Had to cut them out then spend extra time making them passable for painting.

records.title: Consumer's view of product
records.text: Price, programme and delivery good.Communication/confirmation of details sketchy.Product was structurally satisfactory but cosmetically unacceptable - Monetary settlement not wholesome.

records.title: I ordered some spindles and a 4 metre…
records.text: I ordered some spindles and a 4 metre hand rail. Delivery was fine but 2 spindles were warped and unusable. The handrail was also warped and had a split at one end. Luckily I ordered 3 more spindles than needed and I could use the non split end of the handrail.

records.title: The stair was fine but only sending 10…
records.text: The stair was fine but only sending 10 wedges and glue blocks with a flat pack stair was an own goal

records.title: No good; we can not use it take to skip.
records.text: We don’t know what thin wrong. cannot use it

records.title: Terrible communication
records.text: Terrible communication. Too many different staff members trying to deal with one order which caused confusion. Again, poor communication regarding delivery which meant that my staircase was left outside my uninhabited house (which you new about) in the rain. Not happy with my experience at all.

records.title: The hand rail hole was drilled in the…
records.text: The hand rail hole was drilled in the wrong place meaning we had to fill and leave it on show, the winders were only routed on the newell posts for 20mm thick and then hacked about with a belt sander so they would fit in to there. some splits in newell posts .The quality wasnt as good as the last one i had off of you

records.title: dont buy on line if you want a bespoke product
records.text: bottom stair did not have a base to screw to the wall it will sit on..both sales people were told this ..as all companies..quick to take the money..said they made bespoke staircases but i had to buy straight treads ..said they didnt make winders to sizes given...not a good purchase..should have gone to a bespoke staircase maker

records.title: I feel that I was charged too much for…
records.text: I feel that I was charged too much for 4 stairs to be put together. Think there is a flaw in the way the online system charges you for pre made. Instead of one flat rate it should be done by how much can be done. I was expecting more to be together than what arrived. Not put together yet but looks good quality so far.

records.title: Let down by bad delivery
records.text: Although your staircase was of the usual Good quality and exactly as required, your delivery driver let your company down badly, having gone to the wrong address, when he arrived at the correct address as given was extremely rude and used bad language totally unacceptable.

records.title: Ordered plenty of stairs from them…
records.text: Ordered plenty of stairs from them however standards have been seeing to drop. My last order they got wrong 2 times. This order I delayed my delivery date to guarantee an early morning delivery which they agreed to and then let me down. Products are good but standards are slipping in the way it is run

records.title: Having spoken to their designer on…
records.text: Having spoken to their designer on several occasions and sent an updated drawing re the stairs they were manufactured to my initial enquiry which was incorrect to the final design. Having been delivered the only solution was to re buy at a discount of 5% Not a happy customer

records.title: Very poor design
records.text: Very poor design advice the product is made with details that are not included in the design. Ultimately, the company informs that this is their standard and there is nothing they can do. There are more companies on the market that provide similar services to a much higher standard.

records.title: None compliant staircase
records.text: None compliant staircase. Not calculated structurally. Drawing revisions needed doing repeatedly despite detailed design feedback. The routered grooves in the stringers where narrower than the treads, so all had to be re-done & there was no supports under staircase. Quotes for extras took weeks to price & wall mounted handrail option was refused to price.

records.title: Avoid this company who will deliver…
records.text: Avoid this company who will deliver faulty goods which you then have to get resolved by yourself and pay for yourself. Never in my life did I ever sign any terms and conditions agreeing to buying something that wasn't as per the design. But seems you sign up for whatever terms and conditions they want. Recommend DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY

description: At CMH Cleaning Service Ltd, we are proud to provide high-quality cleaning services across the UK. Our team of professional cleaners is fully trained, insured, and dedicated to upholding the highest standards of cleanliness, wherever you need us. Whether it’s your home, office, or another space, we guarantee spotless results alongside excellent customer service. Best of all, we believe top-notch cleaning shouldn’t come with a hefty price tag – that’s why we offer quality services at competitive rates nationwide.

records.title: Excellent Job Done
records.text: Very happy with the quality of cleaning done. Cleaners arrived on time and were thorough with their cleaning work.

records.title: Amazing 5* service & experience!
records.text: I had the most amazing experience with CMH Cleaning. Booked them online on Friday, they came the following Wednesday (today) and cleaned my house so thoroughly. They spent hours going over everything, were kind, efficient, took their time and didn't cut any corners. I could not be happier and will 100% use CMH again without any hesitation & recommend to all my friends. You cannot beat this level of service and cost. Thank you for making my house feel livable after moving in!

records.title: Excellent cleaning service
records.text: Excellent cleaning service, friendly and very helpful. Cleaned my floor really well.

records.title: Lovely cleaner and impressed with results!
records.text: We were really impressed with our cleaner's work for our end of tenancy clean! He was lovely, turned up on time and worked hard - tackling the areas we shared needed some extra attention. You can pay by bank transfer, although not by card payment. Whislt his English was very limited, he had an excellent translator app to overcome the language barrier. I would recommend CMH and would use again.

records.title: Used for one-off deep cleaning and cannot be happier
records.text: It was my first time using cleaning service and I've hired CMH Cleaning for one-off deep clean after we've completed renovation (but there was no building rubbish). Had a great experience from booking to cleaning and apart from 2-3 very minor remarks everything is perfect. In comparison to other companies here I managed to get exact quote which didn't change. Also it was important for me that cleaners cleaned the cupboards and fridge that were not empty as some other companies refused to do it. Thed price was also lower comparing to compatitors. Cleaners were really considerate and polite and arrived on time. Would be happy to recommend the service to anyone hence came here to share feedback. They definitely deserve their rating!

records.title: Fantastic experience and very reliable…
records.text: Fantastic experience and very reliable provider. Due to our estate agents being difficult and pointing out small specs of dust a few days after we moved out, CMH very kindly agreed to come back and address the highlighted areas at no further cost. Highly recommend and great price

records.title: Do not hesitate to book this team…excellent clean!
records.text: Great communication from start to finish. Price reflects the quality of work done, which was to a fantastic standard for an end of tenancy clean. Really lovely cleaning team of two worked their magic on the house and left it sparkling and smelling lovely. Highly recommend!

records.title: Amazing staff and service! Thanks
records.text: I recently hired CMH cleaning for an end of tenancy cleaning, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the service was professional, efficient, and thorough. The team were friendly, and paid attention to every detail. They cleaned every corner of the property, leaving it spotless and ready for the final inspection. The kitchen appliances, carpets, and even hard-to-reach areas were all cleaned to a high standard.The pricing was transparent and very cheap relative to other quotes I got - with no hidden costs, and they were flexible in accommodating my schedule. I highly recommend for anyone in need of a reliable and top-quality end of tenancy clean!

records.title: Excellent cleaning
records.text: Excellent cleaning, very impressed with the quality of the work for an end of tenancy clean . Would recommend this service to friends and family Very happy and thank you!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. Booked at short notice and the team arrived on time and were super friendly and helpful. Nothing was too much trouble and they got straight to work and came with all their own supplies and equipment. Communication was excellent and the whole service was really efficient and well organised. Thanks again to CMH Cleaning Services. I definitely recommend and will use again in future.

records.title: Cleaning of oven was quite…
records.text: Cleaning of oven was quite satisfactory. Unfortunately your cleaner didn’t clean the cooker hubs

records.title: Great for the office
records.text: The communication with the company was ok, everything online. Very nice crew. But when the landlord inspected the property after the cleaning found a few things that were not clean up to the standard.

records.title: Not worth paying £170 for a move in…
records.text: Not worth paying £170 for a move in clean. We’re so disappointed as we have to redo most of it. At first glance, it looks like it was cleaned, but when we checked everything for example fridge’s drawers and corners were still filthy, bathroom’s corner not cleaned, oven remains to have marks and oily. Update: CMH reached out immediately after I have posted this review and offer to resolve issue by sending a cleaner back or provide a partial refund of £40 as a gesture of goodwill.

records.title: Very expensive for average service
records.text: Very expensive for average service. They seemed more interested in taking my money than ensuring I was satisfied with their service. They charged me £25ph yet the cleaner didn’t clean thoroughly. My usual cleaner charges £16ph, but she wasn’t available and since I had family coming over for the weekend I needed to find some cleaners quickly. That’s why I used CMH Services but I will never use them again. Even if my regular cleaner is unavailable I would rather keep looking for someone else. I cannot believe you can charge £25ph and do such a shoddy job. I ended up having to clean after the cleaner left.Also communication was very difficult because they sent a cleaner who didn’t speak English. She was a nice person but what’s the point of sending someone I can’t communicate with?

records.title: Not up to standard
records.text: I liked the cleaner, but the standard of cleaning was not good enough. I paid a lot of money for a deep clean and could still see visible dust and dirt on surfaces. Spent hours the next day cleaning over it all again. I would not recommend this company at all. Poor service.

description: Supply of bamboo flooring and accessories.

records.title: Good product well presented
records.text: We delighted to receive your brochure and the box of samples . So much so that we are most likely going to change our flooring plans to a Bamboo product . We will be getting a floorer to measure the floors in our house so that we can proceed to buy Bamboo flooring from you.

records.title: These guys are excellent
records.text: These guys are excellent in every regard. From samples to advice, awesome delivery times and follow ups, I'd find it hard to believe there's a better flooring company out there anywhere.And the product is fantastic. Bought about 75sq metres two years ago for the upper floor and and no hesitation in returning for more when the new project started.Would never use anyone else for flooring.

records.title: very useful samples
records.text: very useful samples, even thought to include a sample of suitable underlay.  thanks.

records.title: Bamboo flooring company.
records.text: Put Bamboo flooring throughout the house, it looks great together with the skirting. There was never any problems with delivery and any items on back order were delivered promptly when they came in stock.Would recommend them.

records.title: Quick with a sample
records.text: Quick with a sample, efficient delivery, good product. My only problem was the tongue and groove on the narrow width was 180° opposite to my original Westco flooring

records.title: Super fast delivery
records.text: Super fast delivery, great prices, and can 100% recommend bamboo flooring - it;s withstood a month (so far) of two dogs hurtling about on it, without a scratch in sight!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, had all the parts in stock, well packed and delivered on time. This is the second home I have used the Bamboo Flooring Co for, they are always helpful.

records.title: A repeat customer
records.text: This is the 2nd floor I've done with your product as I've been so pleased with the first. On this occasion we had a problem with the delivery (Palletline) with 2 boxes getting damaged. However, it was all dealt with very pleasantly and professionally by Neil in Customer Services, so when I've recovered sufficiently from the hard labour I'll definitely be doing my 3rd floor in the hall.

records.title: The Flooring is excellent and customer…
records.text: The Flooring is excellent and customer service was exceptional too.After a problem with the first delivery which was down to the courier a new delivery was dispatched immediately and everything was fine.The Flooring itself looks amazing and has finished off our renovation perfectly.Highly recommended!

records.title: Excellent delivery options
records.text: The flooring is great quality and really easy to lay. I phoned a couple of time for advice and there were always knowledgable people ready to help. I really appreciated being able to select the delivery day and that it arrived within a two hour time slot.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, even over Christmas period. Fast feedback on order enquiry. Products as advertised and worked well.

records.title: Excellent competent advice and service
records.text: Neil and team are very knowledgeable and experienced in their trade and this came through when they were advising us about the bamboo flooring product and accessories that we purchased.

records.title: Lovely product
records.text: Lovely product, I have recommended it to several people in the year since it was laid.  It would have been useful to have known when the flooring was bought that bamboo stair nosing was also possible, it looks so much nicer but I ended up with metal trim on the two stairs which broke some toes!  Now replaced from yourselves but expensive to acquire this tiny addition with delivery and someone to change it over.

records.title: Friendly and helpful points of contact
records.text: Good communication and helpful advice from Chris and Neil. Would have had a 5* but for an admin error that meant my order wasn't shipped on the arranged day. Delivery was arranged for early the following morning and 2 items, which I'd forgotten to add to the order, were included foc. Everything in the order was present and correct. And the courier was helpful (access was difficult for delivery).An easy company to deal with. Will happily use them again.

records.title: Very good but not perfect.
records.text: The bamboo flooring product is great and this was a repeat order.  However, although the company give sclear instructions on how to store the flooring (flat in a warm dry environment) two individual packs (delivered via DHL) arrived with a slight bow in the timber, at the time of delivery.Previous orders were fine in this respect so I don't know what went wrong..

records.title: Smooth ordering and delivery
records.text: The floor is still in its boxes, but the delivery was smooth and delivered on the agreed date. One box was a bit open, yet it was terrible snowy weather, and the deliverer had difficulty keeping his deliveries dry and safe, so we don't consider it a fault in packing. We received two phone calls related to the order and were able to clarify any questions with the company.We felt stressed and had the floor delivered before we needed it, as we had seen prices go up several times since we decided we wanted the bamboo floor from Bamboo flooring company. So it would be amazing if you could buy the floor and have it delivered some weeks later.

records.title: So pleased with my bamboo flooring
records.text: So pleased with my bamboo flooring, great value, sets my bathroom finish of just great, quality product, big shout out to the staff for there help.

records.title: Nice product. Shame about delivery issues.
records.text: Easy to order. Easy to correct an error. Good choice of items. Good customer service.However, delivery was a disaster. The flooring did not arrive on the day it was supposed to. The tracking system did not work. When I phoned up I was told it would be delivered the next day. Thankfully that driver that came with thr eventual delivery was helpful. But the delivery had got wet either overnight or the day before. I hope that any problems with damages will be rectified promptly.

records.title: From hero to ZERO thanks to a bad courier
records.text: Read the delivery instructions and know that the delivery dis-service will drop the pallet at the curb, even to a residential address.  Any curb that's convenient for the delivery driver.  If you have a favourite or alternate curb, be sure to sing loud.We were NOT advised of the time of delivery as promised.  We were therefore not afforded the opportunity to get help shifting the packs.The driver didn't want to know.  He dropped the pallet "Ding dong- There's a pallet down there for you" and fled leaving my wife at the door, open mouthed. We've had a bamboo floor from Bamboo Flooring Co. in our bathroom for 10 years (shock horror - not supposed to do that) and have been delighted with it.  Five stars for that transaction and the material.We hope that this new Clic floor for our bedroom will be as good..

records.title: Mmmmm Bamboo floor!
records.text: It was easy to speak to the company. I placed the order there & then. Arranged a suitable delivery date.Paid and from there I was kept informed by emails and a follow up phone call.On the day of the delivery, I had a phone call courier and they got the pallet close as possible to my front door. I carried in my stock...All 22 packs and I didn't realise how solid and heavy bamboo is!Now resting in room while I decorate walls and wait until weather is warmer.  I need to put stuff outside when I come to fit electric under floor heating ready for Bamboo floor to float on it.

records.title: Ordering and delivery great customer…
records.text: Ordering and delivery great customer service is outstanding I’m just worried about how tough it will be

records.title: Product is great. Delivery not so.
records.text: Product is great. Delivery not so. Asked for Wednesday as I knew we'd be out Tuesday but order came Tuesday. Luckily, unexpectedly, someone was in.

records.title: Quick response to request for samples
records.text: I wanted to see what the bamboo flooring was like.  I selected some different types of flooring and requested some samples.  They were quickly delivered.  I now have to decide if I want this type of flooring in my living room and hall.

records.title: Brilliant samples and happy with communications from the company.
records.text: Received some samples which I am very impressed with. But as I haven't yet placed an order or haf any fitted, I can only give 4 stars right now, but I like very much what I have seen so far.

records.title: Great products but delivery was a…
records.text: Great products but delivery was a problem for me - the courier was unable to give me a time slot so I ended up stuck at home until the delivery turned up.

records.title: Hi this company is eco friendy and…
records.text: Hi this company is eco friendy and sustainable the samples i received where beautiful there is that much choice i don't know where to start id recommend id give 4/5 thank you for samples

records.title: Very helpful staff and beautiful…
records.text: Very helpful staff and beautiful looking products. I’ve only had samples so far but I’ll be ordering a lot of flooring soon

records.title: Grumpy driver
records.text: Delivery was on time, however I had to unload all of the 16 boxes myself and the delivery driver didn't really want to help at all and seemed very grumpy and impatient and I didn't have time to check for any damage as the driver just wanted to get a signature and go.Perhaps your company could use its own drivers who cold help with the unloading,also the pallet that the boxes came on was particularly flimsy and caused at least 3 of the boxes on the bottom to be ripped.

records.title: Samples were great and arrived nicely…
records.text: Samples were great and arrived nicely packaged.

records.title: Sample Request
records.text: I Sent a request through for some samples and they arrived within 48 Hours which was impressive

records.title: About 15-20% of the flooring arrived damaged
records.text: Floor looks lovely however about 15-20% of the delivered flooring was damaged. Main issue was with the grooves and with a LOT of splinters. LuckilyI was wearing gloves. I didn't bother contacting them to arrange replacement as I already had enough to complete the job, but it

records.title: Easy to order and great help.....BUT
records.text: Easy to order and great help and advice. The disappointment came when I was promised next day delivery (which was what I wanted) if I ordered before 1pm. I placed order at 11am - then confirmation came for delivery for the day after next day. Then I received a 2 hour time slot, so I stayed home. It finally arrived 3 hours after the latest time slot - so I waited in all day.

records.title: Delivery not made on the agreed date
records.text: Delivery not made on the agreed date, admittedly this was due to the transport company. The coms with The supplier were good  still not a good experience

records.title: The flooring is great
records.text: The flooring is great, easy to work with and looks fantastic. Only issue is the returns cost. We over ordered didnt read the fine print the cost os £66 regardless of how many boxes you return, I have two to return meaning I am losing nearly the cost of a box! They do not like using other couriers as they sometimes arrive damaged

records.title: Beaware of what the wooden site isn't saying about FSC certification
records.text: They were very good at answering questions. But they seem to be two companies in one and the second one, selling wooden floors, is misleading about whether its wood is FSC certified or not. I want to deal with a company that puts the environment top of its agenda.

records.title: More help would be appreciated
records.text: Product was as advertised and arrived on the agreed day of delivery. More of a firm for the trade than an individual they don’t seem to appreciate that you might not be used to ordering flooring.

records.title: What you get is not what you see
records.text: I was quite happy with my first purchase last year. But a recent purchase not quite. I bought stair nosing and planks for my staircase. The product "Natural Horizontal Bamboo 15mm Stair Nosing"M1007C is quite well made, with great finish, texture, and color. However it is not matched in terms of color and texture with "Natural Horizontal Bamboo Flooring (F1005)" though it is described on their website as a match. Out of 12 stair nosings, only one matches! The problem is that F1005 is not so great: plainly with almost no texture or very pale, color is lighter than M1007C. My staircase is now finished but it does not look good, it has two distinct color stripes one for the nosing and the other the rest of the tread. I acknowledge that color and texture of solid wood change from plank to plank, however from my experience this is not due to natural factor, but poorly produced. Furthermore, M1007C is poorly cut, many edges are off the right angle a few degrees; so do not suppose both edges are perfectly right angle if you intend to buy it for your project.

records.title: Company & product good delivery very poor.
records.text: the purchase and conversations with Bamboo Flooring Co was good but the service and experience was totally let down by their partner delivery company. The flooring was not delivered on the agreed date and then the next day it was not delivered during the agreed delivery slot and was just left outside the property with no one to accept it on a rainy day, not good for bamboo flooring. Bamboo Flooring Co customer service were very apologetic but there is no recourse against the delivery company. Hopefully this was a one off issue if not should consider changing the delivery company used.

records.title: Thank you for the sample but just…
records.text: Thank you for the sample but just deciding the wood flooring colour from previous wood flooring coz the width size is shortened.

records.title: The product is very good and looks…
records.text: The product is very good and looks great. However, the delivery costs are extortionate. £16 to deliver 1 large pizza sized box and a meter long bar.

records.title: Great product easy to lay and looks…
records.text: Great product easy to lay and looks great. Not so good delivery experience.  Mine were left outside in damaged boxes.

records.title: Delivered to wrong address
records.text: The delivery company dropped off at the wrong address! Guess they couldn't be bothered to check street names...

records.title: I love the concept but there was a very…
records.text: I love the concept but there was a very distinctive smell and I'd be concerned it wouldn't go

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service. Good sample- thank you. Great advice. No need for so much paper or sweets!

records.title: unable to buy smaller quantities than…
records.text: unable to buy smaller quantities than 2m2 even though only needed 40cm to replace small damaged bathroom floor areaChris from company stated that it came in full packs and was sold in full packs--yet they send out samples?thought company was too rigid in their approach--especially after spending 80.00 earlier on skirting board

records.title: I needed some trims to complete the…
records.text: I needed some trims to complete the carbonised bamboo flooring that I was fitting for my client.Unfortunately, they arrived damaged not because of the courier but because of the poor packaging sent out by the warehouse team. I did complain and sent photos, bambooflooringcompany.com were quick to send out replacements which were properly wrapped. Alls good now and my client is happy:)

records.title: Really good but check very carefully for damage.
records.text: The ordering process and delivery was 5 star. We ordered Carbonised Strand Woven flooring with Cush N Wood underlay both arrived undamaged and well packed. We also ordered 2 sq M of door mat this appeared on first looking to be OK, however, on fitting it was found that there were two tears, one each side about the centre possition on the long sides. As a result we can only give 3 star. We haven't contacted the Bamboo Flooring Co. about the damage because the mat had already been cut to fit when the damage was noticed. Fortunately the tears do not show after fitting.

records.title: Damaged box
records.text: I haven't installed the product yet so won't be able to comment on the product quality. But the delivery wasn't very good. the out cover of the cartoon was damaged and i can see a slight damage on the one of the product as well

records.title: Sample
records.text: Ordered a sample of the bamboo flooring to compare against engineered wood. Samples arrived quickly and well packaged. The bamboo does feel nice and sturdy. Yet to make a decision on what to go with.

records.title: Having taken the day out to receive…
records.text: Having taken the day out to receive goods on the agreed date was dissapointed when goods were a no-show ?.  This dispite being told they would be here by 17.30 when I chased.Finally arrived 17.30 the next day, again I had to chase. So i think communications could do with a look at ?That said the flooring is excellent, good quality, well packed and looks great now laid.  Ordered a threshold which arrived next day.

records.title: Awful customer service and communication
records.text: Absolutely shocking communication around the delivery! Even when i tried ringing for an update, it took 4 hours, just to find out when the delivery 'might' turn up. Although the product seems okay, I would avoid using these guys just because of the absolute lack of customer service.

records.title: The dhl courier did not deliver on the…
records.text: The dhl courier did not deliver on the right day twice the package was damaged on arrival Which is a shame as I have purchased a few items from this company

records.title: Great product & poor delivery, zero communication
records.text: Great product, but poor service and very late delivery, zero communication.They missed one full day!

records.title: I worry about the VOC emissions of…
records.text: I worry about the VOC emissions of engineered bamboo flooring. I would like to see recent certificates of independent tests, because there is a strong synthetic smell from the flooring when unwrapped. It looks fantastic and is very durable, though doesn't feel as warm as wood.

records.title: Good flooring poor after sales
records.text: I am happy with the flooring not with customer service.  I rang the morning after it was laid as I had 4 packs of bamboo planks left over and as I sent you the plans and measurements to quote how much I needed I felt It made total sense that you accept a full refund on the 6sqm.  Instead you initially tell me I will have to pay you £122 return fee! When I pointed out again it was your quote you told me the guy who made these calculations wasn’t in the office and he would ring the next morning.  I kept my phone on me all day yesterday and no call back. I should not be taking time out in chasing you again and again for some closure on this. You over quoted by 6 sqm and you should take it back free delivery charge and pay me the full refund. I look forward to your favourable reply. Regards

records.title: Utter disappointment!!
records.text: Spent £2100 on a Pebble coloured bamboo floor and skirting, my thoughts below:-Ordering process fine and delivery good.Skirting boards terrible had to have it removed and replaced, strips too short, so ok for a shoe box but no more...Width of board sizes too small, hard to work with, led to increased cost.Wearing terribly already.Would I do the same again, definitely not!! Very disappointed with the product!!

records.title: Return customer
records.text: Purchased from this company before and once again excellent service and delivery.  Two starts due to the product and I appreciate that I went for the darker flooring this time, but the surface just isn't robust and scratches very, very easily. Our flooring has been down less than a week and looks superb but it already has scratches evident and that's without outdoor shoes being worn on it. I would think within a year I'll be replacing it!I have discussed this with the Bamboo Flooring Company and sent pictures, but if I could go back I would put oak flooring down,... it jut wears better

records.title: Have purchased bamboo flooring from…
records.text: Have purchased bamboo flooring from this company in the past and it was brilliant, I’ve just purchased more and can honestly say I’m so disappointed with the quality of the product... I doubt it will last a year then it will be replaced:-(

records.title: Disappointing longevity
records.text: Always had helpful customer service but product quality is not great. We have the pebbled colour bamboo flooring which is treated to get the colour and is easily marked. Had I known this, I would never have purchased as we have young children and the area gets a lot of foot traffic. When some of the planks first turned up they were already marked and I didn't bother to complain as thought it would just be these small few planks which could be used in areas that would be hidden by sofas etc. Unfortunately the wood has cracked on the joints where I have my dining room chairs  and the thresholds received arrived with white marks on which is disappointing as the product isn't cheap. My partner argued to buy laminate and I insisted on bamboo flooring and now with the state of the floor after just 2years I wish we had used laminate too as it would have lasted longer! It looks nice but the finish scratches easily and just isn't as hardy as it should be.

records.title: Will only deal in complete packs.
records.text: Will only deal in complete packs of flooring. Needed a small amount of planks to finish a job and were unwilling to help.

description: Tiles-Direct is an online tile company which has over 25 years of experience in the tile industry. We are always up to date with the latest trends in the tile industry, therefore, ensuring that we have the best selected range. We work with individuals to companies, from interior designers to architects.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Fantastic service. The 1 star reviews really put me off but I figured it was worth the risk and it definitely was. Large selection of Victorian Style tiles which added a real vibe to our bathroom. Initially tried ordering through the website, but I realised we could collect instead of pay for postage. There was no option on their checkout (this is the only thing I’d say needs looking at), so I rang through to customer service and ordered with a sales person. Lovely customer service, sent the invoice over instantly and was able to pick up that day. Collection was very easy - pressed a buzzer, gave the order details and someone brought to our car. Accidentally ordered too little, so ended up going back a few times, but wouldn’t hesitate to go again for other tiles. Quality of the tile were great too. My tiler was impressed. Thank you for a fab exchange.

records.title: Ordered 300 tiles or so for a bathroom…
records.text: Ordered 300 tiles or so for a bathroom and only 8 had broken, we used those for cut pieces.    I can’t fault this company at all, good communication (Sam) the tiles are beautiful.    I can only assume the majority of the issues are likely caused by bad couriers.

records.title: Top tiles
records.text: Top tiles! There's so many different style of tilingis that you can get. Good quality, good place.Wonderful customer service! Would highlyrecommend.

records.title: The best place you could buy your tiles…
records.text: The best place you could buy your tiles from they beat any prices for tiles on the market very helpful staff quick and brillant service.

records.title: There was a huge variety of tiles to…
records.text: There was a huge variety of tiles to choose from. My tiles arrived within days of ordering and the quality of the tiles were second to none. They’re gorgeous tiles exactly what I was looking for.

records.title: Broken tiles
records.text: So I had a relatively small order, 3 x boxes of metro tiles and 5 larger plain white tiles..Sadly my tiler was delayed coming, but when he did some 3 weeks later, we opened the tiles to discover 2 of the boxes were the wrong colour and the large white tiles were damaged.I had obviously missed the 2 day window to notify the company, but responded immediately to my email and resent replacement tiles, that arrived in two days.Was a genuine mistake on colour and the courier had obviously battered the single tiles..Mistakes happen, but as a business it's how you deal with them.Tiles direct handled it perfectly.5 stars!!

records.title: Really good
records.text: Really good. Prices seem competitive and they refunded the one tile that got broken without any hassle. Prompt delivery too.

records.title: I wanted a small amount of tiles so…
records.text: I wanted a small amount of tiles so couldn’t justify postage of £39. Sent a message asking about postage/collection. Prompt reply received offering £10 postage. Accepted, was able to secure and pay via link from website. Quick delivery and well packaged. Great tiles exactly as described. Excellent service, highly recommend.

records.title: Pleasantly surprised!
records.text: I was very apprehensive in placing an order due to reviews, but couldn’t find what I wanted elsewhere. However, samples received promptly. Tiles ordered on Friday 7th delivered on Tuesday 11th of July. Walkers delivered on time as advised on a pallet at end of long gravel drive because the electric trolley wouldn’t work on gravel so I did have to manually carry up drive in the pouring rain😂  all tiles as per order & expectation. Can’t fault the process or tiles direct. Would use again based on this experience.

records.title: Would recommend buying tiles from this excellent company
records.text: Would recommend buying tiles from this company great product excellent service great response when some tiles arrived broken within days they were replaced just sent photo staff very polite. When friend wanted to purchase couldn't remember details e mailed company seconds later e mail came with all details. I can't fault.

records.title: LOVE LOVE LOVE my new tile!
records.text: LOVE LOVE LOVE my new tile for the downstairs bathroom. I couldn’t find anything like it locally or on other websites. It’s exactly what I wanted and really adds some sparkle! Item packaged well and arrived quicklyThe p&p is very expensive for one tile but it’s what I wanted, so had to pay it.

records.title: Beautiful tiles… but please answer the phone!
records.text: I purchased these tiles as they were such good value, i was concerned about shipping costs as we live in the Shetland Islands. I was quoted £80 delivery and they were quick to call me for that payment (which was confirmed to be £100 but they wavered to additional £20 due to my earlier quote.) now this might seem pricey to most but it as expected for all deliveries on pallets up to our remote islands. I was advised the order would be received within 5 days due to our remote location but after 7 working days had passed they hadn’t arrived. I tried many times to call the company and no one ever answered the phone. I also sent a couple of emails (which didn’t get a reply) then, yesterday about 2 weeks after I ordered, the tiles arrived, in perfect condition and beautiful. I did eventually get a response to my email (around the same time the delivery was made)Having read the reviews I was dubious I’d ever get my order, but I did! So on the whole, a good experience, but getting someone to answer the phone seems to be impossible!

records.title: Great service when buying, but inflexible returns policy.
records.text: Great service when buying. Quick delivery. However, they advise to buy extra to cover cuts etc., and I had 2 boxes left over. Because my tiler had a delay in starting the job, I just missed the 30 day returns policy. I wanted to purchase some more (different) tiles, so I asked if they would consider extending for a few days so that I could travel to Leeds from Sheffield to return and collect my new tiles. Unfortunately, I was refused, which seems a little petty and cost them another order.

records.title: Great Wall Panels AWFUL delivery service
records.text: I would’ve given a 5 as was really pleased with the wall panels but communication let the company down. The delivery company they use also really let them down. I had to ask for a tracking number and then my items (over £200 worth) got delivered to the wrong address and there was no confirmation delivery had happened, luckily I have an honest neighbour and together we managed to get the heavy items to my house, not impressed at all.

records.title: Although our panels were broken on…
records.text: Although our panels were broken on delivery and I could not get through on the phone once I emailed the service was fast and efficient.The panels were picked up the next day and I was refunded minus the delivery feeOverall, a good service

records.title: Good price & customer service.
records.text: Good price & customer service.We had a problem with breakages of quite a number of tiles that probably could have been avoided as it looked as though the breakages occurred at picking rather than in transit.  Customer services addressed the problem quickly and without any hassle.  Would shop here again.

records.title: I purchased some tiles from this…
records.text: I purchased some tiles from this company unfortunately two of the large tiles were damaged in transit, I spoke to them on the phone and after emailing them pictures of the damage replacements were sent quickly and without any fuss. I was very happy with the way they dealt with the broken tiles, cant complain.

records.title: I ordered despite the reviews - glad I did
records.text: I ordered from this website despite the horrid reviews, because they were the only ones who had the tiles I wanted. I have only a minor complaint re. delivery, but the tiles arrived within the week and don't seem to be damaged. The order arrived promptly (ordered Tuesday, arrived Friday). There was no communication around the delivery, it was visible on a portal I could log in to but there were no emails. This meant no one was home when the tiles were delivered, so I'm not sure who supposedly signed for them... the pallet was placed in front of the front door and I received a proof of delivery. This might have been the courier's poor choices rather than Tiles Directs, and it's been a frequent misbehaviour from all sorts of delivery services. Anyway, would order again!

records.title: Short notice of delivery slot.
records.text: Delivery was very prompt. Delivery driver was helpful and courteous. Only criticism is that delivery notice was less than 90min, although it wasn't a problem for me as I'm retired.

records.title: Quick and easy to order
records.text: Quick and easy to order. Large selection of tiles to choose from. Delivery within stated time period of 2-3 working days. Only negative - I think delivery charge is too high.

records.title: Great product, great price
records.text: Great product at a good price. Delivery was fairly quick but notification of delivery on the same day as the delivery not so great, a days notice would be better.

records.title: If we had known this was an Al Murad…
records.text: If we had known this was an Al Murad shop we would have asked for the tiles to be sent to the Scunthorpe shop as this is where we bought the original tiles for our hallway.  But the staff were very helpful.

records.title: This company gets a bad rep, but...
records.text: This company gets a bad rep, it seems.  Perhaps that is valid, but in my experience they were pretty good.  I desperately wanted a particular patterned tile which was out at most major stockists. Tiles-direct.com not only had stock, but Isha (apologies I have misspelled your name) was brilliant and expedited the delivery to my home "next day" at no extra charge.  This meant we had the tiles we wanted in time for the tiler to lay.  Had it not been for Tiles-direct.com and Isha I would most likely have had to go for another type of tile, and that would have annoyed me forever.  Also, just to say, I called twice and my call was successfully answered and dealt with twice.  As I say, perhaps I got lucky, but in my experience Tiles-direct.com were pretty good.  The only reason I have marked down 1 star is because the print on the tile looks a little inferior to the same tile offered by Topps Tiles.  Then again, Tiles-direct.com were much cheaper, so the price reflects this and I guess bumping them down a star is a tad unfair.  Anyway, I thought I would just to convey the quality point.  But price good, and service good in my experience.

records.title: Great tiles and value
records.text: Would of been 5 stars but not communication about delivery day so turned up when no one in

records.title: Positive experience
records.text: Tiles were in stock on the website and delivered within a few days (which included the Christmas period).

records.title: Just lacking customer service skills…
records.text: Just lacking customer service skills when contacting by telephone . Product good delivery good. Mistake by myself rectified no problem .

records.title: Great looking tiles at great price
records.text: Great looking tiles at great priceDelivery was expensive but prompt

records.title: We were helped with information before…
records.text: We were helped with information before we actually bought our tiles and the delivery was efficient and quick

records.title: All in all a decent company
records.text: The tiles were just fine Unfortunately there were 3 broken 🥴

records.title: I made an order last Tuesday and I got…
records.text: I made an order last Tuesday and I got the delivery today Monday instead of requested for tomorrow(message sent one hour before estimated time of delivery) so I had to rush home to be there but overall I am very satisfied with hexagon white tiles, not even one broken. It was very well packed as well. I was a bit worried reading some of the negative reviews and thought I share my experience too. I would use this company again.

records.title: Great customer service - poor quality tiles
records.text: We ordered 46 large format (600x1200) "pure white" tiles.  They arrived as promised within a few days but were stacked vertically on a pallet which was too small for the lifting truck to get off the lorry without damaging it.  The tiles had toppled over during the journey due to the poor packaging and we had to assist manhandling the tiles on to a pallet we had.  We found 9 tiles were broken or chipped.  When I checked all the tiles a further 15 tiles had manufacturing faults so only 18 of the 42 tiles were useable.Tile Direct agreed to send a new batch and collect the bulk of the damaged or faulty tiles but the next batch were no better and I had to reject them and ask for a full refund.Given the quality problems, this would have been a 1 star review and the only reason for the 3 stars is that throughout the process, and whilst it was time consuming,  annoying and caused delay,  Tile Direct's customer service team were excellent.  They answered the phone, listened to the problem and actioned replacements, collections and refunds exactly as they said they would and within a reasonable time frame.  Whilst the situation was not great and the tiles were awful quality, the customer service team were excellent and far better than many others we have contacted in recent months.

records.title: Poor customer service - delayed delivery
records.text: I placed an order for 6 items billing to roughly £500 including delivery on 31st March. I received an email next day advising order had been dispatched. On  2nd April I received 1 item! It was impossible to reach these guys via email or their number I was calling 30+ every day. Thursday I got through to someone. The man I spoke to was rude and arrogant told me to wait “it’ll come when it does” sorry what does that even mean when I’ve paid the extortion of £39 for delivery and then hung up. I called again later that evening and spoke to someone who kindly refunded the delivery fee only. The remainder of my order arrived today 5th April. Good quality but due to customer service don’t think il be shopping here again.

records.title: Good quality tiles
records.text: The only reason it is 3 stars is because they take so long to answer their phones & they don't send emails with dispatch date. I had to call to get courier details so I could track it myself. Once through to them, they are very polite & helpful. They also answered 2 emails in a timely manner. We ordered £500 worth of tiles. They arrived well packaged in styrofoam & look in very good condition. My builder inspected them & said they were good quality tiles. They were about £150 cheaper than their competitors. Just improve your customer service please!

records.title: Damaged goods and frustrating contact trials
records.text: Purchased 3 wall panels however only 2 arrived leading to further delivery the following week. Not a major issue however every panel was damaged which I was able to salvage as I didn’t need the full lengths but if I did then they would have been worthless. Even at delivery I could see the package was damaged so complete lack of faith in any future products arriving in damaged which yes a courier issue but packaging needs review. This combined with having to ring endless times to gain contact just falls short of other similar companies offering similar items. I will not be using or recommending this company.

records.title: Lovely tiles, but shame about the broken ones!
records.text: We were more than happy with the tiles themselves and our bathroom is looking fabulous. Our only complaint is that several of the tiles were broken (unbeknown to us until the workmen started using the tiles - which was 3 months later than anticipated). This meant we were over the 30 day limit to claim money back. However we ordered replacements which have now arrived and were packaged more thoroughly and taped with the words FRAGILE. So really not a problem with Tiles Direct but the lack of care by whoever dispatched and delivered the first lots of tiles.

records.title: Would order again although..
records.text: Ordered tiles 2 weeks ago, supposed to be 2-3 day delivery. Really difficult to get a hold of someone on the phone after 30-40 goes off the trot you do end up finally reaching someone.Finally received my order however a few tiles were smashed but must admit I emailed them and within an hour or so had my order sent out and I received today which was next day. Which I'm over the moon with.Overall I would still in the future use Tiles Direct again however I just think there needs more effort made by staff in regards to answering the phones and also updating customers on the delivery being delayed etc.Few changes and this company would be a 5 star 😊

records.title: Tiles were lovely and sent quickly but…
records.text: Tiles were lovely and sent quickly but edge of one tile chipped off and the cut sample from a 2 x4 panel didn't show the depth of the faux grouting so no further forward. There is no way to just by single tiles without a huge postage fee....frustrating when you just want a few to try with different grouts or even a smaller area job. Huge amounts of tight cling wrap did little to.protect. but took ages to take off...paper more env friendly.

records.title: Order and delivery
records.text: Customer service was good. The ordering process was easy and I was able to talk through my order first. Tiles were poorly packed and will need repacking for shipping. Tiles I ordered from a competitor company came boxed and shrunken wrapped on a pallet.

records.title: courier was awful
records.text: courier was awful, no communication just turned up 2 days later and rung me at work to say they were outside the house!  Two boxes and 4 x loose ones left on a huge pallet & wrapped in a ton of plastic. Asked driver to take out the plastic and put in house and take pallet away but he refused.  Ridiculous & won't use again.  Tiles seem ok btw.

records.title: good but....
records.text: The good points are that Tiles-direct sent me a whole tile as a sample and not a tile cut in half, and that other than one sample that was free their charge was the lowest.  The bad point is that the tile arrived in 3 pieces  so not much different to one cut in half.

records.title: Not the best
records.text: I will not recommend this place if you wnat your tiles on time and all in 1 piece. We had 3 boxes of broken tiles and a lot of them you can see someone stand on the actual boxes. We recieve replacement but each time replacement came all tiles where smashed. Took 4 attempts to deliver them as they should be in the first place. Service also not the greatest to be honest.

records.title: Ordered 60 tiles
records.text: Ordered 60 tiles, 40 came broken and damaged, these 40 were replaced of which 19 were broken… 19 were replaced and so finally we had enough tiles for the area, although even a few of these came slightly chipped but at this point we have laid them out and can use them for the edges as they will need to be slightly cut down. I am left with a huge pile of broken tiles to dispose of. Would not order again from this company due to all the back and forth, it took 3 deliveries in order for us to get the tiles needed, that being said the tiles are lovely and the issues were resolved. Hum in customer service replied quickly and was very helpful.

records.title: Misleading postage costs
records.text: I ordered a tile sample which I was charged 99p. I was told this was all I needed to pay for the sample to be sent. I had a failed divery by Royal mail end of last week, as I was not home. I had a post card from Royal Mail, informing me that I needed to pay £2.50 for a delivery of a package, there was  ot indication of what it was. I paid for it, this morning yhe package from tiles direct arrived with a sticker on it to say that this is what i paid £2.50 for. I contacted Tukes Direct to ask fir them to pay yge xost of delivery of their package, I was told tk tale this up with my bank. Totally rubbish customer service, however after posting this review I have been offered a refund

records.title: Delivery was delayed then a further…
records.text: Delivery was delayed then a further delay by the courier. Advertised as next working day but ended up being  4 days. Tiles were good though

records.title: good communication
records.text: I got emails and texts to let me know when tiles arriving although it was an hour later than expected I found this helpful to plan my day.

records.title: DX express waste of time 10 tiles broke…
records.text: DX express waste of time 10 tiles broke what a joke I hope replacement tiles arrive Friday possibly Saturday as I working at disable person bathroom crap DX

records.title: Too slow with deliveries
records.text: Too slow with deliveries.  I ordered some samples because I needed tiles for my contractor to start in the bathroom this week.  We still have yet to receive it.

records.title: damaged ties
records.text: I have bought several times with this company. Price is ok and have the tiles I was looking for. Every single time tiles arrive with some degree of damage. Today, from 30 tiles 15 were damaged or broken.

records.title: Ordered £550 worth of Tiles arrived…
records.text: Ordered £550 worth of Tiles arrived after 5 working days and not the 2 to 3 working days advertised, I only knew they where arriving when the delivery driver rang as he couldn't find my property so communication could be better between courier and customer. When the tiles arrived they where we'll packaged on a pallet and no breakages to be fair to tile-direct the tiles I ordered where by far the cheapest with all the online retailers. So in summary I would use them again especially if they improved there communication on availability and delivery times.

records.title: This was a journey
records.text: This was a journey. Like everyone else, didn't read reviews before ordering. We wanted very simply a certain size white square gloss tile, to match what we already have, which no one did. Found tiles direct did them, bit iffy about the delivery price being same price as the tiles almost, but we just decided to go ahead as running out of time before our bathroom project. We also added some pretty border tiles to the order. They arrived when they should, but me being heavily pregnant and husband away with work - it took us 3 days to move the tiles to open them safely, which were heavily bubble wrapped. 5 had broken corners. And our border tiles weren't there. No information on these, as in whether they were out of stock, or on their way, or just missed.I contacted Tiles direct on the Friday, and fair play on Sunday they responded.
