Explained the x2 day to complain about breakages (we contacted them on day 3). Ultimately we figured we could probably use the broken tiles anyway for the smaller gaps, so weren't too bothered (although question the legality of this policy?!), but confirmed I was concerned that 50% of the cost of our order hadn't been fulfilled. TD responded to advise they were out of stock, and would I like a refund!Replied advising that I definitely would like a refund if we weren't getting what we paid for! They confirmed this would be processed. In the meantime we ordered more border tiles from elsewhere (B&Q for safety!). Next thing we know, the border tiles get delivered from TD!! What?!By this point I've absolutely lost the will. Haven't had the refund, got tiles we don't want but we decided to keep them for another project eventually. 3 Stars because we did get our order, and we did get responses from TD but I definitely wouldn't use again or recommend anyone goes near them. Some lovely tiles on their website though. A shame!

records.title: Poor description on cladding
records.text: Poor description on cladding. Ordered corners and face cladding both with same description on site. One was slate the other was quartz, not matching. To return I now have to organise and pay a pallet delivery myself. This left me short of cladding so ordered two more boxes which was charged thr same amount as pallet delivery, ridiculous two little boxes hand delivered and to make matters worse one box was opened and two pieces missing leaving me short for tht client. Rang to complain,sounded uninterested after it took hours of trying for someone toanswer a phone. Won't be buying from these again which is their loss as we install alot if cladding.

records.title: Delivery left on the street when I was out.
records.text: I wish I'd read more reviews before choosing this company for my tiles. When spending hundreds of pounds you expect a decent amount of customer service. I waited all day on the delivery day which never happened. I was never given another date. A couple of days later the delivery driver phone to say he was outside (no 2 hour window to let me know?!) I wasn't near my house so they just left the tiles on a busy street outside my flat. Not in a safe space. I'm lucky the tiles were still there when I arrived. When I opened the tiles one was cracked. Lets hope their customer service deals with this efficiently. It's a shame because the tiles are beauitiful but not sure I'd use them again.

records.title: Misleading listings!
records.text: We ordered tiles labelled as 'Monarch Green Metro Tiles,' which appeared quite dark in the photos. This was following our experience with lighter 'Victorian Green Metro Tiles' from another supplier. Upon arrival, we discovered that the tiles were the same lighter Victorian green as previously ordered (even down to the production batch). Moreover, the product description did not indicate that the tiles needed to be glazed or that they were unsuitable for wet areas—requirements that are crucial to prevent damage.We were informed that someone would return to collect the tiles, but this has yet to happen, leaving us with a palette of tiles on the driveway that we are unable to move or unpack. These are now exposed to anyone driving past who may want to take their chances.While customer service was initially very helpful, we are now unable to reach them and we have no indication of when the tiles will be collected.There are significant discrepancies between the product advertised and what was delivered. Additionally, the tiles are bowed, similar to the previous issue we faced with another company, making them unfit for purpose even if they had been the correct type.

records.title: Non existent Customer Service
records.text: Was promised a refund as we had to cancel the order which hadn't left their warehouse yet. No refund has been received as yet, emails are being ignored and nobody answers the phone. Going by the reviews on here, lack of customer service seems to be a common issue. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANYUPDATEFinally got someone to answer the phone. Apparently their system went down. I have been told the refund will be processed. I had received good customer service up until now, so will give them the benefit of the doubt. If my refund goes in I will change my rating.

records.title: Tiles broken nil customer service
records.text: Update: Have received an email from them advising my refund is on its way and also a confirmation from PayPal that this has been actioned so a resolution in the end.Initial review:Have received an order of tiles over half were delivered broken, contacted Tiles Direct who advised more were dispatched but then later received an email to advise they were no longer in stock and could I wait. Unfortunately not as our tiler was due in a few days. Arranged collection of the full order on 5th Sept for a refund but they are now ignoring my emails over a week later asking for confirmation that my refund has been processed. Reading a lot of he negative reviews I wish I had looked here before ordering. I am assuming no one has reported them to trading standards yet. I will be actioning a small claims court in the next few days, have given Tiles Direct 24 hours to reply to my latest email advising them of this next step.Karen Twilton

records.title: Overcharged carriage for under par service
records.text: Considering the carriage fee is £40 for just a small order (for a basin splashback only), rather surprised to find a package left on our doorstep which was the tiles merely wrapped in bubble wrap having come through the courier network. Unsurprisingly a third of the tiles were cracked. Free replacements were quickly sent but again in the same type of packaging and again also arrived cracked.For £40, a far more suitable packaging type could be used. Also would save them sending free replacements!

records.title: I purchased nearly £900 worth of tiles
records.text: I purchased nearly £900 worth of tiles, tiler came to start tiling but the tiles were curved and not straight so cant be used. I have contacted tile direct and sent photos of tiles, am still waiting to hear back from them as I cant afford to buy more tiles until this has been refunded. don't want to give a bad review as its still ongoing, then I hope to give a positive review.

records.title: Good tiles, poor delivery planning
records.text: We're really happy with the tiles, which we're good value and look great. However, we had no notification of the delivery. It was sheer chance that we were in, but we hadn't cleared parking for the delivery van or space in the house which was difficult and the driver was clearly annoyed and inconvenienced. It's a large order, not just a parcel. A 'dispatched' email would at least have given us a heads up; the ideal would be a text when out for delivery.

records.title: The initial interaction with Tiles…
records.text: The initial interaction with Tiles Direct was very good, they responded promptly and got the items sent out quickly. Unfortunately I had to return the order, which I did promptly and paid for myself. Now trying to get them to send my refund is turning into a long drawn out process, and they are not responding to emails and no answer on the phone. Next step is dispute via the bank which is just a pain but I want my money back. Lesson learnt, should have read the Trustpilot reviews before placing an order!

records.title: Could not reach them ever!
records.text: Was very disappointed not to buy tiles from Tiles-Direct.com. They had some wonderful tiles I really wanted. I did have a good experience ordering a sample cut: received prompt email responses and the sample arrived as requested. I sent an email and attempted to call at least 4 time to answer some questions about a full order. No reply to the email and no answer any of the times and the different departments I tried to reach. After seeing the reviews here, coupled with my experience, I gave up and went to Fired Earth and had a great experience. So disappointing.

records.title: A little more considerationwhen working in someones home
records.text: I requested a visit to fit a fused spur to accommodate a sump pump. When the engineer arrived he thought he was coming to fit an outside light and was unable to do the job requested. A further date was arranged and 2 engineers arrived to fit the fused spur and also to fit a motion detector light (a later request) The lads were very polite and did a good job, however, their boots were filthy with wet mud which was trodden into my door mats and over the floors. A little more care would have been appreciated when it is known you will be working inside someones home.UPDATEThank you for your response Kev and also for the email you sent me. I did not reply to this email as I did not wish to get into an argument with you. However, as you have chosen to bring a response to Trust Pilot I must reply as follows.:-Your firm did an enormous amount of work for me last year and because I was impressed with how Peter Cannon and the trainee conducted themselves,  I came back to you. You may also find I did give you a 5* review following this work.I can categorically confirm your lads did not work in their stockinged feet, they also had to go into the kitchen to look at the fuse box housed in a kitchen cupboard. Consequently, the mud, dirt, from their boots trod into my carpet in the doorway and also into the kitchen. Had I been made aware they had dirty shoes I could have provided floor covering.I was also extremely surprised when you personally initially turned up to do the job (fitting a fused spur) thinking you had come to do something to a light? I had filled in your on line form giving full details of my requirements and also mentioned these again when I spoke to you on the telephone. You personally were unable to undertake the job when you came, due to ill health, therefore delaying this job until you had someone available, the day before the sump pump was fitted. Had there been a problem it could have been extremely inconvenient.

records.text: I have been pleased with the Housekeep services. I have had a couple of changes of cleaners but hopefully I can keep the last lady who I am very pleased with, Alina she is very thorough and has good time management. All cleaners have been good and pleasant but 4 stars because unfortunately the 1st one was a bit too thorough for the allotted time so didn’t get all round all rooms. Its early days so might review this and upgrade to 5.

records.title: Overall a good experience
records.text: Overall a good experience, the cleaner did a good job and customer service was polite. Only thing, I wish I could see more details about the cleaners before they come. They switched it last moment and that made me quite nervous I couldn't even see her rating. But all good in the end.

records.title: End of tenancy one off clean
records.text: This was my first experience with booking an End of tenancy clean with Housekeep. The booking process was easy, but I did not get any information in the app about the cleaners until I met them on the day.Nicole and Marius came at the specified booking window. Even though they had to reschedule the clean due to not being able to find parking, we managed to reschedule it for the next day, which was good. The cleaning was done to a very high standard. They were very thorough and professional. They even took the time to take pictures of how immaculate the flat was at the end.

records.title: Happy with my cleaner but the company/…
records.text: Happy with my cleaner but the company/ automated system doesn't seem to know what time their cleaners actually start work. I booked for 9-11:30am but she only came at 10am because that's when she starts work.

records.title: A former cleaner's review
records.text: All the reviews are from the perspective of the customers who book housekeep and their experiences are reflected in their reviews. However, some of these reviews are based on experiences that should not have happened. Customer expectations are often misaligned with what the service provides. By that I mean, the customers should not have been able to make that booking. A classic example is when customers try to avoid paying a lot of money for a deep-clean or end of tenancy clean. So they book housekeep for 4-6 hours thinking that this amount of time can be used to deep clean a small house or flat. NO! Stop doing this! Half way through the clean, the housekeeper often realises the customer is expecting a very thorough clean for which we do not have the materials. Customers book cleans for 2-3 hours but the ovens are caked with thick grease. That takes 24 hours overnight to be done properly. I did have two lovely customers around the Putney area and an amazing customer in Tooting. What made me quit were two things. I had some personal stuff going on. But even after that, I didn't want to go back because of some very unfair bad feedback I got from a couple in the Battersea Park area. After that, I completely lost interest. The company itself are OK. The app never had problems, the support team were good, frequent pay is good, bonus is a good idea too. Cleaners should be paid more for their own products. Again, customers are unaware the cleaners do not have vaccums, mops etc. So I have been to places where they had none of these expecting that I would

records.title: Good service, clunky app
records.text: I have generally found the process of booking cleaners, and for the most part the quality of the cleans received, to be good. However I find the app a bit clunky at times and not intuitive. For example, not clear how to send a message, was unclear when I had changed to a different cleaner, as this was not clearly indicated...With some tweaks to the app, process could be much smoother. Also I have several times posted feedback on cleaners but received no acknowledgement that my comments were ever posted.

records.title: Booked services and they never show up
records.text: EDIT - Housekeep arranged for a replacement gardener to come first thing the following day. He was excellent. However I am still leaving the below as it has been a recurring issue for me.Booked services and they never show up. This has happened to me a number of times now, and given Housekeep provide a window in which the person will arrive I have wasted days waiting in for them, for them to simply not show up. They don't even message to say they won't come. Go elsewhere and save your time.

records.title: The process of booking wasn't as simple…
records.text: Update: do not sign up with them they contact your constantly I've had over 20 emails from them, even after asking that they stop emailing me, they sent another email. The process of booking wasn't as simple as its hoped, it wasn't clear if the cleaner was coming 9-12 or that they were arriving between 9-12.

records.title: Cannot share mobile numbers when…
records.text: Cannot share mobile numbers when chatting with Cleaner neither could I send/recieve photos. I wasn’t able to edit instrucrions either. It’s the Housekeep.com facility that is lacking. Luckily the Cleaner was proactive, so we managed to communicate efficiently.

records.title: Very hit and miss
records.text: Very hit and miss. The only way I can guarantee the cleaner is experienced or will show up is to email housekeep each and every time. Today I had a no show, with zero communication from the cleaner or housekeep. I was texting, calling, emailing...A suggestion is you offer a cheaper price for first-time cleaners and the full price for cleaners with a track record.

records.title: Hit and miss
records.text: I booked a cleaner which was confirmed, but at the last minute they couldn't do the time i asked for. They did offer another time that day but that didn't work for me. I had booked the service because I had house viewings over the weekend, which meant i had to spend hours cleaning my house myself. I did reschedule for another date and all went well that time. The actual cleaning was good though, just the booking was not as smooth as i would like.

records.title: It is a fairly good web site
records.text: It is a fairly good site but needs some adjustments when booking, rebooking some cleans and finding additional details or just using the chat which is a slow, onerous function.  Please look at changing the left sided banner for your menu!

records.title: Lost a customer
records.text: I have felt constrained by the restrictions on the number of cleans I can skip. There should be an option to easily skip a clean whenever I don't feel up to it.I requested to cancel a clean, but they still sent a cleaner over. It led to a back-and-forth in the morning with an advisor named Lily, where I had to prove that I had indeed canceled the clean.I suggest improving the booking process to allow customers more flexibility. Customers should have the option to skip a clean whenever they want, as long as it's done before 24 hours to give the cleaner ample time to adjust their schedule.Also Dherk cabading When customers request a cancellation, please refrain from sending a strange email and not canceling my cleaner. This has resulted in the company losing a customer!

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: We’ve been trying to find a good cleaner for a while and had high hopes for Housekeep - website seemed good where you could specify particular things you’d like done and where bins and bin bags were etc. Was therefore really disappointed when the cleaner didn’t clean the fridge, which we’d booked and paid for, or empty the bins. The clean itself was average. Seems a bit pointless putting all this info on the website if the cleaner doesn’t read it. Have asked customer service to terminate account/future cleans so hopefully that will happen - they did offer me another cleaner but there was no offer of a refund for the work not done do not prepared to pay this company any more money. the search for a good cleaner goes on….

records.title: Beware - won't let you leave
records.text: I've been trying to cancel my schedule and the app won't let me leave because I have "skipped too many cleans". I have requested for the cleans to be cancelled via support and they just keep trying to call me and ask me why I'm leaving bla bla. Just let me leave?! Be careful signing up for anything more than one off cleans.

records.title: Limited Experience with HK…
records.text: First recommended cleaner by HK only came 3 times and left due to travel distance!!?. Did not have domestic cleaning experience requested. No misunderstanding with HK as they claimed retrospectively. I find it ridiculous to rate Housekeep who only provide a platform. Told to email and yet when you email - no reply.Intentionally was cut off twice yesterday following their advice to call them! My initial experience with these companies where there is no personal interaction is their superficiality and written lip service. This can be demonstrated by different people called Support dealing with you and use if impersonal email.

records.title: It was okay
records.text: It was okay, my cleaner was half an hour late though and left before the full time was even up. The time could have been used to do the little details better too. There’s still parts of surfaces that aren’t quite clean and bits of dust that have been missed. Doesn’t make me want to keep my regular service booked going off my first job tbh. Might just try and see who I can find locally.

records.title: Communication All personnel were extremely helpful…
records.text: All personnel were extremely helpful but the process was difficult for a non computer literate, hard of hearing older person when emails are used rather than messages.

records.title: So far I'm not impressed
records.text: So far I'm not impressed. The set up process was smooth. The app works well with the option to add instructions. However, this may have raised the expectations as the cleaning itself was disappointing. Housekeep responded immediately and will match us with a new cleaner. I was here for the clean so I know that cleaning took place. However, none of the surfaces are actually clean now. The instructions clearly weren't read. The floors weren't mopped at all (the mop was still dry). It seems that the wrong vacuum head was used for the carpets so it couldn't have worked (I wish the cleaner had asked me how to change it or informed me that it wasn't working well as I was there). The oven was cleaned as an extra which could have been a nice touch, however, it's not clean and I had to wipe it down again because there's a strong detergent smell. I'm wondering if there's any cleaning protocol provided by Housekeep? I'll give this another try so hopefully I'll be able to give a more positive review.

records.title: Not bad but...
records.text: If a housekeeper requests an extension to  a clean because they are behind, Housekeep should send the request to the customer for approval.  Not AUTOMATICALLY accept it without checking first..extensions are not free after all

records.title: Avoid
records.text: Avoid! I've booked twice with housekeep, and both times the cleaner has been cancelled last minute. The first time we got a replacement to come which was fine, but this time there is no one available to cover. Three stars as the cleaner we had the first time was nice and did an ok job of cleaning, just the service is terrible.

records.title: Brilliant work
records.text: On first sight work seemed good but as I went through checks it was not worth 5 stars. Clean was OK but not good enough, I'm not so pleased. I had to rewash the kitchen floor and clean the kichen sink again. Downstars bathroom had not been touched! My house is not gleaming. Mahmudul is polite but didn't do exactly what was required. I won't be seeing him again.

records.title: Communication could have been better
records.text: Communication could have been better, just to know when to roughly expect the cleanerSlot was from 9-12 and arrived at 11:50 so had to wait a long time otherwise the cleaning was good!

records.title: The site runs fairly smoothly but it…
records.text: The site runs fairly smoothly but it was hard to contact the cleaner and get a clear response back from him regarding his exact time of arrival

records.title: Terrible management and aggressive reps
records.text: Hugely disappointed by 1. inconsistent in quality of services; 2. sloppy work in deep clean; 3. aggressive and disrespectful customer services.Before I managed to cancel my regular clean, I was asked, very aggressively, by the representative: " Could you tell me WHY you still want to cancel after I offered me so many perks??' (the perks were for me to wait at home for the rest of the day for another housekeeper)This is after explaining to her and her colleagues (I was transferred twice after I requested to cancel my regular cleans) multiple times why I wanted to cancel: my housekeeper cancelled last minute and the platform failed to notify me of their late cancellation. I was waiting for most of the day for the housekeeper only to find out they have cancelled when I checked the platform. I could not even cancel the clean even though it had not been fulfilled and it was way past the time slot that I booked. This added to my previous disappointments of having incompetent housekeepers and bad quality cleans from their deep clean team and led to my decision to terminate all future cleans.Is this how you treat customers Housekeep? Are we deemed so guilty for cancelling on your inadequate services that we need to be interrogated by multiple representatives and explain ourselves multiple times?Huge red flag and I'd warn anyone looking for housekeeping services to steer clear.

records.title: Great concept, but significant safety concerns
records.text: The concept is great. However, whilst it says they interview every cleaner and do an 8 step background check, if the agreed cleaner can’t attend, they are able to nominate a totally unvetted friend to stand in. An unqualified stranger let themselves into our house with our teenager at home on their own. Cancelled the service.

records.title: Cancelled my slot the night before
records.text: Cancelled my slot the night before; rearranged to an unsuitable time without asking.I booked a house clean for Saturday. In Friday afternoon I get an email saying "sorry, nobody is actually available to do the job so we've rescheduled it for Sunday."Did I ever say Sunday was a good time? No, because we're actually moving house on Saturday!! Really inconvenient to be cancelled on the night before, and sneaky business practice to try rescheduling without confirming first.

records.title: Very poorly cleaned house
records.text: Very poorly cleaned house. I had to clean afterwards for hours. Didn’t clean many places and cleaner left early before the designated time ended.

records.title: First time user and booked a 4 hour…
records.text: First time user and booked a 4 hour clean - ample time for a 2 bed, 2 bath house which really only required a surface level clean. Included in this was 30 mins for windows and 30 mins for oven (additional charge). Cleaner spent 3 hours 15 minutes downstairs - completing a thorough clean - leaving 45 mins for the rest. Cleaner stated she would stay to complete the job with no charge however, we were then charged by Housekeep (this remains unresolved). My husband had to vacuum both stairwells and i've had to polish the bedrooms.Shame really as I read such good reviews.We chose to use this service as we're both very busy but it just created uneccessary stress all day.

records.title: A Disappointing Experience with Housekeep
records.text: We recently hired Housekeep for an end of tenancy clean. The cleaners arrived an hour late but assured us that the cleaning would take no longer than 3-4 hours, and they would clean the property to a standard that would enable us to get our deposit back. However, after five hours they left the flat still significantly unclean. As a result, £100 of our deposit was deducted for extra cleaning costs.When we complained to Housekeep, our requests for a full or partial refund were denied. Instead, they offered a free re-clean, a policy that wasn’t mentioned in their terms and conditions or during the booking process. We declined having not agreed to this policy and as we had lost trust in their cleaners' ability to rectify the initial poor job.Unfortunately, our experience mirrors other negative reviews so be aware that if the job is not complete or you are not satisfied then you will not be getting any money back. It's clear that Housekeep prioritises offering re-cleans over customer satisfaction and financial compensation. I strongly advise considering alternative cleaning services.

records.title: Poor cleaning
records.text: Poor cleaning and back and forth with customer service who don’t offer refunds just pay money back into your account forcing you to come back with them and that money only lasts 90daysCleaner wasn’t friendly and I paid for own equipment used some of mine

records.title: don't expect too much
records.text: The app is very easy to use, but the service, as expensive as it might be, it's not always consistent. you get offered a "5 start cleaner" which is not always available so the day before you will be assign someone else. even customer service doesn't seem to care as long as you stay in the app and keep paying.

records.title: Terrible first experience
records.text: Terrible first experience. The cleaner came 1:10h late, didn’t apologise, and mainly has done an extremely poor job. She left some areas in the flat untouched, whatever she moved she didn’t put back in place, some dirty countertops were left and the bathroom and toilet was neglected. I’m adding one star for somewhat helpful support but they don’t have a phone line over the weekend so not amazing too.

records.title: Poor end of tenancy clean
records.text: We booked an end of tenancy clean in for our new property and the service was very poor. We expected a more thorough clean for the amount of money we paid. I wishI got my regular cleaner to do this as she’s so much better.

description:
Welcome to Tile Mountain, the one-stop online shop for all your floor and wall tile needs. Founded with over 30 years of expertise in the tile industry, we've become one of the UK's most trusted tile retailers, offering an unrivalled range of high-quality tiles at competitive prices.
Our expansive collection is not just limited to tiles; it includes a diverse range of flooring options to cater to all your needs. From classic ceramics and modern porcelain to designer tiles, we also offer outdoor slabs, vinyl, and laminate flooring. Sourced directly from trusted manufacturers around the globe, we ensure that each product meets our rigorous standards for quality.
Customer experience is paramount to us at Tile Mountain. Utilising a low-cost operating model and an internal escalation process, our dedicated support team works tirelessly to offer you a seamless shopping experience. We understand that choosing the right tile is crucial, which is why we offer a free sample service that delivers cut samples right to your door.
Fast, reliable delivery is another cornerstone of our customer-focused ethos. We pride ourselves on offering prompt deliveries across the UK, enabling you to complete your projects on time.
Your feedback is invaluable. Feel free to browse through our customer reviews to get a sense of what you can expect from Tile Mountain. We appreciate both your positive comments and constructive criticisms.
Contact us for any inquiries. Our customer service team is available via email, phone, and live chat, offering multiple avenues for your convenience.
Thank you for considering Tile Mountain for your tiling needs. We invite you to become a part of our ever-growing community of satisfied customers.
Transform your space today with our stunning tile ranges. Visit our website to explore our offerings and don't forget to share your experience with us here on Trustpilot.

records.title: Problem resolved, end result outstanding
records.text: Problems with payment online so I called in at the Birmingham branch. Service was outstanding, I wish I had gone in person in the first place. We all know problems arise, it's how it gets resolved that's makes the difference. They were brilliant. I will definitely be returning.

records.title: First time ordering 5*…
records.text: First time ordering from tile mountain & they’ve been amazing. Due to a delayed in delivery with the courier outwith there hands they have followed up every day & even phoned today to ensure me it would be delivered today. Highly recommend due to the quality of the service and the tiles themselves.

records.title: Fantastic chat service from Iqra
records.text: Fantastic chat service from Iqra. Speed of response was excellent. My concern was addressed very quickly. I had difficulty ordering a sample. Iqra asked for my details and emailed a quote with a payment option within less than a minute. Many thanks

records.title: Extremely honest and helpful company
records.text: My first time using Tile Mountain and I was sceptical as always when it comes to online! I paid for my sample tile, received confirmation and was sent shipping updates etc. Unfortunately the courier service let me and Tile mountain down by not delivering on said day.I contacted Tile Mountain and got a fast response from Joanna who was most helpful. She found out what had happened and my tile was delivered that day. I was also refunded as an apology for the error. Extremely honest and helpful company. I will be placing my order this week. The tiles are beautiful, exactly how they looked on the website.

records.title: Fabulous customer service
records.text: I had not received my delivery when expected due to an error at there end following an email I sent requesting a change of delivery address. I spoke to Kaz in customer services who was so helpful, polite and apologetic. She arranged for the tiles to be delivered next day and refunded my delivery charge, such a good customer service advisor, turning a negative situation into a very positive experience from my end. A real breath of fresh air these days.A+++++ service Thank you!

records.title: Helpful and knowledgeable
records.text: The help during the enquiry and sale process was an easy and knowledgeable process. The lady I dealt with initially was helpful and matched the tile I needed to add to perfectly.The delivery was fast and all the tiles were intact. Very good experience.

records.title: Samantha was incredibly helpful when…
records.text: Samantha was incredibly helpful when the tiles I liked had been discontinued she made some great suggestions and had samples in the post asap. Great customer service

records.title: Highly recommend
records.text: Beautiful metro tiles that look fantastic in my new kitchen. Easy to order, delivered bang on time, very smooth transaction.

records.title: great lady on the phone did all the…
records.text: great lady on the phone did all the work for me sent me the price i payed two days later the tiles came to my door will recommended 1st class all round wil use again thankyou

records.title: Items matched pictures and description…
records.text: Items matched pictures and description perfectly. Also ordered on a Tuesday night at 10pm and items were delivered Thursday. We don’t like ordering online but we took the risk and it paid off brilliantly.Excellent service thanks very much will always recommend.

records.title: Tiles came good quality
records.text: Tiles came good quality, at a good price, delivery was late hence the star drop, but nearly gave a 5 for the fact that the delivery contractor abandoned the pallet across my pathway wasn't impressed and contacted tile mountain they apologised and refunded a small amount for any disconvenence, proper customer care I'd say we'll done on that one!!!

records.title: Great looking Talent Grey and White tiles ....
records.text: I purchased the great looking Talent white and grey tiles for shower room walls and new extension floor in July and November.  They have only just been laid and waiting for them to be grouted.  Its going to look fabulous when complete.  However, the cleaning of some tiles from cardboard and glue when unpacking them was a challenge!  Otherwise I would have given five stars.

records.title: Excellent response, products and service delivery but was not able to compete on cost on this occasion.
records.text: I requested tile samples from Tile Mountain and one other company. Tile Mountain provided good sized samples faster than the other provider. The tiles were similar (quality, design, weight). The decision to order from the other provider was due to cost: I needed about 45 sq.m and they offered (I assume end-of-line stock) at almost £10 per sq. m cheaper.

records.title: customer service
records.text: Easy to get in touch with the customer service. However I was told that if I want to return my tiles, I have to pay for the courier. It's a shame as being on an online merchant there should be a collection service in place in my opinion. Otherwise all good.

records.title: Ordered some samples
records.text: Ordered some samples. They arrived quite quickly but didn’t end up purchasing as colour wasn’t exactly the same as picture online

records.title: Quick little samples
records.text: Ordered samples. Easy process, prompt delivery. Samples are very small and only indicate the base colours. Great if only need tiles for one room / space and just need to confirm the base colours, or if looking at fairly simple, evenly coloured tiles. For more expensive tiles or those with more pattern / design, the standard free sample isn’t enough for me to make a choice. As I’m doing multiple rooms, buying half size samples could get quite expensive…

records.title: tiles and delivery
records.text: Tiles came without any damage even though they did not arrive as the scheduled date.Great service and communication

records.title: Tile mountain are good value, but…
records.text: Tile mountain are good value; although when I looked at the sample tile they sent it was not the same thickness as described in the listing, it was a couple of mm out. They also gave a super wide delivery window (8-8) which isn’t very helpful. Finally, they are a bit spammy with their emails, I will have to unsubscribe as it’s nearly daily at this point. On top of this, someone from TM called me asking about my experience but they were so obviously keen to hang up I barely got a word in before she said she will email me instead. Why bother calling at all? I have yet to receive the tiles so cannot comment on quality.

records.title: wasn't that impressed by the pallet…
records.text: wasn't that impressed by the pallet delivery - I had to help him lift it down from the lorry.  I mean, I paid to get a kerbside delivery, didn't realise I'd be doing half the work myself.

records.title: Edge Lane Liverpool
records.text: Shopped at Edge Lane Liverpool and their customer service (Scott) was excellent.  Knew the products well and was helpful in follow up calls as I needed to change my original planned delivery date.One small thing to mention was the lorry broke down on the new planned delivery date but the tiles came the next day.

records.title: Great quick delivery service
records.text: Great quick delivery service. Tiles look great but was a little disappointed with the tile variation as it said 22 I think in the print but there was lots of repeat patterns. However the finished bathroom looks stunning. The right installer with pride makes these into a beautiful bathroom.

records.title: Good price and quality materials
records.text: Good price and quality materials. Good delivery schedules. A few tiles were damaged but getting them replaced was prompt and hassle free. Will definitely be using them on future projects.

records.title: Quick service
records.text: Quick service, delivered as promise - securely delivered on a small pallet and the driver kindly placed it in my side alley. My only gripe is the name on the packaging differed to what I ordered so I had to make a call to Tile Mountain.  They advised that Tile Mountain use their own names which differ from the suppliers names.  They should have given me warning of this.  That aside I would recommend using them, I will do.

records.title: Recommend but check pack upon delivery
records.text: Delivery, price and online platform excellent. Unfortunatley I did have a couple packs broken midway down the pallet. Unfortunatley I only realised when my floor layer told me. It did say I had ti check within 24  hours od Delivery but the gent saying them was delayed for 3 days.so I couldn't do anything....but the company very efficient

records.title: Brilliant tiles
records.text: Brilliant tiles, but turned up loose in a van causing breakage

records.title: Great selection of tiles
records.text: Great selection of tiles , awesome colour choices , however it’s a pity their showrooms don’t keep any tiles in at all , not a show stopper but disappointing when you drive an hour to the closest one.Delivery charges … £50 tiles costs £30 to deliver , ridiculous amount .

records.title: Efficient ordering process for samples…
records.text: Efficient ordering process for samples and then the order. Kept me informed about delivery on a Friday afternoon but then the delivery was aborted. There was an extremely helpful response from Customer Services. They refunded the delivery charge and monitored the new delivery time slot.Unfortunately, delivery is to kerbside only by the driver which was a problem for me as an older woman! I had arranged help from my grandson-in-law for the original delivery  time but he was not available the next time.Tiles not yet laid but happy with the quality.

records.title: Sent for a sample tile which arrived…
records.text: Sent for a sample tile which arrived the following day. Lovely colour tile (lime green) phoned custom service as my order wouldn't go through online they were very helpful and sent me a quote to link into, as I live at the end of the country delivery was more but they arrived quickly I'm just waiting for my builder to fit them

records.title: Good online display of tiles
records.text: Good online display of tiles, easy to choose and competitive prices. Also the online calculator saved me hours working out how many I needed!

records.title: Samples order
records.text: Ordered 3 smaples but one arrived incorrect. Contacted team and sam was able to resilve swiftly with the alternative tile requested following a visit to the store. Very impressed with milton keynes store as very well set up and easy to see products.

records.title: Good customer service at the start but…
records.text: Good customer service at the start but didn’t realise you couldn’t return extras

records.title: Beautiful tile
records.text: Beautiful tile, but sadly the postage was too high for this purchase as I only needed one box for my cloakroom

records.title: Company is really good to communicate…
records.text: Company is really good to communicate with. Quick to pick up emails, quick delivery. Quick to rectify issues. My biggest gripe is although the tiles we had look good they are quite expensive for the quality of the tile itself. They are rather thin and every one of them were bowed, the tiler had to clamp them to keep them flat. Delivery needs to be on bigger pallets I had two batches all had one or two corners chipped from lack of protection. MISBAH was good at sorting a partial refund on one tile that arrived on second batch broken. I think half a tile refund isn’t a fantastic compensation as it passes the issue to the tiler to make look good but it’s better than nothing or having to mess around too much with returns etc.

records.title: Poorly cut tiles slightly different and…
records.text: Poorly cut tiles slightly different and out of square, difficult to line up, cheap though so you get what you pay for , look alright once on the wall

records.title: Shocking delivery
records.text: Tiles are great . Look great feel great very happy with the tiles, THE DELIVERY  WAS SHOCKING DID NOT TURN UP DID NOT REPLY  TO EMAIL  .I phone on the next working  day to say I need to rearrange  the delivery  as will not be at home, was told that's fine only for it to turn up that afternoon  when no one home and my elderly neighbour  had to sort it out.

records.title: All ok
records.text: All ok. But if you need tiles on a day they are not available to buy as you can order online or to shop floor only deliveries on Tuesday only. If you are short for couple of tiles you need to wait for a week ?(Tuesday)

records.title: Filter their reviews?
records.text: I can only assume that Tile mountain filter their reviews as the one I left for their Lifeful Blue tiles hasn’t appeared on their website many weeks later despite chasing them.The tiles are not bad, the company is helpful if you approach them the right way but I hate it when they ask you to review their product and then it doesn’t appear on the product page because it’s not a 5 star review.Edit .. Another week goes by an still no review.

records.title: Well when my order came…
records.text: Well when my order came the way it was packaged was wrong,the tiles was packed on the side,I think they should have been laid flat. When unpacking because the way they were packaged one pack fell and cracked all the tile in the pack so I've lost my 10%.Also they randomly put one tile to make up my order but it looks like it came from a different batch number so the shade is different.

records.title: Disappointing, would not purchase again from Tile Mountain.
records.text: I purchased 3 different style of tiles online, floor tiles, wall tiles and skirting tiles which were supposed to match the wall tiles. The skirting tiles were a different shade to the wall tiles, so had to be returned. Tile Mountain would not allow me to return them to the store and had to be posted by courier at my expense. Despite the courier confirming they have delivered the tiles, I am still awaiting my refund and have received no communication from Tile Mountain. The wall tiles were delivered on a pallet wrapped in cellophane and the driver would not wait for me to check them. Several were broken in the same place meaning we did not have enough tiles to complete the job so had to purchase another box through no fault on our part. All in all this has been a poor experience I would not recommend Tile Mountain or buy from them again.

records.title: You need to offer returns on your samples!
records.text: Friendly and helpful staff in the store and you’ve a great selection of tiles but the fact that you don’t offer refunds on your samples forced me to look elsewhere. Tiles look so different in different lights that you need to see them in your home and having to pay approx £20 which is non refundable for a full size tile just doesn’t work for me sadly

records.title: Delivery wasn't great....had to bring…
records.text: Delivery wasn't great....had to bring everything in from a pallet which nearly killed us!  Since I posted this review I have been contacted by Customer Service who offered an apology.  I was impressed with the professional care that was expressed and will order from them again.  A customer feeling appreciated!

records.title: Good delivery, but sizing issues
records.text: Delivery was fine, all on time and tiles were intact. However, unfortunately, many of the tiles were 1mm larger than the majority of them, making it difficult for the tiler to lay them. It took him double the time that he predicted, which has ended up costing me more in labour.

records.title: Mixed reviews
records.text: Positives: Website was easy to use, tiles are lovely, brilliant quality and great customer service helping instantly and easily with pricing query. Negatives: The endless cold calls asking about ‘my thoughts’ on the samples when I already placed the order. And the world’s rudest delivery man I’ve ever encountered (no it wasn’t delivered through a third party). I logged a complaint unfortunately I’m yet to hear a response back.

records.title: Great delivery times but expect to move…
records.text: Great delivery times but expect to move all the tiles yourself. I ordered these for my flat as I don’t have a drive way. I called to check that the tiles could be left by my front door which I was advised could be. I left a note on my order as well to be sure and guess what, I get an email saying it’s only curb side delivery which would mean they are leaving my tiles on the street. How they think I can move all the tiles by myself I have no clue!! Never had this when I have ordered tiles before from other companies, I have always had the tiles brought round to my door.

records.title: Tile mountain gave excellent service…
records.text: Tile mountain gave excellent service but were let down by their carriers.  DHL gave a time slot of between 8am & 6pm but the day before delivery a different carrier, Apollo, gave a time slot of between 7am & 9pm.  As I was going out at 7pm it left me feeling unsettled.  The delivery itself was carried out very efficiently by Louise at 9.10 am but obviously you cannot rely on the time given

records.title: Om My second delivery in 3 weeks 2…
records.text: Om My second delivery in 3 weeks 2 boxes of tiles broken, 18 long tiles, all visible broken exactly unde the fragil sign, I wonder why delivery guy run that quick before to tell him to take the tiles back.I requested my refund for 2 boxes and when I complain on the website customer service I've Ben asked a ridiculous question ' can you use the broken tiles on the corners' this make me feel more angry. Please guys, check asap in front of  delivery driver your order.Order was delivered in Norwich NR5 0SXI have requested refund which was approved

records.title: 4mm without underlay is bad choice
records.text: Delivery was on time.Material was disappointing. 4mm thickness is no good. Easily broken on edge locking. I wouldn't recommend this material. It's extremely fragile on edges where it needed to interconnect planks.

records.title: Tiles were not the same shade as…
records.text: Tiles were not the same shade as before, which mean repair was more visible than ideal.

records.title: Good price . 50% tile damaged on delivery. All Tile replaced by tile mountain team. But it some time ..very annoying when you are losing money.Careful -Some drivers deliver on the kerbside .
records.text: Good price . 50% tile damaged on delivery…we were worried about quality of tiles. All Tiles replaced by tile mountain team. But it took some time . This was very annoying when you are losing money . Careful -Some drivers deliver on the kerbside only. One of the driver was excellent and delivered all tile in designated area on site.

records.title: Mixed Experienced
records.text: Very easy to deal with when ordering tiles, helpful, knowledgeable, great tiles.  However,    I needed to order additional tiles due to breakages.  I picked up 2 boxes, only used 1 box but was told I could not return the other, completely untouched, the day after.  Company policy, I was told.  Very customer UNFRIENDLY, considering how much money I have spent with them.  So beware, only customer friendly until they get your money off you.

records.title: No return/refund policy on UNOPENED NOT…
records.text: No return/refund policy on UNOPENED NOT NEED boxes of tiles 😫👎🏾

records.title: Delivery date mix up
records.text: Asked to add some tiles to an existing order, I was told this was done and they'd come the same day as originally planned which was a huge relief. Just found out the sales person didn't make sure the delivery date was the same on the system, so I have people waiting to fit tiles and no tiles arriving until next week. Offered a 50% refund on the delivery fee (£15), but that doesn't get my bathroom finished as the fitters are moving to another job.

records.title: Disappointing LVT
records.text: *I have tried to upload photos but Tile Mountain have turned off this option* We purchased the Watson almond luxury vinyl flooring in November 2022, it has been down less than two years and has been a real disappointment. The flooring is scratched and damaged on some edges, it is not very well made or durable. We are a no shoes house, and the flooring now looks awful. We have occasional visits from my parents collie dog, and the floor was instantly scratched so a definite no no if you have pets at home. We saved for flooring and had it laid by a professional thinking it would last a number of years but instead we are now looking at what we can do to replace or repair (although this colour now appears to be discontinued). The flooring we had previously was the cheapest wickes laminate flooring and was 10x better than this. We should have realised when a number of packs arrived damaged, it really is very flimsy. Perhaps it’s just a LVT thing but we certainly wouldn’t recommend purchasing the Watson luxury vinyl click flooring range.

records.title: The tiles I ordered were rosette white stone effect Matt porcelain tile
records.text: The tiles I ordered were Rosetta white stone effect tile. In the picture on the website and the sample I received looked more like cream colour. But they look grey now they’re down which wasn’t the colour I was going for so very disappointed. Think your pictures need to be much more clearer on the website.

records.title: Online orders cannot be returned to store
records.text: Working with poorly levelled concrete in courtyard, no way of figuring out what volume leveller to pour, peaks and valleys everywhere. Bought 11 bags Larsen Levelling compound (10+1 extra). Product was decent, but ended up with 5 unused bags. Found store nearby to return and get more supplies, took the 5 bags to store. At desk, told to ring head office for return. Head office said to take to Stoke warehouse 50 miles away. Stuck with 5 unused bags in mint condition.

records.title: Wrongly dispatched order
records.text: I placed my order with you the day before we were due to go on holiday.I went to pick them up at 4;30 on Thursday 29th August.The warehouse assistant was sorting through the boxes of tiles, and somehow managed to give 2 wrong boxes of cliff granite grey tiles and 1 of the correct cliff grey tiles.Now the builder has a dilemma that there may not be enough of the cliff grey tiles to complete the job.

records.title: Half the tiles arrived broken…
records.text: Over half the tiles on my order arrived smashed or chipped. In order to get them replaced I had to provide photos of every single damaged one which involved shifting 60+ 600x300 tiles out into a drive to photo. It was evident from the courier that the product had been damaged between tile mountain and the courier but still felt like I doing the hard work for someone else’s error. Eventually they agreed to replace but it’s set me back 3 days on this job and no offer of any compensation or good will.

records.title: Not very customer friendly
records.text: A number of tiles were delivered broken. Only a discount of 50% offered on broken tiles. This may be industry standard but if I wanted broken tiles I would have ordered them. Attitude of customer service was poor. Immediately led with a passive aggressive response. I required to check the whole order which was large as they only provide one refund per order. Quite a demand which they then chivied me to get on and do. Delivering damaged goods didn’t seem to bother them much.

records.title: I would have truly given tile mountain…
records.text: I would have truly given tile mountain 5 stars if it was not for the delivery firm they used.  Absolute jokers.  Would not deliver onto my driveway.  Kerbside drop off only.  Happy to dump my goods worth over £700 onto the public side walk. Either I accepted this or they would not deliver.  Had to call family members to help.

records.title: Very poorly packaged
records.text: Very poorly packaged. Tiles arrived in a very unstable package. Was dangerously to unload and required multiple people to unpack safely.  Amazingly they were not broken on transport or delivered snd when we had to unpackaged to make safe for storage. Tile themselves lovely quick delivery.

description: London's longest established professional Handyman Service providing a reliable service at a predictable cost. In 2001, 0800 Handyman (then known as Redjacks) was the first of its kind to offer a scooter based professional handyman service in and around London.  Purchased in 2007 by The Zockoll Group, the founding parent of Dyno-Rod (1963-2004), 0800 Handyman offers a full service from Handymen and Decorators to Electricians and Plumbers. Applying Zockoll’s fifty-five plus years of experience for service excellence is at the core of our business, we understand customer needs and consistently delivering on them combined with competitive prices and specialist people we offer a service that consistently receives customer approval.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Khalil at AZ Electrical did  a superb job.  Prompt tidy and efficient.  He even performed acrobatics to change a bulb over my double bed.  Would definitely use again.

records.title: Have used 0800Handyman for many years…
records.text: Have used 0800Handyman for many years for a wide range of household handyman jobs in London.    Have found them efficient and quick.  Today Colin visited and he completed all 4 jobs in 20 minutes and then fixed a couple of other minor issues for me within half-an-hour.  Reliable timekeeping - usually at least 5 minutes early.

records.title: Very Impressed!
records.text: We needed repairs and some redecorating work done due to water damage.Steve came over and gave us a quote.  Once we had settled on a start date, he was prompt every day, very efficient and nothing was too much trouble.A great and seamless experience with a very personable man.Will definitely use these services again.

records.title: I’ve just enjoyed exceptional service…
records.text: I’ve just enjoyed exceptional service once again from 0800 Handyman.  Absolutely the best in the business!! 100% reliable - efficient - great value for money and super talented.  Colin was able to re-grout my two bathrooms, change door handles, change light bulbs, take down blinds, fit a new smoke alarm with absolutely no fuss or bother.  Just quietly getting on with everything.   Super professional and lovely with it.  Brilliant can-do attitude, helpful and cheerful.  Thank you a million time over.

records.title: Our business has been using 0800…
records.text: Our business has been using 0800 Handyman for longer than I can remember - for those small jobs which it can be difficult to get a workman: general handyman work, plumbing, electrical, decorating, and more. They supply the right workman at short notice - sometimes the same day as the initial call to them. Pricing is simple, clear and sensible.  No job too small - so far no job too big. They are always our first call for a handyman - we don't need to make a second call to anyone else.

records.title: Speedy Handyman
records.text: First of all the Handyman arrived 3 minutes early.I had ceiling lightbulbs to fix, which involved getting out the ladder from my basement, also a curtain come off its rail which could only be temporarily fixed as hooks had disintegrated.  All done with speed & efficiency.

records.title: Very helpful
records.text: Very helpful - thanksI was v pleased to have help with carrying out food and equipment, setting up Gazebos and Tables etc for our annual summer party. This was on one of the hottest days of the year and the assistance of the two 'Handymen' was invaluable and made it a lot less stressful. Next time I will mention we need to bring a trolley too :) Thanks for good-humoured assistance, it was much appreciated.

records.title: Consistent high quality work, great service. I have used 0800 handyman...
records.text: I have used 0800 Handyman on a range of jobs for over 5 years.  Jobs have included carpentry, minor electric and plumbing works, painting and general handyman tasks like putting up paintings and shelves.  The service is consistently excellent, including many jobs completed on short notice, and the quality of the work high.  On the one occasion where work has not been to standard, they promptly resolved the issue through sending a new tradesman and did not charge for the work that was not properly done.  A reliable company which stands behind their work and I will continue to use them without hesitation. AS

records.title: Good and quick service.
records.text: Handyman appeared on time as per the agreed time slot. Repaired what was to be repaired, quick and didn't request any involvement from my side. Colin listened to my concerns and took all into consideration while repairing damaged pump . I am very satisfy with Colin East

records.title: Really helpful company
records.text: Really helpful company. Needed an electrician to relocate an oven isolation switch.Electrician called, gave a me a reasonable quote, and the work was done with out any trouble a few days later. Turned up on time, worked quickly, and installed my new oven. No problems whatsoever.

records.title: Carpenter
records.text: The carpenter  was on time and performed the work to a very standard. I would be happy to recommend your firm to others. Many thanks.Patrick Hennessy

records.title: We will use again,
records.text: We have used 0800 handyman for several years and they have always been great. On this occasion due to sickness isolating etc they had problems with a last minute cancellation and then, perhaps because Matt the dispatcher was off, twice inappropriate plumbers without the specialist knowledge needed, were sent. When Matt returned he sorted everything out we welcomed an excellent plumber who dealt with the magaflow boiler promptly. We were pretty irritated with the abortive visits especially since I had described exactly what the problem was but we weren't charged for them and we all need to make allowances for difficult times. Having said that they were all on time and when they cancelled the first visit they let me know. We will be happy to use them again.

records.title: Replaced smoke alarm battery in very…
records.text: Replaced smoke alarm battery in very hard to reach location. Prompt and efficient.

records.title: Used for electrian and handyman work
records.text: Used for electrian and handyman work. Broadly satisfied- transparent charging system. One small issue was electrian appeared slightly unprepared as turned up with no step ladder despite this being necessary for job. However this was not major as I needed to buy one anyway

records.title: Really good service thank you and Colin…
records.text: Really good service thank you and Colin was excellent. I would have given 5 stars, but the prices are just a little too high.

records.title: Electrician was very prompt and…
records.text: Electrician was very prompt and efficient  Did a great job. Would definitely used again.

records.title: Friendly and helpful service
records.text: Friendly and helpful service.  Work was carried out in a timely fashion and to spec.  Thanks. One less star as the electrician did not answer a text.

records.title: Not always the cheapest but on time and do a good job
records.text: My company manage a small block of 6 flats in London and before now we've been using smaller independent handymen. It's great to support small independent businesses (and often a bit cheaper) but you get what you pay for. We've now used 0800 handyman for a few jobs and they've always arrived on time and our tenants have always been very happy with the service. They've always got someone available with a few days notice.

records.title: Very good service
records.text: I was a little concerned at first as my appointment was changed twice, however I decided to go for 3rd time lucky ........ and I was not disappointed.  The chap turned up on time and was extremely friendly, very helpful and got on with the jobs I needed him to do. This job was for my company (who are going to now set up an account with them based on this experience) ....... and I personally would be happy to use them at home if the need ever arises.

records.title: Prompt, efficient, but damn expensive!
records.text: The handyman service was booked with great ease; I phoned the office and successfully booked a handyman to come around the very next day to fix a few things around the house. The handyman arrived on time, was friendly, knew what he was doing, and got the job done well. HOWEVER, it was expensive, expect to pay £60 per hour for labour, plus 20% VAT (£12), plus any extra materials used to complete the job. Combine this with the fact that if you have a lot of jobs to do, than the costs will add up. Just be prepared to pay more than anticipated.

records.title: Flush and very Handy
records.text: Having used 0800 Handyman on two occasions, there is no problem with having to supervise, every step of repair is explained and the concerned area is left, as it is found. All in all a service which can very much be relayed on, and good value for money.

records.title: Good
records.text: Good. Thank you.

records.title: repair of cabinet draw runners
records.text: good work thanks

records.title: Job complete but rude workman
records.text: The work that needed doing appears to have been successful, however the handyman who arrived was extremely inconsiderate. Our front door had been recently painted (it was still wet), so was left slightly ajar to dry. I had deliberately put a sign up next to the doorbell indicating our flat number. The workman brazenly walked straight into the house without ringing the bell, asking if this was the correct flat. I was shocked that they came in suddenly with no warning at all and no apology; it was quite frankly unacceptable behaviour, particularly during Covid-19 and that we are a house of 3 girls in our early twenties. The man didn't speak much English and was totally dismissive of all my questions. Not hugely impressed.

records.title: The job got done ok but wasn’t happy…
records.text: The job got done ok but wasn’t happy with the person who carried it out. Not only he didn’t even bother to ask if I wanted him to wear a mask and he didn’t have one. Also his attitude was Just not a nice one and I wouldn’t like to have him again.

records.title: Rude workman, overcharged, poor customer service
records.text: The plumber spent more time than agreed and although he came for a pre-visit he still went out for one hour (at lunchtime) to get some spare parts. We were charged more than they had estimated although the job was not complicated. The workman was rude and swore at my husband when he questioned the bill. Poor customer service too. I do not recommend at all.

records.title: Very polite and fix the jobs very…
records.text: Very polite and fix the jobs very quicky.

records.title: Not for the time poor
records.text: Based on previous reviews I was a little anxious about using this handyman service, but I'd struggled to actually contact a independent handyman direct, I was finding I was leaving a lot of voicemails/sending a lot of emails and getting no response. The major benefit I found with 0800 handyman was being able to go and speak to someone face to face, explain the job and get a time/cost estimate. On the day of the job, it got to 9:15am and there was no sign of the handyman I had been told to expect at 9. I rang the office and they said he had bailed and wouldn't be coming. Not the best start. Another handyman was located fairly promptly and he arrived at 10:15.I am pleased with the quality of the majority of work carried out, particularly fitting a new lock mechanism into the bedroom door. The exception being a shelf in the bathroom cabinet which needed tightening. He asked if I would need to be able to move it in the future, and I said no, so I assumed he would be gluing it. Fine. He used some kind of clear filler which has not set solidly (24 hours later), I could have done a better job with a tube of super glue.  I was also a little surprised when it took 5 hours instead of the estimated 3, and when his mate turned up to help him "get the job done quicker". This just meant I paid for two people instead of one.In summary, if you are time poor then I would probably avoid. I was able to be flexible, and as a result the job was carried out quickly, cleanly and to a standard I am pleased with (for the most part).

records.title: I had a terrible experience with…
records.text: I had a terrible experience with 0800Handyman. Despite asking for a very simple and straightforward job - hanging artwork- the “handyman” drilled a hole far higher than I requested and then hung the art by the frame, rather than the rope at the back, thereby causing the frame to warp and snap within a few weeks. Honestly, the work couldn’t have been less professional (and costly to me). The company apologised  but no offer of refund. Look elsewhere, they’re not worth your time, patience or cash.

records.title: Terrible Service. Avoid!
records.text: I booked a handyman to do two simple jobs - the first day he didn't bother to turn up whilst I waited home with the  kids. There was no courtesy phone call to let me know he was late - let alone that he wouldn't bother turning up at all. He turned up the next day LATE again, took three hours to complete the jobs and left me house in a state. He failed to sweep up use a dust sheet, used my stuff including glues etc and then had the audacity to charge for light bulbs. NEVER AGAIN.

records.title: Unfortunately Expensive
records.text: I booked one of their handymen to paint my front door, inside and outside, and re-caulk my kitchen working top. I was not happy with the overall tally of charges.Despite rain being a visitor, and the handyman therefore being unable to complete the job, he spent an additional two extra hours at the property. I would like to point out that he told me he would not charge me for an additional hour to the half day rate which I booked him for. In fact he ended up charging me for two.Although he was absolutely pleasant of demeanour, I am still struggling, very much indeed, to work out just why it took him so long to undertake such basic, basic work.The company refused to clarify why they quoted me for a half day rate for a job that, even unfinished, ended up taking a two further hours.I booked their services because of the appearance of fixed prices – no hidden charges. However, I felt utterly let me down by the fact they charged me for two hours more.Not only that, but I will also had to finish the job myself.In my opinion, the handyman could have spent three hours on site to prepare the door and apply initial coats, and then return at a later date to finish the job, rather than hanging about on site to, seemingly, put extra burden on my finances.

records.title: Check your invoice before paying!
records.text: The plumber went out for an hour to get a part which was wrong - a mistake he charged me for. Also when the invoice came, it charged the costings quoted on their website for 1 hours work for half an hours work - check your invoices before paying!

records.title: Hopelessly overpriced - turn up without tools
records.text: Hopelessly overpriced. Turned up without required tools to do a pre-advised job. Had to return with tools another time. I was charged twice (!!) for the service - allegedly took 5 hours to do a straight replacement of a cooker-hood.When I pointed this out I was told the invoice would go to a debt collection service if I didn't pay immediately.Daylight robbery, stay well clear.

records.title: This company is an absolute joke
records.text: This company is an absolute joke! DO NOT USE!!! I have never come across a company that is so unreliable it is ridiculous. The past three times I have booked a handyman no one has turned up, I have had to call in to chase only to be told that the handyman won't be coming in. I could go on and on but honestly just do yourself a favour and don't bother with these people!

records.title: Really poor experience
records.text: Really poor experience. The handyman that was sent by the Putney branch had no idea how to sort out some basic repairs we needed, spent ten minutes muttering to himself and looking tbrough his bag, then made the problem worse on a cabinet door which is now stuck, and then charged £60 plus VAT for the privilege. I hadn’t used up the whole hour and still had things I needed done in the house (basic things like hanging up paintings that even he should have been able tondo) but I just couldn’t bear the idea of more inadequate attempts. Avoid.

records.title: What Happened?
records.text: Been using this company for a long time for all sorts of stuff here in the office. Last job they came in for, they actually ended up breaking something i called them in to do a job on. Very unprofessional outcome. Not only was the item left in an absolute state, no apology has been given and now they refuse to compensate............! Have never really had a problem with these guys, but this completely unacceptable.Wont ever be using them again despite our long work relationship.

records.title: Bad service
records.text: Appointment was made a day in advance for 8am repair. At 9.30am I called the company to be told the workman had not turned up and they could not send anyone else. The company should have advised me at 8am when the workmen did not turn up. Why did I have to wait 1.5 hours and then call the company myself. Bad service. Regarding reply from 0800Handyman: You did not let me know. I called you. You did not offer me another appointment today, you offered an appointment tomorrow. Please get facts straight.

records.title: Terrible Service and Rude
records.text: Very expensive, shoddy workmanship and poor customer service - avoid like the plague.  I had to get another plumber out to deal with the problem, however disputed my claim and implied it was fabricated...  don't even call these guys in an emergency!

description: You will find everything you need to refresh your home with your dream floor here at UK Flooring Direct, the UK’s leading online flooring specialist. Whatever your flooring needs, from premium solid wood, to budget-friendly vinyl and laminate, to all the accessories in between, we've got you covered. Plus, they're all safely stocked in our Coventry site, so that we can get your orders to you as soon as possible. Suitable for every room in your house, including your kitchen, bathroom, lounge, bedroom, conservatory or hallway – there’s something for everyone’s personal style. Simply browse through our easy to use website, get in touch with our friendly Flooring Experts at 02476 012 840 or chat to us online via our LiveChat service.

records.title: Great customer service!!
records.text: Davinder from Lauren's team was absolutely great. He looked into delivery difficulties for us and helped get a great quote for our flooring. One happy customer! Would definitely purchase again from here.

records.title: Was good from start to finish from…
records.text: Was good from start to finish from ordering samples to placing the order! when I called to place my order I had help from Casey from Lauren’s team, she was a big help in making sure I got what I needed and the process was made quick and easy!

records.title: quick and useful advise
records.text: quick and useful advice, livechat a breeze to use and Junaid helped with a bulk buy discount as well as setting up interest free credit which was perfect for my needs.

records.title: Hi great company to deal with
records.text: Hi great company to deal with. Junaid in particular dealt with my order. Couldn’t be more helpful. Would recommend to friends and family.

records.title: Amazing service
records.text: Amazing service, and very quick responses. Really appreciate your help Davinder and Lauren! Looking forward to my new flooring!

records.title: Casey Begley was very helpful over the…
records.text: Casey Begley was very helpful over the phone. She was efficient and thoughtful, and was able to get me a discount which I had not expected. Thank you, Casey!Jeanne

records.title: Fantastic service ordered and on its…
records.text: Fantastic service ordered and on its way within 2 hours that service has got to get a 10 out of 10. Used this company before and had the same service each time.

records.title: help on warranty & finding my floor
records.text: Junaid Shaikh, was very helpful got me exactly what i was looking for and very quick to respond, great help.Thankyou

records.title: Idah was really helpful
records.text: Idah was really helpful and knowledgeable about the product. Have bought a number of times from this company and customer service is excellent.

records.title: Fantastic service by Davinder and…
records.text: Fantastic service by Davinder and Lauren, really pleased with my purchase!

records.title: I was told to contact the sales team it…
records.text: I was told to contact the sales team it was sorted very quickly and loaded in the car quick ascwell

records.title: Better packaging required
records.text: All good until delivery, UK Flooring used a lit weight pallet for 184kg delivery. Pallet damaged, load had to dismantled and hand carried. A little more care required when dispatching.

records.title: Quality flooring
records.text: Flooring is lovely and good quality. I didn’t order enough but the customer service to assist me was excellent. The edging wasn’t a good match and the door trim was too bulky but I would definitely recommend this company.

records.title: Hall flooring
records.text: Ordered 3 samples first & they arrived free of charge, after choosing my flooring I ordered it & it arrived as advised & on a pallet.If I have any downside I would have to say that sinc ordering samples I have been inundated with emails & texts from UK Flooring direct which is a bit of a pain.

records.title: Ok in the end
records.text: Ok in the end, all arrived fine. Haven't actually laid the floor yet but the packages seem to be in good order. The customer service is very very difficult to get ahold of mind, if you need to ring them make sure you find a comfy place to sit for a good hour.

records.title: I can't write a review on something I…
records.text: I can't write a review on something I haven't had. The delivery date has been changed 3 times.Today 5th December they delivered the scotias but no laminate When the laminateturned up on the 6th it didn't disappoint and I will be ordering more in the new year.

records.title: A wide variety of colours
records.text: A wide variety of colours, fittings etc. Free samples arrived within 24 hours.  Did have a little problem placing order as did not get arranged call back and ended up having to contact them myself. Other than that a great experience.

records.title: We are very happy with the final product.
records.text: Our contractor got us to order, ordering was easy. The delivery of the pallet by specialist pallet courier was a day early, all looked ok. The contractor laid the floor, only to discover just at the end that one of the boxes had clearly been damaged by a forklift truck and we ended up being 2 pieces short, which was annoying as the contractor could not finish as planned. I called and emailed and a replacement box was sent by courier with no questions after viewing photographic evidence. On opening the replacement box, 3 pieces had corner damage - luckily we only needed 2 pieces!!  I guess there are risks with a courier delivery and a heavy package... I would suggest opening all boxes on delivery. We are very happy with the final product.

records.title: Good variety of flooring available
records.text: Good variety of flooring availableI order a number of different samples which was invaluable in helping me see the quality and colour of the flooring. In addition, I had great support from Davinder Tiensa who answered all my questions before choosing the flooring that I ordered.I would not have been able to choose the flooring without his help.I would have given the review 5 stars, if they could deliver next day.

records.title: Ordered very easy delivery quick only…
records.text: Ordered very easy delivery quick only thing pallet damaged during delivery. 2 boxes and vinyl flooring damaged. Waiting a response and replacement hopefully. Flooring very nice and good quality shame about the packing very flimsy. A lot of boxes open and flooring exposed. Hanse damaged in transit.

records.title: I started looking for wood floors back…
records.text: I started looking for wood floors back in the summer. I spoke to Junaid Shaikh who was so helpful. I drove him mad with questions and requesting samples!  He was very helpful and patient. Eventually settled on the choice of  flooring. Junaid has made the process stress free.  Now waiting for delivery which has been delayed at my request. Would highly recommend Junaid.

records.title: Getting floored
records.text: Ordered 38m2 or 11 packs , made sure delivery was friday 15th Nov 9am to 5pm but it was dropped off at 11.15 am on Thursday no problem with that but would have been a problem if nobody was here .
