Checked all packaging 1 pack had been ripped opened up and 3 boards damaged but ill use those boards on cuttings so not so bad.  Flooring well packaged though can't fault them and price of materials was good delivery cost £33 but with it being £10 m2 it worked out fine I'd give them 7/10 being honest

records.title: Still have not got my samples despite…
records.text: Still have not got my samples despite numerous advertising emails from you. Courier states they were unable to deliver earlier in the week and would send them the next working day. Not here today!! Problem with delivery company and not UK Flooring.

records.title: Plenty of choice in type and style.
records.text: Plenty of choice in type, style and colours etc. I did have one issue with placing the order. I was promised a call back to help me complete my order which was not forthcoming. In the end I had to chase this up myself. Other than this everything went well. Order was delivered within three working days, on time, and as arranged. I also received a call from the delivery driver 45 minutes before delivery, to check I was in, and to let me know that my items would be with me shortly. I found this useful.

records.title: Great customer service when we needed…
records.text: Great customer service when we needed to change date of delivery, delivery company is poor though, no live tracking or phone call, cannot be expected to wait from 9-5pm because a signature is required!!!!

records.title: Nice quality and quick delivery…overall…
records.text: Nice quality and quick delivery…overall happy with the way it looks.Joints were really tight to knock together on the ends and the installation kit plastic block broke pretty quickly. Had to make a decent one myself which meant the kit was a waste of money.

records.title: Excellent service from ordering to…
records.text: Excellent service from ordering to delivery.   Delivery arrived within 3 working days.  Products are excellent quality.  The only reason I did not give 5 stars, is because they do not deliver on Saturday's, this makes it very difficult when you work fulltime.

records.title: Overcame issues and provided great customer service
records.text: so we didn't have the most straight forward experience, however the company dealt with us really well. There was a glitch in their system which meant our order was delayed but they compensated us so quickly and the flooring then arrived on time and now it's been fitted it looks amazing!

records.title: Delivery complications
records.text: Received today. The price was great, however the delivery arrived without notice and this caused a delay for the driver and inconvenience for us. We had been advised that we would receive a 30min notice but this didn't happen and the tracker was inaccurate.

records.title: Great product, shame about delivery!
records.text: Flooring product and service from your company was definitely 5 stars.   Unfortunately the courier company was another story!  I have a severely bad back so cannot lift the package myself, however they refused to take one single step inside my house, leaving me to unpack and remove floor tiles one by one into the house!! Not at all helpful or considerate!

records.title: Lots of beautiful samples to choose…
records.text: Lots of beautiful samples to choose from,, ordered a few grey laminate samples nd received a lovely pack of some fab designs, much appreciated for the help nd choice was on another level huge thumbs up 👌

records.title: Audacity 12mm Laminate Tile White Marble Built-in Underlay
records.text: Audacity 12mm Laminate Tile White Marble Built-in UnderlayI am not sure if this product is specifically produced for UK Flooring direct but but I need to advise of the quality of the product. I have had no issues with UK Flooring direct itself. The product was delivered with some damage to the boxes and some boards were not usable but since we ordered well over the waste accountability we had plenty to finish the floor. The laminate itself is very disappointing. The joint click in me mechanism (only way I can describe it) would get damaged easily. We didn't think much of it at the time but we've installed it June and since then we've noticed some tiles sink in on the joint connection when you step on them. Also, IT CHIPS SOOO EASILY! this comes from a person who's had all type of laminate across my previous homes and I've never had any issues like this! I dropped my phone the other day and chipped the floor!!! I don't think this will last for as long as an average laminate would. I rated 3 starts simply because of the poor quality product sold.

records.title: I normally give 5 stars for companies…
records.text: I normally give 5 stars for companies such as this, BUT, so far I have only obtained samples (which came very quickly indeed),for a project next year, and EVERY DAY I get pestered with enless emails pushing my project. Sometimes like today four at a time. To date I must have received 20+ emails and although I possibly understand the motive it has really made me mad with this endless onslaught.This is both off-putting and totally unnecessary in my view as well as counter productive.The products are good which is why I came to them for my next project.

records.title: Flooring Direct is fab, but the quality is lacking.
records.text: I can't fault Flooring Direct, from ordering to delivery, it was exceptional but the quality of the flooring we bought really isn't anything to shout about. Our installer commented on how fragile the LVT was compared to others he's worked with. It's been in for around 6 weeks and we already have lots of unexplained scratches/chips - we're not rough with the floor and nothing heavy has fallen etc to make the chips. It's really quite upsetting given how much we spent on the floor and it is so ridiculously fragile that now we're pretty much scared to walk on it because of how fragile it is. We ordered the 'Spectra Luxury Rigid Core Click Vinyl Flooring Light Fawn Oak Plank'

records.title: Service was fab, but quality is lacking
records.text: The service was fab, but the quality of the floor is lacking, we spent almost £1,000 on Spectra Luxury Rigid Core Click Vinyl Flooring Light Fawn Oak Plank and roughly 6 weeks after installations we have many cracks and chips. Our installer commented on how fragile it was and the amount of damage it has without any known 'accidents' is really upsetting. We are not rough or in anyway destructive. This is just everyday wear and tear like I said with no answer for some of the damage because it seems to have happened without even noticing. I can't recommend this flooring and in fact recommend you steer clear of this particular style.

records.title: My flooring arrived with significant …
records.text: My flooring arrived with significant  damaged wet,and muddy.This is down to the currier service,it was not very well packaged product hanging over the edge of the pallet leaving it vunrable to damage.I did.get a full refund from my order but it was quite stressful. They must sell lots of products and things go very well it was unfortunate that I experienced issues, sh....t happens.

records.title: Was told what score to give but thought…
records.text: Was told what score to give but thought it was to be based on my overall experience. Wasn't going to get the correct discount until I prompted for it. Would have been 4 stars but didn't like being told to give 5 stars so dropped an extra one. Product is okay, as expected for the price.

records.title: Delivery costs put me off
records.text: Very efficient at sending the sample and liked the product. The price online was good and I started to order. However the delivery charge of over £30 put me off. It wasn't a large delivery (5 square meters of laminate) and I don't live anywhere out of the way but the delivery was 1/5th of the total cost. Other outlets were a little more expensive for the product but with free delivery were much more affordable.  Shame cos I liked the product. Don't need free delivery but this was far too much

records.title: Hard sell not for me.
records.text: To be honest. The constant " chase" since placing my samples order i find off putting. You even asked for a " how did we do "review immediately after sample order placement. I've had several email chasers too. Candidly " hard sell and marketing ' strategies such as this dissuade me. Not all of us are the same. Please consider this as an even better if observation.  Thanks

records.title: Damaged and no reply
records.text: Sadly the flooring I received was damaged. The damage was identified by the fitter as he was about to fit it. I wrote to the supplier straight away asking for advice but didn’t receive a reply. I tried again in bother email but still no reply. Very sad as a previous order was faultless

records.title: quick and easy to order
records.text: quick and easy to order. Delivery company not the greatest always deliver a day or even two after they originally say it will be delivered.

records.title: Lack of tracking and delivery info
records.text: The sample came quickly and ordering was easy. But after that information relating to delivery was wrong. There is no text message or email the day of delivery, we had kerbside drop off. I called to confirm delivery and advised the driver would phone. No phone call. Just turned up. Lucky I had people available to carry indoors. Driver advised their delivery company don't do phone calls and apologised we were misinformed. The driver was helpful and polite though and helped us carry it indoors. Fault lies with UK flooring direct.

records.title: Great service, poor product
records.text: Order process was very easy and smooth as was delivery of LVT flooring however the quality of the product was poor. Every plank had a flaw, imperfection or damage. To be fair I received a refund straight away ( less shipping)

records.title: Product good, delivery and service let it down
records.text: The product was good and the website works just fine. The problem is that I have twice ordered and both times the delivery has been a week late. No communication about why the delay happened or even that it was going to happen, I had to call (with the rather long hold time) to find out. Both times we have had to rearrange the installer and go without flooring for a week.Again, no problem with the product but DO NOT plan around your selected delivery slot.

records.title: A nightmare return service
records.text: The delivery and wood itself have been ok. However the attempt to return some items, that I was erroneously advised to buy, has been a kafkaesque nightmare. For 4 times I had to organise a pick-up that never happened. I stayed at home from work and each time the pick-up was cancelled with no notification from UK Flooring or the pickup service, having to call over and over again with no success in getting the pieces picked up. Currently still waiting. Staff has been polite but not helpful.---21 oct It was painful but eventually the pick-up was organised and I got my refund.

records.title: Delivery was poor with elements turning…
records.text: Delivery was poor with elements turning up at different times, also kerbside delivery is the only option and when you have a pregnant wife they delivery guys just left it in the middle of the drive way. Product when not defective is pretty good but one whole pack + a few stray boards had delaminated from the board so completely unusable. Product does go together well but all in all not the best.

records.title: Very slow delivery and poor…
records.text: Very slow delivery and poor communication. Happy with the product

records.title: Looks great but a pain to install
records.text: Loved the look of the flooring (Life Classic Oak Herringbone) throughout our entire downstairs space. However, the installation was a pain. 5 flooring companies refused to lay the product after seeing the product and how it clicked together. Was advised it would take a day to install but ended up taking over a week, at increased expense. Very fiddly when installing under door frames due to the 45 degree lock and fold. Edges break easily if you need to undo any boards. Lots of wasted product (over 20%).Would be okay for a simple, straight sided room. Maybe think about glue down LVT for anything more complex...

records.title: Flooring is good quality but order samples
records.text: So the flooring itself looks good quality and looks nice laid, however the colour is nothing like the picture on the website. I would advise to order samples so you are not disappointed. I also never recieved the scotia i ordered. The customer service chat is basic and not very helpful! Measure your floor very carefully because you will have to pay to return any left over flooring.

records.title: Flooring came and one pack is…
records.text: Flooring came and one pack is completely ruined conveniently and the bottom of the pallet 27 packs in total... contacted there customer services online and no one has got back to me!! Not impressed I need another pack to finish my flooring! Also to mention they are passing off the flooring as 'series' but Swiss krono was delivered instead very misleading!

records.title: Nice floor, shame about the couriers they now use
records.text: Third time of ordering from this company. Never had an issue before with the courier service they used. This time, completely unacceptable. £34 for kerbside delivery, which we didnt realise when ordering. The young guy refused point blank to even assist us with bringing it to the porch (saying he wasnt allowed) and  He wouldnt even cut the binding strapping the flooring to the pallet (we only ordered 4 packs!) And he also refused to take the pallet back with him leaving us with the issue of disposing of it. We are elderly and this was a struggle for us. Previous 2 deliveries have never had such unhelpful courier. Rude, unprofessional and a complete jobsworth.

records.title: Absolutely terrible company
records.text: Absolutely terrible company, they have got to be the worst example of a "none communicating" business that in my 40 years in the social housing sector I have ever had the displeasure of doing business with.Order placed: company was brilliant, rapid response,then, 3 packs of flooring arrived cling film wrapped damaged stock, 2 packs where eventually replaced after initially being informed that they would be delivered in 2 days, a day later an email arrived stating no stock and a 6 week wait?After several complaints and citing that we where now left with a safeguarding issue for our 3 yr old foster daughter ( unfinished flooring /trip / toe stub hazard) we where then told that 2 packs where taken from another customers order? And would be delivered two days later, we stayed home all day, no delivery, zero contact from UKFD my wife then phoned to have an unbelievable response of " as it's a discontinued product"?? Then our dispatcher cancelled the order, so when did you intend to let us know we weren't getting a delivery.We where then told a courier would deliver the following Monday, again stayed home all day,no delivery, I phoned the courier who's response was, oh our driver was too busy ,you should get it tomorrow? Again zero communication from the courier.We raised a complaint with UKFD, with an absolute brilliant reply of "we" shouldn't book installers for the delivery days? Good job we didn't for 3 days waiting for confirmed/ none deliveries. (Who would compensate the installers)After another complaint requesting compensating for 3 days waiting for ( none deliveries) the best ever joke of a reply was" you shouldn't stay home waiting in case there's delays" too right there was 3 ## days.We where then sent £40 delivery credit ( not as UKFD) say was compensation.My job as a surveyor lost time of 3 days would be more than the cost of the flooring.2 months later one board has delaminated, I have sent photos, answered a questionnaire, 4 weeks later and numerous emails requesting a replacement 1m/2 to uplift and replace the 1 x plank, the usual zero response, and just ignore the customer My main issue is that UKFD delivered "faulty,substandard goods", but more concerning breaching the sale of goods actually by not stating that what we purchased in good faith was actually a discontinued product, if we had been made aware of this then we would not of purchased the product, we have emailed UKFD numerous times, with their "ignore them and they'll go away" attitude -- customer service does not exist,,,unless you're actually buying from them.Purchase at your peril.I have since noticed quite a few negative reviews with identical issues of faulty goods being delivered, then totally ignored once you complain.All I can say to those with 5 star reviews " you are the lucky ones"Read some of the 1 star ratings of this horrendous company

records.title: Not impressed so far
records.text: I love the look of this click flooring - I haven’t laid it yet BUT already found one chipped plank and that is just opening the first box! The delivery drivers didn’t give any notice of when they would arrive which I wasn’t impressed with, even though I had a tracking email it wasn’t working - so not great so far.  I wouldn’t have reviewed this early but I KEEP on getting these reminder emails - also annoying!

records.title: 1 month to deliver some Flooring..
records.text: Ordered my flooring on the 11th of November got delayed 3 times and arrived on the 10th of December. 2 Delays at least emailed me in advance whilst the last delay I only found out by sitting on a call for 30 mins on a day i specifically took off work only to find out it would be delivered 5 days later. Wanted to raise a complaint to which i was informed i would need to email the company which has been completely ignored. Only reason its getting a 2 star is because the delivery driver took the batch of flooring to my front door even though it was kerbside delivery (although i don't even know if that delivery driver even works for UKFD) Also they did at very least refund my delivery costs though i don't think that £40 covers the wasted time off and the fact ive had to reschedule with my floor fitter 3 times taking out any chance ill have it done by Christmas. wasn't impressed by the slow service and honestly would not recommend using them. PS. if anyone from UKFD is reading this please feel free to respond to my complaint that's been ignored.

records.title: Bit disappointed as I ordered £1500…
records.text: Bit disappointed as I ordered £1500 worth of flooring but had issues at checkout so missed the 10% off offer but no one got back to me when I got in touch.

records.title: Items delivered with one box damaged
records.text: Items delivered with one box damaged, email the customer service but had no reply, a week later still no reply

records.title: I cant get ahold of anyone.
records.text: I cant get ahold of anyone.I ordered a delivery for today, however, it hasn't shown up and i've had no emails or texts with any times slots.Also, I cant get ahold of anyone on the service number, i've been on hold for hours.Very disappointed as I heard so many good things..Edit: Just want to add that I stayed home all day to receive this, so its cost me a whole day!

records.title: Disappointing Customer Experience
records.text: I have six sq m of surplus flooring from a previous project. I have a new 12 sq m project. Original product no longer appears on website so I enquired whether a similar current product would be compatible, The response I received was not very helpful - “no record of previous products so unable to advise”. Was recommended to get a sample. I did this. Finish was similar but tongue and groove format has changed so incompatible. Would have been helpful to have had that advice re changed form factor in the first instance. Advice on similar finishes/products would have been appreciated. What was disappointing was that my previous experience with customer support had been very useful previously. Gave up at that point and placed an order for 12sq m elsewhere.

records.title: It’s not good service at all as we were…
records.text: It’s not good service at all as we were told  to expect a call 30 minutes before delivery, so we we’re tracking it which showed it’s on it’s way when the guy called and said he’s at the delivery address with no notice. He waited till we arrived and then just drove off , no support.

records.title: No communication
records.text: No communication, I specified a delivery date Friday 22/11/24. Check tracking no insight whatsoever just at delivery depot, loosing the will to live! Gets to 1.30pm driver calls me says it will be between 2 and 3pm. Arrives just after 2pm with a third of my order, I ring you to see what's going on and I am told you have split my delivery into 3 lots another driver will bring part 2 of my order later today.... Like I've got all day to hang around. Part 3 of my order will be delivered on the 27/11/24 ridiculous I am a joiner with multiple jobs on the go I don't live at this address it's an empty house. No communication to say you split the delivery.... I will now have to come off a job and hours drive away to sit and wait for you to deliver the goods I ordered and expected losing time and money.....

description:
Costelloes EV specialises in the installation of electric vehicle charging points, Solar PV and Battery storage for home, workplace, and commercial use. 
Our team of knowledgeable, local, and friendly NIC EIC electricians provide high-quality installations, and can provide advice on equipment and installation options to help you choose the best solution for you.

All installation appointments are made at a convenient time for you.

OZEV approved installer across a wide range of manufacturers and equipment to suit every location and budget including Hypervolt, Easee, MyEnergi Zappi, Wallbox, EO, Andersen, Rolec, Pod Point and more.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. All ran smoothly and on time.

records.title: Costellos are professional and excellent
records.text: From booking to insulation . Very professional. Helpful . Luke and his work colleague. Very polite and tidy workers . Would recommend Costellos Ev . To everyone can’t thank you enough

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service Very quick and Tony done an amazing job. Will recommend them to everyone.

records.title: Had a relationship with this firm since…
records.text: Had a relationship with this firm since 2021.  So far two EV chargers and a solar system and battery.  Nothing too much trouble, very responsive and above all else trustworthy.  Have taken care of our house and treated it with care and attention leaving it spotless afterwards.  Happy to recommend for all solar, battery and EV related needs.  I won't be going anywhere else.

records.title: Definitely recommend Costelloes
records.text: Communication was great, responses to inquiries were outstanding. Arrived to appointments timely and delivered very neat and tidy work. We love our new EV charger and it looks fantastic!

records.title: Was able to give me a really quick…
records.text: Was able to give me a really quick instal, great communication and really helpful

records.title: Excellent work as always!
records.text: Excellent work as always!We had five garden lights fitted and two timer switches.The lads worked round another company fitting our  garden fence, both teams worked around each other.Reliable, arrived on time, job done. Highly recommended for any electrical requirements.Thanks Dave, Vickie and all the team.

records.title: Great company
records.text: Great from quote to fitting quick and easy . Very helpful company . Installers are very friendly helpful and clean up after themselves will definitely be a returning customer Really pleased with the job

records.title: Very efficient ev charger installation.
records.text: I struggled to find a company who would transfer an existing ev charger to a new property. From initial telephone contact with Costelloes I found them to be helpful and quick to provide me with a quote for the work required. The installers did a quick and professional job which was completed in only three days from initial inquiry and to a very high standard.

records.title: Hypervolt 7.5 meter cable
records.text: Contacted via website for a quote for the work on Sunday, got an estimate on Monday. Cable ordered and fitted by Thursday - great service.

records.title: Issue but sorted out quickly
records.text: I’ve had a home home pro fitted pretty seamlessly except they installed a ohme e pod rather than a home pro this was quickly sorted as they came back the next day to fix the issue

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service, friendly competent workforce. Came in, got the job done efficiently,

records.title: Very good survey and installation
records.text: Very good survey and installation. Good support with any questions following installation. Would recommend.

records.title: Excellent installation.
records.text: Date of experience: 04 August 2022

records.title: EV Charger Installed
records.text: There was plenty of availability to have my EV charger installed within a few days. Once installed though, there were several teething issues which the Costelloes didn’t assist with/were unable to rectify. It was left to me to look elsewhere to have the problems rectified.

description: Mister Kitchen Worktop Fitter” can offer you a service that is second to none with over 30 years' experience. We are purely expert worktop fitters and will happily complete the renovation for your kitchen using specialist equipment that cuts the worktop efficiently and professionally.  Therefore if you have had your kitchen fitted either by yourself or an installer we will happily complete the worktop.

records.title: 100% recommend
records.text: 100% recommend.  Stewart arrived bright and early at 6am and continuously worked until the job was done 12+ hours later.  He overcame all the problems that unexpectedly arose, from our uneven walls to our questionable choice of sink! (Sorry again Stewart) He is dedicated to providing the best finish possible for his clients and his attention to detail is remarkable.We could not be happier with the end result.  We also purchased our worktops through Stewart and this couldn't have been any easier, he kept us fully updated with delivery schedule right up to the hour before it arrived. Perfect service, expert knowledge and an admirable work ethic.

records.title: L shaped work top fit
records.text: I contacted Stuart to do what I thought would have been a straightforward job. But all the obstacles he encountered once into the job and he passed all the tests. An old Victorian property with not perfect straight walls and 90 degrees corners which weren't true. But he overcame all these problems and did an outstanding job. A truly perfect fit. He works alone and if you're ok with giving him a hand  and are happy with a 6am start, he does the job. Non stop working and meticulous towards every details. Cannot recommend him enough. A true craftsman.

records.title: Great kitchen worktop fitter…
records.text: I regard myself as a competent DIYer but cutting worktops I decided to leave to the professionals. Thank goodness I did. I think if I had tried I'd still be trying 2 weeks down the line and probably on my second set of work tops.Stewart was on site bright and early to start as planned and continued through until he had finished a great job. Worked me hard as his labourer.  Finish high quality and standard. Did everything possible to ensure a great finish. The cutting looks easy once you have all the tools and jigs but it's the experience of planning and measuring for joints and cut outs and the advice he gives you pay for.Next kitchen I do I'll be calling on him again.

records.title: Fantastic installation of compact laminate worktop!
records.text: Stewart recently installed a compact laminate worktop for me and did a fantastic job! I put an initial enquiry on Stewarts web page and he contacted me within minutes to talk thoroughly about the job. I sent him the images of my kitchen design and he returned a quote which was very competitive considering I live in Cardiff and Stewart is in Kettering. 320 mile round trip! Stewarts website, attention to detail and the fact that he took the job on considering where I lived gave me a lot of confidence. He turned up bang on time on the day and got straight to work, producing an excellent finished product. Would definitely recommend Stewart to anyone who wants a quality job done, with super attention to detail.Top professional!

records.title: Compact Laminate Master!
records.text: We found Mr Worktop fitter (Stewart) when we needed our Compact Laminate worktops fitted. He was very helpful, and gave us really valuable advice. On the day he arrived, he set up and completed the job to the highest standard. Stewart is a conscientious craftsman, who cuts no corners (Unless right angles for the worktop!) Highly recommend this service, and worth every penny.

records.title: Couldn't of wished for a better job
records.text: While I was happy to try my hand at most of my kitchen refit, I thought best to leave the worktop to a professional.God I'm glad I did!Got back to me very quickly after initial enquiry and was able to quote me after shotrt what's app chat. Friendly, Informative and definitely knows what he's doing.Older kitchen so uneven walls and crap BnQ worktops I purchased, but the result was brilliant! Would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking to fit or replace a worktop.

records.title: Great job
records.text: Great job, Stewart was punctual and professional. He did a really good with our worktops very happy. Thank you Stewart. Robert Mead, Oxfordshire.

records.title: Best job ever encountered.
records.text: What a pleasure to find a tradesman who cares about their job. We had a complicated kitchen worktop fit to be accomplished. Stewart turned up on time on the appointed day, laid all his tools out with care, worked solidly until the job was completed and was meticulous about cleaning up afterwards.The finished job involved several large and difficult joins all of which were beautifully made. The best piece of work we have ever encountered. Thank you, Stewart.

records.title: Quality workmanship
records.text: Be warned, Stewart turns up early and goes through until all is finished.We recently purchased a Howdens kitchen and opted for the compact laminate worktop.A nice product that looks great.. here is another warning… not many kitchen fitters like this product, it’s a b@tch to cut and put grooves in for the sink drainage( we opted for no grooves in the end).Stewart turned up (as I said.. early, 6am) , got straight on with the job after explaining everything thoroughly.Very pleased with his attention to detail and recommendations along the way.

records.title: Stewart fitted our worktops in June 2019
records.text: Stewart fitted our worktops in June 2019 at very short notice. His work is excellent and the final price is exactly what he quotes. Very reliable and lots of communication. He will arrive exactly when he says - he arrives early in the morning on the appointed day and works until the job is done. Clears up properly too. Would have no hesitation in using him again.

records.title: Expensive
records.text: I contacted them to get a quote to fit two compact laminate worktops which I already had. After sending loads of information I was quoted £900 CASH. Very expensive!!!

description:
Hassle-free trade services.
Get it done the easy way with HandyExperts.
Call us on 0330 912 2323 for friendly advice and bookings.

records.title: Expert Service
records.text: Expert Service. Did have to cancel one appointment, but due to circumstances that were out of their control. Job well done, didn't go above quote price. Would highly recommend.

records.title: On time and efficient.
records.text: Date of experience: 01 November 2024

records.title: Really impressed by HandyExperts
records.text: Really impressed by HandyExperts.  Will definitely use again.  Our electrician was efficient and careful in his work.  He made sure that the work was exactly as I wanted.  Will definitely use again.

records.title: Friendly, Skilled and Diligent
records.text: I am a disabled person and required support with an unusual electrics tasks, Richard the Electrician that Handy Experts sent was brilliant, friendly, knowledgeable and persistent. He came back multiple times to get the task completed in exactly the way I needed it and it was far from straightforward. I really appreciated the persistence, skill and care he applied to the job. Handy Experts communicated clearly and quickly.

records.title: Fast service, tidy work, professional
records.text: Called on Thursday to get some radiators removed and puppies called, arranged for Tuesday first thing, plumber came at 0820, explained the job, plumber estimated time and got on with the job. He didn't stop, just kept gong. Bled the system, took the rads off, capped the pipes nicely, refilled system and checked.Plumber was great.Service was great.

records.title: Reliable service
records.text: Reliable service, very easy to book online. I have been using this company for few years now. I would happily recommend their services.

records.title: Unstable Toilet Seat
records.text: Unstable Toilet Seat. Contacted Wednesday afternoon, good email booking correspondence. Handyexpert then arrived next morning. Provided 45 minutes notice of arrival. Turned up and rectified the toilet seat in 30 minutes, back to good condition. Able to advise on loose tiling above toilet. Very good result, would use them again if needed.

records.title: Faultless Service
records.text: Very professional,  Justin was extremely knowledgeable and went out of his way to help. Thank you for your faultless service.Peter Byrne

records.title: Electric work
records.text: I always think it is a difficult situation when you need to get trades in to sort out problems but Handy Expert were very good when contacting myself to discuss the job to take place and everything was done correctly.I have now booked them to come back and sort out some other electrical work.Thanks

records.title: Prompt, friendly and efficient.
records.text: They replied to my request very promptly, were very friendly on the phone, clearly explained what the visit would involve and the costs and organised a visit for the next morning. The electrician arrived at the agreed time, was very polite and efficient, solved the problems, did an overall check and I felt assured that things were safe again.

records.title: Ervin was a great electrician
records.text: Ervin was a great electrician, friendly, helpful, and on time. Was a great experience and much better than previous electricians we have had both from handy experts and elsewhere

records.title: An excellent job
records.text: An excellent job.  My only reservation is that I was not informed that the plumber had been delayed on a previous job.  Whilst I fully understood this, it would have been helpful to  know that he was going to be late.  Nonetheless, overall, a really excellent serviced that Iwould use again.

records.title: Although work wasn't carried out on the…
records.text: Although work wasn't carried out on the day, Dom provided options for us. On the whole from placing the job on check a trade to receiving a call from HandyExperts and email confirmation, call from Dom to say he was on his way, and Dom explaining what needed to happen and options available, I can not fault.  Great customer service.

records.title: Professional, reliable and honest
records.text: Honest service quoting for works and not charging by the hour, but as an overall job allowance...mine was 2days work. Good follow-up and customer service.  Plus, the plumber sent, Dominic, was friendly, reliable, honest and dedicated to ensuring that my 95yr old neighbour had heating and hot water.  Thank you.

records.title: We used PGS while British Gas were on strike
records.text: We used PGS while the British Gas were on strike during February. Turned up fast and got the boiler working temporarily. We needed a replacement part, had to pay  half of the bill before the part was ordered. We were lucky and could afford the payment, not sure how anyone who couldn’t afford it would cope. Luckily the gas board refunded us back the money, but was a bit scary. Boiler is now working really well, so they knew what they were doing!

records.title: Fitting of overhead lights on
records.text: The electrician arrived promptly following a phone call with the correct replacement ceiling lights, which he managed to fit without turning off the mains supply. He was courteous, friendly and quick at his work.

records.title: The electrician Ollie was perfect
records.text: The electrician Ollie was perfect. He was helpful and did the work to such an outstanding standard. I wasn’t happy with some info that I was given by customer service and then another charge on top but with the work Ollie did cut out that altogether. I would use them again just knowing myself that the work to be to high standard. Thanks for all the help Ollie

records.title: My go to firm for property works
records.text: My go to firm for property works, have used for gas and electrical works. Prompt and efficient. No crazy cancellation fees when they could get in because of a mix up with keys.They brought forward a job that became urgent. Office staff just brilliant.

records.title: Electrical work by HandyExperts
records.text: Electrical work carried out by HandyExperts is of good quality and electrician was punctual, so no complaints on those aspects, but labour charge is a little pricey and also got charged £30 (before VAT) for a switch which I could see advertised online for £20.54 (including VAT).

records.title: First rate service
records.text: First rate service. Called pm and had an electrician following am.Understood my problems discussed solutions, Agreed and remedy was completed very quickly, within the hour. Very pleasant encounter

records.title: Always there when you need them
records.text: My daughter is an absentee landlord of an apartment in Bromley. Occasionally work is required such as servicing the boiler etc and it's good to have a company that can deal with any aspect of the maintenance.

records.title: I was very happy to have your plumber…
records.text: I was very happy to have your plumber come at such short notice. Sam was very courteous, very obliging and worked very hard. The new kitchen tap’s parts were not corresponding to the pipes to which he had to join them.  I do not know if that could have been avoided by comparing the two makes in advance. I suspect not, but if so, extra time for him and expense for me could have been lessened.  I liked Sam very much and I appreciated his work and his attitude. I have not asked him how to use the shower had inside the tap, which I am able to pull out but it does not spring back, so I wonder if he could let me know.There is absolutely NO hurry. Kind regardsRia Holt

records.title: Handyman was great
records.text: Handyman was great. The company should sort out why both iPhone and btinternet completely blocked their emails, except one which I found in spam

records.title: The engineer James was excellent phoned…

records.title: A good job
records.text: The engineer who came to assess whether I needed a new boiler was positive and helpful in getting my existing boiler working again. If it lasts, I would willingly upgrade my mark to five stars!

records.title: Prompt and efficient service
records.text: They got in touch very promptly, and everyone I spoke to at the office was very polite and efficient, as was the electrician who did the work. I needed the new socket installed before a decorator was arriving, so had a tight timescale - they were able to get the electrician to me the following day, allowing my other work to continue on schedule.

records.title: All the trades people have been very…
records.text: All the trades people have been very polite and very knowledgeable in their work. Know exactly what needs doing and how long it will take. Only one person didn't turn up or call.  Good going.

records.title: Excellent service and professional…
records.text: Excellent service and professional friendly staff.  Quick on emergency service, however this is reflected in the price they charge which is why only 4 stars.

records.title: Very good but no fixed quote,
records.text: Very good back office processes and quick to find a suitable electrician. But one does have to pay for that level of service. The work was carried out very well.

records.title: Boiler Service
records.text: The work was good and the engineer communicated effectively throughout.  There was some confusion at the office end regarding lines of communication, but this was resolved after a couple of conversations.  All were clearly willing to help.

records.title: The Company offers a wide range of…
records.text: The Company offers a wide range of house maintenance services. The estimator was prompt and polite, and their customer services staff were efficient. Their main issue is their pricing, as they are in competition with much smaller companies and sole traders. Prices were three times higher than other quotes for replacement fencing.

records.title: Really good engineer new his stuff
records.text: Really good engineer new his stuff, unfortunately turned out to be a very easy fix, he was only in my property for 10 mins yet we were charged full price.

records.title: great service but not cheap
records.text: Rang them as the socket that supplied power to the cooker had broken and required a new socket. Plus points - really friendly person answered immediately and had someone round to me (not in any pgs uniform or anything, just a contracted guy who admittedly knew his stuff) in less than 2 hours and he took about 20 minutes to replace and test the socket. Negative point  - £156 for a replacement socket was a LOT! I rang my usual bloke who had been unavailable due to an injury and he said he would have felt bad taking half that sum. I suppose you pay for the service and speed but its a lot of dosh for a quick job and a replaced socket. Happy with the service but did burn a hole in my wallet, even though I was told of the price beforehand. Problem was there was no-one who could have come round sooner.

records.title: Phoned on Wednesday 5 October for an…
records.text: Phoned on Wednesday 5 October for an emergency appointment.Sent me a booking confirmation for that day between 10am-2pm. At. 1. 50pm I was contacted to say they could now no longer do that day.OK could you do tomorrow? Answer no. Friday? No.Obviously this was down as a emergency call out @ £99 an hour plus VAT.I did not know what else to do but wait until the next order confirmation on the following Monday.The plumber turned up and was a nice enough bloke. Did the job in 30 minutes at a cost of £132.Hardly an emergency service, but most definitely an emergency cost.Certainly won't be using them again.

records.title: Will use this firm again

records.title: Pricey

records.title: Thanks

records.title: I think the mark up price on articles…

records.title: Indifferent

records.title: It took 3 visits to solve a problem…
records.text: It took 3 visits to solve a problem involving washers on a tap

records.title: PGS was helpful and understanding when…
records.text: PGS was helpful and understanding when illness meant I had to cancel the first appointment. The operative who attended for the re-arranged appointment was helpful. But it was a very expensive for what ended up as just advice, so I've docked a star for that. (I did know the charge in advance, but hadn't time to shop around). But having paid the invoice in full the morning after the appointment, I wasn't pleased to receive a red writing demand for non-payment 2 days later. I emailed to point out that I'd actually paid immediately. No apology, so there goes another 2 stars.

records.title: 4 star customer service let down by overcharging for parts
records.text: I was impressed by the efficient and friendly customer service and use of online record keeping and payment but annoyed by the clear overcharging for parts. I was told people sometimes sourced them themselves but not the level of mark up PGS levy. I would use again but definitely try to buy the parts myself next time.

records.title: Good engineer, painful price
records.text: Ok, so when your washing machine starts leaking you want to sort it asap. PGS are a safe bet. Almost certainly not the cheapest and not even the quickest (the best they could offer me was 7 days from time of call) but they are thorough and know their stuff. The guy they sent to have a look was an ex-Bosch staff member and knew the machine inside and out. His advice was sensible, he could have fixed it (but not on the spot) but his honest advice was to buy a new machine. Which I have done

records.title: Good quality service but could be improved in places
records.text: I booked for some simple repairs to my bathroom. The procedure was quick and easy and I was informed via SMS of the arrangements and phone personally when to expect the engineer.On the day the engineer arrived promptly and was well-presented. The standard of works seems to be good as no issues after 4 days.I  would say that despite all their attention to detail for a simple service they are quite expensive as I ended up paying over £300 for replacement of 2 tiles and some re-sealing of a shower door.

records.title: Not expert with shower units
records.text: I recently had PGS attend a suddenly noisy shower unit which sounded like it was about to break-down. PGS responded quickly and an engineer came the same day. Upon arrival he admitted to not being an expert with showers. After some while examining the unit he admitted to not knowing why it was so noisy but suggested it would likely fail completely. I suggested he speak to the manufacturers which he did. But after further testing he was still unable to resolve the problem. This is the first time PGS have not been able to solve the problem and at a cost of just short of £140 this was an expensive call without result.

records.title: Good service eventually but poor communication in initial stage
records.text: Was initially promised a same-day appointment by PGS, having been let down by another service. However, poor communication between the engineer and office/the office and customer (me) meant I waited in all afternoon for an appointment and after much chasing was finally told it wasn't possible because the engineer was massively delayed. Would have been much better to be told this early on and to have experienced more proactive customer communication from PGS. However, although not as proactive as I'd have liked, staff arranged a first-thing appointment next day.  The engineer arrived on time, completed the work promptly and followed up with a further quote as promised.

records.title: good
records.text: The whole tean was helpful and gave a good support

records.title: Full price for an issue not resolved
records.text: I can't say I am happy about paying £375 for an issue that wasn't resolved. Apart from that, a lamp got chipped (only after I asked about it, it was brought up -- but i did get £35 off, hardly the value of the john lewis lamp to replace), I have finger marks on the white ceiling and I had to clean after. Worst of all is that the issue was not resolved, I was left in pretty much the same state but around £400 less on my account and marks on the wall and lamps.

records.title: Handy Experts failed to turn up for a repair booked weeks ago.
records.text: Handy Experts were meant to change a stopcock today 18th July 2023, including two new bathroom taps. They had been to our property before so Dan knew the tools and equipment required. The initial visit was over 2 weeks ago so failing to turn up today 18th July between 8am and 13pm without the correct equipment is not a good enough excuse. Our tenant also had to take a day off work to accommodate this work, Needless to say, she was not happy either having lost a day's salary. Let's see what the customer service team has to say?

records.title: No-show twice, unfinished job

Failed to show up twice despite my tenants waiting in for them and having to rearrange work commitments. Finally suggested another date six weeks after orginal work. Made me pay in full in advance and not completed the work as promised. Still waiting.

records.title: Slow to respond and to solve the issue
records.text: Came in on a Monday to fix a leak in the toilet, took them 2 days to send the quote for the fix. Once we paid 50% deposit to fix they changed the date of the repair and now we cannot use the toilet for a whole week just to fix a minor leak.

records.title: Inability to fix the problem
records.text: The original problem was that the relay between the boiler and water heater was not workingSo although the boiler worked and heated the radiators it did not heat the water because there was no "call to action via the boiler"The only way we could get hot water was using the electric immersion heaterAs part of this process they broke our entire system and took months (April to July)  to put back together. I've just discovered the radiators in our room don't appear to be bound to the same room control. It seems that the same problem is happening as the boiler is working but not heating the water tank. I am posting this on the trust a trader review site and will update when they fix the problemThe traders were friendly but missed a few appointments and did not seem to speak to each other (and criticised the work of previous traders). Overall feels like could be a good source of assistance but this time have failed to solve the problem and kept invoicing for which we had little choice to pay

records.title: Individual task pricing, despite charging hourly
records.text: Didn't actually review the job spec - a different system/issue was addressed.Charged for an hour, when I requested an additional item was looked at during a waiting period the job pricing doubled.  Not a great model, a proper plumber would have been more effective, wouldn't use again or recommend.

records.title: Plumber left cold water ball fix in…
records.text: Plumber left cold water ball fix in closed position on 6/6/ when I phoned was told plumber was on annual leave and he couldn’t attend until 13//6 I removed tile to access valve and restored valve to on position, shower now working

records.title: I have been advised that my job would…
records.text: I have been advised that my job would cost £99 plus VAT I was reassured that the materials would cost no more than £20 but then the materials cost £55 and I was left with a final quote which was much higher than what I had been promised by their booking system and so I wasn't very happy as I had gone with their quote because they have come out the best I would like to say that the electrician was very good and nice but they're quoting system was a bit unfair and not very transparent

records.title: Very helpful call center think engineer may have tried it on.
records.text: Got a guy to come out and look at boiler as there was water dripping outside and we were losing pressure slowly from our boiler.Got charged for 1 hour (£100) just to hear his diagnosis, without him actually doing anything. He said that the pressure relief valve (£18 + VAT) and expansion vessel (£201+ VAT) needed replacing. (I found this part myself for £124 on the internet)I had raised the issue of the pressure relief valve with the call center, but yet he did not bring one out and replace it... why not? A quick and easy job he could have easily done within the hour I paid him. Instead he stayed 10 mins.I've got another engineer coming in who has been working on these boilers for 23 years and has never had to change an expansion vessel- he will be changing the pressure relief valve and pumping up the expansion vessel (my research on the internet show this is probably right)...Anyway, so in the end I will be paying £100 as opposed to the £450-£550 quoted to me by PGS.Just peed off that I already paid £100 for a PGS engineer to pop out for 10 minutes.If indeed there turns out to be any problem with this expansion vessel I will of course change this review, but looks highly unlikely.

description:
If you’re giving your space a makeover, you’re sure to find the very latest on trend tile designs for your project here at Tons of Tiles. Our products are imported directly from leading factories in Spain, Italy and Portugal, keeping our prices competitive too. Here at Tons of Tiles we have hundreds of up-to-date designs and finishes to choose from to give your room that on-trend look.

We have a great choice of Metro Tiles in various sizes and finishes, Crackle Glaze Tiles, Porcelain Tiles, Glass Mosaics, Slate Effect, Wood Effect as well as Vintage and Patterned Tiles. We pride ourselves with giving good quality customer service with a fast-free next working day delivery service on most orders over £150 when ordered before 4pm.

With our fast and efficient sample service, you can try out different styles before you buy, with full-size samples available from only 20p each, with free postage. It's the perfect way to ensure you’re happy with your choice before ordering.

Once you’ve decided on your tiles, placing an order is simple. You can buy through the website or alternatively call our helpful and knowledgeable customer service team on 
02477 500004 where we will guide you through your order and assist you with any grout, adhesives or tools you may need for the job.

We look forward to being part of your project!

records.title: Delivery issues 📦
records.text: I selected a delivery date on the website and, after doing so and paying £75 for delivery I was called and told that the originals delivery date i selected was not going to be possible. Two of the tiles were also delivered broken - I suspect this was due to lack of care by courier. This led to me needing to order more tiles (I was now 1 short despite leaving 15% margin for cuts etc). I therefore needed to order 1 more box of tiles (£25) and pay again (£75) delivery.

records.title: tiles as described
records.text: Tiles came just as picture showed! Although one box was crushed luckily no breakages my only niggle is that there is no confirmation as to when you will receive your order and the price for delivery is a little annoying brilliant for people ordering 100's of tiles but when the price for delivery is a third of the total order its a little eye watering! If I could of gone else where this would have swayed me!

records.title: The tiles are great and good price but some were chipped
records.text: I'm really pleased with my tiles, they look great but I received 3 out of the 13 tiles chipped! Good job I ordered extra so I had enough. They were well packed but the box was pretty damaged and had been squashed, the delivery driver had left the box in a bush on my drive way as it was not in!  Not very pleased about that! But again I'm very happy with the tiles just not the delivery.

records.title: Tiles good, sample not so...
records.text: The tile sample was so small it was pointless. Will still need to pop into the shop to see if we'll order the design we're looking at. Most samples we've ordered in the past (from other suppliers) are the full tile, so you can see how it will look in the room. A segment of the tile doesn't really show what to expect. Quality very good for price though, as was the speed of delivery.

records.title: There was one sample missing that I…
records.text: There was one sample missing that I ordered and I am still waiting for the replacement. One of the samples was broken.

records.title: Delivery was quick and tiles were well…
records.text: Delivery was quick and tiles were well packed. However the colour was not the same as advertised and when I enquired about a free return for miss sold goods ( as advertised on their site) I was told no and that I should have ordered a sample!

records.title: Tiles are beautiful, delivery is not
records.text: Tiles are beautiful, excellent quality and value for money ,your delivery service however is rubbish, despite easy to follow delivery instructions eg leaving with 2 named address neighbours the delivery didn't happen on the agreed day ,my tiles weren't even loaded for next day delivery! After I made contact the delivery was agreed for following day delivery (2 days late) the driver was rude to my neighbour, for £30 delivery, I really expect a delivery on the agreed day tbh ,and don't expect rudeness when the delivery is eventually made.

records.title: Poor delivery
records.text: Poor deliveryProducts seem good quality, but delivery didn't arrive on stated date - I only found out because I was in contact - meant I had to arrange for another tiler, and when re-delivered I had to chase to ensure its delivery - it came last thing in the day, having been promised morning delivery - very nearly had to cancel on another tiler

records.title: Broken tiles and tiles not actually available
records.text: One order had to be cancelled because the tiles weren't available, contrary to website info. Both orders arrived with significant number of broken tiles that weren't immediately apparent. I would have had to unpack every tile to find them, which I didn't have time to do within 48 hours of receipt.  That said, customer service were polite and helpful.

records.title: If the delivery could have been…
records.text: If the delivery could have been faster.. would have been better and Def would have purchased your tiles then.Unfortunately we already had the team on site as the product could not be ordered..

records.title: I ordered a sample tile to be delivered…
records.text: I ordered a sample tile to be delivered to a different address to my billing address.They sent the sample to my billing address. Fine, emailed and reassured they would send out another tile to the correct address. Sent to the wrong address again. Third time? Tile never turned up at either address. Funnily enough I won't be ordering from them.

records.title: Maybe I’m the one who is colour-blind?
records.text: First batch came, completely the wrong colour and three boxes smashed, second batch came and again, a different colour to what they were showing online. I would have given one star had it not been for the good customer service. Be warned... the photos you see online do not match the product!

records.title: The delivery arrived three days late
records.text: The delivery arrived three days late. I was not contacted to advise of this until I contacted tons of tiles myself. I was then given an hours notice of my delivery. (And only then because I had complained)It meant that the tiler I had booked had to be cancelled.

records.title: Great customer service but really poor…
records.text: Great customer service but really poor quality tiles. We had three sets sent out to us and ALL had at least half with flaws, e.g. chipped corners, uneven glaze, dark dots, broken, etc. They very kindly kept sending different batches out, but they were all the same. In the end we got our money back and disposed of the tiles. A total waste of time. We went to Topps Tiles in the end instead, spending slightly more, but the quality was much better.

records.title: The job was successfully done and I was…
records.text: The job was successfully done and I was satisfied.Will happily recommend them.THE REASON AM WRITING THIS REVIEW.The FOB or Remote Key for my Sprinter Van was completely broken. Faster and Cheaper than trekking to main dealership. So impressed that I will pass on this company’s name to everyone I know.

records.title: alin Is great

records.title: Locked keys in the car
records.text: Locked my car keys in the boot of my car and wasted time calling AA who could not get in without damaging the car. I then called UK AUTO Locksmith who came the very next day and got into my car without any damage. Very happy with the service.

records.title: Professional prompt service
records.text: Polite, professional and a very prompt service. My only complaint was that the price quoted didn’t include VAT which was an extra £31 on the £155 quoted. That said, a new programmed key was the answer to the car not starting.

records.title: My key broke in my ignition just as I…
records.text: My key broke in my ignition just as I started up my car after finishing work. I called the company who made me feel at ease. The technician came in the timeframe gave. He called me to say he would be 20 mins away which was reassuring. When he came he said it would be done in 15 mins. Nice person who also made me feel at ease. New key was issued and programmed. Very happy with the service.The only criticism was when I called the company and I asked the pricing I did not realise that the quote was without vat added, so I was slightly shocked when the guy finished the job he gave me the real price. So just beware of that info. Otherwise happy with the service.

records.title: Emergency reaponse
records.text: I had an emergency with my car and reached out to UK Locksmith, they responded promptly but would not negotiate price. Good service delivery and would recommend to anyone needing their service.

records.title: Key half working
records.text: They came quickly but the key made for my car is only half working . Which when you paid £160 is a lot of money

records.title: £300 for 2 new keys (batteries included even if they DO run out the next day)
records.text: Everything about this company was 'A OK' - their communication and timely visit to me, the speed with which my keys were cut and the politeness of the engineer UNTIL at the very end, I noticed my keys were sluggish to respond. When I remarked on this to the engineer, he told me it was because it was 'the first time' the key had been used. I paid £300 for the two keys. The next day, a message shot up in my car 'REPLACE KEY BATTERY'. I was very cross. When I pay a significant sum of money for 2 new keys, I reasonably expect NOT to have to start replacing batteries on day 1! When I challenged the engineer, the response was 'there is no warranty for the batteries' certainly making clear his position. To me it's like buying a new mobile phone only to have to spend yet more money replacing its battery the next day. It is not good enough and it has left a really bitter taste -especially as the company had so many positive aspects to the way it conducted itself. To me, this is a gaping chasm in their Customer Service provision - all they needed to say was 'We're terribly sorry, we'll send you 2 new batteries' and I would have felt my issue was dealt with properly. Hence me writing this review which, I hope they read and digest! I shall not be using you again.

records.title: I enquired about a replacement Audi key…
records.text: Similar cost to Audi...I enquired about a replacement Audi key with Audi whilst my car was being serviced. I was quoted £290. I then enquired with UK Auto Locksmith and they quoted me £285 - only £5 savings sadly.I will go with Audi at my next service as it will be more convenient for me (my car will be with them anyway) and I feel my consumer rights will be better protected should something go wrong. The upside of UK Auto Locksmith is that they come to you to do it. Depending on what's important to you (convenience/trust/cost), choose what works best for you.

records.title: polite Teo save the face of the company
records.text: I had lost my transponder chip and the guy over the phone agreed a reasonable price for fixing the key but at the end they were keep asking for the full price of new key . It was a bit argumentative but later they agreed to the price they already agreed over the phone.  I was happy with the service of Teo , technician although the remote was not working due to technical issues which Teo tried his best to solve but despite that it was still OK for me because it happens . The strength of this company is worker like Teo who represents a polite and dedicated service but the communication of the office needs to be improved and they should focus on customer satisfaction should not be rigid in thier approach. Over all experience was ok and special thanks to Teo and the guy over the phone being understandable about the price znd work had been done . Will recommend to friends in future ,

records.title: I found this company online and I have…
records.text: I found this company online and I have to say the service was very efficient from the technician Adrian however after getting my new key I noticed that there were about 10 different faults in my vehicle starting from the windows not going up and down , the turbo not working,  the start stop function not working and many more. Upon calling the company I was told by the manager that we only issue new keys and have nothing to do with the faults. The thing is any average customer would then take this car to the mechanic and pay additional funds however I knew that this problem arisen from the programming of the ECU of the new key so I corrected him. The service of the manager would be something to be improved as I have a child and only one vehicle and trying to tell me that the problem isn't anything to.do.with them is simply not correct.Upon 2nd visit from Adrian the technician the faults were rectified within 15 minutes and I was very satisfied with his service.Treat customers with respect as without good loyal customers your company will not grow

records.title: BEWARE: 20% VAT ADDED ON WITHOUT WARNING
records.text: PLEASE READ - WARNING: 20% VAT IS ADDED ON WITHOUT WARNING.This seems to be an informal company where business is conducted from the back of their vans - they have mini-workshops built in where the keys are cut, modified, programmed etc. They arrived 30 minutes later than they said they would on the phone. To be fair, they did complete what was asked of them in under 30 minutes - the key functions as it should.  However, the person on the phone promised the duplicate key would look identical to the original. The person could not deliver this on the day and said it would cost more money. BUT I strongly do not appreciate the addition of 20% VAT right before payment, without any warning - the price that is quoted on the phone should have included this charge. This company does not offer invoices or formal receipts either; all we have to show for our payment is the small receipt from the card machine that was used. They seem to be a small number of guys that operate informally via WhatsApp.If you need something done urgently, go through the aftermarket (maybe not with this company). Otherwise, use your local car dealership for transparency and possibly cheaper prices, even if it takes longer.

records.title: Fantastic service turned very sour and a pain!
records.text: Edit: after 1.5 months (23/04/24) - this company are awful to deal with and I would never have gone to them knowing how difficult and bad they are. The key they cut and the coding broke an electronic part of my car as they didn't correctly code the key to the car. This has meant an error showing up on the dashboard nulling the mileage and putting my car in jeopardy for its MOT. I spent weeks trying to get the company to rectify this and they were extremely difficult, rude/didn't listen, non committal and messed me around the whole process. I had told them so many times that a specialist diagnostics tool at a garage said it was the key and they were trying to blame me and the car, and charge me for call out (which they told me two prices for)! I took it to a garage in the end and had it sorted there by their professional locksmith. The only thing I'd say they were good at in this whole process was their WhatsApp made them easy to contact. _____________________________________Sandeep came out today to cut me a spare key for my Skoda. He called when he was on his way, giving an estimate of how long he'd be. Once here he communicated well and got started straight away; very professional and polite. He ran into a few issues with signal in my area causing problems connecting to a central database but he communicated this with me keeping me updated. Whenever I asked questions he answered obligingly and very clearly. Key seems to be working well in all respects and for cheaper than going to Skoda themselves. Would definitely recommend this company (and particularly Sandeep) to others. Have been to Timpsons in the past and had nothing but issues and stood in a car park (in -5°c) and they didn't even succeed in getting me a key. Can't fault Sandeep's service today.

records.title: Poor phone etiquette
records.text: Very disappointed with the service received over the phone. I called about an older vehicle and the first agent was very helpful and speaking to an ignition specialist. When I called back after getting the details he requested a colleague answered and just completely dismissed me and kept saying “can’t do it” then hung up on me.

records.title: Waited longer than I was supposed to…
records.text: Waited longer than I was supposed to for the driver to come. With no form of communication Inbetween. Lack of professionalism. The only good thing i could say is that when he eventually did come the driver was friendly and the job was done quick.

records.title: Wouldn't use again
records.text: Pre-service - Not good at all. When we called the number the operator couldn't really understand us well and said he had the address and details down. Then he rang my wife later and was very rude to her down the phone saying she had given the wrong details - only for us to realise later that he had taken the wrong last two letters of our postcode.During service - Decent. The guy and van came to us and fixed the issue and explained what he was doing.Definitely will not use again due to how rude they were to us.

records.title: mislaid car key - replacement
records.text: I had mislaid my car key. I contacted this company who said could do a replacement key. They was very polite and came out the same day. A new key was made. I then found my old key following day. I tried to use this but did not work. I spoke to there Locksmith following day and I received a text 'did I not tell technician to not erase old programme' I would of had no idea that I should have. After speaking to Auto today all they could offer was another key at cost of £160!!  Had I been advised this prior to get new key and knowing old one would not work after, I would not of had it done in the first place as I am still only left with having 1 key. No compensation was offered to me but apologised that I was not informed correctly!! Which does not help me at all

records.title: I contacted this company after coming across them on social media
records.text: I contacted this company after coming across them on social media. I needed a key made for a classic bmw, I provided them with the key code, they said they would post out the key the very next day. Couple of weeks had passed and i still had not received the key. I contacted them a number of times before I got a reply. I urged them to sent out another key this time with recorded signed for delivery, they were happy to do this. I was then told the code I provided was not working in their machine and they would offer a refund. If this was the case how did the code I provided which was from the main dealer BMW work the first time around? A month wasted chasing this company for a key. I would not recommend this company, poor customer service, lack of communication. I managed to get the key made from another auto lock smith providing the same key code with in minutes.

Shop around before going here.

records.title: Finished my kitchen to perfection.

records.title: Wow had my table delivered today LOVE…

Craig was there when I had questions an even advised me on a few things ie measurements as I was thinking of a smaller table. Anybody out there have no fear ordering from Trentside Furniture it is stunning furniture now thinking about ordering a sideboard. Thanks Craig.

records.title: Could not be happier!

records.title: The table and bench was fantastic

records.title: Fantastic quality and craftsmanship

records.title: Love our table - and great customer service!

records.text: Really love the table, it's so sturdy and love the little knots and marks which make it unique. Was really difficult to get the floating middle piece in, which did cause some damage to the table as it was so tight, so caused some scratches and bits of the wood being scraped off when putting it through. However, once together, the table is beautiful and we love it!

records.title: all good so far
records.text: all good so far. Great response to questions asked and very accommodating.  placed order and will await delivery.  so far from pass orders furniture is excellent and build to last

records.title: Stunning piece of furniture
records.text: Absolutely love it. Lovely piece of wood and well made. Only not given 5 stars as it is not as grey as the picture suggested. More a wood colour with a slight grey tint to it. records.title: A very expensive mistake
records.text: I had a new bathroom installed last year and we had water coming through which left a large stain on the kitchen ceiling. I called this company ( website: Glasgow Plumbing Services) around 10am on a Tuesday (not evening, night time or weekend) and was asked to pay £147 up front for a plumber to visit, despite their website stating 'no call out charge'. I was assured the price was to guarantee a plumber that same day and for them to undertake diagnostic work and perform any fix that could be done within the hour I had paid for. He arrived at 5pm and only had a mobile phone with cracked screen for a camera and torch to explore under the shower tray. He was here for an hour but couldn't identify the leak. The next day I recieved an expensive quote of several hundred pounds for work needed to identify the leak (trace and access). I called another plumber via a Nextdoor app recommendation the next day who arrived within 3 hours and brought an endoscope (worth £70) and a high powered torch, which allowed him to identify the leak and fix it with re-sealing, the total cost was £120. Sad to say contacting this company originally feels like a very expensive mistake. I have likely saved myself hundreds of pounds and a lot of hassle by contacting a different plumber to take on the job. I do hope this company act on this feedback by reviewing their overly expensive pricing, their upfront payment policy and the poor equipment they send their plumbers out with, all of which felt unsatisfactory. It's important to highlight that the plumber they sent was professional, friendly and tried his best with the 'diagnostic' equipment he had. The office staff were also very friendly and professional when dealing with my calls. That's why this review is 2 stars and not 1.
